jobs.description:
Description

CapsLock is a company that specializes in providing digital marketing services to businesses that are facing sales growth challenges. Our comprehensive services include sales consulting, data analytics, and recruitment support, all seamlessly integrated to ensure efficient and accelerated growth.

Our company was founded by industry professionals with expertise in IT, design, and data analytics. We identified a significant need for an exclusive, scalable customer acquisition solution in the market. Our vision is to provide a unique integrated solution for B2C clients that enables profitable customer acquisition, flexible scaling, and optimized internal processes.

At CapsLock, our core values center around our people, client orientation, quality, continuous improvement, integrity, and fostering strong relationships. Our diverse and skilled team speaks 10+ languages and is located worldwide. We are dedicated to pioneering new and efficient marketing strategies to ensure our clients’ success.

﻿Role Description

As a Finance Director at CapsLock, you will be responsible for overseeing all financial aspects of the fast-growing marketing business, ensuring accuracy in financial reporting, and providing strategic guidance to support our business goals. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills and extensive financial expertise.

This role will report to the Chief Finance Officer of the Company.

Requirements

Responsibilities

  • Team leadership: Lead and mentor bookkeeping, FP&A, and taxation/compliance teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.
  • Accounting: Oversee accounting. Lead implementation and improvement of financial and accounting policies/practices.
  • Budgeting: Oversees budgeting process. Supervise plan/fact analysis and provide explanations and recommendations.
  • Reporting: Ensure timely and accurate financial, and investment reporting for the Group of Companies
  • Internal Controls and Audits. Assist with developing and maintaining robust internal controls. Lead internal audits to ensure compliance with established financial procedures.
  • Tax and Compliance: Oversee tax filings, regulatory reports, and compliance with statutory obligations. Tax planning and optimization for the group
  • M&A transactions: Navigate the complexities of mergers and acquisitions including initial financial assessments, Due Diligence, and post-merger integration.
  • Process Improvement: Continuously improve financial processes, systems, and financial reporting to enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and strategic relevance
  • Stakeholder Communication: Provide insights and recommendations on financial performance and key financial metrics to the executive team
  • Third-party Communication: Manage relationships with banks, tax advisories, and external consultants

Desired Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA, CPA, ACCA preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in finance, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
  • Experience with financial reporting, month-end / year-end processes, and IFRS/GAAP compliance.
  • Proven track record in financial planning, analysis, and management within a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with executive management and external stakeholders.
  • Proactive nature, growth mindset, self-regulation.
  • Fluent English.
  • Ability and desire to work collaboratively with a diverse, remote global team.

Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer above-market compensation, but we also offer perks and benefits that promote people’s well–being. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.

Ongoing Learning

People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.

Home Office

We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.

Physical Well–Being

Fitness is more than a gym membership. We all have different tastes and preferences. That’s why we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program that fits all.

Unlimited Sick Days

We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.

Fun Stuff

There is never a shortage of fun stuff when you work with amazing people. But we like to spice things up and take them to the next level, you will soon learn how.

jobs.excerpt: Our Mission:6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.
jobs.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

Senior Manager, GTM Engineering

Marketing Operations | Reports to: Sr. Director, Marketing Operations | Direct reports: 1 (BDR Operations Specialist)

About the Role

6sense's Marketing Operations team builds the technical backbone behind our go-to-market motion: systems integration, campaign orchestration, and AI-assisted workflows across the marketing and BDR stack.

This role will create the AI architecture, agents, and workflows that power our agentic GTM motion.

Why this role, why now

6sense is building the intelligence engine for agentic go-to-market, and this role is central to how our own Marketing team puts that strategy into practice. What you build will run our pipeline motion and get regular visibility from leaders across the company. It's a rare chance to build agentic GTM inside the company defining it.

The Sr. Manager, GTM Engineering builds the automations, integrations, and AI agents that let Marketing scale output efficiently while increasing productivity and impact. That spans core GTM engineering (lead capture, routing, and BDR handoff), BDR prospecting automation, agentic support for content and campaign creation, and ABM personalization across Marketing.

This is a hands-on technical role with management responsibilities. You'll independently weigh tradeoffs across speed, scale, data quality, privacy, AI governance, adoption, and pipeline impact, and serve as the go-to technical voice on what's scalable and sound, turning strategy into working systems that marketers and BDRs actually use. You'll own GTM engineering priorities and delivery across Marketing and BDR teams, partnering with Marketing Operations, Revenue/Growth Marketing, Customer and Event Marketing, BDR Leadership, RevOps, and IT.

Key Responsibilities

AI Agent & Workflow Architecture

  • Build agentic workflows for end-to-end campaign creation, from brief intake to first-draft assets, using Claude and comparable enterprise LLM platforms. Orchestrate agents across MCP connectors to optimize AI usage across the stack. Partner with Growth, Customer, and Event Marketing to cut manual production time on recurring campaign types, with human review in the loop.
  • Automate Marketing work management. For example, create workflows that allow marketers to build campaign assets leveraging centralized context governing product positioning, use cases, personas, and marketing channel best practices.
  • Build reusable patterns, templates, and playbooks so Marketing teams can adopt automations without GTM Engineering support.

GTM Systems Architecture & Integration

  • Be our own best customer: Build the best-in-class use of the 6sense platform within a headless GTM architecture, using 6sense data and intelligence through external tools, APIs, and MCP.
  • Build BDR prospecting automation, including signal-based account prioritization, research assembly, outreach drafting, and task automation, to increase high-quality pipeline per BDR.
  • Own the BDR technology stack, including the sales engagement platform and dialer, with BDR leadership and your BDR Operations Specialist.
  • Partner with BDR leaders to find productivity bottlenecks, then prioritize, ship, and measure fixes.

Governance, Experimentation & Iteration

  • Embed security, privacy, and compliance into workflows and agents by design, including data handling, agent permissions, and access controls, in partnership with Business Technology and Security.
  • Flag design or scale risk in workflows and agents before they ship.
  • Run technical experiments on automation and agent logic, and iterate on performance data and pipeline impact with BDR and Marketing leadership.

Team Leadership & Influence

  • Manage, coach, and prioritize work for one direct report (BDR Operations Specialist), developing their ownership of BDR tooling and process.
  • Run intake and prioritization of automation requests across competing stakeholders, and influence senior Marketing and Revenue leaders without relying on authority.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years in marketing operations, GTM/revenue systems engineering, or marketing automation, with ownership of complex GTM systems, cross-functional roadmap delivery, and executive stakeholder management.
  • Hands-on experience building automations and integrations across a marketing/RevOps stack, such as Salesforce, Marketo, and 6sense or comparable ABM/intent platforms (APIs, webhooks, iPaaS).
  • Strong understanding of top-of-funnel GTM and BDR/SDR operations: lead routing, scoring, handoff SLAs, sales engagement and dialer tooling, and attribution.
  • Experience building AI-assisted workflows or agents in a business context using Claude or comparable LLM platforms, with working fluency orchestrating agents through MCP connectors or similar.
  • Experience building content and campaign automation workflows, from brief intake to first-draft assets.
  • B2B SaaS or subscription GTM experience, ideally across multiple regions, segments, or sales motions.
  • Experience managing, mentoring, or technically leading others.
  • Ability to translate business needs into practical technical delivery plans and build effective relationships across Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and IT.

Who You Are

  • Curious and a natural problem solver: you dig into root causes, not just the request in front of you.
  • Proactive with a strong bias to act: you form theories and test them on your own, without waiting to be asked, move fast within guardrails, measure the results, and retire what doesn't work.
  • A strategic translator: you turn business strategy into tangible actions, workflows, and systems.
  • Comfortable with visibility: you communicate credibly with senior leaders across Marketing, Sales, and the executive team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building ABM personalization and GTM workflows at scale.
  • Experience automating work-management tools such as Asana.
  • Familiarity with attribution platforms such as Dreamdata.
  • Exposure to AI governance and responsible-AI practices.

Success Measures

  • Increase in high-quality pipeline generated per BDR to contribute to bookings.
  • Measurable improvement in speed-to-lead and routing accuracy from lead capture to BDR handoff.
  • Measurable reduction in BDR manual and administrative time.
  • AI-assisted workflows and agents that run reliably in production with real adoption across Marketing, not just GTM and outbound.
  • Measurable reduction in manual production time for campaign creation and ABM personalization.
  • Zero production incidents from agents or automations reaching customers or prospects without review.

Base Salary Range: $150,081.25 - $180,852.50. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

The role at a glance

Team

Sales

Location

Type

Full-time

Who you sell to

CEOs, CFOs, COOs, CMOs and VPs of E-Commerce at mid-market omnichannel brands

Markets

Primarily US, plus UK and EU

Sales cycle

60–90 days

Package

$110K–$140K base, $220K–$280K OTE, 50/50, uncapped, plus stock options and a strong benefits package

About SuperchargeMe

SuperchargeMe is one brain for the whole commerce business. Ten products, Ads-IQ, Retention-IQ, Restock-IQ, Stores-IQ, Marketplaces-IQ, Crossborder-IQ, NPD-IQ, Concierge-IQ, Feeds-IQ and Partnership-IQ, share one set of numbers. They don't stop at recommendations: they make the changes too, at the level of control each brand chooses. It works inside Slack, plugs into 100+ tools from Shopify and NetSuite to Meta, Google and Amazon, and is running 23 brands today across paid media, retention, inventory and wholesale, stores, marketplaces, catalog and partnerships.

Every function has a tool. Nothing runs the whole. We built SuperchargeMe to run the whole.

The product is live and brands are paying for it. Selling it full-time is the next step. That's you.

The role in a sentence

You'll be the first person selling SuperchargeMe full-time: finding mid-market omnichannel brands that haven't heard of us, getting meetings with their leadership, and closing deals on numbers the CFO can sign off.

Where we are

SuperchargeMe is already revenue-generating, with brands paying for it every month. Case studies from our first clients are being written now. Until now the founders have sold it themselves. You'll take over the deals and conversations they've started, then build a much bigger pipeline with your own outbound, contacts and partner introductions.

Who you sell to: mid-market omnichannel brands, roughly $20M to $300M in revenue, primarily in the US with UK and EU brands too, selling across their own store, marketplaces, wholesale and retail. Brands starting with a single product sign up on their own. Brands that want several platforms working together, with onboarding, come to you.

There's no sales team or SDRs yet, and what works in a sale is still in the founders' heads. Writing it down is part of the job. A founding Growth Marketer joins at the same time to bring in demos. A Chief Revenue Officer will join as we grow, and you'll be the first seller on the team they build.

Most brand leaders recognize the problem as soon as you describe it: ten or twenty tools, several with their own AI, all reporting different numbers. We call it the Silo Tax. Putting a number on it for every brand you meet is the job.

The work

  • Take over the deals and conversations the founders have started, then build on them with your own target accounts, outbound, contacts and introductions from agencies, Shopify partners and systems integrators.
  • Run each deal from first call to signature: discovery, an ROI case built on the brand's own numbers, a live demo, a trial, negotiation and close.
  • Keep the risk low for buyers with short trials, a phased setup and a clear plan for what they'll see in the first 30 days.
  • Show finance and operations leaders what connecting Shopify, their ERP, ad platforms and marketplaces is worth in margin, inventory and cash.
  • Start each customer on whichever product proves value fastest, then add more. Brands that signed up on their own for one product are good candidates.
  • Write down what wins and loses deals, so the next sellers have a playbook and the product team hears what buyers want.

What good looks like

We'll judge you on new revenue you found and closed yourself.

  • In your first month you can demo the product without help, you've agreed a target list with the founders, and your first meetings with senior people are booked.
  • By the end of your first quarter your pipeline has grown well beyond what you took over, with trials running and your first deals closed.
  • Buyers who had never heard of us take your second meeting.
  • The founders stop joining your first calls, because they don't need to.

What you bring

  • Five or more years selling B2B software, with at least three as a mid-market or commercial Account Executive on 60 to 90 day sales cycles and contracts in the five to six figures.
  • Proof that you've beaten your number, such as commission statements or how you ranked against other sellers.
  • Deals won with buyers who had never heard of your company, with most of your closed revenue coming from leads you found yourself.
  • You're comfortable talking to finance and operations leaders about margin, inventory, cash and payback.
  • Your own relationships with senior people at mid-market omnichannel brands.
  • A working knowledge of the commerce stack: Shopify, NetSuite or another ERP, Meta, Google and Amazon ads, and email and SMS tools.
  • You use AI tools and agents in your own selling and can show us how. We sell AI agents, so we'd expect that.

Bonus points

  • You've been one of a startup's first three salespeople.
  • You've sold at companies like NetSuite, Celigo, Wunderkind, Feedonomics, Bloomreach, Daasity, Extensiv, Brightpearl, Skio or Okendo.

Skip this one if

  • You need inbound leads and a famous logo to open doors.
  • You want a finished playbook, an enablement team and SDRs from day one.
  • You'd rather demo features than build an ROI case a CFO signs off.
  • You'd rather manage a book than build one.

Why join

  • You'll set how we sell: the pitch, the playbook and the feedback that shapes pricing. Every seller after you will build on it.
  • Most brand leaders haven't yet seen AI that takes actions on their business. You'll be the one showing them.
  • You'll work directly with both founders, who ran commerce brands before building software. Deals get decided quickly, and what buyers tell you reaches the product fast.
  • Commission has no cap, contracts grow as customers add products, and you get stock options in the company you're helping build.

How we hire

  • A 30-minute intro call with the co-founders.
  • A deal deep-dive: talk us through two deals you found and closed yourself, with proof of what you hit.
  • A mock first call where you pitch a CFO who has never heard of SuperchargeMe.
  • References, including a former manager.

What you get

$110,000–$140,000 base · $220,000–$280,000 OTE

50/50 base and variable, uncapped commission, stock options so you own a real piece of what you build, and a strong benefits package.

Remote within the United States, with travel to client meetings and industry events, and some calls on UK and EU hours.

Junior Data Engineer

Job Title: Junior Data Engineer
Job Type: Full-Time
Work Arrangement: Remote / Hybrid / On-site
Experience Level: Entry-Level to Early Career (0–3 Years)
Salary Range: $75,000–$115,000 per year
Job Locations: Seattle, WA | Austin, TX | Dallas, TX | New York City, NY | Atlanta, GA
Candidate Location Requirement: Must currently reside in the United States.

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Data Engineer to join our data engineering team. The ideal candidate will have a foundational understanding of Python, SQL, ETL processes, and Apache Spark, with a strong interest in building reliable, scalable data pipelines.

In this role, you will help develop and maintain data ingestion workflows, transform raw data into usable datasets, and support data integration initiatives. You will collaborate with data engineers, data analysts, data scientists, and other technical teams to ensure data is accurate, accessible, and ready for reporting and analytics.

This opportunity is ideal for recent graduates and early-career professionals who want to build their skills in data engineering, big data processing, and modern data platforms.

Eligibility requirement: Applicants must currently reside in the United States. Remote work is available only where permitted by the employer's employment and payroll requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, and maintain data pipelines using Python and SQL.

  • Assist in building and managing ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) workflows.

  • Extract data from databases, APIs, files, and other source systems.

  • Clean, transform, validate, and load data into target systems.

  • Use Apache Spark for distributed data processing and large-scale data transformations.

  • Write efficient SQL queries to retrieve, join, aggregate, and manipulate datasets.

  • Monitor data pipelines and troubleshoot failures, performance issues, and data quality problems.

CancerNavigator is an early-stage healthcare company (remote, headquartered in Washington, D.C.) dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.

Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief

Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.

CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. All of our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who work with members to catch cancer early, get them to fantastic experts for their care, and help them through the thousands of other problems patients and their families face.

Join us to help serve cancer patients in their hour of need.

The “Nurse Navigator” Role

Our oncology nurse navigators are the front-line of CancerNavigator’s patient service. Nurse Navigators support patients at all parts of their journey – newly diagnosed, in active treatment, and entering remission. With more specificity, oncology nurse navigators:

  • Educate cancer patients (and their families) about their diagnosis, treatment options, and provide helpful information on any related questions and concerns the patient may have
  • Work closely with the researchers on our team to deliver tailored information to patients, guiding them to the centers and doctors that would be a great option for the patient’s care
  • Do everything possible to address any barriers to care (e.g. registering and scheduling appointments, coordinating with their health plan or their care team, transferring records, etc.)
  • Provide longitudinal support to the patient throughout their journey – helping them solve any issues related to their cancer diagnosis and care – whether connecting patients to mental health support, finding resources to ease the financial burden, arranging transportation to appointments, or answering any questions that may arise

The Requirements

The main requirement of this role is oncology nursing experience and a passion for serving cancer patients. More specifically, we are looking for someone with the following experience and qualifications:

  • Ability to work Pacific hours (8am-5pm PST)
  • Native Spanish Speaker
  • 3+ years of oncology nursing experience

Description

About the Role

The Salesforce Administrator owns and optimizes our Salesforce platform — a mature, heavily automated environment spanning Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. You will manage significant custom configuration, a body of existing legacy automation, and numerous critical integrations (NetSuite, marketing automation, e-signature, telephony, and more).

This is a hands-on role for a skilled administrator who can configure declaratively, keep our integration ecosystem healthy, and translate cross-functional business needs into reliable, scalable solutions. We actively manage and extend this org using AI-assisted tooling (including Claude Code), so we are especially interested in someone who already leverages AI to streamline administration or is genuinely driven to work in an AI-forward setup.

Key Responsibilities

System Administration & Security

  • Serve as the primary system administrator for Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
  • Manage user lifecycle, roles, profiles, permission sets, field-level security, and sharing rules.
  • Support end users with troubleshooting, training, and documentation to drive adoption across departments.

Automation & Process Modernization

  • Design, build, and maintain complex declarative automation using Salesforce Flow (record-triggered, screen, scheduled, and HTTP callout flows).
  • Audit, rationalize, and retire legacy Workflow Rules and Process Builders into clean, maintainable Flows.
  • Administer Service Cloud processes, including Case assignment rules, queue management, and automated offboarding cases tied to client cancellations.

Integrations & Ecosystem Management

  • Own and maintain integrations across connected platforms, including NetSuite (via Celigo / ), GoHighLevel, PDF Butler (e-signature/doc-gen), Dialpad, Apollo, HubSpot (sunset phase), and Outlook/Teams sync.
  • Configure and support custom API- and webhook-based integrations to ensure uninterrupted data flow across systems.

Deployments, Data Hygiene & Analytics

  • Manage deployments across sandboxes and production using the Metadata API, Salesforce CLI, or Change Sets, troubleshooting test-coverage and deployment failures.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards supporting pipeline, subscription-revenue metrics (MRR, ARR, churn), and operational decision-making.
  • Ensure data hygiene through validation rules, deduplication, and regular audits (e.g., lead-source completeness, duplicate resolution).

AI & Innovation

  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT) to accelerate Flow design, formula building, metadata analysis, documentation, and troubleshooting.
  • Stay current on Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to propose continuous system improvements.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience: 8 years of dedicated experience as a Salesforce Administrator in a complex, heavily automated environment. Experience in healthcare, marketing, or agency/managed services environments is a strong plus.
  • Certifications:Salesforce Administrator certification required. Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Platform Developer I (PDI) strongly preferred.
  • Core Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of the Salesforce data model, security architecture, and Flow Builder (including HTTP callouts and complex sub-flows).
  • Cloud Knowledge: Hands-on administration experience across both Sales Cloud and Service Cloud (Case management).
  • Integrations: Experience owning third-party and custom integrations, including middleware/iPaaS (e.g., Celigo / ) and REST/Webhook syncs. Experience with NetSuite or marketing tech stacks is a major advantage.
  • Analytics: Strong proficiency with custom report types, bucket fields, and dashboards; comfort with SaaS metrics (MRR/ARR/churn) preferred.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

2. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate for this specific setup fits the "Technical Modernizer" persona:

  1. The Flow Architect: They don't just "know" Flow; they understand architectural patterns (one Flow per object per event, sub-flows, fault paths) and are comfortable deprecating legacy Process Builders without breaking downstream logic.
  2. The Integration Specialist: They aren't intimidated by API error logs, webhook payload mismatches, or Celigo flow errors between Salesforce and NetSuite. They can trace data failures across system boundaries independently.
  3. The AI-Augmented Admin: They actively use AI tools (Claude Code, LLMs) to draft formulas, analyze SOQL/XML metadata, or generate test cases 2–3x faster than traditional manual admins.

# Shift Time will be 6.30 PM to 3.30 AM IST (+/ - 1HRS )

jobs.description:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at .

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is looking for a Fertility Medical Expert (RN, NP, or PA) to join our Medical Experts team on a contract basis for approximately a 3-month engagement, working a minimum 15 hours per week in a fully remote role. In this role, you will serve as a clinical resource for members navigating fertility and family-building, providing evidence-informed information and guidance that helps people understand their options and make confident, informed choices.

Day to day, you will meet with members by video to talk through their fertility questions and goals, offering clear, practical information without diagnosing, prescribing, or directing care..

This is a chance to put your fertility experience to work in a fast-growing digital health environment, with the flexibility of a contract schedule. You will work alongside a diverse team of medical experts across fertility, pregnancy, urology, mental health, and nutrition who share a passion for continuous learning and an evidence-based approach.

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

  • Provide members with evidence-informed information and guidance on fertility topics, such as fertility evaluation and testing, treatment options, and family-building pathways
  • Conduct one-on-one virtual sessions (video) that educate and present options without diagnosing, prescribing, or directing care
  • Stay current on reproductive and fertility regulatory trends and clinical practice guidelines in the US
  • Participate in quality assurance initiatives and audits to help ensure a safe, compliant member experience that meets the highest standards
  • Collaborate with the broader Medical Experts team and cross-functional partners to deliver a consistent, high-quality member experience
  • Maintain a reliable, flexible schedule within ~15 hours per week range to meet member demand throughout the engagement

What Success Looks Like 📈

In your first 30 Days, you will have:

  • Delivered consistently high-quality, well-rated fertility sessions that help members feel informed and supported
  • Stayed within Carrot’s non-diagnostic, non-directive scope of practice and met documentation and quality standards across member interactions
  • Met your agreed weekly hours and availability, communicating proactively about scheduling and capacity
  • Ramped up quickly and worked independently with minimal oversight in a confidential, remote environment
  • Built trusted working relationships with the Medical Experts team and cross-functional partners

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • An active US license as a Registered Nurse (RN), Nurse Practitioner (NP), or Physician Assistant (PA)
  • 3+ years of experience providing patient care in a fertility clinic or a hospital clinic that addresses reproductive health
  • Superb listening skills and the ability to empathetically discuss fertility and family-building topics
  • The ability to work independently and to distinguish good clinical judgment from non-directive guidance
  • The ability to work from a confidential and private remote environment with reliable internet and digital resources
  • Flexibility to adapt to evolving business needs and availability for 15 per week for a 3-month engagement

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience in third-party reproduction (e.g., gestational surrogacy, donor gametes), urology, pregnancy, or menopause
  • Experience in digital health or telehealth settings, including virtual member or patient education
  • Prior contract or consulting experience with a quick ramp-up
  • Fluency in an additional language

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Fertility journeys are deeply personal, and members often arrive with more questions than answers. As a Fertility Medical Expert, you will be the knowledgeable, compassionate clinical voice who helps them understand their options and feel prepared for the conversations they have with their own care teams.

Your expertise helps make Carrot’s clinical program one that members trust and rely on, and it strengthens the confidence of the employers and health plans who count on Carrot to deliver high-quality, whole-person care. Even in a focused 3-month engagement, your work will make a direct, visible difference for the people we serve.

Interview Process 🤝

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  • Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  • Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes
  • Mock Chat- 45 Minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation 💰

The starting base hourly for this position will range from $70-$90/hr. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to:

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

jobs.description:
Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.

Analytics Engineer

We’re hiring Analytics Engineers to join Convene Hospitality Group’s (CHG) Technology organization. We’re building out the foundational platform to democratize data at CHG so that a venue GM, a finance lead, and an AI agent are all able to ask a question and get the same trusted answer.

Analytics engineers own the full path from ingestion to visualization, including governance and observability. You’ll bring data in from source systems, model it through bronze, silver, and gold, define the semantic layer, and breathe life into the visualizations, conversational analytics, and business agents that teams rely on to make decisions.

You’ll join the Data Platform team, reporting to its Engineering Manager, and work closely with other analytics engineers and business partners across the company. You’ll build on Snowflake, dbt, and Fivetran, using Snowflake-native capabilities like semantic views and Cortex to power ThoughtSpot and beyond.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with the business. Work with Finance, Sales, Operations, and venue teams to understand their needs and turn them into models and metrics they trust.
  • Own ingestion for your domains. Set up and maintain Fivetran connectors, land data in bronze, and handle schema drift and load failures.
  • Model the business. Build dbt models that move data through bronze, silver, and gold, and shape gold around how CHG runs so people outside the data team can understand and use it.
  • Own the semantic layer. Set metrics, dimensions, and relationships so a number means the same thing in a dashboard, a search, or an agent’s answer. Tune synonyms and descriptions so a model picks the right measure, trace wrong answers to the root cause, and help us decide where each definition lives.
  • Power self-service in ThoughtSpot. Build the models and Liveboards that let teams explore data on their own, and turn the questions people actually ask into new test cases.
  • Own the quality of conversational analytics. Test answers the way you’d test code. Build and maintain a golden question set of real business questions paired with certified answers as your test cases, run them as a regression suite on every model or semantic change, and block releases that fail. Back your models with dbt tests and clear documentation.
  • Apply governance day to day. Tag sensitive data at ingestion, apply access controls such as tag-based masking and row access policies, and follow the standards the team sets, so an agent only returns what the person asking is allowed to see.
  • Keep it fast and fresh. Monitor freshness, data quality, and pipeline health so problems surface to you before they reach a dashboard or an agent’s answer. Tune query and model performance, from incremental dbt models to warehouse sizing, so answers come back fast and Snowflake costs stay in check.
  • Work AI-native. Lead with specs, then hand agents end-to-end tasks, from exploring source data to building models, tests, and documentation. Let agents run loose in the wild (with some guardrails in place). You hold agent and human work to the same review bar, so code from Claude and code from a teammate get the same scrutiny. Share what you learn, and help set the playbook for agentic data work.

What We Look For:

  • You have 3+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI development, building data products people rely on.
  • You write strong SQL and have built and maintained dbt models in production.
  • You’ve worked in a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake.
  • You’ve worked with ELT ingestion tools like Fivetran and can troubleshoot source-data issues such as schema changes, late-arriving data, and API limits.
  • You understand data modeling: dimensional models, medallion layering, and clear reasoning about grain, slowly changing dimensions, and event lifecycles.
  • You’ve built dashboards or self-service data products that people use to make decisions.
  • You test and document your work as a habit.
  • You’re curious about the business. You ask what decision a request supports before you start building.
  • You use AI agents for real multi-step work, like writing SQL and dbt models, generating tests, and drafting documentation, and you verify what they produce.
  • You explain your work clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
  • You take ownership. You see work through, ask for help when you’re stuck, and look for ways to make things better.

Bonus Points

  • You’ve evaluated LLM or natural-language analytics output, for example with golden sets or regression testing.
  • You’ve worked in hospitality, events, real estate, or another customer-centric, multi-location business.

Compensation:

We’re Here For You:

At Convene Hospitality Group, we want you to feel supported in every part of your life. Here’s what you can expect:

At Convene Hospitality Group, we believe great teams are built by bringing together people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Our values of GRIT (Genuine, Relentless, Integrity, and Teamwork) shape how we show up for each other every day. We want everyone here to feel welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. If you’re excited to grow, learn, and make an impact, we’d love to have you on the team.

The impact of this role

The AMA Marketing Team is looking for an intern who is excited to learn more about lifecycle marketing, content marketing, and membership marketing! Work with the senior leaders on the marketing team to learn how to use core marketing ops tools like HubSpot, WordPress, and more. This role will support Membership, Certification, and content initiatives that are integral to AMA's overall marketing strategy. This intern will leave with an understanding of how all the sections of our in-house marketing team work together to support multiple products and business lines.

What you'll do

  • Building content/article pages on the new website
  • Certification messaging audit and revamp
  • Completing the manual activation for free memberships from events (like Content Marketing World)
  • Create, execute, and analyze survey information
  • Plan, design, and execute promotional campaigns

What you bring

  • A current Junior or Senior studying Marketing
  • Being comfortable with a variety of tools or the ability to not be phased by learning new tools (we use WordPress, HubSpot, Qualtrics, Salesforce, Payload)
  • Fundamental knowledge of Marketing
  • Understanding of marketing funnels and personas
  • Copywriting experience for a public-facing audience

What you may also have

  • Any prior experience working on customer journeys would be helpful, but not necessarily required

Why the AMA

The AMA is the essential community for marketers, from students to executives to academics. Through our five scholarly journals, conferences, PCM® certification, 70 regional chapters, and presence on 350 college campuses, we help the profession learn, grow, and make a lasting impact. The AMA Foundation (AMAF) strengthens and elevates the marketing profession by advancing knowledge, building a global community of marketing leaders, and supporting marketing initiatives that drive innovation and societal impact. Want to learn more about AMA? Check out our website.

What it's like here

  • Fridays are ours. No internal meetings after 12 pm. Use that time to catch up, explore learning and development, or whatever you need to avoid the Sunday Scaries!
  • Remote, but not alone. Teammates in 20+ states, annual team member summit in Chicago, monthly town halls, and lots of cross-team collaboration.
  • Recognition is built in.Our Bucketlist rewards program enables gratitude in tangible form!
  • Growth: Free AMA membership, professional development content, and the PCM® Marketing Manager certification exam
  • Flexibility: We know you may have a balance of classes and this internship. We offer flexibility with your schedule.

How we hire

  1. Resume review by our recruiter and the hiring manager. A person reads your resume; AMA never uses AI to screen candidates.
  2. One-way video interview (Spark Hire): Five (5) questions, about 15-20 minutes, unlimited think time. We promise it isn't scary. We wrote the questions carefully because we want your answers to be just as thoughtful. Our recruiter is the face you’ll see asking the questions. No robots here.
  3. 30-minute phone interview with a member of the People and Culture team.
  4. Virtual interview with the hiring manager and the stakeholders you'll work with most.

We won’t leave you hanging. You will always hear from us within a week about the status of your application and status.

Please note that only applicants who apply officially will be considered in this process. We appreciate the candidates who apply and express interest, but we cannot circumvent the recruitment process for any candidates, regardless of their relationship to the AMA or our team members.

Eligibility

You must live in one of the states listed above. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without employer sponsorship. For internships, F1 visas are okay.

Equal opportunity

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, reproductive health decisions, family responsibilities, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. AMA is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

As a Vision, Mission, and Driven company, VMD has been delivering information technology solutions to the Federal government in Agile Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Critical Infrastructure Protection since 2002. Our mission has now expanded, and we have merged with Xcelerate Solutions to revolutionize end-to-end enterprise security. Together we are committed to protecting our nation’s citizens, critical infrastructure, and resources.

Why Join VMD Corp?

At VMD, now a part of Xcelerate Solutions, you have the opportunity to thrive in your career and become a Game Changer. The quality and talent of our people is what drives our success. We embrace an employee-first culture and make it a priority to provide professional development opportunities that foster career growth.

We help protect American Citizens and the nation’s most critical infrastructure by working alongside our customers and delivering game changing solutions to strengthen their missions. We believe our passion and commitment to achieving our customers' goals and solve their most critical challenges defines who we are. We don’t just dream big, we act on it – through teamwork, dedication, and resilience.

About the Mission You Will Join:

You will be helping to transform and modernize the nation’s lawful systems and adjudication process. The portfolio of systems supports millions of applicants as go through Citizenship and VISA processing. This work is critical to securing the homeland and protecting the American people. The team you will be joining uses Agile and innovative practices to bring technical solutions to the USCIS mission.

Your Impact to the Mission:

The CI/CD Pipeline Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, maintaining, and optimizing Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines that support enterprise application development and deployment. This role automates software build, testing, security scanning, artifact management, and deployment processes to improve release efficiency, software quality, system reliability, and security compliance.

The engineer works closely with application developers, cloud engineers, system administrators, cybersecurity personnel, and program leadership to implement automated DevSecOps practices across development, test, staging, and production environments. The position supports cloud-native applications, Java microservices, containerized workloads, and enterprise integration platforms while ensuring compliance with applicable security and configuration management requirements.

Key Responsibilities

CI/CD Pipeline Development and Automation

  • Design, develop, configure, and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines for enterprise applications and microservices, automated testing jobs, infrastructure builds, etc.
  • Implement and optimize build, unit testing, integration testing, code quality analysis, artifact publishing, and deployment workflows.
  • Develop reusable pipeline templates, shared libraries, deployment scripts, and automation components to standardize delivery processes.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline failures, build errors, deployment issues, and configuration inconsistencies.

DevSecOps and Security Integration

  • Integrate automated security testing, static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), container image scanning, and vulnerability assessments into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Enforce security gates, code quality thresholds, and approval requirements before software is promoted between environments.
  • Support remediation of security vulnerabilities, software dependencies, and container image findings.
  • Maintain pipeline configurations and deployment processes consistent with organizational security policies and applicable NIST SP 800-53, RMF, and federal cybersecurity requirements.
  • Support audit readiness through pipeline logs, deployment records, traceability, and documented release approvals.

Cloud, Containers, and Infrastructure Automation

  • Support containerized application deployments using Docker and Kubernetes, including Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS).
  • Integrate pipelines with cloud services, infrastructure automation, container registries, and environment configuration management.
  • Implement automated deployment strategies, including rolling deployments, blue-green deployments, and rollback procedures, as appropriate.
  • Collaborate with cloud and infrastructure teams to resolve environment, networking, access, and deployment issues.

Configuration Management and Release Support

  • Manage source control workflows, branching strategies, versioning, artifact repositories, and release tagging.
  • Implement environment promotion controls across development, test, staging, and production.
  • Maintain pipeline documentation, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical standards.
  • Monitor pipeline performance and identify opportunities to reduce deployment time, improve reliability, and increase automation.

Collaboration and Continuous Improvement

  • Work with cybersecurity, quality assurance, architecture, and operations teams to resolve delivery and compliance issues.
  • Provide technical guidance to developers on pipeline usage, deployment standards, and DevSecOps best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve software delivery performance, pipeline reuse, operational consistency, and release quality.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience as well as 10+ years total experience in the field.
  • Three or more years of experience developing, maintaining, or supporting CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation.
  • Demonstrated experience with one or more CI/CD platforms, such as Jenkins, Harness, GitLab CI/CD, or GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with source control systems, particularly Git.
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Groovy.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, container registries, and automated application deployments.
  • Understanding of software build processes, automated testing, version control, release management, and configuration management.
  • Experience integrating code quality tools and automated security scanning into software delivery workflows.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS cloud services and Amazon EKS.
  • Experience with Harness pipeline development, reusable templates, service and environment configuration, and deployment orchestration.
  • Familiarity with SonarQube, Twistlock/Prisma Cloud, or comparable code quality and security tools.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or comparable technologies.
  • Familiarity with observability platforms such as New Relic, CloudWatch, or comparable monitoring solutions.
  • Experience supporting Java, REST APIs, and microservice architectures.
  • Experience supporting federal government IT programs and security compliance requirements, including NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, and the Risk Management Framework (RMF).
  • Experience supporting production systems with stringent availability, auditability, and change-control requirements.

Performance Expectations

  • Deliver reliable, repeatable, and maintainable CI/CD pipelines that support timely and controlled software releases.
  • Increase automation and reduce manual intervention in software build, testing, security validation, and deployment activities.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline documentation and traceable deployment records.
  • Identify and resolve pipeline issues promptly to minimize development delays and production deployment risks.
  • Ensure security and quality controls are consistently applied throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Collaborate effectively with development, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to meet program milestones and operational objectives.

Basic Qualifiers:

  • Education Requirement: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience as well as 10+ years total experience in the field.
  • Can Additional Years of Experience Substitute for Degree? No
  • Required Certification(s): None
  • Minimum Years of Specific Experience in Field: 10
  • Minimum Clearance to Start: Public Trust
  • Work Status Allowable: US Citizenship

Travel and Telecommuting:

  • Travel: None
  • Telecommute Options: Remote
Xcelerate Solutions and its subsidiaries are Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employers. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, equal pay, disability, veteran status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or expression of another protected characteristic. As part of this commitment to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals, Xcelerate provides reasonable accommodations if needed because of an applicant's or an employee's disability. Xcelerate Solutions maintains a drug-free workplace.

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Digital Marketing Specialist (Social Media, Email Marketing & Lead Generation) • Compensation: 26,000 • Location: Remote • Commitment: Part time Job OverviewWe are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist to manage and execute our social media strategy, email marketing campaigns, and lead generation efforts.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Digital Marketing Specialist (Social Media, Email Marketing & Lead Generation)

  • Compensation: 26,000
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: Part time

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist to manage and execute our social media strategy, email marketing campaigns, and lead generation efforts. You will be responsible for growing our online presence, nurturing leads, and driving sign-ups for our online workshops focused on helping people overcome their fear of water.

The ideal candidate is highly creative, data-driven, and skilled in social media management, email marketing automation, and lead generation strategies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Social Media Management & Content Creation

  • Develop and execute a content calendar focused on overcoming water fear, success stories, FAQs, and engaging posts.
  • Create and schedule 4 social media posts per week (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn).
  • Design and produce 3 short-form videos per week (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts).
  • Write compelling captions, hashtags, and CTAs to boost engagement and conversions.
  • Engage with followers by responding to comments, messages, and community interactions.
  • Collaborate with influencers and potential partners to expand audience reach.
  • Track and analyze social media performance, optimizing content based on insights.

2. Email Marketing & Automation

  • Develop lead magnets (e.g., downloadable guides, free checklists) to capture emails.
  • Write and automate a 7-email nurture sequence to convert leads into customers.
  • Send a weekly email newsletter with customer success stories, tips, and workshop updates.
  • Create and manage promotional email campaigns for upcoming workshops and special offers.
  • Segment and clean email lists to ensure targeted messaging and high deliverability.
  • Perform A/B testing to optimize subject lines, email copy, and CTAs.

3. Lead Generation & CRM Management

  • Optimize landing pages to increase lead capture and conversion rates.
  • Track leads in a CRM system and implement an effective follow-up strategy.
  • Plan and run Facebook & Instagram ad campaigns (ad budget separate).
  • Generate leads organically through engagement in Facebook Groups, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Quora.
  • Organize and promote free webinars and online workshops to attract potential clients.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing strategies to re-engage lost leads.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Proven experience in social media management, content creation, and engagement strategies.
  • Strong expertise in email marketing platforms (Mailchimp, ConvertKit, ActiveCampaign, etc.).
  • Knowledge of lead generation techniques (organic outreach & paid ads).
  • Basic video editing skills for creating short-form content.
  • Experience with Facebook & Instagram ads (audience targeting, retargeting, and optimization).
  • Strong writing skills for crafting engaging social media captions, emails, and ad copy.
  • Experience using Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, or similar tools for tracking performance.
  • Highly organized with strong project management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in coaching, wellness, or swimming, education industries is a plus.
  • Familiarity with automation tools like Zapier, ClickFunnels, or HubSpot.
  • Prior experience working with online courses or coaching businesses.

jobs.title: Talent Development & Community Program Manager
jobs.excerpt: At Evolve, we’re on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone.
jobs.description:
At Evolve, we’re on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone. Our high-performing, customer-obsessed team runs on curiosity, communication, and accountability—working together to create exceptional experiences for our owners and guests. Whether solving big challenges, delivering outstanding results, or celebrating wins, we approach every day with purpose and passion. If you’re ready to join a mission-driven company where every teammate has the opportunity to thrive, Evolve might just be the place for you.

Why this role

We are looking for a Talent Development & Community Program Manager to raise the bar on how we grow and connect Evolvers.

You’ll design our Evolver Experience Ecosystem, unifying our learning programs and culture initiatives into one connected experience. You’ll own talent and leadership development programs and New Evolver Onboarding, alongside our community and culture programming including Employee Resource Groups, CSR, and connection events.

This is a builder role, designed for a person who can own a project from ideation and design through delivery and measurement. You'll shape the strategy, put the systems in place, and facilitate in the room yourself.

If you’ve been waiting for a role that puts learning and culture in the same hands (and trusts you to build it!), this role is for you.

What you’ll do

  • Drive Evolve's talent and leadership development strategy from design through measurement, connecting learning with culture and community.
  • Lead New Hire Orientation (NEO), designing both the content and the experience so new Evolvers understand our business, learn our values, and feel connected to our customer-obsessed and high-performance culture on day 1.
  • Build and facilitate leadership development programs, from first-time manager foundations to ongoing leader cohorts, grounded in Evolve's player-coach leadership expectations.
  • Plan and deliver the company moments, in person and virtual, that build connection across a distributed team.
  • Oversee Evolve’s Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) and related DEIB initiatives, partnering with ERG leaders and Executive Sponsors on charters, budgets, and impact.
  • Engage Evolvers in the company’s Corporate Social Responsibility work through our signature Building Hospitality program.
  • Leverage AI and other tools to scale our programs through system building, content creation, automating logistics, and tracking impact (not just activity).

What makes you a great fit

  • 7+ years of experience in learning and development, talent development or employee experience, including designing and facilitating programs for managers and leaders.
  • A confident facilitator who can engage any room, from tenured executives on a virtual call to new hires in our Denver office.
  • Experience building learning and culture programs from scratch at a growth company, from onboarding and leader development to ERGs, company events, and workplace experience.
  • Technical aptitude: You’re comfortable in the platforms behind your programs, from an LMS or HRIS like Rippling to survey, event, and project management tools. You build workflows and automations, and you turn participation and survey data into impact reports partners can trust.
  • AI Fluent & Digitally Agile: You already use AI tools to improve your programs and you're comfortable learning new systems to support your work.
  • Strong program management and ownership: You run several initiatives at once, manage budgets and vendors, and hold yourself to clear outcomes, not just completion rates.
  • Business acumen and sound judgment: You tie development and culture programs to business priorities and build trust with leaders across the business.

Compensation

Annual base salary range: $125,000 - $135,000 depending on relevant experience.

Location

All Evolve team members must live in one of our approved locations by their first day. We can hire from anywhere in the U.S. except D.C. and Hawaii. Some positions may also have restrictions based on compensation in the following states: California, Maryland, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, and Washington. If you live in Colorado, you can work remotely anywhere in the state, at our downtown Denver office, or a hybrid of both! If you're planning to move soon, please let us know, and we'll be happy to review your application again.

California Applicant Privacy Policy | Evolve

How we reward Evolvers

We’re intentional about offering benefits that empower every Evolver to thrive both professionally and personally because they’re more than perks—they’re investments in our customer-obsessed, high-performing team.

We believe in treating others as they want to be treated, providing benefits that deliver real value, and challenging the status quo to meet the diverse needs of our team. Whether it’s helping you take care of your health, plan for the future, or celebrate life’s milestones, our offerings are designed to support you every step of the way.

  • Financial Wellness: Industry-competitive pay, equity in the company, and a 401(k) with a 4% immediate vesting match.
  • Family Support: 16-18 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 10 weeks for non-birthing parents, plus infertility coverage.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, with 100% employer-paid dental and vision for individual coverage, a low-cost medical option, 10 free mental health visits, and pet insurance.
  • Time to Recharge: Generous PTO, RTO (for full-time exempt employees), sick leave, holidays, and a personal holiday to celebrate what matters most to you.
  • Travel Perks: Annual Evolve travel credit after one year and discounts on stays at all Evolve properties.
  • Growth Opportunities: World-class onboarding programs, learning, and development resources to help you grow your impact.
  • Connection: Employee Resource Groups celebrating our diverse communities at Evolve.

How we work together

With our core values as our guide, every Evolver helps shape the company we want to work for and the people we want to be. We’ve cultivated a culture of collaboration, care, and responsibility that we can all be proud of, and we’re excited to see what you’ll bring as your authentic self.

Still curious about who we are and what we do? Read more about our business and our culture at .

EEO

At Evolve, we are committed to diversity and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified candidates will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, military service or veteran status, physical or mental disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. Evolve participates in e-Verify for all positions.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.description:
Senior Elixir Engineerat Vic.ai Remote

Location: Remote

This is a fully remote position, full-time, with flexible working hours and work arrangements.

About Vic.ai

Vic.ai is creating the “Intelligent Accounting” era, using artificial intelligence to automate accounting and provide advisory, business insight, and eventually business foresight.

We’re a Series A stage start-up, founded by three Norwegian entrepreneurs and backed by renowned Silicon Valley investors (including Costanoa Ventures, Cowboy Ventures, and GGV Capital).

We’re US-based, but our team is global, from New Zealand to California. We’re bringing AI to Finance and Accounting because the industry is ripe for automation and big-data insight and the market is huge: $200B just in the US.

Our main office locations is in New York. We have a well established remote-work culture, and over 50% of our team are working fully remote.

We have a solid team of very experienced, yet humble, Elixir engineers, will you be our next team member?

About you

You’ve been a software engineer for 5+ years, but you’ve been a tinkerer and a builder your whole life. We’re a team of builders—when we aren’t building Vic.ai, we’re tinkering with a personal project, contributing to open source, modding a drone, building a computer from components, etc.

We’re looking for an experienced developer who enjoys working with server-side technologies. You possess a good mixture of DevOps and application development skills and would like to build innovative solutions with experienced teammates in a flexible environment.

You should have plenty of experience in building performant, easy to use, well-monitored, and well tested APIs, designing efficient data flows, communicating clearly, sharing knowledge, and questioning existing solutions.

You’re ready for the next step in your career, ready to take on fast-moving challenges. You’re enthusiastic about AI and the possibilities it opens for software development and transforming traditional work. You aim at reaching greatness and delivering exceptional outcomes in your work.

As a team player, you are not afraid of reaching out to your colleagues to discuss development challenges, especially when you are stuck trying to solve a specific issue.

You are fluent in English.

Job Requirements

  • Advanced Elixir programming experience is a must
  • Solid understanding of working in Linux shells
  • Ability to spin up servers, setting them up and make them available for application deploys
  • Having great understanding of the value of automated tests, and ability to implement them across the whole stack
  • Designing efficient deploy flows and continuous integration
  • Solid knowledge of key-value stores, SQL, and relational databases; preferably PostgreSQL
  • Ability to implement and maintain robust concurrent background job systems, having a grasp of concurrency patterns and message queues
  • Fluent English, spoken and written, clear and effective daily communication with the team

What you’ll do

  • Build and deploy high-uptime products and infrastructure as part of the Vic.ai platform
  • Integrate Elixir systems with non-uptime-critical systems in Python
  • Design and establish validation, testing, correctness, and resilience best practices across teams
  • Ship products and services as part of a small, collaborative team
  • Help establish engineering process, tools, and systems that will allow us to scale the code base, productivity, and the team

Who we're looking for:

  • BS (or higher) in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent technical experience
  • 5+ years of relevant work experience
  • Professional experience with Elixir programming language
  • Track record of shipping high-quality products and features
  • Ability to turn business needs into engineering solutions

As an early employee, you'll be working with a small team of committed and talented engineers and having a large, long-term impact on technical design and engineering culture.

We Offer

We're not just fully remote, we also offer

Competitive salary

Generous vacation time, family and travel-friendly environment
Work alongside an enthusiastic, collegial, and driven team in a highly meritocratic environment

Above all, you should enjoy the journey. Our engineers are creative, technical, smart, and genuinely like each other. They enjoy the work they do, and so should you!
