jobs.description:
Senior Growth Marketing Manager – Business & Government

Remote - United States

About the Role

The Senior Growth Marketing Manager is the campaign engine behind Blackboard’s new logo pipeline — and a critical connector between acquisition and the post-sale customer journey. Sitting within the Revenue Marketing org and reporting to the VP of Revenue Marketing, this role is responsible for translating GTM positioning and segment strategy into integrated, multi-channel demand generation campaigns that create and accelerate pipeline across the Business & Government market.

This is a creator and executor role. You will own end-to-end campaign planning and delivery: from brief to launch to performance reporting. You will work in close collaboration with Product Marketing, Marketing Intelligence, Marketing Operations, andthe Salesorg to ensure campaigns are tightly connected to targeted audiences, pipeline goals, andrevenue-focused strategies. You won’t just fill the top of the funnel — you’ll be accountable for the quality and conversion of what flows through it, and you’ll stay connected to the customer signals on the right side of the bow tie that inform where and how we show up.

You will also own our physical and digital field presence in Business & Government — regional events, third-party conferences likeDevLearn, and our flagship customer event BbT. For this role, field is not a logistics function. It is a pipeline strategy. Every event runs against a documented pipeline target, with a measurement plan and clear post-event attribution.

The right person for this role understands that AI is changing the buyer journey. You are expected to actively build AI-native workflows — not justuseAI tools, butdesignsystems and automations that let you operate at a pace a traditional marketer cannot match. You will also stay ahead of how Blackboard’s buyers are increasingly using AI in their own research and selectionprocess andadapt campaign strategy and channel mix accordingly.

What You'll Own

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Own the integrated campaign calendar for new logo acquisition in the Business & Government segment, with pipeline targets defined for every program.
  • Translate GTM positioning and competitive differentiation from the GTM Marketing team into compelling, audience-specific campaign narratives and assets.
  • Execute multi-channel campaigns spanning paid media, email, content syndication, webinars, and field event integration.
  • Design and run ABM programs for target accounts across the Business & Government universe — account-based thinking is core to this role, not optional.
  • Support Blackboard’s visibility in AI-generated research environments (GEO), coordinating with the VP GTM on which prompts and themes buyers are searching.
  • Partner with Marketing channel teams to ensure programs compound ROI rather than run in isolation.
  • Build AI-native workflows for always-running campaign analysis, audience personalization, and performance optimization — and share what you’re building with the broader team.

Field & Event Marketing

  • Coordinate with Events, Sr Manager to manage regional field activation programs — road shows, executive dinners, partner-hosted events — tied to pipeline goals in specific accounts or geographies.
  • Serve as a key campaign contributor to BbT26, Blackboard’s flagship customer event, ensuring field and campaign strategies are coordinated.
  • Build and own post-event attribution models: every event investment is measured against pipeline sourced, pipeline influenced, and closed won contribution.

Pipeline Generation & Attribution

  • Own a direct pipeline contribution target — not just activity metrics. You hold a number, review it weekly, andcourse-correctwhen programs underperform.
  • Work with Marketing Intelligence to define campaign-level pipeline targets and track performance against them.
  • Leverage intent data andbuyingsignals from the Marketing Intelligence team to prioritize campaign audiences and personalize outreach.
  • Build and maintain multi-touch attribution to ensure campaign contribution is accurately captured across the full funnel.
  • Flag expansion signals — customer engagement patterns, advocacy activity, product usage — to the Customer Growth & Advocacy team so post-sale programs can act on them.

Content & Asset Development

  • Brief and collaborate with Content and Brand teams to develop campaign assets: landing pages, nurture emails, one-pagers, and digital ads.
  • Coordinate with Marketing Ops to ensure proper list segmentation, lead routing, and campaign tracking in HubSpot and Salesforce.
  • Align with Product Marketing on sales enablement and ensure campaign messaging is consistent across GTM teams.
  • Develop field-specific assets — event booth briefs, executive event guides, post-event nurture sequences — that connect field presence to campaign pipeline.

Reporting& Optimization

  • Own campaign performance reporting: pipeline contribution, MQL-to-SQL ratios, closed won rates, cost per opportunity, and event ROI.
  • Continuously test and optimize campaign elements — messaging, creative, CTAs, audience segments — to improve performance.
  • Present campaign results and recommendations at weekly pipeline reviews; come with a point of view, not just a dashboard.
  • Influence without authority: work across Sales, CS, and Marketing to ensure campaigns are well-supported and properly credited.

How You FitIntothe Team

Revenue Marketing at Blackboard is accountable for pipeline volume and new logo acquisition. As Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you are the operational heart of that effort for the Business & Government segment. You are also a connective tissue role: you run the acquisition motion, but you stay connected to what happens after a customer signs.

You will work closely with:

  • GTM Marketing for campaign narrative, positioning, and competitiveangles — theyset the strategy; you build and execute the campaigns
  • Marketing Intelligence for attribution tracking, intent signals, lead data flows, and AI workflow infrastructure
  • Customer Growth & Advocacy team for customer proof points, expansion signals, and advocacy assets that feed back into campaign programs
  • Sales as a direct partner: you pass pipeline data, support field alignment, and ensure marketing programs are set up to be credited correctly
  • Brand + Creative for asset production and visual consistency with Blackboard’s brand standards

Required Skills and Experience

  • 8–10 years of B2B demand generation or growth marketing experience, ideally in EdTech, SaaS, or a similarly complex enterprise environment
  • Proven track record building and executing integrated campaigns that generatepipeline —not just leads — with a measurable contribution number you own
  • Real ABM experience: you have run account-based programs, not just heard of them. You know how to design plays at the account level and measure their impact
  • Field and event marketing ownership: you have managed conference presence, regional programs, and event budgets end-to-end, including post-event attribution
  • AI-native operator: you have built workflows and automations with AI as a core part of how you work, not as a side project. You can show examples of what you’ve built and how it performed
  • Data-driven mindset: you review your own numbers, spot what’s working, andmake adjustmentswithout being asked
  • Strong working knowledge of HubSpot or Marketo and Salesforce; you understand how leads flow, how campaigns are tracked, and how attribution works
  • Experience with intent data platforms — 6sense,Demandbase, or similar — and the ability to act on those signals in campaign targeting
  • Experience managing agency relationships for paid media (search, display,programmatic) and coordinating creative production
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-moving org — you manage your own calendar, brief your own collaborators, and own your outcomes
  • Strong written communication: you translate complex positioning into campaign copy, clear creative briefs, and executive-ready performance summaries
  • Cross-functional influence: you work well with Sales and can push back when you need to, without burning relationships
  • Fluency in written and spoken English

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience marketing to corporate or government/public sector audiences
  • Familiarity with GEO (generative engine optimization) and how to optimize content for visibility in AI-generated answers
  • Experience with AI SDR platforms or outbound sequencing tools integrated into campaign workflows
  • Background contributing to flagship customer events or user conferences as part of an integrated campaign strategy

About Blackboard

Blackboard is a leading EdTech company and SaaS provider that delivers the digital environment for transformational teaching and learning. We serve thousands of institutions with the industry's most AI-advanced LMS, Blackboard Ally for accessibility, and institutional effectiveness solutions that put educators and learners at the center. We're an education company that builds technology. Learn more at blackboard.com.

BforeAI is an innovative and rapidly expanding scale-up dedicated to deterring cybercrime through cutting-edge predictive and preemptive technologies. We've harnessed the power of prescriptive AI to revolutionize the way we tackle cyber threats, stopping attacks before they launch.

Named by Gartner® in 48 reports over the last 4 years and recognized as a Tech Innovator for Preemptive Cybersecurity in the 2025 Emerging Tech report, BforeAI is the industry’s fastest, most accurate solution for automated protection against online fraud.

Join us in the fight for a safer cyberspace!

🚀 Why it’s great to work here

We are a location-independent company with a fully distributed team. We believe diversity of experience, background, and thinking leads to stronger teams and a better product. We value autonomy, intellectual honesty, practical decision-making, and engineers who take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for perfectly defined tasks.

We offer an intellectually stimulating company environment and you’ll be working with a bright, dedicated team from across the globe. Additionally, we offer flexible time off, sick days, all public holidays, and stock options.

✨ What’s cool about this job

You will work with a dedicated global team on technically difficult problems involving cybersecurity, distributed systems, data engineering, machine learning, and SaaS product development. You will help turn raw and rapidly changing threat information into dependable product behavior. That means writing production services, defining clear boundaries between components, handling failure deliberately, and making results understandable to operators and customers.

📣 What you’ll be doing

You will build Python and Go services, APIs, and customer features using shared data capabilities delivered by Platform Engineering. You'll work with security researchers to implement production detections and expose the supporting evidence through customer workflows. You'll own defined capabilities from technical design through testing, release, and production support, including resolving implementation details and integration requirements.

  • Build and maintain Python and Go services and APIs for product features and detections.
  • Design features around shared identities, evidence, relationships, and history. Reuse existing data capabilities and resolve interface requirements with Platform Engineering.
  • Turn researcher-developed detection methods into tested production services with defined inputs, outputs, and evaluation criteria.
  • Build APIs that expose threat evidence and support customer investigation workflows, working with Product and frontend engineers.
  • Implement reliable reevaluation and customer updates when underlying evidence or intelligence changes.
  • Test failure handling, detection regressions, and authorization boundaries.
  • Design for safe retries, idempotency, and predictable behavior in asynchronous and event-driven workflows.
  • Enforce tenant isolation and access controls; preserve evidence and source context for results.
  • Add observability, investigate production issues, and improve reliability and performance as usage grows.
  • Contribute designs, code reviews, estimates, and documentation; identify unclear requirements and dependencies.
  • Verify AI-generated code before incorporating it into production software.

💥 You’ll be a great fit if

  • Experience building SaaS products and/or product features on shared data platforms.
  • Experience building, shipping, and supporting backend software in production.
  • Strong proficiency in Python or Go, with willingness to develop proficiency in the other language.
  • Experience designing or implementing APIs and integrating services with databases and external or internal systems.
  • Understanding of asynchronous processing, distributed system failure modes, and practical reliability patterns.
  • Ability to write maintainable code and automated tests, review others’ work, and debug production behavior.
  • An understanding of secure software development, authorization, and protecting customer data.
  • Ability to translate product requirements into service designs and implementations, working with domain specialists to resolve unclear requirements.
  • Understanding of how data quality, freshness, relationships, and access permissions affect feature behavior and customer results.
  • Ability to document decisions and coordinate assigned work in a remote team.
  • Willingness to learn AI-assisted development practices and critically evaluate generated code.

You do not need every item below, but relevant experience may help you have an immediate impact:

  • Production experience with both Python and Go.
  • Experience with cybersecurity products, threat intelligence, or detection engineering.
  • Experience with Azure, event-driven architectures, or multitenant applications.
  • Experience building customer features on a data platform, including consuming shared APIs, data models, graph services, or analytical services.
  • Experience working with researchers or integrating ML outputs into production workflows.
  • Practical experience using AI development tools alongside automated testing and code review.

💻 Our environment

Our Azure-based environment includes Go and Python services, Event Hubs and Kafka-compatible messaging, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Explorer, PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Redis, Databricks for appropriate analytics and machine-learning workloads, Kubernetes, and Azure-managed compute services.

Experience with every component is not required. We care more about whether you understand the engineering principles underneath these technologies, can become productive in an unfamiliar environment, and can choose the appropriate combination of managed services and custom software.

At BforeAI, we're dedicated to building a diverse workplace based on merit, work ethics, and character, and we believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success! If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we hope you’ll still consider applying!

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Own the Portfolio: You are the dedicated advisor and primary point of contact for a portfolio of SMB accounts, accountable for their retention, growth, and success. You exercise discretion and independent judgment in how you prioritize and grow each account.
  • Discovery and Diagnosis: You run insight-driven conversations with clients to understand the business objective behind each request, assess account health, and uncover challenges Toptal can solve. You earn the right to recommend before you recommend.
  • Account Planning: You build and execute proactive account plans that connect each client’s business goals to the right Toptal offering, with clear next steps, timing, and expansion targets.
  • Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You expand accounts across Toptal’s full portfolio, including specialized talent, HireGlobal for global hiring and payroll, and our AI-driven, platform-powered services offerings, positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction talent vendor.
  • Qualify, Manage, and Win Expansion: You own expansion from identification through qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close across departments, projects, and offerings. You explain why the relevant offering fits and address concerns, bringing in teammates as subject-matter experts for specialized offerings and working with internal specialists and experts for solution expertise and scoping. You own the client relationship. You maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in Salesforce (SFDC).
  • Uncover Value Early: You monitor demand signals and platform data to offer “uncovered value,” identifying needs before the client voices them, and you use outreach and engagement campaigns, including Salesloft cadences, to educate clients on Toptal’s full breadth of services.
  • Own the Client Experience: You own the client relationship and the client’s experience of every engagement, from kickoff onward. You stay close to active work, address concerns with a client-first mindset, and partner with Talent Operations and Delivery, who execute the work, to keep engagements on track so that retention is earned through results.
  • First Line of Defense: You are the first to respond when a client raises an issue, resolving smaller concerns yourself and escalating to Client Experience when an issue needs more than you can solve on your own. You partner with Talent Operations, Delivery, HireGlobal, and services experts to bring the right expertise into an account at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
  • Meet colleagues across Customer, Talent Operations, Delivery, and HireGlobal to begin your onboarding journey.
  • Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the Account Manager did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales and vertical-specific training, demonstrating fluency in our full range of talent, HireGlobal, and services offerings, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Begin joining client calls, learning who the business partners are on both sides of each relationship and where Toptal can help them grow.
  • Review and prioritize your portfolio, and draft an initial account plan for each of your accounts.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Complete all onboarding and portfolio transitions, and establish yourself as the primary point of contact for your accounts through introduction and discovery calls.
  • Establish a working cadence with key clients and with the team members supporting those accounts, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. Run account health check-ins that surface at least one new business need beyond the client’s original request.
  • Build a qualified expansion pipeline across your portfolio based on priority account plans with consistently high-performing call-quality metrics and accurate forecasts maintained in SFDC.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Execute your account plans and consistently meet or exceed your defined revenue and expansion metrics, with a clear pattern of organic growth across your portfolio.
  • Expand the scope of engagements to include new departments, projects, and offerings, including HireGlobal and services opportunities.
  • Identify where expansion opportunities lose momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Demonstrate portfolio net revenue growth through sustained retention and expansion performance, with a consistent qualified pipeline of new opportunities across your accounts.
  • Be a trusted advisor to your clients, and a reference point for the team on maintaining forecast accuracy, account planning excellence, and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.
  • Mentor new team members, sharing best practices on Toptal’s model and on moving from transactional to consultative account management.
  • Position yourself for senior-level partnership responsibilities.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 3+ years of B2B account management or sales experience, with a demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding revenue-based quotas.
  • 1+ years of experience in a software consulting or tech sales role, with proficiency navigating the software project lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated experience growing and retaining existing client accounts, including proactively creating and closing expansion opportunities, reaching new decision makers, and connecting new business needs to additional solutions.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of accounts in parallel and maintaining momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
  • Ability to translate a client’s business objectives into recommendations and actionable project scopes that demonstrate Toptal’s value.
  • Experience maintaining accurate pipeline, forecast, and account data in a CRM.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a diverse array of clients and competing deadlines. Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to a named sales methodology, such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.
  • Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.
  • Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
  • Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies

These are what we assess for in interviews and coach against after you join.

  • Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You uncover the “why” behind a client’s request.
  • Proactive ownership. You do not wait for a client to name a new opportunity or voice dissatisfaction. You analyze their trajectory, spot gaps, needs, and roadblocks before they occur, and you own the outcome, successes and failures alike.
  • Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk, and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve.
  • Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation, stay current on industry trends, and are willing to respectfully reframe a client’s thinking when their stated request is not the best path to their goal.
  • Portfolio thinking. You see beyond the single engagement and can position specialized talent, HireGlobal, and services offerings as parts of one growth plan.
  • Account discipline. You bring consistent, disciplined account management and process adherence, including rigorous SFDC hygiene, to execute account strategies and long-term growth.
  • Client-centricity. You are committed to the client’s success, across the talent we provide, the experience we offer, and the outcomes we deliver, and you are direct about fit when Toptal is not the right answer.
  • Will to win. You are naturally competitive, with yourself first, and optimistic and ambitious in the face of change. You want to exceed targets, not just meet them.
  • Learn-it-all mindset. You seek feedback, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Collaborative and grounded. Nothing we do is done in isolation. You work as a team within Toptal and within client accounts, and you don’t take yourself too seriously. We are a high-performance team that values authenticity and wit.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. “Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Regional Sales Director

The Regional Sales Director (RSD) will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned region. This leader will be accountable for translating national strategy into regional execution, driving business performance through strong field leadership, cross-functional partnership, and disciplined execution against launch objectives.

The RSD will build and lead a high-performing team of territory managers, foster deep customer relationships, and ensure alignment with corporate priorities, compliance standards, and Mineralys’ values. This is a highly visible field leadership role requiring strong business acumen, launch experience, and the ability to lead with urgency in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership / Launch Execution

  • Lead all regional launch planning and execution activities to ensure successful market entry and sustained product uptake
  • Translate national brand strategy into actionable regional business plans and field execution priorities
  • Lead team to achieve or exceed sales goals, market share targets, and key performance metrics at launch and beyond
  • Monitor market dynamics, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to adjust strategy in real time
  • Drive accountability for performance through data-driven decision making and disciplined execution

Team Leadership / Coaching

  • Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain top-performing territory managers across the region
  • Lead, coach, and motivate a team of approximately 8–12 territory managers
  • Establish and maintain high level of disease state, clinical and product knowledge
  • Evaluate performance of territory managers and coach to skill and career development through regular field contact
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Build strong succession plans and talent pipelines

Customer / Market Engagement

  • Develop and maintain relationships with key healthcare providers, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs) and strategic accounts
  • Partner with territory managers on key customer interactions, access challenges, and develop account strategies
  • Support pull-through with IDNs, organized customers, and priority accounts
  • timely and effectively sharing of customer insights with internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Training, Operations, and HR to support launch readiness and execution
  • Provide field-driven input into brand planning, messaging, and tactical adjustments
  • Collaborate with Area Sales Directors and peers to share best practices and drive consistency across regions
  • Support national meetings, launch planning sessions, and field communications

Compliance / Operational Excellence

  • Ensure all regional activities are conducted in full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and legal standards
  • Manage regional budgets and resources effectively
  • Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM utilization, and reporting discipline
  • Uphold Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech sales experience
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience in a district / regional manager role
  • Proven success leading specialty sales teams and exceeding performance goals
  • Prior launch experience required; first-launch / startup biotech experience strongly preferred
  • Experience in cardiovascular, nephrology, hypertension, or related specialty markets strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated success in recruiting and developing top talent
  • Strong business planning, analytical, and coaching skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment
  • Willingness to travel extensively within region

Leadership Profile

  • A strong coach who develops people and builds winning teams
  • Highly accountable, with a bias for action and urgency
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping build infrastructure
  • Collaborative and able to influence across functions
  • Resilient, adaptable, and energized by launch environments

Travel

  • This position requires up to 60% travel. Frequently travel is outside the local area and overnight.

jobs.description:
React Native Mobile Application Developer

Start Date: November 2026

Job Type: Full-Time

Labor Category: TECH

Location: Remote

Xentity is seeking to fill a React Native Mobile Application Developer position to lead the development and continued enhancement of mobile applications supporting the wildland fire community. The developer will be responsible for designing and implementing mobile experiences used by field personnel and fire management teams, with an emphasis on reliable operation in challenging environments where connectivity may be limited or unavailable.

The position will focus primarily on React Native mobile application development while also contributing to Xentity's React-based web applications. The successful candidate will have hands-on experience developing and supporting at least one production mobile application that has been published to the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and will be able to demonstrate their specific development contributions to that application.

The developer will work extensively with React Native, offline application capabilities, local data storage, mobile mapping, and Esri ArcGIS technologies. The role requires an understanding of the complete mobile application lifecycle, including local development, testing, application configuration, signing, builds, and store submission processes. The developer will not be responsible for operating the mobile CI/CD deployment pipeline, but must have sufficient knowledge of mobile build and deployment processes to define requirements, troubleshoot issues, and effectively support the team responsible for mobile CI/CD.

Position Scope

  • Lead the design and development of React Native mobile applications supporting wildland fire operations and field personnel.
  • Develop mobile applications designed to operate reliably in remote and low-connectivity environments, including offline mapping and data capabilities.
  • Implement mobile mapping functionality using Esri ArcGIS technologies, including maps, feature layers, geographic data, and offline workflows.
  • Work closely with backend, GIS, and web application developers to integrate mobile applications with APIs, data services, and existing Xentity application platforms.
  • Provide technical guidance to the mobile CI/CD team regarding application build requirements, environment configuration, signing, provisioning, testing, and App Store/Google Play release requirements.
  • Troubleshoot mobile build, device, operating system, performance, connectivity, and application issues and work with the appropriate team members to resolve them.
  • Help establish approaches for offline data storage, synchronization, caching, and recovery for field applications.
  • Support application testing across iOS and Android devices and operating system versions.
  • Work directly with product owners, project managers, GIS specialists, UX designers, and wildland fire subject matter experts to translate operational requirements into effective mobile solutions.

Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of professional software development experience.

Required Requirements

  • Must be US Citizen to meet government contract requirements
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a position of Public Trust clearance
  • Demonstrated professional experience developing React Native mobile applications.
  • Must have been a developer on one or more production mobile applications published to the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and be able to describe their specific development role and contributions.
  • Strong experience with React Native and TypeScript.
  • Experience developing mobile mapping applications and working with geospatial data in an offline or constrained-connectivity environment.
  • Required experience with Esri ArcGIS technologies, including the ArcGIS Maps SDK for React Native or equivalent ArcGIS mobile development technologies.
  • Ability to design mobile applications that efficiently manage maps, geographic data, feature layers, and other potentially large datasets on mobile devices.
  • Understanding of Android and iOS application development requirements, including application configuration, permissions, certificates, provisioning, signing, builds, and store requirements.
  • Ability to work effectively with a mobile CI/CD team and provide technical requirements and guidance for mobile builds, testing, signing, and deployment.
  • Experience troubleshooting mobile application issues across both Android and iOS.
  • Strong understanding of mobile application performance, memory management, storage, connectivity, and battery considerations.
  • Experience with Git and modern software development practices.
  • Ability to collaborate with UX designers, web developers, GIS developers, backend developers, project managers, and technical leads.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical documentation skills.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Demonstrated experience implementing offline-capable mobile applications, including local data storage, synchronization, caching, and handling intermittent or unavailable network connectivity.
  • Experience developing native Android applications using Kotlin.
  • Experience developing native iOS applications using Swift.
  • Experience building React Native applications that incorporate native Android or iOS modules.
  • Experience implementing offline GIS workflows, including offline maps, feature data, synchronization, and conflict handling.
  • Experience with Esri ArcGIS Maps SDK for Native Apps, ArcGIS Runtime, ArcGIS Feature Services, ArcGIS Online, or related Esri technologies.
  • Experience with local mobile databases or storage technologies such as SQLite.
  • Familiarity with OAuth and Authentication frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Geospatial formats like KMZ, KML, GeoJSON, Shapeful, FileGDB.
  • Familiarity with Agentic Pair Programming and VS Code.

Job Goal:

  • First 30 days
    • Familiarity with the Application stack and current application and codebase
    • Familiarity with the backlog of tickets and roadmap of the applications
    • Applications running on development platform and able to contribute changes
  • First 60 days
    • Completed ticket work from assigned backlog
  • First 90 days
    • Providing feedback and support with backlog refinement and ticket prioritization and clarity
  • First Year Job Goal
    • Full understanding of application. Deployment of main mobile applications and supporting portfolio of applications.
Salary: 90k- 100k

jobs.description:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified
TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.
Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.
We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.
But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.
At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.
The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

This is the role that owns the first impression. From the moment someone lands on our homepage to the point they hand over their payment details, you’ll shape every critical step. We’re redesigning how millions of pet lovers discover and join TrustedHousesitters - and this hire will lead that work. If you’ve spent your career moving conversion needles, experimenting relentlessly, and building beautiful product at speed, this is your next chapter.

The Role: Experimental, Visual, and Commercial

You’ll own the full acquisition and onboarding experience at TrustedHousesitters - web and mobile - sitting within the New Member Revenue squad. That means everything from the homepage and landing pages through to registration flows, onboarding nudges, and first payment. You’ll work directly with product, engineering, data, CRM, and our CRO Manager, and you’ll have real ownership of the experimentation roadmap for your area.

The challenge is genuinely interesting. Our product is loved - but our acquisition experience needs to match that. We’re running ‘Project Heartbeat’: a push to make TrustedHousesitters feel as aspirational as Airbnb, peppering real trust signals and community moments into journeys that currently skew too utilitarian. You’ll need to balance a high visual bar with a rigorous test-and-learn mindset. Neither alone is enough.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own the acquisition journey end-to-end: From homepage to first payment - web-first, with mobile increasingly in scope - including landing pages, onboarding flows, and lifecycle nudges.

  • Drive conversion through experimentation: Co-own the experimentation roadmap with our CRO Manager: frame hypotheses, define success metrics, and ship rapid tests. You should be able to name the number your last test moved.

  • Raise the visual bar: Strong UI craft is a non-negotiable - every surface you touch should feel considered, current, and well-executed.

  • Translate insight into shipped product: Self-serve with Amplitude, turn quantitative and qualitative signals into testable ideas, and move quickly from insight to design.

  • Shape strategy, not just output: Partner with product, engineering, data, and commercial teams - your voice should be in the room before decisions are made, not after.

    Who you are:

    • The Growth Designer: You’ve owned acquisition or conversion work in-house, at pace - and you can tell the story of an experiment you ran, the hypothesis behind it, and the number it moved.

    • The Visual Craftsperson: Your portfolio stops people. You’ve worked where the visual bar is genuinely high and you hold yourself to that standard regardless of where you are.

    • The Hypothesis Writer: You think in problems before solutions - you can frame a clear problem statement, propose a test, and explain why that test design makes sense.

    • The Collaborator: You treat design as a shared effort, not a hand-off - you partner closely with PMs, engineers, data, and CRM and you’re a stronger designer for it.

    • The B2C Product Thinker: You’ve worked on consumer products - ideally marketplaces or subscriptions - and you understand how trust is built digitally and what actually makes someone convert.

    The Process:

    We value your time and aim for a transparent, efficient process:

    1. Talent Screen: A 20-minute conversation with our Talent team to cover your background, motivations, and the role in detail.

    2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 30-minute call with our Director of Design - a two-way conversation about your craft, your approach to growth design, and whether TrustedHousesitters is the right fit for you.

    3. Portfolio & Technical Review: A deeper session with the team focused on your case studies, your experimentation thinking, and your approach to strategic and UX challenges.

    4. Final Stage: You’ll share a high-level view of what you’d focus on in your first 90 days - not a polished strategy, just your honest read of the opportunity and what you’d want to dig into.

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

🐾 For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits
  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

💜 Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan
  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan
  • Specsavers eyecare scheme
  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions
  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

💻 Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident
  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start
  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe
  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year
  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth
  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

💰 Compensation & time off

  • 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)
  • Competitive salary which is reviewed annually
  • Generous equity package for permanent employees
  • Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly
  • Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters
  • £500 recruitment referral bonus
If you're ready to join us on our mission to become the most loved pet travel solution, we'd love to hear from you!

We partner with our customers to achieve business objectives by using our proven customer-centric, value-driven business practices and service delivery methodologies.

Nüvitek is seeking a ServiceNow QA Tester with at least 3 years of experience in software testing and Agile environments to test ServiceNow applications, validate workflows, develop test cases, and track defects. The ideal candidate has experience with functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing, with familiarity with test automation tools. Candidates must have an active Secret security clearance and a bachelor’s degree in a related field.

In assuming this position, you will be a critical contributor to meeting Nuvitek's mission: To deliver innovative, cost-effective solutions and services that enable our customers to rapidly adapt to dynamic environments.

What you will do

  • Execute functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for ServiceNow applications and workflows.
  • Develop, document, maintain, and execute detailed test cases and UAT scripts based on business requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Perform manual testing of forms, reports, configurations, workflows, and role-based access controls.
  • Execute and maintain automated tests using ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) or comparable test automation tools, as applicable.
  • Validate application enhancements, defect fixes, integrations, data updates, and release changes across development and test environments.
  • Identify, document, track, and retest defects through resolution.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and stakeholders to clarify requirements, confirm expected outcomes, and resolve testing issues.
  • Support UAT coordination, release readiness, production validation, and the collection of test evidence.
  • Maintain accurate testing documentation and ensure results align with applicable security, compliance, and project requirements.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint activities, and release planning to support quality delivery.

What you will bring

  • U.S. citizenship and an active Secret security clearance.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software testing, quality assurance, or test engineering.
  • At least 3 years of experience testing ServiceNow applications or comparable enterprise workflow platforms.
  • At least 3 years of experience working in Agile delivery environments, including user stories, acceptance criteria, and sprint ceremonies.
  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience developing and executing test cases, documenting results, identifying defects, and validating fixes.
  • Experience performing functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing.
  • Familiarity with workflow dependencies, system integrations, data validation, and role-based access controls.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to thorough test coverage, accurate documentation, and clear defect reporting.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing tasks, adapt to changing requirements, and take ownership of assigned deliverables.
  • Sound judgment in resolving issues independently and escalating concerns when appropriate.

It would be great if you also had
  • Experience with ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) or other test automation tools.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
  • ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) certification.
  • Experience supporting federal technology programs or working in environments with applicable security and compliance requirements.
  • Experience supporting enterprise application enhancements, software releases, and workflow changes.

Benefits

Nuvitek is proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package:
  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Disability and Life Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • 401K
  • Paid Time Off
Equal Opportunity Employer StatementNuvitek is an equal-opportunity employer as to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Nüvitek uses artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist with the review and organization of job applications. AI-assisted tools may be used to help identify application information relevant to the position; however, AI does not make hiring decisions. Employment decisions are made by Nüvitek through human review and consideration of candidate qualifications.

jobs.description:
Wer sind wir?

Entstanden sind wir aus Deutschlands größter Finanzbildungsorganisation. Über 250.000 jungen Menschen haben wir gezeigt, wie Finanzen wirklich funktionieren. Aus dieser Mission ist Finanzklar entstanden. Denn Wissen allein reicht nicht – die meisten Menschen scheitern nicht am Verstehen, sondern an der Umsetzung.

Genau hier setzen wir an: Wir helfen ganz konkret dabei, die richtigen Finanzentscheidungen zu treffen. Ohne Provisionslogik gegen den Kunden. Ohne undurchsichtige Produkte. Sondern mit echter, unabhängiger Beratung.

Unsere Mission: Gute Finanzentscheidungen dürfen nicht länger nur den Experten überlassen sein – wir demokratisieren sie.

Und dafür suchen wir dich. Als Werkstudent/in sorgst du dafür, dass Finanzklar dort sichtbar wird, wo Menschen nach Antworten auf ihre Finanzfragen suchen – auf den Seiten, denen sie vertrauen, und in den Suchergebnissen, die sie anklicken. Wir suchen dafür jemanden, der nicht einfach Massenmails verschickt, sondern echte Partnerschaften aufbaut.

Aufgaben

Du baust unser Netzwerk an Kooperationspartnern auf – von der Recherche passender Seiten über die erste Kontaktaufnahme bis zur fertigen Veröffentlichung. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Content-Kooperationen: Partner veröffentlichen Artikel auf unserer Seite, wir veröffentlichen Artikel auf ihrer. So entstehen wertvolle Inhalte für beide Seiten – und hochwertige Backlinks für Finanzklar.

Deine Aufgaben im Detail:

  • Recherche und Identifikation passender Kooperationspartner (z. B. Blogs, Online-Magazine, Fachportale, Newsletter)
  • Bewertung potenzieller Partnerseiten nach Themenrelevanz, Reichweite und Qualität
  • Eigenständige Kontaktaufnahme per E-Mail und LinkedIn sowie professionelles Nachfassen
  • Anbahnung und Abstimmung von Content-Kooperationen – Gastartikel von Partnern auf unserer Seite, Gastbeiträge von Finanzklar auf Partnerseiten
  • Aufbau hochwertiger, themenrelevanter Backlinks im Rahmen dieser Kooperationen
  • Koordination von Themen, Briefings und Veröffentlichungsterminen mit Partnern und internem Team
  • Strukturierte Pflege aller Kontakte, Anfragen und Kooperationsstände in Outreach-Listen bzw. im CRM
  • Monitoring veröffentlichter Beiträge und Backlinks sowie regelmäßiges Reporting der ErgebnisseEnge Abstimmung mit unserer SEO-Agentur und dem Marketing-Team

Qualifikation

Stellenanforderungen – was du mitbringst

Fachlich:

  • Immatrikulation an einer Hochschule, idealerweise in BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Kommunikation, Medien oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
  • Echtes Interesse an Finanzen, Wirtschaft und KI – du bewegst dich gerne in diesen Themenwelten
  • Grundverständnis für SEO und die Bedeutung von Backlinks – oder die Bereitschaft, es schnell zu lernen
  • Erste Erfahrungen in Outreach, Linkbuilding, Kooperationsmanagement oder PR sind ein Plus – kein Muss
  • Affinität zu digitalen Tools – Kenntnisse in SEO-Tools (z. B. Sistrix, Ahrefs oder SEMrush) von Vorteil
  • Sauberes, fehlerfreies Deutsch in Wort und Schrift – Pflicht; gutes Englisch von Vorteil

Kommunikativ:

  • Freude an schriftlicher Kommunikation – du formulierst Anfragen, die gelesen und beantwortet werden
  • Sicheres, sympathisches Auftreten gegenüber Redaktionen, Seitenbetreibern und Partnern
  • Hartnäckigkeit und Frustrationstoleranz – nicht jede Anfrage wird beantwortet, und das bringt dich nicht aus dem Takt
  • Gespür dafür, welche Themen und Partner zu Finanzklar passen – und welche nicht

Persönlich:

  • Hohe Eigenmotivation – du treibst dich selbst an, auch wenn niemand nachfragt
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Lernbereitschaft – du bist bereit, in kurzer Zeit viel aufzunehmen und anzuwenden
  • Strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise – du behältst den Überblick über viele parallele Kontakte und dokumentierst sauber
  • Offenheit für Feedback und Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Teamfähigkeit – du arbeitest eng mit dem Marketing-Team und unserer SEO-Agentur zusammen und kommunizierst proaktiv

Vorerfahrung im Linkbuilding oder Outreach ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss. Entscheidend ist, wer du als Mensch bist, nicht was auf deinem Lebenslauf steht.

Benefits

Was du bekommst

  • 15–20 Stunden pro Woche, flexibel planbar rund um deinen Vorlesungsplan
  • 100 % Remote – du arbeitest ortsunabhängig von überall aus
  • Direkter Einblick in SEO und Content-Marketing – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer SEO-Agentur
  • Einen Platz in einem Team, das wächst, direkt kommuniziert und zusammenhält
  • Echte Entwicklungsperspektive: wer hier gut wird, übernimmt wachsende Verantwortung und baut unser Partnernetzwerk aktiv mit auf
  • Ein Unternehmen mit echter Mission – du hilfst Menschen, bessere finanzielle Entscheidungen zu treffen
  • Praxiserfahrung, die sich gut im Lebenslauf macht – inklusive Option auf Übernahme nach dem Studium

Position Overview

The AEM Technical Architect owns the architecture and technical direction of complex Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) solutions and digital experience engagements. The role translates business, functional, security, data, integration, performance, and operational requirements into scalable technical designs, implementation patterns, and delivery plans.

This individual leads AEM solution architecture and technical consulting across the project lifecycle, from discovery and estimates through implementation and quality reviews. Working with clients and cross-functional teams, the architect evaluates technology options, resolves architectural risks, guides engineers, and ensures solutions support maintainable, high-performing digital experiences.

Location: Remote - United States

Key Responsibilities

AEM Solution Architecture & Technical Direction

  • Lead architecture and technical direction for sophisticated AEM-centric websites, content management, and digital experience solutions, including integration with other enterprise systems.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into architecture designs covering system boundaries, interfaces, data flows, deployment approaches, performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Evaluate AEM and adjacent platform capabilities, existing infrastructure, implementation constraints, technical debt, and build-versus-buy options; document decisions and tradeoffs.
  • Diagnose client technical environments and recommend practical architecture and performance improvements.

Delivery Governance & Engineering Quality

  • Guide full-lifecycle solution delivery, including technical discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, and solution readiness.
  • Govern implementation quality through design reviews, architecture checkpoints, risk and exception management, and clear architectural decision records.
  • Provide technical direction to engineering teams on scalable implementation patterns, integrations, troubleshooting, and web performance.
  • Assess complex technical issues, develop solution options, and present recommendations and long-term implications to stakeholders.

Client, Presales & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with client leaders and internal Solutions, Product, Data, Quality, Delivery, and Engineering teams to align technical decisions with business objectives.
  • Support presales discovery, technical scoping, feasibility analysis, solution estimates, and identification of risks and dependencies.
  • Communicate sophisticated architecture decisions clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences and build trusted client relationships.

Mentorship & Practice Improvement

  • Mentor Lead Engineers and Engineers, provide technical guidance, and support knowledge sharing and effective project delivery practices.
  • Develop reusable architecture patterns, accelerators, standards, and lessons learned; stay current with AEM capabilities and evolving engineering practices.

Required Skills & Experience

Architecture & Consulting Leadership

  • 10+ years of relevant software engineering, solution architecture, web content management, or equivalent technical experience, aligned with the 5B Technical Architect level.
  • Experience owning architecture and key technical decisions for complex client engagements, products, or digital solution domains.
  • Experience translating functional and nonfunctional requirements into solution designs, implementation plans, estimates, and architecture decisions.
  • Strong client consulting, stakeholder facilitation, written and verbal communication, and technical presentation skills.

Adobe Experience Manager & Web Technologies

  • Demonstrated expertise designing and leading Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) solutions and integrations with enterprise systems.
  • Proficiency in object-oriented design and Java-based application architecture; understanding of web application performance, troubleshooting, and optimization.
  • Knowledge of web and integration technologies such as RESTful services, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, XML, SQL, HTTP, web servers, and content delivery networks.
  • Ability to evaluate architectural tradeoffs, reliability, security, scalability, technical debt, and production-readiness considerations.

Delivery, Collaboration & Governance

  • Experience conducting design reviews, managing technical risks and dependencies, and guiding engineering teams through complex implementation challenges.
  • Experience working with Agile delivery approaches, including Scrum, and supporting technical scoping and estimation.
  • Ability to mentor engineers and collaborate across product, data, quality, delivery, and client teams.
  • Ability to travel up to 40% as required by client assignments.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience with AEM as a Cloud Service and AEM-specific technologies such as Apache Sling, OSGi, JCR, Dispatcher, and related caching or CDN configurations.
  • Familiarity with UNIX/Linux environments, Apache web servers, TCP/IP networking, debugging tools, and advanced XML integration patterns.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Expectations

Lead architecture and technical delivery within an assigned engagement, product, or domain; make key discipline decisions, manage architecture risks, mentor engineers, and drive high-quality outcomes. An 85% utilization target applies. Depending on client assignments and specialization, additional platform expertise, technical skills, certifications, domain knowledge, or travel may be expected.

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is $165,000 - $200,000 annually. Actual compensation may vary depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors.

Blue Acorn iCi, a business unit of Infosys Nova Holdings, LLC, is a digital experience partner helping global brands design, build, and optimize the future of customer engagement. Specializing in the Adobe Experience Cloud, we provide end-to-end services across commerce, content, analytics, and customer insights. Backed by Infosys, we’re growing fast—and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

Regional Vice President, Strategic Sales

at Motive - Eastern Region

Who we are:

Motive builds technology to improve the safety, productivity, and profitability of businesses that power the physical economy. Motive combines IoT hardware with AI-powered applications to connect and automate physical operations. Motive is one of the fastest-growing software companies in the world, serving more than 120,000 businesses, across a wide range of industries including trucking and logistics, construction, oil and gas, food and beverage, field service, agriculture, passenger transit, and delivery.

Motive is built on four foundational attributes; Own It, Less but Better, Build Trust, and Unlock Potential. While most of our employees are remote, many have the opportunity to work on-site at any of our 8 global office locations. Visit our careers website to learn more about opportunities at Motive.

About the Role:

As a Regional Vice President, Strategic East Sales at Motive, you will be a key leader in our fastest growing segment at Motive. Our RVPs manage a team of Strategic Account Executives and guide them in both engaging and closing Motive’s largest prospects. You’ll lead initiatives across hiring, coaching, and enablement to support Motive’s growth & success. Your team will sell into the most impactful companies in North America that power the physical economy.

We are seizing the opportunity created by our strong product positioning in the market by heavily investing across all Go-To-Market (GTM) teams within our Enterprise segment. You will lead the charge, selling the value of our products and the business outcomes that can be achieved for our customers in partnership with Motive.

Our Strategic Sales team sells consistently into Fortune 500 companies across multiple industries, including trucking, oil & gas, construction, agriculture, manufacturing, consumer transit, or any other business that requires a fleet of vehicles. In this high-energy role, you should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with high standards of quality.

  • Collaborate with your Account Executives and directly engage high-priority client prospects to help sell the value of Motive

jobs.title: Remote AWS Senior Cloud Architect - Ireland
jobs.excerpt: Join Our Team – Contractors or Employees Welcome | Remote Across Europe We’re on the lookout for talented AWS Cloud Architects to join our growing team.
jobs.description:
Join Our Team – Contractors or Employees Welcome | Remote Across Europe

We’re on the lookout for talented AWS Cloud Architects to join our growing team. If you're an experienced Senior Architect/ Engineer or have 5+ years in the field, this is your opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking company where innovation drives our success and shapes the future of cloud technology.

Who we are

We’re a professional services company with a difference!

We work as a 100% remote team, engineering cutting-edge, transformational technology solutions that deliver rapid business results for our clients. Our core expertise lies in serverless architecture and implementation, cloud migration, and modernisation of critical business systems. While many prefer to build complex solutions from scratch, we excel at simplifying complex problems and delivering simple, effective solutions.

As a certified AWS Consulting Partner, we bring advanced cloud expertise to every project.

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!

What will you do

As an AWS Cloud Architect, you’ll play a pivotal role within our team, specialising in designing, building and implementing cloud solutions, creating and optimising cloud infrastructure, developing software applications, integrating systems, and defining architecture best practices. In collaboration with both our team at fourTheorem and our clients, you'll contribute to crafting solutions that tackle complex business challenges. Your expertise will be instrumental in shaping and empowering our clients' teams by providing valuable guidance and knowledge. Tasks include:

  • Architect and design scalable, secure, and highly available cloud solutions on AWS, using best practices in DevOps and cloud-native design.
  • Implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like CloudFormation or Terraform to enable efficient and consistent deployments.
  • Work collaboratively with fourTheorem colleagues and our customers to understand business goals, incrementally deliver new technology to meet those goals, reduce complexity and demonstrate the impact of our approach.
  • Automate the deployment, configuration, and management of infrastructure and services using CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitHub Actions.
  • Collaborate with development and operations teams to define and implement strategies for monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as Amazon CloudWatch or third-party solutions.
  • Optimise applications for cost, performance, and security and work with clients on best practices for infrastructure, data, and application deployment.
  • Mentor and guide teams on AWS architecture patterns, DevOps methodologies, and operational best practices.
  • Evaluate and integrate third-party tools and services into applications to enhance automation, performance, and security.

What will you bring

  • 5+ years of experience building and/or architecting distributed applications on AWS.
  • Software development skills with a focus on cloud applications.
  • An understanding of the benefits and drawbacks of any approach, with the ability to make trade-offs to ensure that a solution is right for the customer.
  • Strong proficiency in AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, EC2, API Gateway, IAM, or S3.
  • Hands-on experience with automation and IaC tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.
  • Proficiency in building and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or AWS CloudWatch.
  • Proven ability to architect solutions that meet business and technical requirements while balancing performance, scalability, and cost.
  • Communication skills, with a focus on listening and understanding first, but also presenting high-level solutions and implementation details to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Our aim is not to intimidate our customers or colleagues by the un-necessary use of jargon - translating complex technology into plain english understandable by all is our main goal.

Looking for the right fit, not just a checklist

We believe in finding the right fit, not just ticking boxes. While we’re looking for the experience above, we also value the unique skills and experiences you bring. If you're passionate about cloud technology, eager to learn, and ready to make an impact, we encourage you to apply. We're flexible and open to making trade-offs to find the right fit for you and the team.

Some of what we offer

Fully Remote: No office, no commute, no problem!

Flexible Hours: We trust you to manage your time - flex your schedule to fit your life.

Annual Leave: 25 days annual leave, in addition to public holidays.

Team Meet Ups: Meet the crew four times a year.

Macbook: Relax - your MacBook is taken care of.

Co-working Allowance: Need a change of scenery? We’ll chip in for your co-working spot.

A culture of respect, collaboration, and inclusion

We respect and value learning at all stages of your career. We believe in listening to ideas from everyone, regardless of experience, and fostering a culture of collaboration. We prioritise team performance over individual contribution, supporting each other and stepping outside the "lane" of any given role to get the job done.

We’re building a team where everyone’s welcome, no matter your background, identity, or how you show up in the world. We believe in respect, fairness, and giving everyone a real shot to grow, thrive, and do great work together.

If you require any reasonable accommodations during the hiring process, please reach out via email to

If you enjoy being part of a collaborative, creative team that is not afraid to challenge others or be challenged, you’ll be a great fit here!

jobs.title: Principal Technical Marketing Engineer  | Sweden | Remote
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Labs is looking for a technically fluent engineer who loves building powerful demos, explaining complex systems clearly, and helping SRE and platform engineering leaders understand the value of our open approach to observability.

As Grafana’s offering shifts from dashboards to industry-leading agentic observability, our Product Marketing team is responsible for closing the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. That means building clear, consistent positioning, enabling sellers with trustworthy technical narratives, and creating content that helps Platform Engineering teams quickly grasp why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them.

As a Technical Product Marketer you will play a critical part in that transformation. You’ll be the hands-on engineer who brings our technical story to life for buyers, not just practitioners. You’ll build core demos, run technical workshops and webinars, and act as the technical bridge between our Product and Sales orgs. Your work will help SRE and platform engineering leaders evaluate Grafana with confidence, equip sales engineers with better tools and talk tracks, and ensure our technical value shows up clearly and consistently across the entire customer journey.

This is a unique chance to shape how Grafana tells its story as we evolve our positioning in the AI era, strengthen seller enablement, and build a repeatable system for communicating product value.

What You'll Be Doing:

Build strategic, buyer-focused demos, videos, workshops, and webinars

  • Create and maintain polished, narrative-driven demos that highlight Grafana’s value for SRE and platform engineering leaders.
  • Record high-quality technical demo videos and walkthroughs in partnership with our video and content teams.
  • Lead webinars, workshops, and technical sessions designed for evaluators.
  • Teach customers not just how Grafana works, but why our approach is differentiated and valuable.
  • Use AI tools to generate variations, summaries, and reusable assets that scale technical content across channels.

Enable Solutions (Sales) Engineers with clear, consistent technical storytelling

  • Serve as PMM’s technical liaison to the SE org, ensuring consistent messaging and demo guidance.
  • Produce technical enablement assets, value-driven talk tracks, competitive narratives, and demo best practices.
  • Help SEs and sellers communicate Grafana’s story with clarity, confidence, and differentiation.

Collaborate with PMMs to drive technical buyer engagement across high-impact channels

  • Partner with PMMs to identify the most important buyer personas, problems, and technical messages, and help shape the content strategy needed to reach them.
  • Extend technical narratives into impactful buyer-facing channels including analyst briefings (Gartner, Forrester), industry forums, podcasts, conferences, and online technical communities.
  • Bring a technical perspective to PMM planning—helping ensure our content, campaigns, and enablement reflect the real challenges and priorities of SREs and engineering leaders.

Use automation & AI to scale technical content

  • Partner with software engineers to streamline demo setup, content workflows, and asset updates through workflows, agents, scripts, and AI-driven tools.
  • Use automation to make technical content more repeatable, discoverable, and scalable across teams.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 5+ years in a technical role (solutions engineering, SRE, DevOps, backend engineering, technical PMM, or similar).
  • Interest and ability to travel to training and customer events 10-12 weeks per year.
  • Strong understanding of observability concepts and the needs of SRE/platform teams.
  • Ability to translate deep technical concepts into clear, value-focused stories.
  • Experience presenting technical content through demos, workshops, or webinars.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a crisp, structured, persuasive style.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration; comfort working with PMM, Product, SEs, DevRel, and Field Engineering.
  • High ownership mindset with the ability to drive projects from concept to completion.
  • Comfort with light scripting or workflow automation.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, or similar observability tools, or a background in Observability or Platform Engineering.
  • Prior experience in Sales Engineering, DevRel, or technical product marketing.
  • Familiarity with demo environment automation or infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Exceptional live presentation or workshop facilitation skills.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Sweden, the base compensation range for this role is SEK 878,578 - SEK 1,054,294. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.
