Job Description:

The Programmatic Specialist is responsible for supporting channel strategy, execution and stewardship of effective programmatic campaigns on behalf of a major, high-profile advertiser. This individual will have experience with campaign management, programmatic execution, and has hands-on experience in self-serve advertising platforms. Experience executing various campaign types including online display, video, and audio, in an agency environment is required.

This Programmatic Specialist will have a firm grasp and ability to navigate intricacies of hyper targeted, complex campaigns as well as an understanding of basic digital metrics and calculations, media measurement, terminology, and how these impact delivery and performance. The nature of this role requires extreme attention to detail and above average data management skills, heavily leveraging Microsoft Excel, to ensure correct application of a large amount of campaign parameters and for performance monitoring and reporting.

This Programmatic Specialist will possess knowledge of ad serving technology and an emerging understanding of supply chain partnerships in the programmatic ecosystem. They are comfortable participating in client meetings and possess knowledge of trends and new partnerships.

KEY OUTCOMES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Planning, Strategy, and Programmatic Expertise Development

  • Kick oﬀ the planning process by working cross functionally with Channel Manager, Integrated Planning and Account teams. Provide guidance and answer questions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather insights, identify new opportunities, and provide strategic recommendations and optimizations that exceed campaign benchmarks and align with client goals and challenges
  • Continuously analyze key performance metrics to measure eﬀectiveness of campaign initiatives.
  • Support materials like POVs and other thought leadership to educate internal and client stakeholders on strategy shifts, account restructuring etc.
  • Stay updated on the latest paid programmatic tools, applications, and strategies, providing client-relevant research, analysis and trends.

Effective Campaign Management and Performance Optimization

  • Manage and execute programmatic campaigns across display, audio, video, and digital out-of-home, ensuring adherence to budgets and timelines while ensuring KPIs are met or exceeded.
  • QA campaigns to ensure accuracy and proactively troubleshoot any errors or mismatches.
  • Bring forward suggestions on campaign optimizations, addressing delivery toward campaign objectives through best practices within bid management, audience and placement analysis, and performance tracking of key KPIs.
  • Conduct ongoing delivery pacing checks and provide comprehensive weekly, monthly, and campaign wrap-up reports.
  • Develop and maintain positive relationships with digital media partners, ensuring eﬀective collaboration and communication.
  • Support in the communication, evaluation, and implementation of programmatic media partners, technology, and platforms, including Private Marketplace (PMP) and Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) deals.

Data-driven Insights and Reporting

  • Leverage advanced Excel functions (Pivot Tables, VLookups, Concatenates, and IF statements) to gather, analyze, and articulate mid-level insights on campaign performance to maximize results.
  • Accurate QA of all data including PowerBI models.
  • Ability to address questions, articulating campaign performance and trend analysis to internal and external parties via detailed written and verbal summaries.
  • Monitor performance against measurement frameworks and push for higher quality delivery by evaluating delivery, audience analysis, supply path optimization, and placement performance.
  • Manage multiple client campaigns, ensuring high-quality performance, and results that align with our client’s business objectives.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of changes, trends, and learnings to inform future campaign strategy and optimization.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Additional accountabilities and tasks may be assigned by leader/management, to contribute to overall team and agency sucess.

This is NOT a client-facing role.

Familiarity openness to AI tools is preferred (Claude, AI planning tools, etc.)

REQUIRED –

  • Minimum 2-4 years of experience managing campaigns in the digital marketing ecosystem
  • Strong knowledge/familiarity of DV360
  • High level of proficiency in Excel, being able to create &/or utilize formulas, VLookups, concatenate and other functions

• PREFERRED –

  • Experience in hands on execution of advertising within biddable platforms (programmatic, paid search, paid social, media operations, ad operations, etc.). DV360 skills a must!
  • Experience in strategic planning and applied experience of bringing plans to execution.
  • Experience involving heavy utilization of MS Excel (or similar tools) to manage large amounts of data with precision and accuracy.
  • Proven track record in operating with a high-level of integrity, commitment, and enthusiasm to take on a challenging role with cross-functional commitments.

CORE COMPETENCIES

  • CUSTOMER FOCUS/CLIENT INTIMACY: seeking to understand client business challenges/needs and delivering continuous value to our clients
  • COLLABORATIVE: working with teams and across the organization with ease
  • OWNER AGILITY: able to continuously learn and quickly adapt to changing circumstances
  • RESULTS DRIVEN: accepts accountability to deliver business outcomes, even under changing circumstances. Delivers on commitments
  • DISCIPLINED: Thinks, plans, and prioritizes work on an ongoing basis; plans and aligns with key team members before acting

jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role.

What you'll do:
  • Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering.
  • Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries.
  • Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams.
What you'll bring:

Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below.

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful.
  • Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling.
  • Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use.
How you work:
  • You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state.
  • You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve.
  • You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns.
  • You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment.
  • You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

At WelbeHealth, we serve our communities’ most vulnerable seniors through shared intention, pioneering spirit, and the courage to love. These core values and our participant focus lead the way no matter what.

The Senior Facilities Manager provides strategic and operational leadership for WelbeHealth’s facilities portfolio, including new site development, ongoing facility operations, maintenance, vendor performance, equipment and supplies, occupancy services, and financial oversight. This role builds the infrastructure, standards, systems, and team capabilities needed to scale the facilities function as the organization grows. The Senior Facilities Manager creates, owns, and drives consistent enterprise processes, identifies and delivers continuous improvement opportunities, establishes performance measures and governance, and translates business needs into sustainable, repeatable solutions.

This role is different because the Senior Facilities Manager WelbeHealth:

  • Owns the strategy and execution of facilities operations across a growing, multi-state portfolio, building scalable systems, standardized processes, and vendor partnerships that support new market launches and ongoing operational excellence
  • Drives cross-functional collaboration and continuous improvement by partnering with market leaders and internal stakeholders to optimize facility performance, manage costs, mitigate operational risks, and deliver safe, reliable, and compliant environments that support our participants and team members

We care about our team members. That’s why we offer:

On the day-to-day, you will:

Who We Are

Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. Just as importantly, we empower our people—providing the tools, support, and opportunities they need to grow and succeed.

We don’t just make bold promises—we deliver results. As the largest cloud-based software provider for the Property & Casualty market, Insurity is trusted by 22 of the top 25 P&C carriers and 7 of the top 10 wholesale brokers in the MGA space. Behind that trust is a team that delivers exceptional value and deep industry expertise.

While our technology sets us apart, it’s our people who truly make the difference. At Insurity, you’ll collaborate with some of the most creative and knowledgeable minds in insurance tech—in a culture that fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning. Our award-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer.

Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you. #UatInsurity

Insurity’s Next Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

Insurity is seeking a strategic, operational, and technically credible Chief Information Security Officer to lead Insurity’s enterprise security, cybersecurity risk and privacy programs.

The CISO will protect Insurity’s information assets, products, customer environments, and technology ecosystem while enabling growth, cloud adoption, international expansion, and responsible use of artificial intelligence. This leader will translate cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, and technology risk into clear business decisions for executive leadership and the Board.

The successful candidate will combine executive presence with practical execution. They need to be comfortable setting strategy, leading through influence, engaging with customers executives and regulators, directing major incidents, reviewing architecture, and building the processes, team, and culture required for a growing SaaS company.

 What Our Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) Will Do

Enterprise security strategy and governance

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve Insurity’s enterprise information security strategy, policies, standards, and control framework.
  • Establish security priorities that align with business strategy, product roadmaps, customer commitments, and the organization’s risk appetite.
  • Reinforce an enterprise security governance structure, including executive steering forums and appropriate reporting to the executive team and Board of Directors.
  • Define clear accountability for security across Engineering, Product, Corporate IT, Cloud Operations, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance business functions.
  • Provide risk-mitigating direction for initiatives with technology, data, cloud, product, or customer-security implications.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of emerging threats, technologies, regulations, and business risks.

HIPAA, PHI data protection

  • Own and mature Insurity’s HIPAA compliance and electronic protected health information program where applicable to Insurity’s products, services, customers, vendors, and business operations.
  • Lead documented HIPAA risk analyses, risk treatment plans, control testing, remediation tracking, and periodic program evaluations.
  • Ensure appropriate administrative, physical, and technical safeguards for protected health information, including access control, authentication, audit controls, integrity, transmission security, encryption, contingency planning, and workforce security.
  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Product, and Customer Success on the HIPAA Privacy, Security, and Breach Notification Rules.
  • Establish requirements for Business Associate Agreements, customer obligations, subcontractors, cloud providers, and other third parties that create, receive, maintain, or transmit PHI.
  • Maintain audit-ready evidence and support customer diligence, independent assessments, regulatory inquiries, and OCR requests.
  • Lead the security component of PHI breach assessment, containment, investigation, notification coordination, and post-incident remediation.
  • Ensure HIPAA-specific workforce training, sanctions, and awareness requirements are incorporated into the broader security program.

AI security, governance, and responsible adoption

  • Establish and lead Insurity’s enterprise AI security and governance program.
  • Maintain an inventory of AI, machine learning, large language model, generative AI, and agentic systems used, developed, procured, or embedded in Insurity products and operations.
  • Define AI intake, risk classification, ownership, approval gates, prohibited uses, and human-oversight requirements.
  • Establish secure-use standards for generative AI, including requirements for confidential information, PHI, PII, customer data, source code, proprietary data, prompts, outputs, retention, and model training.
  • Define controls for AI-specific risks, including prompt injection, data leakage, insecure agents and tools, model abuse, data poisoning, supply-chain risk, unauthorized access, and unreliable or harmful outputs.
  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Product, Engineering, Data, and Compliance to address transparency, intellectual property & data rights of emerging AI regulations.
  • Incorporate AI security and governance requirements into procurement, third-party risk management, secure development, cloud architecture, product reviews, and customer commitments.

Risk management, compliance, and assurance

  • Develop a risk-based process for identifying, assessing, prioritizing, treating, and accepting information security and technology risks across Insurity’s ecosystem.
  • Maintain alignment with applicable requirements and leading practices, including HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR & the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
  • Orchestrate internal and external audits through planning, evidence collection, testing, findings management, remediation, and executive reporting.
  • Establish control ownership, evidence standards, issue-management processes, and sustainable remediation tracking.
  • Advise management on the costs, value, and risks of security and technology investments.
  • Support cyber-insurance requirements, underwriting reviews, claims preparation, and risk-improvement initiatives.
  • Monitor regulatory and contractual changes and translate them into practical requirements, policies, and implementation plans.
  • Report material risks, exceptions, incidents, and remediation plans to executive leadership and the Board.

Security operations and incident response

  • Lead the enterprise security operations program, including monitoring, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, detection and response, penetration testing, and security investigations.
  • Manage security incident response coordinating both internally and externally from inception to resolution.
  • Maintain an incident response program that covers cyber incidents, privacy events, PHI incidents, ransomware, cloud compromise, insider threats, supply-chain events, and AI-related incidents.
  • Lead security incident response partnering with Insurity’s COO and CLO while remaining sufficiently engaged in technical and operational details.
  • Establish escalation criteria, severity definitions, communications protocols, evidence-preservation practices, and post-incident review requirements.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Communications, customers, insurers, law enforcement, and regulators as appropriate.
  • Measure response effectiveness through exercises, lessons learned, time-to-detect, time-to-contain, time-to-recover, and remediation completion.
  • Lead regular cyber crisis tabletop exercises and simulations with executive leadership, key operational teams, customers, and external partners where appropriate.
  • Maintain crisis communications and breach-disclosure playbooks in partnership with Legal, Communications, Privacy, and executive leadership.
  • Ensure lessons from incidents and exercises are converted into funded improvements.

Product, application, cloud, and infrastructure security

  • Embed security-by-design into product development, architecture, engineering, DevOps, and change-management processes.
  • Establish and oversee application security practices, including secure coding, threat modeling, SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, penetration testing, vulnerability disclosure, and release gates.
  • Lead software supply-chain security, including dependency governance, SBOMs, artifact integrity, code-signing expectations, CI/CD controls, and third-party component risk.
  • Oversee cloud-security architecture, identity and access management, encryption, secrets management, network segmentation, logging, monitoring, data-loss prevention, and secure configuration management.
  • Promote Zero Trust principles, least privilege, strong authentication, secure-by-default configurations, and continuous control monitoring.
  • Review and approve security architecture for major products, platforms, infrastructure changes, AI systems, and customer-facing capabilities.

Third-party risk, customer trust, and commercial enablement

  • Establish a risk-based third-party security and privacy program covering vendors, cloud providers, subprocessors, partners, supply-chain participants, and other external parties.
  • Ensure contracts, security requirements, audit rights, breach obligations, data-use restrictions, and Business Associate obligations are addressed with Legal and Procurement.
  • Establish and maintain data classification, data inventory, data-flow, retention, deletion, residency, and access-governance practices.
  • Ensure security requirements are addressed across the lifecycle of customer, employee, regulated, confidential, and proprietary information.

Leadership, organization, and culture

  • Build and lead a cost-efficient, high-performing security organization with appropriate direct and dotted-line relationships across Engineering, Product, IT, Cloud Operations, Privacy, Compliance, and other functions.
  • Hire, develop, coach, and retain security talent while establishing clear operating rhythms and accountability.
  • Create and manage security awareness and role-based training for employees, contractors, approved system users, developers, administrators, and executives.
  • Promote a culture in which security is viewed as an enabler of customer trust, product quality, resilience, and business growth.
  • Manage the security budget, partner strategy, managed service providers, and external security resources.
  • Define and report meaningful security metrics, risk indicators, maturity measures, control health, remediation progress, incident trends, audit results, customer commitments, and AI-governance metrics.

Who We’re Looking For 

  • A strategic leader and builder who can establish vision, create alignment, and execute through influence.
  • A credible executive communicator who can brief the Board, lead a crisis, engage customers, and explain complex issues in simple terms.
  • A pragmatic security leader who balances risk reduction, business enablement, customer commitments, speed, and cost.
  • A collaborative partner to Engineering, Product, IT, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership.
  • A calm, decisive leader who can operate effectively in high-pressure, high-stakes situations.
  • A leader who is comfortable working hands-on when necessary while building a scalable team and operating model.

Required qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in information security, computer science, information technology, business, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 8–10 years of progressive experience in information security, cybersecurity, technology risk, or related disciplines within a SaaS, cloud, technology, insurance, healthcare, or other regulated environment.
  • At least 5 years of executive or senior leadership experience in a CISO, Deputy CISO, Head of Security, or comparable role.
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating an enterprise security program across a distributed or remote organization.
  • Experience with HIPAA, ePHI, Business Associate requirements, healthcare data protection, or comparable regulated-data obligations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading security risk assessments, audits, remediation programs, and regulatory or customer assurance activities.
  • Experience leading material incidents, crisis response, business continuity, disaster recovery, and executive communications.
  • Experience establishing or operating an AI security, AI governance, responsible AI, model-risk, or secure-generative-AI program.
  • Strong understanding of cloud, SaaS operating models, identity, encryption, application security, vulnerability management, incident response, and third-party risk.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-influencing skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, partners, vendors, priorities, and complex cross-functional programs.

Preferred qualifications

  • CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, or equivalent certification.
  • Experience with SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, NIST AI RMF, or comparable frameworks.
  • Experience with AI/ML security, LLM security, agent security, model risk management, AI impact assessments, or AI red teaming.
  • Experience supporting customer security reviews, RFPs, renewals, and executive-level trust discussions.
  • Experience in insurance technology, property and casualty insurance, healthcare technology, or another data-intensive regulated industry.
  • Experience with cyber-risk quantification, cyber insurance, secure software supply chains, DevSecOps, and cloud-native security.

What’s In It For U 

Work Where You Thrive
Find the work environment that supports your best—whether that’s remote, in-office, or hybrid—depending on your role and location. Our Flex First Workforce approach offers many fully remote opportunities, while some teams follow hybrid or in-office schedules to stay connected and collaborative.

Take Time When You Need It
We trust our team to manage their time with our Open PTO Policy, empowering you to recharge when it matters most.

Benefits That Start on Day One
Enjoy comprehensive health coverage and employer-matched retirement savings right from your first day—because we know how important these are to you.

Living Our Values Every Day
Our core values are more than words on a wall—they guide how we hire, grow, and retain the very best talent.

Award-Winning Onboarding
From your first day to your first anniversary, our onboarding program is designed to set you up for success and help you make an immediate impact.

Grow Your Career from Within
We believe in promoting from within. In fact, over 25% of our open roles are filled by internal candidates.

Mentorship That Matters
Our mentorship program connects you with experienced leaders who are committed to helping you grow both personally and professionally.

Insurity Podcasts
Explore podcasts from our Learning & Development team for deeper insight into Insurity products, company innovation, and the business as a whole.

Keep Learning, Always
Fuel your growth with full access to LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan—because continuous development is key to success.

Invest in Your Future—And Your Family’s
Through our partnership with the University of Arizona Global Campus, you and your family can access discounted tuition and pursue educational goals affordably.

Earn When You Refer
Love where you work? Invite others to join us! Our Employee Referral Bonus program rewards you for bringing great people on board.

Insurity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer 

We are dedicated to creating an exceptional work environment for all our employees by extending a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging into the very fabric of our organization.  We embrace differences and diversity of identity, experience, and thought, and actively strive for inclusive behaviors across our company.

jobs.description:
Hypori, Inc. is a high-growth cybersecurity SaaS company transforming how organizations think about secure mobility. Our virtual workspace platform enables users to access enterprise apps and data from any mobile device—with zero data on the endpoint and total personal privacy. Backed by $55M in funding from investors including UBS, AE Industrial Partners, Hale Capital Partners, and GreatPoint Ventures, Hypori is expanding into new commercial and regulated markets. Learn more at hypori.com.

Hypori is looking for a builder-minded Channel Account Manager to join our growing commercial sales team. You will recruit, enable, and drive revenue through the MSSPs, MSPs, RPOs, and C3PAOs that serve small and mid-size defense contractors, building partners who sell, deploy, and support Hypori on their own. You will report to the VP of Commercial Sales.

More than 100,000 companies sit in the Defense Industrial Base, and most buy security from the partner that runs their IT. Hypori gives those partners a proven answer: more than 95,000 Department of War users are on the platform today, and we hold IL5, FedRAMP High, NIAP Common Criteria, NSA CSfC, CMMC 2.0 Level 2, and SOC 2 Type II, so it clears review with defense clients. The DIB partner program is being built from scratch, and the person in this seat builds it.

Responsibilities

  • Own an annual target for new MSSP, MSP, RPO, and C3PAO partners serving defense contractors
  • Source partners through outbound, the CMMC practitioner community, and events including CMMC CON, AFCEA small business forums, and Hypori CMMC Accelerate
  • Understand the partner’s why first: why add Hypori, why now for their clients, what it does for their practice and margin, and why not stick with the status quo
  • Qualify partners on DIB client base, CUI exposure, GCC High or enclave practice, and willingness to sell, then negotiate and sign agreements across referral, co-sell, and resell tiers
  • Take every new partner to first transaction on a defined timeline, and move partners from referral to selling on their own as an extension of Hypori
  • Build and run the partner certification path with the channel sales engineer
  • Get partner sellers ready to position isolation and defend the scope reduction argument to their clients
  • Own partner content, deal registration, the partner portal, and the enablement calendar
  • Carry a partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue number and forecast it accurately in Salesforce
  • Run joint business plans and quarterly business reviews with top partners, and co-sell into partner client bases with Hypori account executives and sales engineers
  • Work with Carahsoft, our distributor, on distribution and procurement paths, including opportunities under 100 licenses, and with Marketing on campaigns, co-branded content, and events
  • Report monthly on recruitment, time to first transaction, pipeline, and revenue by tier
  • Over time, help stand up the foundation for a broader security reseller and solution provider channel

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in channel sales or partner management at a cybersecurity, infrastructure, or SaaS vendor
  • Experience building a DIB-focused MSP or MSSP partner program, not just managing an existing one
  • A track record of recruiting and activating MSP or MSSP partners from signature to first transaction and beyond
  • Working relationships across the MSP, MSSP, or CMMC practitioner ecosystem serving the DIB
  • Working knowledge of CMMC 2.0 and NIST SP 800-171: CUI vs. FCI, the 5 asset categories, SPRS scoring, and DFARS 7012 obligations
  • Experience carrying and hitting a partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue number
  • Experience building your own enablement material, and familiarity with deal registration, partner portals, and margin structures
  • Strong Salesforce and pipeline hygiene
  • Location: Remote, United States, with travel up to 40 percent to partner sites and industry events

Who You Are

  • Speed: You move with urgency and get things done today, not next week
  • Focus: You spend your time on the partners who will actually sell
  • Extreme ownership: Your program, your partners, your number. No excuses
  • Accountability: You do what you say, when you say. You flag slips early
  • Coachability: You ask for feedback, act on it, and get better
  • Humility: You know what you don’t know, and you say so
  • Creativity: You find new ways to recruit partners and get them selling

Preferred Attributes

  • Technical credibility: Partners only carry products their engineers and compliance leads believe in. You will have a dedicated channel sales engineer, but this is still a technical role, and you should be able to have these conversations whether your SE is in the room or not
  • CMMC and 800-171: Walk a partner through how an unmanaged device moves from CUI Asset to out of scope. Speak to the External Service Provider question, FedRAMP Moderate equivalency under DFARS 7012, and shared responsibility
  • Microsoft 365 GCC High: Commercial vs. GCC vs. GCC High, enclave vs. full-tenant migration, and where Hypori shrinks the GCC High footprint
  • Endpoint and mobile: MDM, UEM, MAM, mobile threat defense, enterprise browser, VDI, and DaaS. You know where the data rests in each
  • Hypori platform: Run a partner enablement session covering architecture, deployment scoping, licensing, and what each accreditation means to a client
  • MSP operations: RMM and PSA platforms, per-seat packaging, margin expectations, and multi-tenant administration
  • Prior time at an MSP, MSSP, RPO, or C3PAO serving defense contractors
  • CMMC CCP or CCA certification
  • Military service or Department of War civilian experience

About Us

Compensation: $215,000 – $235,000 on-target earnings (commensurate with experience). Variable compensation is uncapped, with accelerators above 100 percent attainment, and the role includes equity. Targets are based on partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue, plus partner recruitment and activation.

About Us

Hypori Inc. provides a generous benefits package for full-time employees that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, parental leave, and life and disability packages. We also invest in our employees' futures by providing a 401(k) plan with employer-matching contributions that vest starting from your first day of employment. In addition to the base compensation, Hypori also offers a performance bonus, which is primarily contingent upon company-wide performance. We are dedicated to investing in the tools and skills required to be strong, collaborative colleagues and people managers to help build and retain a strong workforce.

Hypori is an Equal Employment and Affirmative Action Employer. At Hypori, we are committed to creating and promoting an inclusive workplace that embraces differences and perspectives – making us a stronger, more successful company. About Delegate Solutions

Delegate Solutions provides Fractional Executive Enablement to entrepreneurs, CEOs, and leadership teams. We combine proactive executive support, thoughtful execution, accountability, and process improvement to help leaders get the right work off their plate and create more capacity for growth.

We are looking for an experienced strategic thinker to join our team and serve as a trusted executive support partner to our clients.

This is a consultative executive support role for senior leaders—not a task-based administrative position. Our executive assistants are proactive thinkers, problem solvers, client partners, and project coordinators who are also highly capable of executing administrative work when needed.

About the Role

As an executive assistant, you will manage a portfolio of client relationships and work alongside an Implementer to help clients delegate more effectively, strengthen their executive support systems, and keep important work moving.

You will get to know each client’s business, priorities, challenges, and working style, then proactively identify opportunities to improve how work is delegated, organized, coordinated, and executed.

You won’t simply wait for clients to tell you what to do. You’ll identify opportunities within their executive support needs, make recommendations, create a plan, coordinate execution, and make sure delegated work gets done.

About the Client
Our client is a US-based property management business that oversees residential rental properties, including single-family and multifamily units, on behalf of property owners. They’re growing, and daily tenant communication, leasing paperwork, maintenance follow-ups, and bookkeeping are taking up more of their time. They’re looking for a dependable, detail-oriented coordinator who can keep operations running smoothly and know when to bring them in.
Why does this role exist?
The client needs to step back from daily tenant and admin work without anything slipping through the cracks. This role exists to take over day-to-day operations, from tenant communication and leasing to maintenance coordination, light bookkeeping, and owner updates. In your first 30 days, you’ll learn their systems, properties, tenants, and vendors, and handle requests quickly and independently so the client can trust you to run the day-to-day.

The Impact you’ll make

Tenant Communication
  • Answer tenant calls, emails, and texts within set response times
  • Log maintenance requests and send confirmation to the tenant
  • Send rent reminders before the due date and late notices after
  • Share move-in and move-out instructions
  • Send building notices about inspections, water shutoffs, pest control, or repairs
  • Escalate emergencies to the property manager right away
Leasing Lease Administration
  • Post vacancy listings on Zillow, Apartments.com, Facebook Marketplace, and similar sites
  • Respond to prospect inquiries and schedule showings
  • Send rental applications and track which ones are complete
  • Coordinate background, credit, and income checks through the screening platform
  • Prepare lease agreements from approved templates for review, then send for e-signature and follow up until signed
  • Track lease start dates, end dates, and renewal deadlines, and send renewal offers 60 to 90 days before expiration
  • Keep a lease tracker updated with rent amounts, deposits, and key terms
  • Prepare move-in and move-out inspection checklists
Maintenance Coordination
  • Create work orders and assign them to the right vendor
  • Request and compare vendor quotes
  • Schedule repairs and confirm access with tenants
  • Follow up until each job is closed and the tenant confirms it’s resolved
  • Keep a vendor list with contacts, rates, insurance, and license expiration dates
  • Schedule preventive maintenance such as HVAC service, gutter cleaning, and smoke detector checks
Light Bookkeeping
  • Record rent payments and match them to each unit
  • Track late fees and outstanding balances
  • Enter vendor invoices and bills into QuickBooks, Buildium, AppFolio, or the owner’s system
  • Upload and categorize receipts
  • Reconcile bank and credit card transactions monthly
  • Track security deposits and prepare deposit return calculations
  • Prepare a simple monthly report per property showing income, expenses, and net
  • Collect W-9s from vendors and keep records ready for 1099s
  • Flag unusual charges or missing payments to the owner
Admin, Records Owner Relations
  • Keep tenant, lease, and property files organized in a shared drive
  • Track insurance policies, permits, and property tax due dates
  • Manage the property manager’s calendar for showings, inspections, and vendor visits
  • Update the tenant and unit database after every change
  • Prepare a weekly status summary covering vacancies, open work orders, overdue rent, and upcoming renewals
  • Send monthly owner statements and get owner approval for repairs above a set dollar limit
  • Answer basic owner questions about their property

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required
  • Prior property management experience, such as property management, leasing, or real estate admin support
  • Hands-on use of at least one property management platform such as AppFolio, Buildium, Rent Manager, Yardi, or TenantCloud
  • Working knowledge of QuickBooks Online or Xero and basic bookkeeping (payments, invoices, receipts, reconciliation)
  • Understanding of how leases work, including renewals, deposits, late fees, and notices
  • Advanced or fluent English (C1 or higher), spoken and written, with a clear, professional phone presence
Your superpowers are...
  • Technical
    • Property management platforms (AppFolio, Buildium, Rent Manager, Yardi, TenantCloud)
    • QuickBooks Online or Xero for payment tracking, invoice entry, and reconciliation
    • Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, especially spreadsheets and shared drives
    • E-signature tools such as DocuSign or Dropbox Sign
    • Phone systems such as RingCentral, OpenPhone, or Google Voice
    • Working knowledge of tenant screening and US fair housing basics
    • Awareness that landlord-tenant rules vary by state
    • Bonus: experience supporting US landlords or property managers, and with both single-family and multifamily properties
  • Soft skills
    • Very organized and detail-oriented, especially with numbers and dates
    • Calm and polite with upset tenants
    • Clear, professional communication on calls and in clean, error-free emails and notices
    • Following up without being reminded
    • Prioritizing when several urgent requests arrive at once
    • Good judgment about when to escalate instead of making the call on your own
    • Handling confidential tenant and financial information responsibly
    • Learning new systems quickly
WFH Set-Up:
  • Computer with at least 8GB RAM, an Intel i5 core processor/AMD Ryzen 5 Processor and up.
  • Internet speed of at least 40MBPS
  • Headset with an extended mic that has noise cancellation and a webcam
  • Back-up computer and internet connection
  • Quiet, dedicated workspace at home
You should apply if...
  • You’ve worked in property management and enjoy keeping a busy portfolio running smoothly
  • You stay calm and courteous when a tenant is frustrated or a repair is urgent
  • You like owning a process from start to finish, from the work order to the tenant confirming it’s fixed
  • You check your numbers and dates twice and take pride in clean records
  • You follow up without being asked and don’t let loose ends sit
  • You know when to make the call and when to bring in the property manager
  • You can be trusted with sensitive tenant and financial information
  • You want to become a trusted right hand to your client
What to expect...
Work Setup:
  • Remote position
  • Must have a reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace
  • Required to provide own computer with Intel Core i5 or something similar or higher operating system
Working Hours:
  • 40 hours per week
  • 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time
Compensation:
  • $7 per hour
  • No benefits package included

Backend Geospatial Software Engineer

Chesapeake Technology, Inc. | Remote — US

About Chesapeake Technology

Chesapeake Technology is a 25-year leader in marine survey software, developing SonarWiz — the industry-standard platform for processing sidescan sonar, sub-bottom profiler, bathymetry, and magnetometer data. We serve commercial survey companies, research institutions, government agencies, and defense customers worldwide. We are currently building a next-generation cloud-native platform that brings AI/ML-powered processing to the browser, along with edge computing capabilities for real-time AUV data analysis.

The Role

We're looking for a Backend Geospatial Software Engineer to architect and build the cloud processing engine powering our new platform. You'll work on large-scale geospatial data pipelines — ingesting, transforming, and serving sonar and bathymetric datasets — using modern Python-based scientific computing tools on AWS. You'll also help design lightweight edge processing solutions that run onboard autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) for real-time sensor analysis and decision-making. High-impact role on a small, focused team where your work ships directly to production.

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement scalable backend services for cloud-based geospatial data processing

  • Build distributed data pipelines using Dask and Xarray to process large multi-dimensional sonar datasets

  • Architect and optimize AWS infrastructure (S3, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Step Functions, SQS) for compute-intensive workloads

  • Develop edge computing pipelines for onboard AUV data analysis, enabling real-time target detection and adaptive survey planning

  • Design systems that bridge edge and cloud — syncing, validating, and enriching AUV-collected data post-mission

  • Develop APIs that serve processed geospatial data to the web-based frontend

  • Integrate ML/AI models for automated bottom tracking, target recognition, and data classification

  • Optimize data storage, compression, and retrieval for large raster and point-cloud datasets

  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years of backend software engineering experience with Python

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS (S3, EC2/ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, or equivalent orchestration)

  • Production experience with Dask for distributed/parallel computing

  • Production experience with Xarray for multi-dimensional array data

  • Solid understanding of geospatial data formats and CRS (GeoTIFF, NetCDF, shapefiles, WGS84, UTM)

  • Experience building RESTful or GraphQL APIs

  • Comfort with containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes)

Preferred

  • Experience with edge computing or embedded processing on resource-constrained platforms (ARM, NVIDIA Jetson, or similar)

  • Familiarity with AUV/UUV systems, robotics middleware (ROS/ROS2), or real-time sensor data processing

  • Experience with marine survey, hydrographic, or oceanographic data

  • Familiarity with sonar data processing (sidescan, multibeam, sub-bottom profiler)

  • Experience with GDAL/OGR, Rasterio, or similar geospatial libraries

  • Background in scientific computing or numerical methods

  • Experience with ML/AI pipelines (TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar), including model optimization for edge deployment

  • Familiarity with Zarr, Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG), or other cloud-native data formats

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK)

  • Active or ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance

Why Chesapeake

  • High impact — your code processes real-world ocean data used by navies, researchers, and survey companies worldwide

  • Cloud + edge — work across the full spectrum, from scalable cloud infrastructure to real-time processing onboard AUVs

  • Greenfield platform — built from the ground up with modern tools, no legacy constraints

  • Small team, big ownership — direct influence on architecture decisions and product direction

  • Domain expertise — 25 years of sonar processing knowledge; you'll learn a fascinating domain

  • Flexible work — fully remote within the US with a collaborative, low-bureaucracy culture

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience. Benefits include health insurance, flexible PTO, and professional development opportunities.

jobs.title: Sr. Applied ML Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At Memory Bridge, we’re tackling one of the hardest problems in AI: Large language models perfect memory while preserving user privacy.
jobs.description:
At Memory Bridge, we’re tackling one of the hardest problems in AI: Large language models perfect memory while preserving user privacy.

We’re looking for an exceptional ML Engineer who sees beyond simple RAG tutorials and understands that building production-grade memory systems requires deep software engineering expertise first, ML knowledge second. You’ll architect and build the core retrieval engine that powers personalized AI experiences across conversations, privacy-aware filtering, and adaptive memory updates.

This is a rare opportunity to join our team as the founding ML engineer, where your code will directly shape how AI systems remember and learn. If you’re a strong programmer who has evolved into NLP/ML, we should talk.

About You

  • The ideal candidate has evolved from senior software development into NLP/ML, bringing the architectural thinking and code craftsmanship needed to tackle complex memory persistence, multi-tier retrieval, and real-time personalization challenges that separate production systems from proof-of-concepts.

  • You champion frequent deployments. You believe in shipping code regularly and improving through real-world feedback rather than seeking perfection.

  • You solve problems creatively. You tackle challenges with a can-do attitude, recognizing when to build new features versus strengthening foundations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement the core memory subsystem architecture, including storage tiers, retrieval pipelines, and privacy-aware filtering mechanisms

  • Build evaluation frameworks to measure memory retrieval quality, relevance scoring, and augmentation effectiveness with clear metrics and benchmarks

  • Implement sophisticated memory extraction and classification systems that identify, rank, and surface relevant user context from chat histories

  • Research and adapt cutting-edge memory architectures from academic papers and open-source implementations (e.g., MemGPT, Reflexion, cognitive architectures)

  • Architect the memory update pipeline that learns from user interactions, including relevance feedback, correction mechanisms, and adaptive privacy classification

  • Design hybrid search strategies that combine semantic embeddings with structured metadata, graph relationships, and temporal patterns for optimal memory retrieval

  • Collaborate with PM to define technical constraints and feasibility for memory system features

  • Takes ownership of production reliability for AI features—comfortable being on-call for prompt failures, extraction issues, or integration breakdowns

  • Understanding of AI system failure modes and fallback strategies—knows when to gracefully degrade vs. retry vs. escalate to human review

Requirements (Must-haves)

  • 5+ years total experience, with at least 3 years in software engineering and 2 years building ML/NLP systems

  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered systems with a focus on context management, memory persistence, or personalization features

  • Production experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma) and hybrid search systems combining semantic and keyword search

  • Proven experience shipping LLM-powered features to production, with an understanding of prompt engineering, context window management, and API reliability patterns

  • Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Mem0, MemGPT, Letta) for building complex AI workflows

  • Demonstrated ability to implement hybrid search systems combining dense vectors, sparse indices, and metadata filtering

  • Strong debugging skills for RAG pipelines, prompt reliability, extraction accuracy, and function calling/MCP integrations

  • Experience with agentic architectures, including tool calling, MCP (Model Context Protocol), and function orchestration for database access and external integrations

  • Experience with privacy-preserving ML techniques or building systems with strict data isolation requirements

  • Expert Python programming, plus working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript for API integration and JSON schema design for LLM tool definitions

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • You’re familiar with underlying technologies like transformer networks, attention mechanisms, and how they contribute to models’ abilities to generate coherent responses, function calls, and other language tasks

  • Experience with graph databases or knowledge graphs for representing user memory relationships

  • Familiarity with testing LLM applications—prompt regression tests, evaluation datasets, and A/B testing for AI features

  • Experience designing LLM-friendly APIs with structured outputs, streaming responses, and token usage optimization

  • Experience with experiment tracking and model versioning for memory/retrieval systems

  • Experience with privacy regulations (GDPR/CCPA) and implementing data deletion, consent management, or audit trails in ML systems

  • Background in recommendation systems or personalization engines

  • Contributions to open-source LLM/RAG projects or memory-related research

  • Master’s or PhD degree in physics, biology, CS, Electrical Engineering, etc., can be helpful but not required

Tech Stack & Tools

Core

  • Python – Primary language for ML/AI development

  • FastAPI – For building high-performance async APIs

  • Git/GitHub – Version control and collaboration workflow

  • GitHub Actions – Familiarity with CI/CD automation pipelines

  • JSON – Standard for structured data exchange and API contracts

Databases

  • Vector Databases – Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Qdrant

  • PostgreSQL – Primary relational database for structured data

  • MongoDB – Document store for flexible, user-defined memory structures

AI/ML Frameworks

  • LLM Orchestration – LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Haystack

  • Model Provider APIs – OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, and others

Nice to Have

  • Elasticsearch – Full-text search and log-based memory indexing

  • Docker – For local development and containerized deployment

How To Apply

At Memory Bridge, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We’re looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the updated resume is essential.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

Memory Bridge is an equal-opportunity employer and we’re excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Memory Bridge does not discriminate based on someone’s identity in any aspect of hiring or employment, as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging, and Equity. Our code of conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Memory Bridge will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date the job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

How We Work

We are a remote-native company, intentionally designed for deep work and focused execution. We hire the best minds, wherever they are, and empower them to solve some of the hardest problems in AI. Our culture thrives on asynchronous communication, radical transparency, and a commitment to sustainable performance—not burnout.

If you’re obsessed with solving the AI context problem and want to ship products that will redefine human-computer interaction, we want to hear from you.

Recognized as a 2025 Best Workplace by Inc. Magazine and as a 2023 Fastest-Growing Private Company in America by Inc. 5000, we believe that what sets Chicory apart is our diverse experiences and skillsets coupled with our shared values. Learn more at .

About the Role

This is a great opportunity for someone who is curious about how digital advertising works behind the scenes and enjoys working with data, problem-solving, and digging into the details. Prior ad tech experience is not required. We'll provide the training, mentorship, and support to help you build expertise in advertising technology and campaign management while taking on increasing ownership over time.

Our PhilosophyAt Chicory, we know that we are strongest when every person is valued, respected and treated with dignity. We actively put aside assumptions and judgment and work to make space for all points of view. We do serious work but don’t take ourselves too seriously. We consider our playful spirit a competitive advantage to building better relationships and finding the smartest solutions. We produce the best results by hiring smart people and giving them the space, safety and the resources to do their work. We are building a company people love working with and working at.

Our Commitment Statement to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging

At Chicory, diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are key ingredients in our recipe for success. Our diverse experiences, backgrounds, identities, and ways of thinking elevate the level at which we operate; this allows us to innovate in old-school industries by looking not at how things have been done, but how they should be done. We are building a workplace built on merit and equity where every one of us has a voice at the table.

Our Principles

  • Be Good People: The success of our company is totally dependent on having good, smart people.
  • Own It: We take pride in our work. When we see a problem, we step up. We hold ourselves, and each other, to the highest standard. We learn from mistakes, admit when we are wrong, and take full responsibility for delivering results, not just for our role, but for the mission.

Clarity comes from curiosity, not certainty. We don’t settle for surface-level answers. We seek reality, even when it’s inconvenient.
  • Have a Beginner’s Mind: Just because something has been done a certain way doesn’t mean it’s the best way. We stay curious, challenge assumptions, and question the status quo. We stay innovative by tackling problems from a fresh perspective.
  • Bias for Action: Speed matters in business. We don’t wait for permission, perfect clarity, or endless alignment. We cut through noise, complexity, and politics to drive progress. When in doubt, we act, learn, and adapt because action beats indecision every time.
  • Customer Obsessed: Our customers are our North Star. We listen closely, dig deep to understand their needs, and deliver 5-star service at every touchpoint. We build products that actually work: simple, intuitive, and designed to solve real problems.
  • Above and Beyond: We don’t settle for “good enough,” we aim for exceptional. We go above and beyond what’s expected for our team, our customers, and ourselves. We stay curious and hungry. Every day is an opportunity to get better.

Role Description

Dropbox is hiring an Integrated Campaign Strategist to architect and orchestrate marketing campaigns for priority product launches and evergreen marketing motions. This role turns business priorities, audience insight, and product positioning into a clear campaign strategy that defines the audience, narrative, journey, channel roles, activation sequence, and measurement plan.

You will be the steward of how these campaigns show up in market across owned, earned, and paid channels. Working across Product Marketing, Brand and Creative, Comms, Web, Lifecycle, Paid Media, Content, Events, Marketing Operations, Analytics, and Sales, you will align teams around one integrated plan, connect individual activations into a coherent enterprise buyer experience, and guide the campaign from brief through launch, optimization, and learning.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a strategist who can lead through influence, make tradeoffs in ambiguity, and balance strong market storytelling with measurable business impact. You will help Dropbox bring important product stories to enterprise audiences with greater consistency, relevance, and effectiveness.

Responsibilities

  • Campaign strategy architecture: Translate mid-market and enterprise business goals, product positioning, audience insight, and market context into integrated campaign strategies for key launches and evergreen motions, including objectives, audience, narrative, journey, channel roles, phasing, and measurement.
  • Cross channel orchestration: Build and manage the integrated activation plan across owned, earned, and paid channels so that web, lifecycle, content, social, communications, events, partner, and media programs work as one connected campaign rather than separate channel plans.
  • In-market stewardship: Own the campaign through launch and sustainment, protecting the strategic throughline while ensuring creative, messaging, timing, and audience experience remain coherent across touchpoints and regions.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Establish the brief, operating rhythm, decision rights, milestones, dependencies, and readiness criteria that align Product Marketing, Brand and Creative, Communications, channel owners, Marketing Operations, Marketing Data Science, regional partners, and Sales.
  • Audience and journey design: Define target audiences and buying groups, map the role of each touchpoint across the customer journey, and ensure campaign experiences respond to buyer needs, market moments, and stages of consideration.
  • Performance and optimization: Partner with Marketing Data Science and channel owners to define full funnel success measures, synthesize owned, earned, and paid signals, identify what is driving or limiting performance, and recommend changes to audience, narrative, creative, sequencing, or channel mix.
  • Portfolio learning and scale: Capture campaign insights, codify reusable plays, distinguish enduring strategy from launch specific execution, and apply learning across the enterprise campaign portfolio to improve future launches and evergreen motions.

Requirements

  • 8+ years B2B marketing experience in integrated campaigns, enterprise marketing, product marketing activation, brand to demand, or a related discipline, ideally in SaaS or technology.
  • Direct experience building out campaign strategy and accountable to the outcome(pipeline generation, revenue generation).
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex integrated campaigns from strategy and brief through activation, optimization, and post campaign learning.
  • Strong campaign architecture skills, including audience definition, narrative development, buyer journey design, channel planning, phasing, and measurement.
  • Experience orchestrating owned, earned, and paid programs and understanding the distinct role each plays in building awareness, consideration, demand, and customer growth.
  • Ability to translate product positioning and enterprise customer insight into a cohesive market story and connected audience experience across multiple teams and touchpoints.
  • Strong cross functional leadership and program judgment, including the ability to establish decision rights, navigate competing priorities, resolve dependencies, and influence without direct authority.
  • Analytical fluency and experience using campaign, brand, engagement, and revenue signals to evaluate performance, communicate impact, and make optimization decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading enterprise product launch campaigns and building evergreen motions for a multi product B2B portfolio.
  • Experience partnering closely with Corporate Communications, analyst relations, customer advocacy, or social teams to connect earned programs with owned and paid activation.
  • Experience marketing to complex enterprise buying groups across industries, company sizes, regions, or stages of maturity.
  • Familiarity with marketing automation, CRM, media, intent, experimentation, and attribution platforms used to activate and measure integrated campaigns.
  • Experience using AI to accelerate research, briefing, content variation, synthesis, or analysis while retaining human ownership of strategy, judgment, and brand decisions.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.

jobs.excerpt: The Garage Door Industry Is in a Gold Rush.  We're Leading It.
jobs.description:
The Garage Door Industry Is in a Gold Rush. We're Leading It.

Private equity is buying up garage door companies at a pace the industry has never seen. That capital is driving up the cost of leads, reshaping how companies compete, and forcing every garage door business to evolve fast.

Most marketing agencies don't understand this. They treat garage door companies like any other home service business, the same playbook they'd use for a plumber or a roofer. They don't understand that a $3M independent competing against a PE backed regional rollup needs a completely different strategy than a locksmith trying to rank on Google.

We do.

Garage Door Marketing Lab is the only marketing agency built exclusively for the garage door industry. Our clients are garage door companies doing $1M to $10M+ in revenue, independents fighting to stay competitive and growth stage operators positioning for scale. We build the marketing systems that drive profitable growth, and we have posted industry record ROAS results doing it: 10.9X, 8X, and 6X.

Our brand is inspired by Apple, Porsche, REI, and Lululemon: premium, modern, best in class.

We Are an AI First Agency. This Is Not Optional.

Every person here uses Claude daily. We build in Claude with VS Code. Real automations are already running in production: our Weekly Marketing Update system, a client tracker that auto syncs Meta, Google PPC, LSA, GoHighLevel leads and Google reviews every day, an automation health watchdog, and a strategy session deck generator.

We believe this is what a marketing agency looks like going forward. If that excites you, and you want to add to it rather than just tolerate it, keep reading. If AI is something you will get around to learning eventually, this is not your seat.

The Role

You will be our clients' primary point of contact: their coach, their advocate, and the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. You own your book of clients and work alongside our specialists in SEO, Google PPC and Advanced Verification, GoHighLevel, and Meta Ads.

Your week:

  • Tuesdays: Deep dive into client ad performance, lead quality, and campaign health
  • Wednesdays: Send concise Weekly Marketing Updates (WMUs) to every client
  • Thursdays: Run your Scorecard in our L10 meeting (we run on EOS)
  • Monthly: Lead 45 minute client meetings on Zoom plus Loom video reports
  • Daily: Monitor client health, respond inside 1 business day, keep Asana current

What You'll Be Measured On

  • Client meetings held per week. Goal: 10
  • Client show rate. Goal: 90%
  • Escalations to CEO. Goal: 0
  • Escalations with a solution attached. Goal: 100%
  • WMUs groomed before sending. Goal: Yes
  • Client Health Dashboard updated. Goal: Yes
  • Responsive on Slack. Goal: Yes

Must-Haves (No Exceptions)

  • Account Manager experience at a marketing agency. Agency side, owning client relationships directly. Not general marketing experience. Not a coordinator role. Not in house client success. We do not consider candidates without this.
  • Excellent written and spoken English. You will be coaching business owners.
  • Proactive problem solver. You fix things before the client notices.
  • Comfortable explaining PPC, SEO, and Meta Ads to business owners
  • You already use AI in your daily workflow and can show us how
  • Video communication skills (Loom, Zoom)
  • You can commit to the set Arizona hours and the 90 day term

Strong Advantages

  • 7 Figure Agency community member or alumnus. Our single strongest signal.
  • Garage door industry experience. Worked at a garage door company, marketed for one, or sold into the space.
  • Home services or trades marketing experience
  • GoHighLevel, Google Ads, Meta Ads, or LSA familiarity
  • EOS experience (L10s, Rocks, Scorecards)
  • SOP building and process improvement track record
  • Automations you have built yourself

Logistics

Contract: 1099 independent contractor. You handle your own taxes, insurance, and benefits. 90 day initial term.

Eligible locations: USA, Canada, Mexico, or Europe.

Hours: Full time, 40 hours per week, Arizona Time (AZ does NOT observe Daylight Saving Time). These are set hours, not flexible.

  • Offshore: 3:30 AM to 12:30 PM AZ
  • USA: 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM AZ

Pay: $45,000 to $60,000 per year DOE, plus bonuses. Paid weekly via Wise (international) or Zelle (USA).

Target start date: Monday, October 12, 2026.

Tools: Asana, Slack, GoHighLevel, Google Workspace, Loom, Notion, TrackingTime, Claude, Manus.

Meetings: Monday Team Meeting (7:30 AM AZ), Thursday L10 (7:30 AM AZ), weekly 1 on 1.

The First 90 Days

You get a real handover and shadowing window with our current Account Manager, plus structured training on our systems, the garage door industry itself, and how to coach clients toward running better businesses.

By Day 90 you are 100% self sufficient: running accounts, leading meetings, sending WMUs, and managing your Scorecard without daily guidance.

Who This Is For

  • You take extreme ownership of outcomes
  • You overcommunicate rather than assume
  • You build systems instead of relying on heroics
  • You are genuinely excited about AI and want to push it further
  • Closed mouths don't get fed. You ask questions.

Who This Is NOT For

  • You need to be told what to do every day
  • You avoid hard conversations with clients
  • You think that's not my job
  • You treat AI as a box to tick rather than how the work gets done
  • You can't commit to Arizona Time hours

How to Apply

1. Send a 2 minute Loom video. Introduce yourself and tell us why you want this role. You MUST say the word Pineapple within the first 5 seconds of your video. This is how we know you read carefully. Applications without it are not reviewed.

2. Take the Crystal Knows DISC assessment. Free, about 10 minutes, no signup required: Send us your profile link.

3. Take the HIGH5 strengths assessment. Free, about 20 minutes: Send us your report.

4. Tell us your expected pay.

Optional: if you already have Kolbe A results, send them along. Do not buy one. We do not ask candidates to pay for assessments.

Bonus points if you can tell us something about the garage door industry that most people don't know.

Our Interview Process

Three Zoom conversations, all with Andy, our founder. Our current Account Manager joins the first two.

  1. Fit and ownership (30 minutes)
  2. Live mock client meeting (45 minutes). You run a real scenario with Andy playing the owner of a $2M garage door company.
  3. Final conversation and offer (30 minutes)

We move fast. Strong candidates hear back inside 48 hours.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;

  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;

  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
