Senior UX & Product Design Consultant (Part-Time Contract)

2 Days per Week | Remote

About Societ

Societ is a leading software company dedicated to empowering nonprofit organizations. Our integrated platform provides case management, donor management, fundraising, and financial processing solutions that help nonprofits focus on what matters most—their mission.

As we continue to grow our platform, we're looking for a senior product design professional who can help transform how we think about user experience across our product portfolio. This role goes beyond creating mockups or visual designs. We're looking for someone who can influence product thinking, challenge assumptions, advocate for users, and help establish a lasting culture of user-centered design throughout our organization.

The Opportunity

We’re seeking a highly experienced UI/UX professional who can bring industry best practices, challenge our assumptions, and help us build software that is intuitive, efficient, and enjoyable to use.

Our product portfolio spans both modern cloud applications and mature enterprise software. This role offers the unique opportunity to influence the evolution of new products from their earliest stages while also improving the usability and consistency of long-established products used by thousands of nonprofit professionals.

This is more than a design role. We’re looking for someone who can evaluate existing workflows, identify usability issues, establish UX standards, and work closely with our Product and Development teams to ensure user experience becomes a core part of how we build software.

Working approximately two days per week, you’ll become a trusted advisor and partner to our product team.

What You’ll Do

  • Help ensure our products not only function exceptionally well, but also present a modern, polished, and cohesive experience that reflects the quality of our platform and strengthens our position in the market.
  • Conduct comprehensive UX reviews of existing products and workflows
  • Identify friction points and recommend improvements based on established UX principles
  • Evaluate new features before development to ensure they are intuitive and user-friendly
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Developers, and stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle
  • Create user flows, prototypes, and interactive designs where appropriate
  • Introduce UX methodologies and best practices into our product development process
  • Help establish design standards, interaction patterns, and usability guidelines
  • Recommend improvements to navigation, information architecture, accessibility, and overall product consistency
  • Partner with Product leadership to influence roadmap prioritization through a UX lens.
  • Help evaluate product decisions based on customer outcomes, usability, and market competitiveness.
  • Identify opportunities where improved experience creates strategic product differentiation in the market.
  • Help balance usability improvements against technical realities and product priorities.
  • Participate in design reviews and provide constructive feedback
  • Help embed UX thinking into planning, estimation, feature discovery, and product reviews.
  • Mentor developers and other stakeholders on user-centered design principles, helping build lasting UX capability across the organization.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • 8+ years of professional UI/UX design experience
  • Significant experience improving B2B SaaS products
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating complex software applications (not just marketing websites)
  • Expertise in user-centered design methodologiesStrong knowledge of interaction design, information architecture, and accessibility standards
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills
  • Comfortable constructively challenging assumptions and advocating for user needs while balancing business objectives and technical realities.
  • Experience working with Agile product teams

Bonus Experience

  • CRM, ERP, case management, fundraising, or enterprise software
  • Experience modernizing or evolving established enterprise software products
  • Software serving nonprofit organizations
  • Design system creation and governance
  • UX research and usability testing
  • Accessibility (WCAG) expertise

Success in This Role

After six months, you will have:

  • Built strong relationships with Product and Development teams as a trusted design partner.
  • Identified high-impact usability improvements across both our legacy and modern platforms.
  • Introduced practical UX practices that are becoming part of our everyday product development process.
  • Helped establish a shared design language and interaction standards.
  • Increased confidence across the organization in making customer-centered product decisions.

Why This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to make a lasting impact, not just on our products, but on how we build them.

You'll partner closely with Product and Development leadership to influence the user experience across a diverse product portfolio, from modern cloud applications to mature enterprise software. You'll help improve the experience of products relied upon by thousands of nonprofit professionals while shaping the UX direction of emerging products from their earliest stages.

We're looking for more than someone to create mockups or design standards. We want a trusted advisor who will champion the customer, challenge assumptions, raise the quality of our product experiences, and help build a culture where thoughtful, user-centered design is part of every product decision.

Engagement Details

  • Independent Contractor
  • Approximately 2 days (15 hours) per week
  • Flexible schedule
  • Remote
  • Initial 6-month engagement with the opportunity for ongoing work

One of you learns how a consulting company runs from the inside, across Marketing & Sales, Finance, HR and IT, and gets to know the consulting profession on the way.

We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just want to learn consulting.
We’re looking for someone who wants to become really good at it, fast.

How do you design a workshop or learning journey that changes how people work on Monday, not just how they feel on Friday afternoon?

Clients, deadlines, stakeholders and a plan that never survives day one. Take ownership of a real piece of a customer project and deliver it.

jobs.title: Head of Go-to-Market Operations
jobs.excerpt: Very Big Things · Remote · Eastern Time ±2 hours preferred · South Florida a plus · Reports to the CEO ABOUT VERY BIG THINGSVery Big Things is an enterprise AI transformation company headquartered in Fort Lauderdale.
jobs.description:
Very Big Things · Remote · Eastern Time ±2 hours preferred · South Florida a plus · Reports to the CEO

ABOUT VERY BIG THINGS

Very Big Things is an enterprise AI transformation company headquartered in Fort Lauderdale. We help large companies adopt AI successfully at scale by redesigning critical workflows and building AI directly into the work. We do that through Transform Work, our engagement model; SHIM, the open-source methodology we created; and TrackFrame, the platform backbone beneath the workflows we build. Our clients range from PE-backed mid-market companies to Fortune 100 enterprises, and we have grand ambitions for growth. That’s where you come in.

JOB PURPOSE

VBT has a documented go-to-market strategy, a set of committed bets, and a senior team with deep relationships and real deal flow. What it needs is an operator: the person who turns strategy into a weekly operating rhythm and keeps it running at full pressure.

You will own the go-to-market operating system end-to-end: the cadence, the scorecard, the pipeline hygiene, and the execution of each bet, working with the team members who own relationships and revenue.

The CEO currently carries much of this. Your job is to take it off his plate and build a machine that no longer depends on him to keep it running.

Success looks like: bets executed on cadence, a dashboard the whole team trusts, and a steady, measurable flow of qualified conversations that become revenue-generating client relationships.

To be successful in this role, you need a bias for action. Ideas are not the constraint; consistent execution is. You should be energized by turning a plan into owners, dates, fields and dashboards, then relentlessly making sure all of it gets done with autonomy and agency.

This starts as a highly hands-on operating role, but the mandate is bigger than maintaining the current system. As VBT grows, you will help build and ultimately lead the GTM operations function around it.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Run the GTM operating rhythm: own the weekly go-to-market meeting, deal reviews, and a scorecard review cadence that drives decisions.
  • Own the scorecard: define and track the leading indicators for every live bet, including qualified conversations, second meetings inside 14 days, partner-sourced briefs, room and event outcomes, and make HubSpot the single source of truth the team actually trusts.
  • Operationalize the bets: for each committed motion, including relationship re-engagement, partner and reseller enablement, executive events, consultant strategy, and demand generation marketing, ensure there is an owner, a backup, next actions with dates, and follow-up sequences that run to completion. Seven or eight touches, not one.
  • Own the executive event production line: including vendor management for audience generation and syndication, pre-booked 1:1 meeting management, and post-event follow-up outreach.
  • Run the consultant channel operating system: own briefing materials, touch cadence, brief intake and attribution. Senior leadership owns the relationships; this role makes sure the channel actually operates.
  • Manage the partner operating cadence: keep relationships with ServiceNow, AWS, resellers, and other strategic partners moving through enablement materials, deal registration, standing presence at partner sales meetings, certification and program requirements, and consistent follow-through.
  • Run trigger intelligence: maintain the account list and the signals that time our outreach, including new executive mandates, stalled AI pilots, funding and regulatory events, and turn them into a weekly call order for the revenue team.
  • Own GTM tooling and data hygiene: required fields, source attribution from day one, meeting grading, workflows, automation, and the reporting the CEO and leadership team use to run the business.
  • Build the GTM operations function as VBT scales: determine where internal hires, agencies, fractional resources, technology, and automation are needed, and ultimately manage the people and resources responsible for running the system.
  • Coordinate marketing execution: manage the fractional, agency, and internal resources behind our media, content, and events programs and connect their output to pipeline. Support case study content production and award programs.
  • Prepare the weekly leadership view: what’s working, what’s stalled, what gets cut, and what should change. Bring a recommendation, not just a report.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 6–8+ years in revenue operations, GTM operations, or growth/business operations for a B2B services, consultancy, or agency business, ideally one selling complex work into mid-market and enterprise clients. Exceptional candidates with less traditional experience but a strong track record of operating at this level are welcome.
  • Proven experience running an operating cadence for a revenue team: pipeline reviews, scorecards, and QBR-style reporting that leadership actually used.
  • Experience running partner or consultant channels to generate pipeline.
  • Hands-on HubSpot fluency, or equivalent CRM experience at an admin level: fields, workflows, sequences, attribution, dashboards.
  • Experience working directly with a founder or CEO: comfortable taking a system off their plate, disagreeing constructively, and holding senior colleagues to commitments without owning them hierarchically.
  • An operator’s temperament: organized, persistent, detail-oriented, and allergic to loose ends. You’d rather close eight loops than open eight new ones.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI and the ability to learn quickly. You do not need to arrive as an expert in enterprise AI transformation, but you should be interested enough in the space to become fluent over time and eventually speak credibly about what we do and why it matters.
  • An AI-native approach to your own work: actively looking for ways to use AI and automation to improve research, reporting, follow-up, analysis, and GTM execution.
  • Comfort with a small, fast, remote-first team where the playbook exists but the machine is still being assembled.

HOW THIS ROLE IS JUDGED

First 90 days: the operating cadence is running and respected; the scorecard is live with agreed definitions of “qualified”; every committed bet has an owner, a backup, and current next actions; the dashboard is trusted enough that leadership decisions cite it.

Ongoing: leading indicators trend up quarter over quarter, follow-up sequences complete rather than stall, the GTM operations function gets stronger as the company scales, and the CEO spends his go-to-market time in rooms with clients rather than running the machine.

POSITION DETAILS

This is a full-time position.

Remote. Candidates located within roughly two hours of Eastern Time are preferred. South Florida is a plus given our client, partner, and leadership footprint, but we will prioritize exceptional talent over location.

jobs.description:
TRAINING BUSINESS OPERATIONS LEAD

Kotter Training | Job Description

About Kotter

Kotter helps organizations turn strategy into results. Through our consulting and training offerings, we help leaders mobilize people, lead change, and achieve meaningful business outcomes.

The Opportunity

Kotter Training delivers learning experiences that help leaders and organizations create lasting change. As our business grows, we need strong operational leadership to ensure our programs run smoothly, our resources are used effectively, and our operating model can scale.

The Senior Training Business Operations Lead will own and continuously improve the operational foundation of Kotter Training. This role brings together program delivery, business operations, systems, processes, and performance data to ensure we deliver an exceptional client experience while running an effective and financially healthy business.

Working closely with the Head of Training, this person will oversee the details that keep our corporate and public training programs running while helping the business make better decisions about performance, capacity, resource allocation, and growth. The role requires someone who can move comfortably between hands-on execution and broader business problem-solving: someone who sees what needs to be done, understands why it matters, and finds better ways to accomplish it.

This is a senior individual contributor role with broad ownership and cross-functional influence. It is an opportunity for a resourceful, analytically minded operator to shape how a growing professional services training business works, not simply coordinate delivery or maintain existing processes.

This is a Remote, U.S.-Based position.

Responsibilities

Own Program Operations

Oversee the operational details of Kotter’s corporate and public training programs, from initial planning through delivery and follow-up.

Sales Handoff + Onboarding. Partner with the training sales team to transition closed deals into active projects, ensuring all client requirements, customizations, and SOW details are clearly understood and documented.

Client Liaison. Act as a point of contact for clients post-sale. Manage logistical communications leading up to the training delivery, including facilitation requirements, materials production, and participant preparation.

Delivery Coordination. Coordinate delivery resources assigned to client engagements. Ensure facilitators have the materials, context, and support they need prior to stepping into the room (or Zoom).

Program Logistics. Own the end-to-end execution of the open-enrollment public training calendar. Ensure registration pages are set up, manage attendee communications, order materials, and oversee event logistics (virtual platform management or physical venue coordination).

Attendee Experience. Serve as the primary concierge for public attendees, handling inquiries, distributing pre-session instructions, and tracking post-session certificates and surveys.

Delivery support. Occasional on-site or virtual event support and session production, including on-site attendee and vendor management for in-person sessions and technical support for virtual sessions (breakout room management, in-session participant troubleshooting, etc).

Strengthen Business Performance

Partner with the Head of Training, Sales Enablement, and Finance to monitor the health and performance of the business. Use performance data to identify trends, surface risks, and recommend actions.

Corporate Contract Scope Management. Monitor project health and proactively flag any scope creep or necessary change orders to the SOW.

Delivery Economics. Monitor vendor spend, venue costs, translation costs, and other inputs to track margin and product performance. Help identify opportunities to improve financial performance and operational efficiency.

Quality Monitoring. Gather client feedback post-delivery, conduct internal debriefs with facilitators, and ensure project closure protocols are established and followed. Ensure success stories are shared with the Training and Marketing teams to feed our library of case studies for use in marketing, business development, and instructional design.

Strategic Internal Initiatives. Manage the timeline and actions required to deliver projects, such as core training curriculum asset updates and new product development

Stabilize and Scale Processes, Systems, and Ways of Working

Evaluate how work gets done across the training business and identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce friction, and improve consistency. Build and maintain practical workflows, tools, documentation, and systems that support reliable delivery as the business grows.

Establish operating rhythms that create visibility into priorities, upcoming programs, business performance, and emerging constraints. Ensure responsibilities are clear, issues are surfaced early, and important decisions lead to action.

Resource Management. Collaborate directly with the Heads of Training and Consulting to forecast capacity, allocate delivery resources effectively across both corporate and public programs, and prevent team burnout.

Product Launch Operationalization. Coordinate dependencies, ensure go-to-market and delivery readiness, and help keep stakeholders accountable to timelines and deliverables.

Materials Management. Organize – and track access to – training materials, including folder structures in Google Drive and the central asset manager in our LMS. Establish tight version control protocols to ensure all accessible materials reflect the most current copies.

Certified Trainer License Maintenance. Track progress of delivery requirements for Kotter Certified Trainers, and alert the Head of Training when a Certified Trainer has not met annual requirements to maintain their facilitation license.

Process Optimization. Standardize templates, status reports, and delivery checklists to make our operations more repeatable and scalable. Bring ideas that improve our back-of-house processes.

Tool Administration. Maintain project management tools (e.g. Asana), ensuring all data is accurate, tasks are updated, and the team is adhering to operational best practices. Optimize and standardize the use of delivery tools (e.g. Zoom, Miro, Mentimeter, and Jotform).

Coordinate Across Teams and Partners

Work across Training, Consulting, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and external facilitators and partners to align priorities and keep work moving. Build productive relationships, communicate clearly, and influence outcomes without relying on formal authority.

Internal Communications. Implement mechanisms that keep the work of the Training team visible to the rest of the firm so the entire firm feels informed and appropriately engaged. Make it easier for stakeholders to understand what is happening, what is needed, and where decisions or action are required.

Strategy Execution. Partner with the Head of Training to translate business priorities into operational plans, identify dependencies, and ensure the business is ready to deliver new programs, initiatives, and growth opportunities.

Marketing Alignment. Collaborate tightly with the marketing team to align on promotional schedules and campaigns. Ensure marketing has the correct dates, program descriptions, and assets needed to drive enrollment, and report back on registration pacing.

Sales + Delivery Alignment. Work with Sales and Training leadership on pipeline visibility, delivery feasibility, capacity constraints, and readiness for new offerings.

Translation Management. Manage translations of training materials into new languages – including coordinating with our third-party translation service and global partners.

Based on skill set and expertise, there is also potential to support:

  • Facilitation

  • Product development

  • Proposal production

What We Are Looking For

An Experienced Operations Owner. You bring a proven track record in professional services or leadership development, using business judgment and financial data to drive performance and streamline complex delivery systems.

An Orchestrator. You can seamlessly manage the schedules, capacity, and priorities of multiple stakeholders, from senior leaders to external contractors, keeping work moving across organizational boundaries.

A Master of Context Switching. You can jump from a client onboarding call to an internal capacity planning meeting without missing a beat, moving effortlessly between high-level strategy and ground-level tactics.

Detail-Obsessed but Strategy-Aware. You sweat the small stuff while understanding how operational performance, utilization, and client experience directly impact revenue and growth goals.

A Clear Communicator. You are comfortable holding boundaries, defending scope, managing up to firm leadership, and bringing people together to solve complex operational challenges.

Self-Directed and Independent. You are exceptionally organized and take complete ownership to anticipate issues, bring structure to ambiguous situations, and follow through on solutions without rigid playbooks.

A Voracious Learner. You love learning new technologies and skills, seeking out root causes rather than temporary workarounds to continuously improve core systems.

We Are Most Interested In

  • Candidates with experience in business operations, professional services, consulting, training as a service, or leadership development.

  • People who combine operational excellence with business acumen and use data to improve performance, resource utilization, and profitability.

  • Operators who are able to build scalable processes, strengthen systems, and improve how teams work.

  • People who take ownership, solve problems, and influence across functions to turn business priorities into results.

This Role Is Not Aligned To

  • Traditional project management, PMO coordination, PMP, or administrative support.

  • Traditional Training, L&D and Instructional Design professionals.

  • Training Coordinators or people focused only on managing schedules and deliverables without broader ownership of operational performance or continuous improvement.

  • Candidates who prefer strategy without hands-on execution or who are looking for a people-management role.

  • People who focus on completing tasks without connecting their work to business performance, client outcomes, or growth.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in business operations, training operations, program operations, service delivery, or a related field.

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree or MBA a plus.

  • Experience managing complex operational workflows and coordinating multiple stakeholders, priorities, and deadlines.

  • Demonstrated ability to improve processes, systems, or operating practices and translate ideas into lasting changes.

  • Experience using data, reporting, and performance metrics to identify issues, evaluate results, or inform decisions.

  • Business and financial acumen, including an understanding of operating costs, resource utilization, and factors that affect profitability.

  • Strong planning and organizational skills, paired with the judgment to prioritize and adapt as circumstances change.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships across functions.

  • Comfort working independently, navigating ambiguity, and influencing without formal authority.

  • Proficiency with business productivity tools and operational systems. Experience with CRM, learning management, scheduling, or reporting platforms is a plus.

  • Must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer-sponsored visa support.

Reports To

Executive Director, Head of Training

Location

Remote US Based. Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, client programs, or company events.

Compensation and Benefits

Salary Range: $85K-120K

Compensation will be based on experience and qualifications. Kotter offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, 401(k), unlimited paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Accessibility Commitment

ADA and Physical Requirements | Accessibility Commitment

Kotter is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in all aspects of employment.

Physical Requirements

● The ability to communicate effectively in person, over video, and via digital platforms.

● The ability to operate standard office equipment (computer, phone, video conferencing tools).

● Occasional lifting of materials up to 20 pounds (e.g., training materials or presentation equipment).

● Travel (up to 10%) for client meetings, workshops, and events, which may involve extended periods of sitting, standing, or presenting.

AECOM is hiring for a Transmission Engineer with a primary focus on Transmission and Distribution projects to support our growing Energy Business Line.

Our team provides a wide range of civil and structural engineering services across markets sectors including electrical transmission and distribution, renewables and substations. We are looking for an enthusiastic individual to develop within and further the technical skills we bring to our new and existing client base. Qualified candidates will have a familiarity with civil and structural design aspects for transmission and distribution.

This can be remote or hybrid position based in but not limited to: Charlotte, NC; Raleigh, NC; Columbia, SC; Atlanta, GA; Richmond, VA; Nashville, TN; Chattanooga, TN; Orlando, FL; Louisville, KY

The job responsibilities of this role will include, but may not be limited to:

  • Perform engineering analysis and design for overhead transmission lines, including structure loading, conductor sag/tension, foundations, and line routing
  • Prepare construction packages including plan & profile drawings, structure selection, material specifications, and engineering calculations
  • Utilize industry‑standard software such as PLS-CADD, PLS-POLE, PLS-TOWER, and related tools
  • Support project lifecycle activities including scope development, cost estimating, scheduling, and field support
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable codes, standards, and guidelines (NESC, ASCE, company standards)
  • Coordinate with internal teams (siting/permitting, substation engineering, project management) and external stakeholders (contractors, vendors, regulatory bodies)
  • Provide engineering support during construction, including responding to RFIs and performing field verifications
  • Maintain accurate documentation and contribute to continuous improvement of design standards
  • Identify and mitigate site issues such as geotechnical conditions, access and environmental constraints and constructability challenges by providing timely technical support
  • Interact with customer’s internal engineers and technical experts on a day-to-day basis
  • Develop and maintain professional relationships with clients
  • Assists with the developing task and effort estimates for proposal support
  • Works to maintain positive working relationships with peers
  • Occasional travel required to other AECOM locations and Client sites
  • Able to participate in field walks and create field sketches, take dimensions, climb ladders, etc. as necessary

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related field + 2 years of relevant experience or a demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
  • Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification
  • Understanding of transmission line design principles (loading criteria, structural analysis, conductor behavior, foundations).
  • Experience with CAD or engineering design tools; familiarity with PLS-CADD strongly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Currently working towards Professional Engineer (PE) License is a plus
  • Experience with high-voltage transmission projects (69–500 kV).
  • Familiarity with NESC, ASCE 48, ASCE 10, and utility design standards.
  • Experience preparing engineering packages for capital projects.
  • Field experience supporting construction or inspections.
  • Familiarity with utility transmission standards.
  • Self-motivated
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Success in working with remote teams
  • Experience on full EPC, Design/Build projects from start to finish.
  • Owner’s Engineering experience
  • Experience with retrofit or brown field projects
  • Exposure to supporting renewable generation projects
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Relocation assistance is not available for this role

jobs.excerpt: About LyraLyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships.
jobs.description:
About Lyra

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role:
Lyra developed an innovative video therapy program called Lyra Care Therapy: Blending live video sessions with between-session digital psychoeducation and customizable skill building tools. The Lyra Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) program capitalizes on Lyra Care Therapy to supplement standard individual DBT and DBT skills groups with novel between-session DBT-relevant digital activities—activities that help promote skill generalization and integration into your clients’ daily lives. Lyra DBT clients also have 24/7 access to a team of licensed clinicians who have been trained in DBT skills coaching for around the clock support.

As a Lyra DBT Therapist, you’ll provide individual DBT and DBT skills groups via live video to adolescent clients. You’ll also assign DBT-relevant digital lessons, videos, and assessments to your clients to enhance learnings and monitor outcomes between sessions. Lyra's clients come from a multitude of backgrounds and experiences, and have varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally responsive care—an approach that accounts for the impact of cultural backgrounds on each person’s care experience.

Our therapists enjoy connecting with their colleagues who share a passion for providing evidence-based care. You’ll attend weekly consultation team meetings as well as one-on-one consultation meetings with an expert DBT team lead, co-lead DBT skills groups with other DBT providers, and attend robust trainings to enhance your clinical skills. You always have a team behind you if a crisis comes up. You’re never alone, even while working remotely in the US.

This role is a great fit if you’re a MA licensed DBT clinician who enjoys working with complex clients in a supportive, collaborative, and feedback rich environment. You may also find this role rewarding if:

- You are passionate about helping others improve their lives through skills-based interventions and work to understand your clients through a lens of compassion and curiosity.

- You enjoy evidence-based practice, continual learning, and professional improvement.

- You prefer to work within a collaborative team environment.

- You are accountable for your own outcomes and performance, and are willing to embrace challenges that others may shy away from.

BforeAI is an innovative and rapidly expanding scale-up dedicated to deterring cybercrime through cutting-edge predictive and preemptive technologies. We've harnessed the power of prescriptive AI to revolutionize the way we tackle cyber threats, stopping attacks before they launch.

Named by Gartner® in 48 reports over the last 4 years and recognized as a Tech Innovator for Preemptive Cybersecurity in the 2025 Emerging Tech report, BforeAI is the industry’s fastest, most accurate solution for automated protection against online fraud.

Join us in the fight for a safer cyberspace!

🚀 Why it’s great to work here

We are a location-independent company with a fully distributed team. We believe diversity of experience, background, and thinking leads to stronger teams and a better product. We value autonomy, intellectual honesty, practical decision-making, and engineers who take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for perfectly defined tasks.

We offer an intellectually stimulating company environment and you’ll be working with a bright, dedicated team from across the globe. Additionally, we offer flexible time off, sick days, all public holidays, and stock options.

✨ What’s cool about this job

BforeAI stops cyberattacks before they launch. That means many customer conversations start with explaining a capability buyers haven't purchased before. Enablement here is a direct revenue lever, not a support function. You'll work across Sales, Sales Engineering, Product, and Marketing on a hard and rewarding problem: turning deeply technical, predictive security capabilities into stories that win deals.

We are hiring a VP of Sales Enablement to build BforeAI's sales education program from the ground up and to be the person our commercial teams turn to for how to pitch, demo, and win.

📣 What you’ll be doing

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll set the strategy for how BforeAI's commercial teams learn and win, and you'll do much of the building and coaching yourself. We're a small team where everyone is a doer, VPs included.

Build the sales education program

  • Design and launch BforeAI's sales education program, standardizing how commercial team members learn, from onboarding through ongoing development.
  • Define the knowledge and skills required to win customer opportunities, and formalize them into a clear learning journey for Account Executives and Sales Engineers.
  • Build the scripts and supporting materials the team uses every day, and keep them current as the product and market evolve.

Analyze and improve the sales motion

  • Synthesize current sales motions and assess how well they open opportunities and close deals.
  • Analyze wins to document what successful pitches look like, and examine losses to run gap analyses and improve performance.
  • Join customer presentations to observe, document recurring challenges and objections, and feed what you learn back into training and messaging.

Create playbooks and messaging

  • Create and present playbooks for our product and target verticals, covering pitches, product demonstrations, value propositions, and objection handling.
  • Review messaging with team members for both live and written customer communications.
  • Partner closely with Product and our product experts to understand every capability of the platform and translate it into what the commercial team needs to win deals.

Coach, assess, and report

  • Build realistic opportunity scenarios, run role-play sessions, grade participants, and create improvement plans where needed.
  • Maintain an ongoing record of Account Executive and Sales Engineer performance to guide targeted enablement.
  • Report regularly to leadership on individual and team capability in delivering product messaging.

Be a hands-on technical voice for BforeAI

  • Support customer calls alongside Account Executives and Sales Engineers when volume requires it.
  • Create content for public outreach, including blogs, LinkedIn posts, white papers, and SEO content.
  • Represent BforeAI as a technology expert at webinars, industry events, and other outreach opportunities.

💥 You’ll be a great fit if

  • You have significant experience building and leading sales enablement, education, or training programs for B2B SaaS, including at least one high-growth startup.
  • You have worked as a Sales Engineer or in a comparable technical presales role, and you know what it takes to demo and defend a technical product in front of a buyer.
  • You are deeply technical in cybersecurity, fraud prevention, predictive analytics, or data analytics, and can explain complex technology clearly to technical and business audiences alike.
  • You turn win/loss analysis and deal observation into specific, measurable improvements in how a team sells.
  • You design and run effective role-plays, assessments, and coaching, holding people to a clear standard while helping them reach it.
  • You write well and present confidently, whether it's a playbook, a customer email, a blog post, or a webinar.
  • You have built certification programs with readiness metrics tied to pipeline and win rates
  • You are a hands-on leader who sets the strategy and does the work, and you're comfortable without a large team or ready-made infrastructure.
  • You collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, and Marketing in a fully remote, distributed environment.

You do not need every item below, but relevant experience may help you have an immediate impact:

  • Experience in a quota-carrying sales role
  • Experience selling to enterprise security, fraud, or risk teams
  • Familiarity with threat intelligence, digital risk protection, brand protection, or online fraud
  • A public profile as a speaker, writer, or industry voice in cybersecurity

If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we hope you’ll still consider applying!

The target annual base salary range for this role is $200,000 to $225,000, plus equity. Final compensation is determined by geographic location, relevant experience, and role-level benchmarking.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

Prenuvo is building a longitudinal care model, where patients have an ongoing clinical relationship rather than a single scan. Our nurse practitioners are the clinicians patients talk to after their scan.

You will review imaging and laboratory results with patients by phone and video, explain what the findings mean, and agree on the right next step together. You will work scheduled consult blocks alongside our full-time nurse practitioner team, to the same clinical and documentation standards.

This is a remote contract role, and it reports to a Nurse Practitioner Manager. This is a 3-month contract position, with the possibility of extension based on business needs.

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct results review consultations by phone and video, reviewing imaging and laboratory results and explaining what they mean
  • Prepare for each consult by reviewing the patient's report, intake, history and prior scans
  • Identify care gaps and recommend next steps, including follow-up imaging, referrals and the interval to the next scan
  • Follow established protocols for actionable findings, and escalate urgent findings to Radiology and Preventive Medicine physicians through the defined escalation pathway
  • Work with care coordinators and registered nurse navigators on follow-up and referral loop closure
  • Document every encounter to clinical standard in HealthCloud, including a care plan the patient can access
  • Work the consult blocks you commit to, and give advance notice of schedule changes
  • Participate in quality reviews and complete required onboarding and protocol training
  • Maintain active licensure and credentialing in assigned states

What You’ll bring

  • Active, unrestricted Nurse Practitioner license (minimum of 10 licenses) and national board certification (FNP, AGNP or ANP), with the ability to obtain licensure in additional states as required; compact state nursing license required
  • Two or more years of clinical practice as a Nurse Practitioner, preferably in primary care, internal medicine, preventive medicine or a related field
  • Demonstrated ability to explain complex clinical findings clearly and without alarming patients
  • Comfortable delivering care by phone and video
  • Strong documentation practice and comfort working in an electronic health record
  • Strong commitment to patient privacy and the handling of protected health information
  • Experience with imaging interpretation in a clinical context preferred
  • Experience in preventive or longevity medicine preferred
  • Experience working remotely in a clinical role preferred

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • The hourly compensation range is $60 to $65 USD depending upon experience

While Freedom Health Systems does not provide direct clinical services, the organization delivers critical operational support through revenue cycle management, prior authorization, medical billing and coding, compliance consulting, and administrative services to outpatient behavioral health providers.

DISCLOSURES:

This document defines the scope of work and service expectations for an independent contractor engagement and does not create an employment relationship. Scope, deliverables, tools, priorities, and assignments may be modified through written amendment based on client needs, regulatory requirements, or contractual obligations.

COMPANY PHONE NUMBER: 667-239-9572

SCOPE OF ASSIGNMENT

This scope of work applies to Team A, supporting one or more outpatient mental health center clients. The Medical Biller & Coder is responsible for executing accurate, compliant, and timely billing and coding services to support end-to-end revenue cycle operations.

SUMMARY OF CONTRACT SCOPE

The Medical Biller & Coder provides medical billing and coding services for outpatient mental health center clients. This includes translating clinical documentation into accurate diagnosis and procedure codes, entering charges, submitting claims, correcting errors, and supporting accounts receivable workflows.

All services are performed under the functional oversight and quality review of the Medical Billing & Coding Analyst 2 (Team Lead – Team A) and are a critical component of the Revenue Cycle Management process.

  • Review clinical documentation to confirm required elements are present prior to billing (signed notes, treatment plans, service dates, units, provider credentials)
  • Assign accurate CPT, ICD-10-CM, and applicable HCPCS codes based on documentation
  • Enter charges accurately into the EHR or billing system
  • Submit claims timely and in compliance with payer-specific requirements
  • Verify patient demographics, insurance information, and payer details prior to claim submission
  • Identify and correct claim rejections, coding errors, and data entry issues

  • Ensure all services rendered are captured and billed; escalate suspected missed charges

  • Support internal quality assurance reviews and audits
  • Participate in training, coaching, and cross-training activities
  • Provide coverage for essential billing tasks during team member absences
  • Support process improvement initiatives related to billing accuracy and turnaround time

TECHNOLOGY, DATA SECURITY & MONITORING REQUIREMENTS

  • All work must be performed exclusively on the assigned Amazon Workstation (AWS virtual workstation) authorized by Freedom Health Systems.
  • Use of personal devices, local storage, screenshots, external email forwarding, or unauthorized systems is strictly prohibited.
  • The Amazon Workstation environment is monitored by the Company for security, compliance, productivity, and quality assurance purposes.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Service quality and contract effectiveness will be evaluated using, but not limited to, the following KPIs:

  • Coding accuracy rate
  • Charge entry accuracy and completeness
  • Clean claim submission rate
  • Claim rejection rate
  • Timeliness of claim submission
  • Error correction and resubmission turnaround time
  • Audit findings and error trends
  • Adherence to established workflows and instructions
  • Responsiveness to Team Lead requests and escalations

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Continuous use of EHR and billing platforms
  • Frequent virtual communication via chat, phone, or video

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Fully remote (Argentina-based) via assigned Amazon Workstation
  • Production-driven, deadline-oriented revenue cycle environment
  • Collaboration across time zones with U.S.-based leadership and client operations

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERTISE

We are on a truly exciting journey as a company. We're growing quickly, investing in our teams, and have bold plans for the future. To support that growth, we're looking for a Senior Customer Success Executive to join our Customer Success Team.

The job in two bullet points:
  • Own and grow a portfolio of higher-complexity and enterprise customers, taking direct accountability for minimizing churn while driving renewal and expansion revenue.
  • Build genuine, long-term relationships with senior stakeholders and lead complex renewal negotiations using a business-development approach rather than a fixed outreach cadence.

You will love this job if...

  • You have 5-8 years of experience in customer success, account management, or licensing, with a track record of managing renewals and mitigating churn.
  • You have a background in business development or strategic account management and experience building long-term relationships at senior stakeholder level.
  • You are comfortable handling commercial objections, including cost-driven pushback, in a calm and consultative way.
  • You have strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • You are comfortable working across internal teams and directly with client contacts at varying seniority levels.
  • You are proficient with CRM tools.

Let's be honest!
This is a senior, commercially focused role involving higher-complexity and enterprise accounts. You will be expected to lead the hardest renewal conversations, build relationships with senior stakeholders, protect and grow the customer portfolio, coach colleagues, and help shape how the team works.
Collected revenue, not simply a signed renewal, is what counts toward your book of business and your results. You will ensure every customer site and location is properly covered, monitor customer usage declarations against public sources, provide compliance assurance, handle renewal objections, identify and close upsell opportunities, and ensure customer invoices are paid in full and on time.

You will develop a strong working knowledge of our licensing model and rightsholder mandate, with full training provided, so you can speak confidently and accurately with customers. jobs.excerpt: Knak is a mission-driven companyWhy?  Because our time is limited, our competition is fierce, and our margin for error is small.
jobs.description:
Knak is a mission-driven company

Why? Because our time is limited, our competition is fierce, and our margin for error is small. To have the biggest impact on the world, we stay focused on our core mission, which is...

Empowering marketers to be creative.

That’s why Knak exists.

In a world where AI has made everyone a creator, Knak helps marketers turn ideas into on-brand, high-performing campaigns at scale. The world's most AI-forward companies, including Meta, OpenAI, NVIDIA, Vercel, Notion and Stripe, use Knak as their agentic marketing production layer.

Here's what they and our investor Insight Partners figured out: creation got easy, but that’s making production harder. Every new idea and brief still has to be built, versioned, checked, approved, and shipped across every channel, and that work runs on handoffs, review cycles, and a lot of copy-paste. That middle stretch of the marketing stack has no system, no standard, and no owner.

Knak is the flexible factory for that work. Our customers set the brand rules, choose the tools that feed in and the platforms that send, and decide where AI does the work and where people do. We handle the repeatable parts, so marketers get their time back for the parts that aren't.

We're built by marketers, for marketers. We started with email because it's the hardest channel to get right and where many campaigns win or lose. Now we're bringing that same production discipline to every channel our customers use.

The Role: Senior Software Developer, Editor

We're looking for an experienced full-stack developer to join the team behind Knak's editor, where marketers design on-brand emails and landing pages without writing code. It's a complex, stateful application: a structured document model, a canvas that renders it live, reusable and lockable modules, translations, version history, and realtime collaboration so whole teams can build together.

You'll work across the entire editor and take ownership of our realtime collaboration engine: the CRDT-based sync layer, running on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects, that lets multiple people, and increasingly AI agents, edit the same asset at once. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves hard frontend architecture and isn't afraid of the distributed-systems problems underneath it. You'll also contribute to architecture decisions, mentor teammates, and work with product and design to shape how marketers create.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build the editor: Design and ship features across our Vue 3 and TypeScript editor, including the canvas, attribute panels, undo/redo, selection, modules and locks, and translations. Keep it fast and correct on large, complex designs.
  • Own realtime collaboration: Evolve and scale our multi-user editing engine (CRDTs, WebSockets, and Cloudflare Workers with Durable Objects). Harden it against reconnects, stale clients and partial failures, and make sure every editor feature behaves correctly when several people are editing at once.
  • Evolve the document model: Extend the structured document format behind every asset, and the pipeline that turns it into production-ready email and landing-page HTML.
  • Enable AI-driven editing: Partner with our AI team so agents can edit designs through the same operations and sync model as people.
  • Build reliable APIs: Develop and maintain the Laravel (PHP) APIs and persistence behind the editor, with a focus on testability, observability and performance.
  • Own it in production: Instrument, monitor and roll out changes safely with feature flags, and debug issues end to end, from the browser through the edge to the database.
  • Elevate code quality: Lead design and code reviews, write down architectural decisions, and keep the bar high.
  • Collaborate and mentor: Work with product, design, QA and DevOps, and share deep knowledge of the editor so the whole team can work on it confidently.

What You Should Bring

  • 6+ years of software development experience, with significant full-stack work
  • Experience building complex, stateful, editor-style web applications, such as design tools, page builders, or rich-text or canvas editors
  • Deep expertise in TypeScript and a modern frontend framework (Vue 3 preferred), including reactivity internals, state management and performance tuning
  • A product mindset: you care about the marketers using the editor, push back on requirements when there's a better solution for them, and judge your work by whether it solves their problem, not just by whether it shipped
  • A progressive, hands-on approach to AI in your own workflow, using coding agents and AI tools every day to move faster, and with the judgment to review, test and own everything they produce
  • Strong web fundamentals: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, the DOM, browser storage, rendering performance and profiling
  • Solid backend experience with PHP/Laravel or a comparable framework, plus MySQL
  • A good grasp of distributed-systems concepts such as consistency, idempotency, ordering and failure handling
  • Production experience with realtime systems such as WebSockets, presence and reconnection
  • Expertise in RESTful APIs, TDD and CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, strong written communication and a collaborative mindset

Nice to Have

  • Experience with collaborative editing technology (CRDTs or OT, e.g. Yjs, Automerge, Loro)
  • Experience with edge or serverless runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, AWS Lambda)
  • Email HTML rendering or cross-client compatibility experience
  • Experience integrating LLMs or AI agents into product features
  • Prior experience in a fast-growing SaaS company

Base Salary

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $130,000 – $160,000/year. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. This range reflects base salary only and does not include other forms of compensation that may be available as part of the total rewards package.

What We Offer

At Knak we have four foundational pillars. Culture, customers, product and growth. Culture is our number one pillar because we know that is at the core of building a strong company that can build amazing products and delight our customers. We do this with a laser focus on hiring the right people who are smart, positive and who want more than the typical nine-to-five offers.

We offer an extremely rewarding, second to none work environment as acknowledged by Ottawa’s Best Places to Work 2026! We show our investment in our people through our competitive salaries, great benefits, paid vacation, Life leave days (because life happens), team lunches and off-sites, and most importantly our commitment to YOUR career growth.

If this sounds like something you’re looking for, then we’d love to hear from you!

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that women and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply. Knak believes in creating an inclusive, barrier-free working environment. If you require ANY accommodation to the interview process please contact Knak, our recruitment process includes AI screening for keywords and minimum qualifications as well as video interviews which are transcribed with AI. Humans are still at the core of our decision making! Please note that this job post is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Location: Remote, United States

Role Type: Full-Time

Reporting to: Chief Product Officer

Total Compensation: $165,000 to $239,000 per year

  • Base salary: $165,000 to $200,000
  • Total compensation includes the base salary plus a guaranteed supplement

The Senior Director of Curriculum is a senior leadership role responsible for the vision, strategy, and execution of CodePath’s entire curriculum portfolio. You will set long-term curriculum direction while directly shaping high-impact courses, particularly in AI-native software engineering, technical interview preparation, cybersecurity, and web development.

You will partner closely with Learning (Programs & Student Experience), Engineering, Platform, Revenue, and Employer Partnerships to ensure CodePath courses remain rigorous, engaging, and aligned to rapidly evolving industry needs. You will own the systems, processes, roadmap and initially manage a small, high-impact team and own hiring as the function scales that allow CodePath to move faster without compromising quality.

Check out our Course Catalog and our 2024 Annual Report to learn more!

Software engineering is changing faster than traditional academic programs can adapt. Generative AI is reshaping how engineers design, build, debug, and ship software—and employers increasingly expect new graduates to be AI-native from day one.

As Director of Curriculum, you will define how CodePath bridges the gap between academic computer science programs and industry expectations. You will lead the transition to a more modular, flexible curriculum architecture that enables rapid iteration, targeted updates, and new delivery models across:

  • Undergraduate, for-credit university partnerships

  • Undergraduate, Direct-to-student programs

  • Employer-focused upskilling and reskilling offerings

Our programs, run both online and in-person, begin with inspiration and build toward technical excellence and practical mastery, supported by learning pathways and strong student support systems. Our curriculum is grounded in proven learning principles — proper leveling, balanced pacing, spaced repetition, blended synchronous and asynchronous learning, peer collaboration, and project-based work.

You will define how we prepare students to become AI-native software engineers and steward our course portfolio to support CodePath’s growth from 20,000 to 100,000 students per year.

Key Responsibilities

Curriculum Strategy & Portfolio Ownership

  • Lead CodePath’s long-term curriculum strategy and transition to a modular, flexible architecture that supports AI- native skills, rapid iteration, and multiple delivery models

  • Own the curriculum product roadmap, maintaining 12-month visibility into new courses, major revisions, and portfolio investments

  • Maintain and evolve a comprehensive course catalog across Web Development, Mobile Development, Cybersecurity, Technical Interview Prep, Foundational CS, and AI-native offerings

Course Development & Quality

  • Lead the design and launch of new courses aligned to emerging industry needs, particularly in AI-native engineering and applied AI workflows

  • Oversee ongoing maintenance, revision, and improvement of existing courses to ensure relevance, rigor, and student impact

  • Ensure curriculum combines rigorous learning science with real-world engineering practice, clear career pathways, and applied experiences including open-source and industry-aligned projects

Team Leadership & Operations

  • Build, manage, and develop a high-performing curriculum team, including full-time staff and external contractors

  • Establish clear processes for curriculum planning, development, QA, feedback, and continuous improvement

  • Partner with senior leadership to forecast hiring needs and scale curriculum capacity in line with organizational growth

Cross-Functional & External Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Learning to ensure curriculum translates effectively into classroom delivery, aligned pedagogy, and student experience

  • Collaborate with Engineering to align curriculum with tooling, content systems, and delivery infrastructure within the CodePath Platform

  • Represent CodePath externally with university partners, employers, funders, and at industry events, clearly articulating curriculum quality and rigor

Key Success Metrics

12–18 Month Success Outcomes

You will be successful in this role if, within your first 12–18 months, you:

  • Establish a clear, opinionated curriculum strategy and modular architecture that reduces the amount of resources required to develop and launch and maintain curriculum by incorporating AI-first curriculum process/tooling

  • Refresh or significantly improve the majority of the existing course catalog with targeted improvements, raising the overall quality bar

  • Launch 2-3 new AI-focused courses that meet industry expectations, strong student satisfaction, and learning outcome benchmarks. Completion (70%), Job attainment (60%) and student NPS (50-60) are expected to be upheld or improved upon

  • Improve curriculum alignment with delivery, contributing to higher completion rates, clearer value propositions, and stronger student confidence entering internships and full-time roles

  • Build a scalable, disciplined curriculum function that is capable of accelerating CodePath’s continued growth and improving quality with successful hiring of two new FTEs and onboarding of key resources

Qualifications

Required

  • Strong software engineering background with the technical credibility to shape CS and AI-native curriculum

  • Demonstrated excellence in curriculum design, computer science education, or instructional leadership

  • Experience owning end-to-end technical curriculum used by thousands of learners, from design through iteration and measurable outcomes

  • Experience or excitement to incorporate an AI-first curriculum process/tooling that accelerates and improves quality

  • Proven ability to lead and develop teams, including managing full-time staff and contractors

  • Deep understanding of the computer science degree journey and the gap between academic preparation and industry expectations

  • First-principles thinker with evidence-based curriculum expertise, high ownership, and a bias towards action grounded with disciplined execution

Preferred

  • Experience designing AI-native, GenAI, or applied ML curriculum

  • Familiarity with open-source software development or community-based contribution models

  • Experience operating in fast-growing, mission-driven organizations

  • Exposure to platform-based or large-scale learning environments

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position’s level, no matter where you live. For this role, we’re hiring for a Senior Director level position at an annual salary of $165,000 to $200,000. Total compensation is $165,000 to $239,000, which includes base salary plus a guaranteed supplement. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

Full-Time Employee Benefits:

This is a 100% remote position—work from anywhere in the U.S.! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program

  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection

  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)

  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support

  • ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt

  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Job Title: Associate Director, Patient Recruitment and Retention Execution Manager

Job Location: Remote, USA

About This Role

The Patient Recruitment and Retention Execution Manager leads a team responsible for delivering patient recruitment, retention, and site engagement solutions across Biogen’s clinical trial portfolio. The role manages team performance, resource planning, and execution to ensure patient engagement strategies are implemented effectively and consistently. Key objectives include optimizing recruitment and retention outcomes, supporting study timelines, mitigating risks, and driving continuous process improvement. Reporting to the Director of Patient Recruitment and Retention Execution, this position is a key leadership role within the Patient Insights and Recruitment organization, partnering closely with Clinical Development and cross-functional stakeholders to support successful trial delivery.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Recruitment & Retention Delivery Leads supporting study-level execution.
  • Set team priorities, goals, performance expectations, and operating standards.
  • Manage resource planning, workload allocation, onboarding, performance feedback, and employee development.
  • Build team capability through best practice sharing, talent development, and consistent execution standards.
  • Oversee delivery of patient recruitment, retention, and site engagement tactics across studies and programs.
  • Ensure recruitment and retention strategies are translated into actionable plans, timelines, milestones, and risk mitigation activities.
  • Monitor execution progress, identify delivery risks, optimize outcomes, and provide recommendations to study teams.
  • Serve as the senior operational liaison for recruitment and retention activities, communicating status, insights, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Influence stakeholders and drive alignment, decision-making, and timely action without direct authority.
  • Drive continuous improvement of processes, tools, governance, reporting, vendor oversight, and functional initiatives while demonstrating strong business acumen, accountability, and ownership of deliverables.

Who You Are

You are a proven people leader with deep expertise in patient recruitment and retention, and a track record of successfully executing strategies across complex clinical trials within biotech, pharma, CRO, or patient recruitment organizations. You are a strategic and operationally focused professional who excels at influencing stakeholders, leading teams and vendors, navigating ambiguity, and driving measurable results in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

Required Skills

  • B.A. or B.Sc. in a scientific discipline; advanced degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in patient recruitment/retention within either CRO, patient recruitment vendor, or related pharma/biopharma environment.
  • 5+ years of people management experience required, including experience coaching, developing, and managing performance of employees or equivalent leadership of a functional delivery team.
  • Strong vendor oversight experience, including KPI monitoring, budget awareness, risk management, issue resolution, and escalation management.
  • Demonstrated experience leading patient recruitment and retention execution across studies, programs, or disease areas, including complex or high-priority clinical trials.
  • Scientifically and clinically astute, with strong project management, communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and business acumen.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority, lead through ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and drive decisions in a matrixed clinical development environment.

Preferred Skills

  • Rare disease experience
  • Neurology experience
  • Global clinical trial experience
Job Level: Management

The base compensation range for this role is: $194,000.00-$266,750.00

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills.
