  • Work with sales teams to keep opportunity values, close dates, next steps, and account information accurate
  • Identify gaps in pipeline data and support timely resolution
  • Provide analysis that helps sales leaders prioritize opportunities and address performance risks

Sales Reporting and Analysis

  • Maintain dashboards and reports covering bookings, pipeline, forecast performance, quota attainment, and sales productivity
  • Work with Finance to ensure consistent definitions and reconcile reporting discrepancies
  • Respond to sales performance questions with clear analysis and practical recommendations
  • Prepare accurate, timely reporting for commercial leadership
  • Coordinate renewal and expansion reporting with the relevant account owners and Client Service teams

Sales Planning Support

  • Support annual and in-year planning through analysis of territories, account coverage, sales capacity, and quota allocation
  • Maintain account and territory assignments and coordinate approved changes
  • Model productivity, ramp time, and coverage scenarios with Sales leadership and Finance
  • Track performance against approved plans and highlight emerging gaps
  • Document and communicate planning decisions to affected teams

Incentive Compensation Administration

  • Support the modeling of sales compensation plans under the direction of Sales leadership, Finance, and Human Resources
  • Maintain approved quotas, plan documentation, and sales-crediting records
  • Prepare and validate commission inputs with Finance and other relevant teams
  • Investigate compensation queries and route exceptions through the agreed approval process
  • Ensure approved plan changes are accurately documented and communicated

Sales Processes and Technology

  • Identify opportunities to simplify sales workflows and reduce administrative effort
  • Gather business requirements for Salesforce enhancements, reporting, and automation
  • Maintain process documentation and support consistent adoption across sales teams
  • Coordinate deal approval workflows with Sales, Finance, and Legal
  • Support accurate handoffs from Sales to implementation and Client Service

Enablement and Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales Enablement on training related to sales processes, reporting, and CRM use
  • Support new-hire onboarding through territory information, reporting access, and operational guidance
  • Provide data and operational support for sales kickoffs and other planning activities
  • Build effective relationships across regional sales teams and supporting functions
  • Manage competing requests transparently and prioritize work according to business needs

What You’ll Need

  • 7+ years of experience in Sales Operations or a closely related commercial operations role, preferably within enterprise B2B software or SaaS
  • Experience supporting international sales teams or working in supply chain technology, enterprise integration, manufacturing, or logistics is very highly preferred
  • Hands-on experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, reporting, and CRM data quality
  • Experience supporting sales planning and incentive compensation processes
  • Strong Salesforce reporting and dashboard skills, with the ability to translate business needs into clear system requirements
  • Advanced Excel or equivalent analytical skills; experience with business intelligence tools is an advantage
  • Understanding of enterprise sales cycles and recurring-revenue business models
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify and resolve data inconsistencies
  • The confidence to facilitate discussions with sales leaders, question incomplete information, and follow up on commitments
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage recurring deadlines alongside improvement projects
  • Clear communication skills and a practical, collaborative approach

What Success Looks Like

Expectations for the First 90 Days

  • Understand the sales structure, forecasting process, reporting requirements, and compensation workflows
  • Establish reliable delivery of recurring sales reports and forecast submissions
  • Identify and address priority pipeline and CRM data-quality issues
  • Implement clear action tracking for sales reviews
  • Agree a focused operational improvement plan with your manager and key stakeholders

Expectations for the First Year

  • More timely, reliable forecasts and sales reporting
  • Better pipeline visibility and more consistent CRM data
  • Accurate, well-documented compensation inputs and timely resolution of queries
  • Effective operational support for territory and quota planning
  • Reduced administrative friction through process improvements and automation
  • Consistent follow-through on actions agreed in sales reviews

Who We Are

Elemica is a leading provider of Digital Supply Chain Management solutions and the premier multi-enterprise collaboration network for global process manufacturing industries. Its portfolio of SaaS-based, network-powered digitization and visibility solutions automate critical information flows, enable multi-channel data strategies, and improve end-to-end supply chain performance. Elemica solutions connect many of the world’s largest manufacturers to their direct material suppliers, logistics service providers and end customers, helping them realize the promise of, and return on, their investments in supply chain digitization. Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

Ce que nous recherchons

Nous recherchons un développeur .NET alliant une expérience dans le développement multiplateforme, avec un fort intérêt pour l’engagement communautaire. Si vous avez travaillé avec WPF, Silverlight, UWP, WinUI, MAUI ou Xamarin, vous connaissez déjà les outils de base utilisés dans Uno et vous vous y sentirez comme chez vous !

Compétences techniques

  • Expérience .NET, C# et des technologies XAML, en particulier pour le développement d’applications multiplateformes.
  • Expérience en développement pour iOS, Android, WebAssembly, Windows, Linux et macOS est un atout
  • Une expérience avec React Native, Flutter ou Skia est un atout.
  • Concevoir, développer et maintenir des fonctionnalités et des bibliothèques au sein de l’écosystème Uno Platform.
  • Garantir le bon fonctionnement sur toutes les plateformes prises en charge.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les chefs de produit, designers et développeurs pour assurer une expérience utilisateur fluide.
  • Connaissance des systèmes de design et des outils comme Blend et Figma est un atout
  • Se tenir à jour sur les tendances du développement .NET et multiplateforme.
  • Maîtrise de l’anglais écrit et parlé pour la documentation, les démonstrations et le travail en équipe asynchrone.

Chez Uno Platform, nous offrons un travail 100 % à distance, avec un siège social basé fièrement à Montréal — vous offrant la flexibilité de travailler de n’importe où tout en restant connecté à une équipe dynamique et innovante.

Uno Platform is a modern, open-source UI framework that empowers developers to build performant, single-codebase applications for Windows, iOS, Android, macOS, Linux, and WebAssembly using C# and XAML.   • Stay current with trends in .NET and cross-platform development.
  • Clear written and spoken English for documentation, demos, and async teamwork.

jobs.description:
About Terawatt Infrastructure

The once in a century transition to autonomous and electric vehicles is underway and will require a multi-trillion-dollar investment in energy and charging infrastructure, and the real estate to site it on. Terawatt is the leader in delivering large scale, turnkey charging solutions for companies rapidly deploying AV and EV fleets. Whether it’s an urban mobility hub, or a carefully located multi-fleet hub for semi-trucks, Terawatt brings the talent, capabilities, and capital to create reliable, cost-effective solutions for customers on the leading edge of the transition to the next generation of transport.

With a growing portfolio of sites across the US in urban hubs and along key logistics and transportation corridors. Terawatt is building the permanent transportation and logistics infrastructure of tomorrow through a robust combination of capital, real estate, development, and site operations solutions. The company develops, finances, owns, and operates charging solutions that take the cost and complexity out of electrifying fleets.

Our Values

Six core values guide how we work: commitments we make to each other. Our pace is set by a simple conviction: imperfect action beats perfect inaction, so we move with purpose, adapt without ego, and measure ourselves by progress rather than activity. Ownership travels with autonomy. Your name is on the work, and the best answer wins the conversation, wherever it lives. That candor works because of what surrounds it: people who show up with intention and have each other's back, tough on ideas and generous with people. Our customers feel this as reliability earned daily, every interaction treated as a chance to build something lasting. And underneath it all is why the work matters. The climate doesn't wait, and the stakes are also human: behind every checklist and every inspection is a person going home safely. We call it "This work has a heartbeat” — it's what the other five rest on.

Our Technology

Terawatt is not a traditional infrastructure operator. Our technology platform transforms a portfolio of sites into a reliable, intelligent network — through advanced power management, operational optimization, and data-driven systems that back our customers with hard performance guarantees. That's what makes us a de-risked operator and a category-defining company.

We sit at a rare intersection: software, hardware, real estate, energy systems, and live site operations. The work is concrete and the stakes are real. The code you write today runs physical infrastructure tomorrow. You'll build systems that orchestrate megawatts of power across hundreds of chargers, ingest millions of telemetry events per day, and keep autonomous fleets, rideshare vehicles, and heavy-duty trucks moving — in real time.

Role Description

    Join Terawatt’s innovative technology team as a Staff DevOps Engineer and help drive the evolution of our platform to support one of the leading fleet EV charging solutions in North America. In this role, you will lead the development and reliability of Terawatt’s charging network management system and the capabilities that enable a high-quality site experience for customers.

    Working closely with the SVP of Technology, the Product team, and other technical partners, you will play a key role in expanding our platform and delivering meaningful value in a rapidly evolving industry. This role will help scale our cloud infrastructure and support organizational growth by implementing best practices that improve the reliability, performance, and maintainability of our charging infrastructure and software systems.

    You will also own the infrastructure behind Terawatt's internal tools and AI platform, partnering with our AI Product Manager and engineers to deploy, secure, observe, and scale agentic workflows across the company.

Core Responsibilities

  • Set technical direction for DevOps and platform engineering, mentor engineers, and champion infrastructure standards across the organization.

  • Lead planning for team goals that align with overall business goals and technology roadmap

  • Lead and architect the evolution of our cloud infrastructure using Terraform, building resilient and scalable systems to support business growth.

  • Maintain helm charts and deployment patterns that enable teams to manage the lifecycle of their services while adhering to established deployment standards.

  • Build tooling to enable engineering teams to own the application deployment process through CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.

  • Drive security across every layer of the stack, using industry-standard tools to detect vulnerabilities and anomalies and automating SOC 2 compliance controls.

  • Extend security controls to AI and agentic systems, covering risks such as prompt injection, over-permissioned tool access, and sensitive data exposure.

  • Advance observability with OpenTelemetry and Grafana Cloud across services, infrastructure, and AI workloads.

  • Build developer tooling for local and remote container-based development, plus automated production-like scenarios for testing and release validation.

  • Build and operate infrastructure for ML and internal AI workloads, including compute for model training, hosting for agents and MCP servers, and least-privilege access to internal data.

  • Partner with the Data team on core data infrastructure, including our Databricks data lake and Kafka event streams (Aiven/AWS).

  • Contribute to building a highly available, web-based depot operations platform that supports the future of EV charging using NodeJS.

  • Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation and lead incident response and blameless postmortems.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years building and operating high-availability production systems, including leading DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering initiatives.

  • Deep experience with building and maintaining AWS, managed Kubernetes (EKS), and infrastructure as code (Terraform).

  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) and observability with tools such as OpenTelemetry and Grafana.

  • Experience leading SRE or DevOps initiatives supporting production cloud platforms.

  • Experience with managed databases such as PostgreSQL or MongoDB.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and infrastructure teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multi-region AWS and EKS at scale

  • Experience operating LLM-based applications or agents in production, including monitoring, cost optimization, evaluations, and LLM-specific security controls.

  • Experience with data platforms such as Databricks or Kafka (MSK) or similar streaming/data platforms.

  • Proficiency in Python or NodeJS.

Compensation for this role is determined by several factors, including the cost of labor in specific geographic markets, and these ranges are intended to provide a helpful reference. The actual compensation offer will be based on the candidate’s location, skills, level of expertise and experience, and internal equity considerations. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package and, where applicable, performance-based incentives.
We are building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. At Terawatt, we continuously strive to foster inclusion, humility, energizing relationships, and belonging, and welcome new ideas. We're growing and want you to grow with us. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

We've delivered high-performance embedded computing solutions for four decades across industries including defence, telecoms, and aerospace. We’re proud to be experts in what we do and are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our brilliant team.

The constant requirement for new, better, and more complex products means that the company requires an additional BIOS Engineer. What will I be delivering?

jobs.description:
Spyre Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company committed to developing next-generation therapies that elevate the standard in immunology by delivering more complete disease control, greater durability, and a simpler treatment experience for patients. Spyre's pipeline includes investigational extended half-life antibodies targeting α4β7, TL1A, IL-23, and IL-17A/F as well as rational combination programs.

Role Summary:

The Executive Director, Clinical Operations, will provide strategic leadership and hands-on oversight of global clinical trials, ensuring trials are delivered within agreed timelines and budgets and meet quality standards and applicable regulatory requirements.

This individual will translate clinical development objectives into operational plans and lead trial execution from start-up through close-out. Responsibilities include trial planning, enrollment, site engagement, CRO and vendor oversight, budget management, risk mitigation, and operational readiness for key trial milestones.

The Executive Director will partner closely with Clinical Development and other functions, serve as a key point of contact for CROs and clinical investigators, and develop and mentor Clinical Operations personnel. Success requires sound judgment, accountability, and the ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a growing biotechnology company.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and execution of clinical operational strategies and study plans aligned with clinical development priorities and corporate objectives. Oversee global clinical trial activities from feasibility and start-up through enrollment, trial conduct, database lock, and closeout.
  • Establish and manage trial timelines, budgets, resource plans, and performance metrics; identify risks early, establish mitigation plans, and drive timely resolution of issues.
  • Partner with Clinical Development and cross-functional colleagues to assess protocol feasibility and contribute operational input to protocols, informed consent forms, study plans, and other trial-related documents.
  • Implementation and management of the clinical operational plans and programs in order to meet corporate goals and objectives.
  • Lead CRO and vendor selection, contracting, governance, and performance oversight, ensuring clear responsibilities, effective communication, and accountability for deliverables.
  • Oversee country and site feasibility, site selection, activation, monitoring, and closeout activities.
  • Build effective relationships with clinical investigators and site teams to support trial execution, participant recruitment and retention, and timely issue resolution.
  • Develop and oversee enrollment strategies along with Medical Affairs, monitor recruitment performance, and implement actions to address enrollment challenges.
  • Partner with Data Management, Biometrics, Clinical Development, and other functions to support data quality, timely query resolution, database lock, and clinical trial reporting.
  • Develop and manage study budgets, oversee contract and budget negotiations, and monitor forecasts, invoices, and payments in partnership with Finance and Legal.
  • Partner with Quality to maintain inspection readiness, support audits and regulatory inspections, and ensure timely resolution of findings and implementation of corrective actions.
  • Develop and maintain Clinical Operations SOPs, processes, and tools; provide training and drive improvements that support quality and efficient execution.
  • Provide clear, actionable updates to senior leadership and Development Teams on study progress, budget performance, risks, and decisions requiring escalation.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Operations personnel, establishing clear expectations and fostering collaboration, ownership, and high-quality execution.
  • Maintain current knowledge of relevant therapeutic areas, clinical trial practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Regularly make presentations to senior staff members and participate in relevant Development Team meetings.
  • Ensure familiarity with new developments in disease indications being studied as well as relevant guidelines and regulations pertaining to the conduct of clinical trials.
  • Attend scientific and external training meetings as needed.
  • Other clinical operations activities as required.

Ideal Candidate:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, healthcare, or related discipline required; advanced degree preferred. A minimum of 10 years of global clinical research experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Late-stage dermatology clinical trial experience is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success overseeing clinical trial planning, start-up, enrollment, monitoring, data cleaning, database lock, closeout, and clinical trial reporting.
  • Experience leading CROs and other clinical service providers, including vendor selection, contract negotiation, governance, and performance management.
  • Strong financial and operational management skills, including study budgeting, forecasting, resource planning, and risk management.
  • Thorough understanding of Good Clinical Practice and applicable local and global clinical trial requirements, with experience supporting audits, regulatory inspections, and inspection readiness.
  • Experience contributing to protocols, SOPs, clinical study reports, and regulatory submissions preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop Clinical Operations personnel and guide cross-functional teams through influence.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and decision-making skills, including the ability to communicate complex issues and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, adapt to changing needs, and combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a growing organization.

What We Offer:

  • Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where you help shape the culture of our young company, contribute broadly to advance meaningful medicines, and learn quickly.
  • Market competitive compensation and benefits package, including base salary, performance bonus, equity grant opportunities, health, welfare & retirement benefits.
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Two, one-week company-wide shutdowns each
  • Commitment to provide professional development opportunities.
  • Remote working environment with frequent in-person meetings to address complex problems and build relationships.

The expected salary range offer for this role is $285,000 to $310,000. Actual pay offered may vary depending on job related knowledge, experience, education, and geographic location.

As an equal opportunity employer, Spyre is committed to a diverse workforce. Employment decisions regarding recruitment and selection will be made without discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, genetic information or characteristic, gender identity and expression, veteran status, or other non-job-related characteristics or other prohibited grounds specified in applicable federal, state and local laws. We also embrace differences in experience and background, and welcome diversity of opinions and thought with active recruitment designed to create a stronger and better Spyre that is focused on developing life-changing products for patients.

jobs.description:
À propos de Workleap

Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006. Bâtisseurs dans l'âme, on crée des produits simples qui font une réelle différence pour ceux qui les utilisent. On a deux lignes de produits : L'agent Workleap, notre nouvelle solution conçue pour aider chaque gestionnaire à être plus efficace et ShareGate, la référence mondiale de migration et de gouvernance Microsoft 365. Plus de 15 000 entreprises dans le monde nous font confiance pour faire exactement ça. On est intentionnels dans notre choix des gens qu'on recrute : des personnes qui ont envie de retrousser leurs manches et de construire quelque chose de significatif dans une des périodes les plus excitantes de l'histoire de la tech.

Ton rôle

Dans ce rôle, tu seras au cœur de l’expérience employé : c’est toi qui assures un support fiable, humain et efficace pour toute l’équipe de Workleap. Tu touches à une belle variété de demandes, de la gestion des accès et des outils SaaS à l’administration du parc informatique, et ton objectif reste simple : aider vite et bien.

Au quotidien, tu analyses et résous des enjeux techniques, puis tu documentes ce que tu apprends pour que toute l’équipe en profite. Tu as aussi voix au chapitre : si tu vois une façon d’améliorer un processus ou un outil, tu la proposes, et on l’essaie rapidement.

Tu travailles main dans la main avec l’équipe sur les incidents et les projets ponctuels, en gardant tes priorités claires dans un environnement qui bouge vite, et c’est exactement ce qui rend le poste stimulant.

Ton impact :

  • Assurer un support fiable et humain à toute l’équipe de Workleap, pour qu’elle retrouve rapidement sa productivité et que l’expérience employé reste au cœur de nos priorités ;
  • Prendre en charge la gestion des accès et des outils SaaS, afin que chaque nouvelle personne soit opérationnelle dès son premier jour et que nos accès demeurent sécurisés ;
  • Maintenir le parc informatique (rotation, déploiement, inventaire) pour garantir des équipements fiables et à jour à l’ensemble de l’équipe ;
  • Documenter et structurer les connaissances de l’équipe, pour réduire les demandes répétitives et permettre à chacun.e de résoudre plus vite ;
  • Intégrer l’IA dans ton quotidien (Claude, automatisations Slack, skills) pour accélérer la résolution des demandes et libérer du temps pour des projets à plus forte valeur ;
  • Proposer et mener des améliorations de processus et d’outils, afin d’augmenter l’efficacité de l’équipe et l’expérience utilisateur.

Ton équipe

Dans les prochains mois, notre priorité est d’offrir un support rapide, humain et constant à une entreprise en transformation, tout en réduisant le travail répétitif. Concrètement, on travaille sur les profiles, on déploie One Login pour simplifier l’accès de toute l’équipe à ses outils et on automatise la coordination des demandes. Le défi, c’est de garder une excellente expérience pour nos collègues pendant que les volumes et les besoins augmentent. Notre ambition : mieux documenter, automatiser ce qui peut l’être (Slack, Jira Assets) et faire de chaque technicien.ne un point de contact fiable et autonome.

On est une équipe de sept, composée de technicien.ne.s, d’un.e administrateur.trice système, d’un.e administrateur.trice endpoint et d’un.e gestionnaire, qui travaille en français et en anglais selon les besoins. On communique surtout par Slack, de façon directe et sans trop de cérémonie. On partage l’information, on s’entraide et on reste curieux : chacun.e peut proposer des améliorations ou tester de nouveaux outils. On prend des décisions rapidement et on les ajuste en cours de route.

Ce que tu apportes

  • Bilinguisme français et anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, car tu soutiendras des client.e.s internes qui parlent les deux langues ;
  • Solide expérience en support TI de première et deuxième ligne, avec un excellent sens du service et de la communication ;
  • Aisance avec les environnements Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, la gestion d’accès et les outils SaaS (SSO, MDM, ticketing) ;
  • Connaissance de la gestion de parc informatique (déploiement, inventaire, cycle de vie des équipements) sur Windows et macOS ;
  • Mindset builder : tu documentes, tu structures et tu automatises ce qui est répétitif plutôt que de le refaire à la main ;
  • À l’aise avec l’IA au quotidien (Claude, assistants, automatisations) pour résoudre plus vite et créer de nouveaux outils pour l’équipe ;
  • Atout : expérience avec Jamf, Jira / Jira Assets ou Slack, ou notions de scripting (PowerShell, Python) ou d’automatisation no-code.

La plupart de cela te ressemble ? Postule.

Ce que le poste inclut

  • Salaire de base : 68 000$ - 85 000$. Cette fourchette reflète notre échelle salariale pancanadienne. L'offre finale peut être ajustée selon la région du candidat pour s'aligner avec les conditions du marché local.
  • Assurances collectives familiales + télémédecine + budget bien-être annuel.
  • Politique de vacances flexible.
  • Télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal.
  • Rassemblement en personne deux fois par an.
  • Claude accessible à tous.

Ce qui nous anime

Chez Workleap, on construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux.

On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement.

Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici.

Comment on recrute

La transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous.

Voici comment ça se passe : un premier échange avec un.e recruteur.euse, puis un entretien virtuel avec le.la gestionnaire d'embauche. Tu complètes ensuite une étude de cas à faire chez toi, suivie d'une rencontre avec de futur.es collègues pour en discuter ensemble. Selon le poste, le parcours peut varier légèrement — ton.ta recruteur.euse t'en donnera tous les détails lors de votre premier appel.

On utilise l'IA pour soutenir certaines étapes du processus, mais chaque décision d'embauche reste humaine.

On a hâte de te rencontrer.

En postulant, tu confirmes avoir lu et accepté notre politique de confidentialité.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Enterprise Product team is responsible for bridging the gap between Stripe's core capabilities and the bespoke needs of the world's largest organizations. We are hiring product managers who will be aligned to specific priority industries (e.g., insurance, healthcare, public sector), with each product manager acting as the "CEO" of their assigned vertical—identifying high-leverage opportunities, building 0-to-1 products to solve industry-specific blockers, and influencing our global product roadmap. You will be a critical partner to GTM leadership (Sales, Partnerships, Marketing) and a navigator across the broader Product organization. We are looking for high-agency builders who thrive in ambiguity and know how to move mountains through both direct execution and cross-functional influence.

What you'll do

We're hiring a product manager to own Stripe's product strategy and execution across our priority industry verticals, starting with complex, regulated industries like insurance, healthcare, and public sector. We are seeking a highly-entrepreneurial, data-driven product leader who will define where Stripe plays, build 0-to-1 products to unlock new revenue, and influence Stripe's broader Product organization to meet the unique needs of enterprise customers in your vertical. The products you build will directly shape how the world's largest companies use Stripe—and how Stripe grows within one of its most strategic segments.

Responsibilities

  • Own the industry product roadmap—Define and execute the multi-year product strategy for your priority vertical. Translate your "where to play and how to win" thesis into a concrete roadmap—deciding what Stripe builds natively, what we solve through platform extensibility, and where we partner. Own measurable outcomes tied to revenue, adoption, and merchant satisfaction.
  • Ship 0→1 products—Identify unmet needs through deep customer research, data analysis, and market intelligence. Lead the full product lifecycle for industry-relevant functionality—from problem definition and technical scoping with engineering, through PRD, API and UX design, build, launch, and post-launch iteration. You'll make hands-on trade-off decisions about scope, technical approach, and sequencing with your engineering team.
  • Be a strategic partner to GTM and customers—Work deeply with our largest customers, partners, and GTM teams. Translate "market noise" into clear product signal—shaping feature requirements, and defining the data models and integration patterns that enterprise customers in your vertical need.
  • Act as a force multiplier across Stripe's platform—Influence Stripe's core product teams (Payments, Billing, Connect, and beyond) to ensure their roadmaps reflect the requirements of enterprise customers in your vertical. To do this credibly, you'll need to go deep on Stripe's platform—understanding our APIs, infrastructure constraints, and extensibility model—so you can advocate for changes with technical specificity, not just business cases.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 12+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping successful products in complex, regulated environments.
  • Technical fluency—You don't need to write code, but you're comfortable reading an API spec, reasoning about system design trade-offs, and holding your own in engineering discussions. You've shipped products where the "how we build it" mattered as much as the "what."
  • Deep customer obsession—A talent for getting close to customers—talking to merchants and partners—and distilling complex pain points into simple, elegant product requirements.
  • Analytical rigor—You use data—not just intuition—to prioritize. You're comfortable defining metrics frameworks, digging into usage data, and making quantitative arguments for (or against) product investments.
  • A master communicator—Stripe is a writing-heavy culture. You must be able to articulate deep technical and strategic concepts through precise, persuasive prose—your narrative docs are things of beauty.
  • High agency and influence—Adept at finding "homes" for initiatives, building consensus across disparate teams, and driving momentum without needing formal authority.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and bias for action—Comfortable with ambiguity, skilled at prioritizing high-impact initiatives, and experienced operating with limited resources to unlock outsized outcomes.

Preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience building products in Healthtech, Insurtech, Public Sector, or similarly complex, regulated industries.
  • Experience building platform, API, or developer-facing products.
  • Experience working closely with Enterprise Sales teams and C-suite stakeholders at Fortune 500 companies.

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Technical Owner you’ll own every technical decision behind our programs, from the first conversation with a course author to the bug that never reaches a learner. This is a technical partner role, not a coding job: you weigh each decision against cost, time to learner, and bugs shipped, and you lead one engineer who writes autotests. The role is fully remote and full-time, for candidates based outside the US.

What you will do

  • Own each program’s technical setup. Know its environments, services, providers, and autotests, and keep a written map of what each program depends on.
  • Shape new and updated programs. Collect requirements from authors and constraints from product, test the options, and land on a workable trade-off.
  • Replace what no longer fits. Find, cost, and run the switch when a tool, provider, or setup is outdated or too expensive.
  • Manage providers. Compare offers, negotiate terms, and own integrations with external providers.
  • Lead autotest coverage. Set coverage and priorities for the autotest engineer, and write or fix tests yourself when needed.
  • Be our customer to engineering. Write specs with acceptance criteria for automation, API, and platform needs, and chase each one to done.
  • Cut bugs reaching learners. Trace each bug to where it entered, close the gap with a test, check, or process change, and track the trend.

Requirements

Must have

  • End-to-end technical ownership. 3+ years in engineering, QA automation, or technical operations, including choosing a product’s setup and living with the trade-off after launch.
  • Solid mid-level coding. Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, Git, CI, containers, and REST APIs: enough to read unfamiliar code, fix bugs, and write autotests.
  • English for requirements work. Strong enough to run requirements sessions and write specs engineering teams accept without a round of questions.

Nice to have

What we can offer you

Job Description

Join Us as an Assistant Clinical Research Associate – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.


As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to perform remote activities on assigned projects in liaison with the CRA and study Clinical Lead. As an Assistant Clinical Research Associate, you'll provide support with site preparedness, logistical support to the monitoring process, and assist with assigned tasks for site management and remote monitoring in accordance with SOPs and regulatory guidelines. You may be assigned limited site contact activities during study start-up, site management, recruitment, and close-out phases.

What You’ll Do:

  • Completes study and site management activities as defined in task matrix, andas applicable and directed for study assigned.
    •Completes and documents study-specific training.
    •Orients and trains on any study-specific systems.
    •Provides in-house support during pre-study assessments and with pre-study assessment waivers, as agreed for project.
    •Supports to customize Site ICF with site contact details, as needed.
    •Performs remote review of EMR/EHR checklist and supports collection, as applicable assessments.
    •Verifies document collection and RCR submission status; updates site EDL and verifies site information.
    •Reviews patient facing materials and review translations, as directed.
    •Supports site staff with the vendor related qualification process, where applicable.
    •Provides support by ensuring system access is requested/granted and revoked for relevant site staff during pre-activation and subsequent course of the study.
    •Provides support to follow-up on site staff training, as applicable.
    •Coordinates and supports logistics for IM attendance, as directed.
    •Supports maintenance of vendor trackers, as directed.
    •Coordinates study/site supply management during pre-activation and subsequentcourse of the study.
    •Supports Essential Document collection, review and updating in systems, as applicable.
    •Follows up and supports on missing study vendor data like ECGs, lab samples, and e-diaries, as directed.
    •Supports ongoing remote review of centralized monitoring tools, as directed.
    •Supports Site payments processes by coordinating with various functional departments within organization and site. Supports system updates and reconciliations, as directed and follows-up on site invoices throughout the study period.
    •Performs reconciliation tasks on assigned trials including but not limited to CRF and query status, deviations, SAEs and safety reports, as applicable.
    •Verifies document collection status in company systems and drives action for missing/incomplete/expired documents and open document findings, as directed.
    •May perform other assigned site management tasks, as directed by CRA and as per Task Matrix.
    •May perform a specific role profile for FSP opportunities according to Client requests.
    •Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.

    Education and Experience Requirements:
    •Bachelor's degree in a life science discipline or related field or a Registered Nursing certification or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.
    •Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 0 to 2 years).
    In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

    Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
    • Basic medical/therapeutic area knowledge and understanding of medical terminology
    • Ability to attain and maintain a working knowledge of ICH GCP, applicable regulations and company procedural documents
    • Effective oral and written communication skills
    • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
    • Good organizational and time management skills and strong attention to detail, with proven ability to handle multiple tasks efficiently and effectively
    • Proven flexibility and adaptability
    • Ability to work in a team or independently, as required
    • Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to critical mindset, in-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving
    • Proficient computer skills with good knowledge of MS Office ability to learn and use appropriate software. Leverage modern technology when applicable
    • Ability to extract pertinent information from all study documents, electronic study data systems, CTMS and dashboards
    • Excellent English language and grammar skills



    Working Conditions and Environment:
    • Work is performed most of the time in an office or home office environment.; occasional travel toclinics/hospitals may be required.
    • Exposure to electrical office equipment.
    • The Assistant CRA role does not involve regular travel, however, any direct, promotional opportunities in the CRA career track will require frequent travel (60-80%).

jobs.excerpt: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business.  By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.
The Software Engineering Manager – Foundry is responsible for leading the team that builds Signal, the in-house ERP application that runs the operational backbone of Foundry, AHEAD’s engineering and integration arm that designs and deploys custom enterprise infrastructure from the data center to the edge. Signal supports workflows such as production and work order management, inventory and materials tracking, procurement, and integration scheduling, serving as the system of record that keeps engineering, operations, and delivery teams aligned as infrastructure moves through design, build, and deployment. This role owns the health, growth, and performance of a globally distributed team based in the US and India, while partnering with product and business stakeholders to deliver features that drive real value. While primarily focused on people leadership and delivery, this position requires strong technical instincts to guide architectural decisions, remove blockers, and set the standard for the fluent, responsible use of AI tools and coding agents. The ideal candidate will embody AHEAD’s values of passion, quality, teamwork, and integrity, and will measure success by the success of the team and the impact of the products they deliver.

Duties/Responsibilities

    • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of software engineers building Signal, the software that drives Foundry.

    • Global Collaboration: Lead a globally distributed team, collaborating closely with developers based in both the US and India.

    • Career Development: Conduct regular 1:1s, provide feedback, and support career development for team members.

    • Hiring and Onboarding: Participate in hiring efforts, including sourcing, interviewing, and onboarding new engineers, hiring and developing for judgment, product sense, and verification skills rather than raw output.

    • Team Culture: Foster a healthy team culture built on collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

    • Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with product management and business stakeholders to translate requirements into actionable development plans.

    • Delivery Ownership: Own delivery timelines and ensure the team ships high-quality software on schedule.

    • Technical Guidance: Guide technical discussions and help the team make sound architectural decisions.

    • Removing Obstacles: Remove obstacles and shield the team from distractions so they can focus on building.

    • Development Process: Establish and refine development processes and AI-assisted workflows, balancing agility with predictability.

    • AI Leadership: Champion fluent, responsible use of AI tools and coding agents as a force multiplier, so the team delivers faster while staying firmly accountable for review, testing, quality, and security.

    • AI Workflows and Standards: Shape the team’s AI workflows, tooling, and standards, and keep improving them as the landscape shifts.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, customer success, and other engineering teams.

    • Technical Engagement: Stay close enough to the codebase, and to how the team works with AI, to give meaningful input during code reviews and technical planning.

Education and Experience

    • Minimum Required – 5+ years of experience in software development, with at least 2 years in a management or team-lead role.

    • Preferred – 8+ years of experience in software development, with 3+ years managing teams building web applications and experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or ERP systems.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

    • Programming Languages and Technologies: Experience managing teams building web applications, ideally in Elixir/Phoenix or similar modern stacks, with the ability to provide meaningful technical guidance.

    • AI-Assisted Development: Fluency with modern AI development tools, and a clear point of view on how they change the way teams build, hire, and measure impact.

    • Development Practices: Strong understanding of software development practices, including testing, CI/CD, code review, and Agile methodologies.

    • People Management: Proven ability to hire, develop, and retain strong engineering talent, with a genuine interest in the growth and well-being of the people you manage.

    • Delivery Management: Experience managing delivery across multiple products or initiatives simultaneously.

    • Trust and Collaboration: A track record of building trust with both the team and cross-functional partners.

    • Communication: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences.

    • Adaptability: Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

    • APIs and Infrastructure: Familiarity with REST and GraphQL APIs, database design, and cloud infrastructure is a plus.

    • Domain Knowledge: Experience in manufacturing or supply chain is a plus.

The compensation range indicated in this posting reflects the On-Target Earnings (“OTE”) for this role, which includes a base salary and any applicable target bonus amount. This OTE range may vary based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

Why AHEAD:

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1400+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Our business opportunity is significant; we can deliver both infrastructure and business applications to the enterprise market. As companies refresh their data centers, our goal is to be the platform for cloud and apps. As they re-architect their business applications to embrace open source, our goal is to deliver the majority of their databases, analytics, messaging, publishing, identity, security, workflow... everything that is open source. We are committed to do that at the most efficient price points possible to drive down the total cost of IT, but this is nevertheless a significant global market, and our ambition is to be counted among the most valued software suppliers to the Global 10,000.

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Manager to lead a regional team in our financial forecasting, budgeting, and corporate performance tracking initiatives. In this role, you will bridge the gap between financial data and executive decision-making, aligned with the company roadmap. You will manage a talented team of analysts, build robust financial models, and provide actionable insights directly to senior leadership and department heads to drive sustainable growth.

Location: This is a remote role, in AMER or EMEA time zones.

What your day will look like

  • Develop executive reporting dashboards and documents including Board reporting, monthly financial results and other management presentations
  • Analyse & Report monthly results, leading indicators and KPIs to support monthly forecasting and annual plan attainment
  • Provide commercial analysis, develop growth targets, and evaluate strategic initiatives
  • Work with product managers to produce, aggregate, and distribute both market insights and competitive intelligence
  • Manage financial models, including budgeting, forecasting, and long range planning
  • Drive improvements in data analysis, and determine the appropriate processes, methodologies, and modeling techniques to deliver insights.
  • Partner with Accounting and Investor Relations to support month end close, flux review processes, and financial reporting
  • Drive multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy
  • Play a key role in preparation of critical public financial documents to support an IPO process, including supporting the production of investor materials and public filings

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Have operated in a high growth, multi currency/geography technology business with a mixed go-to-market motion
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities
  • Highest ethical standards, integrity, authenticity, credibility, and character
  • Curiosity and willingness to work on a wide range of projects
  • Proficiency in spreadsheets, financial modeling, and BI tools
  • Understanding of core accounting principles
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Passionate, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet and exceed commitments
  • Ability to travel up to 4 times per year, for company events up to two weeks long

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • MBA or equivalent combination of professional certifications and experience
  • Previous experience as a subject matter expert in Financial Planning & Analysis

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Voltus is seeking a Partnerships Sales Director to grow our battery energy storage business through partnerships with battery developers and the companies that install and deploy battery projects.

Interest from partners who want to work with Voltus is growing quickly, and this role exists to turn that interest into signed deals. You will make the case that Voltus is the best monetization and optimization partner for partner's projects, while building partnership structures that deliver the most value for our customers, our partners and for Voltus.

  • Own partner relationships and projects from initial interest through diligence, definitive agreement, and ongoing management

  • Carry a sales quota and own the pace of every deal, finding ways to shorten the sales cycle.

Desired Qualifications

  • 5+ years of full cycle sales experience.

Job Description Summary

GE HealthCare’s Strategic Advisory Services team partners with health systems to improve patient outcomes, operational performance, financial sustainability, and strategic growth through expertise-led, technology-enabled care transformation.

We are seeking a deeply experienced Theranostics leader to serve as a domain expert within our national healthcare advisory team. Working alongside experienced strategy and operations consultants, this individual will help health systems design, launch, scale, and optimize Theranostics programs and associated oncology care pathways.

The successful candidate will bring credible, hands-on understanding of radiopharmaceutical therapy, molecular imaging, multidisciplinary care delivery, and the operational, regulatory, and financial requirements of successful Theranostics programs. This expert-practitioner will translate deep domain knowledge into executive-level strategies, practical recommendations, and implementation road maps that create measurable customer value.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Theranostics and Executive Advisory

  • Advise clients on the clinical, operational, organizational, regulatory, facility, and financial considerations involved in developing and sustaining high-quality Theranostics programs.
  • Translate complex Theranostics considerations into clear strategic choices, practical recommendations, and implementation priorities.
  • Maintain current knowledge of relevant clinical evidence, emerging indications, regulatory developments, reimbursement policy, technologies, and care-delivery models.

Client Engagement and Delivery

  • Lead on Theranostics and Molecular Imaging advisory engagements focused on program development, growth, transformation, and performance improvement.

  • Integrate clinical, operational, strategic, and financial considerations to support complex health system decisions.
  • Structure engagements and deliver executive-quality analyses, recommendations, and implementation plans.
  • Manage projects with rigor and risk management to deliver on-time and on-budget.

  • Contribute Theranostics and Molecular Imaging expertise to the continued development and improvement of Strategic Advisory Services capabilities and client work.
  • Support business development through customer discovery, engagement scoping, proposal development, and executive presentations.
  • Contribute to relevant thought leadership, professional forums, and relationships within the Theranostics community.
  • Collaborate across GE HealthCare and contribute Theranostics and molecular imaging expertise to broader oncology and adjacent care-transformation engagements, as appropriate.

  • Bachelor’s degree in nuclear medicine, molecular imaging, clinical sciences, medical physics, healthcare administration, business, or related field.
  • Progressive leadership experience in nuclear medicine, molecular imaging, oncology, radiopharmaceutical therapy, healthcare operations, or a closely related field.
  • Substantial direct experience designing, launching, operating, expanding, or optimizing a Theranostics or radiopharmaceutical therapy program.
  • Deep understanding of the Theranostics patient journey and the clinical, operational, regulatory, infrastructure, facility, staffing, and financial requirements of successful program delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise senior executives, physicians, and cross-functional health system leaders with credibility.
  • Ability to translate complex clinical and operational issues into structured analyses, executive-level recommendations, and actionable plans.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives through ambiguity, organizational change, and competing stakeholder priorities.
  • Strong analytical skills, experience with healthcare data, and able to find impactful insights in complex data sets.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.
  • Self-directed and intellectually curious, with the ability to lead complex work and manage multiple priorities in an evolving healthcare environment.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree or relevant professional credentials in nuclear medicine, molecular imaging, medical physics, radiation safety, oncology, healthcare administration, or related discipline.
  • Direct experience with PSMA-targeted and somatostatin receptor-targeted diagnostic and therapeutic pathways.
  • Experience addressing multiple dimensions of Theranostics program development, including care pathways, program operations, infrastructure, regulatory readiness, and financial sustainability.
  • Experience with radiopharmaceutical therapy clinical trials, emerging indications, or evolving care-delivery models.
  • External thought leadership through publications, conference presentations, professional societies, research, or industry working groups.

jobs.title: General Counsel
jobs.excerpt: AE Studio is a ~160-person, fully bootstrapped applied AI company.
jobs.description:
AE Studio is a ~160-person, fully bootstrapped applied AI company. We've spent over a decade building and shipping production AI for clients in finance, defense, aviation, healthcare, and education, including generating millions per week in additional revenue for a major airline and building the AI-enabled school of the future, where students are performing in the top 1% nationally. Without outside investors we are able to choose where the money goes, and we put it into alignment research through the AI Alignment Foundation, a nonprofit we founded to scale this work.

We're running a DARPA seedling on alignment and control, our policy team engages directly with the government on AI alignment, and our work has been featured many times in the Wall Street Journal. We collaborate with researchers at Anthropic, Princeton University, University College London, Redwood Research, and MATS. The research team is 25 people and growing.

About this role

We need our first in-house lawyer. Demand and our own expansion have outpaced what we can handle today: research grants closing, government and national-security work opening up, university and lab partnerships forming, and a shift toward outcome-based commercial work. All of it carries real legal weight and business urgency, and today it sits largely on the founders' shoulders, backed by excellent outside counsel.

You'd start by learning what already works here and helping scale it, then improving and adapting it as new opportunities arise. The timing is the real opportunity: we're 10 years in, established and growing fast, and right at the start of a major inflection point. You'd be here during a step change.

What you'll work on

A handful of things are happening at once, and the legal side of each is the core of the role.

  • We're shifting the commercial business toward outcome-based and productized work. That moves delivery ownership to us, meaning stronger margins and tighter focus on outcomes; you'd shape these deal terms.
  • Major research grants are coming in to fund our foundational AI Alignment work, and you'd help us win them and put them to work.
  • Government agencies, research labs, and universities are coming to us to collaborate. These partnerships are often first-of-their-kind, and you'd help shape them.
  • Our government work is expanding fast, opening a category of contracts and programs that are new ground for us and full of upside.

Intellectual property runs through all of it, and there's real opportunity in how we own, license, protect, and publish it. Underneath sit the steady in-house workstreams: NDAs and vendor agreements, employment, corporate governance, and the processes that let legal scale.

About you

We're after a strong generalist more than a specialist: solid fundamentals, judgment from real experience, and the ability to pick up new areas fast and get good at them. Day to day you'd work alongside executives, making the key calls and scaling the function.

Specifically, someone with:

  • Real business sense. You read the gap between strict interpretation and what's sensible, see where the real risk sits, and give practical guidance.
  • A negotiator who stays flexible but takes care of us, and knows which terms are worth fighting for.
  • A clear translator in both directions: turn complex business dynamics into plain strategy, and translate business goals into the right legal structure.
  • No-job-too-small instincts. A one-page NDA and a government contracting strategy are both yours, handled without ego.
  • A technical background, or deep experience with technology and technical people. You're comfortable around AI and can hold your own with engineers.
  • An AI-native way of working. You use the latest AI tools in your own legal practice to move faster and go deeper, and you do it with care for confidentiality, accuracy, and privilege.
  • Strong organizational and process skills and a systems mind, with an ownership mentality for building.
  • Creativity and the hunger to find the best answer, including approaches most lawyers wouldn't reach for.
  • A real partnership with outside counsel: when to bring them in, how to brief them, and how to get the most out of them.
  • Alignment with how we operate. We move fast, take high-variance bets, care a lot about getting things right, and own our outcomes.

Requirements

  • JD from an accredited law school, with active, good-standing membership in the California bar (open to options for exceptional out-of-state candidates).
  • Required: real strength in commercial transactions and in technology/AI work.
  • Ideal: experience across IP, nonprofit, grants, and government. You'll touch all of these here, and growing into some is fine.
  • Enough experience to have real judgment, usually substantial in-house time and/or strong firm training. We weigh judgment, adaptability, and business instinct as heavily as years or a prior GC title.
  • Complete integrity and discretion with sensitive matters.
  • Comfort in a fast, ambiguous, high-ownership environment.

Logistics

  • We are open to either full-time to start or starting on a fractional/consulting basis and convert to full-time as the work and fit develop.
  • Ideally Los Angeles; remote considered for the right person, with regular travel to HQ.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Good-faith base salary range (full-time) is $225,000 - $300,000, plus variable compensation and equity participation. If starting as an initial fractional engagement, compensation is a mutually agreed rate or retainer based on scope.
  • Remote-first with flexible schedules, health insurance, free lunches at the office, weekly knowledge-sharing talks, and an annual team retreat. Regular performance-based raises and a diversified employee equity program.

Role: Sales Manager, Other LATAM

Reports to: Regional Sales Director, LATAM

Location: Santiago, Chile preferred

Description: 

The Sales Manager will join our high-performance Global Sales and Marketing team, renowned for its excellence and success. The manager will be tasked with spearheading the sales strategies and activities for ILSC, Greystone and ELS in Chile, Argentina or Uruguay. The sales role entails orchestrating comprehensive plans to drive enrollment into our language and higher education programs. We are seeking an adept communicator with a proven track record in collaborating with agencies, schools, and universities to foster student enrollment to ILSC, ELS, Greystone College and Greystone Institute. The ideal candidate will possess a blend of charisma, ethical conduct, and a results-driven mindset, while harboring a passion for international education. The manager will be a personable and persuasive communicator, results-oriented, highly ethical, a great team player, who is seeking an opportunity to grow with a world-leading global organization in international education.

This full-time sales role offers a competitive salary package, covering 37.5 hours of work per week. However, there may be occasions when the manager will need to work additional hours per week to fulfill project deadlines and tasks, including exhibiting at fairs and/or while travelling within the region on behalf of the company. As a remote sales position, candidates should be located in Santiago, Chile or Buenos Aires, Argentina, though Chile is preferred.

Job Duties: 

The duties of this position include, but are not limited to:

  • Collaborate closely with the Regional Sales Director and sales team members to ensure the attainment of enrollment targets. This objective will be realized through increasing sales from our current agent partners and onboarding new agents with significant growth potential.
  • Support the Regional Sales Director in crafting sales projections and budgets, aiding in strategic planning for sales initiatives and resource allocation.

Drive the promotion of all ILSC Education Group brands through a multifaceted approach:

  • Presentation skills: Utilize effective presentation techniques to showcase the value propositions of ILSC Education Group to potential partners and clients.
  • Agent workshops and fairs: Participate in workshops and fairs to engage with students to increase sales.
  • Pricing strategies: Develop and implement competitive pricing strategies that resonate with the target market, ensuring optimal balance between affordability and profitability.
  • Training of agents: Provide comprehensive training programs for agents to equip them with the knowledge and skills necessary to effectively promote and sell all ILSC Education Group programs, thereby maximizing enrollment opportunities.
  • Produce group quotes.
  • Actively listen to our clients’ needs and share it with the management in a timely manner.
  • Recruit new agents and strengthen relationships with existing agents.
  • Report on agents’ performance as well as market conditions that impact enrollment numbers.
  • Participate in the development of new promotional materials in Spanish for LATAM markets.
  • Respond to general agent inquiries within one business day.
  • Travel to attend agent fairs and workshops.
  • Regularly liaise with agents to obtain student arrival information and payments, and to gather reasons for student cancellations.
  • Other duties and projects as per the direction of the Regional Sales Director.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Attributes: 

  • While not mandatory, candidates with an educational background in sales, marketing, business, communications, or related fields are preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in the international education industry.
  • Willingness and ability to travel.
  • Keen understanding of the higher educational systems in the US, Canada, Ireland and Australia.
  • Familiarity with key competitors is essential.
  • Possession of an existing network of relationships within the education industry is a valuable asset.
  • Eligibility to work in the hiring location without sponsorship.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • A self-starter who works well individually and in group settings.

Contact Information: 

While we thank all applicants, only those who are shortlisted will be contacted.

About ILSC, ELS, Greystone College & Greystone Institute

A world leader in language education & vocational training, ILSC Education Group, which opened its first language school in Vancouver, Canada in 1991 and Greystone College in 2002, offers life-changing educational experiences in Canada, Australia, Ireland and India, some of the world’s most attractive and popular English-speaking work and study destinations. Since opening its first school in Vancouver, BC, Canada, ILSC has become a world leader in language and career training and has grown to include 10 incredible locations around the world, in Vancouver, Toronto and Montréal, Canada; New Delhi, India; and Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide and Perth, Australia; and Dublin, Ireland; as well as two online language schools, ILSC HELLO and ILSC ALLO. In 2025, ILSC Education Group launched Greystone Institute, a new Higher Education provider in Brisbane.

In early 2022, ILSC Education Group joined forces with ELS Educational Services, bringing together over 100 years of combined experience delivering life-changing learning experiences to international students. Since 1961, when ELS Educational Services opened its first school in Washington DC, ELS has developed a global reputation for delivering top-quality English language programs. ELS now has the most extensive network of on-campus English language programs and University partners, across the USA.

Our mission is to provide our global community with transformative learning, living and work experiences by offering the finest language, career and higher education programs.

PASSION: To enrich & transform people’s lives

INNOVATION: To evolve through creativity & diversity.

RESPECT: To treat everyone with compassion & dignity.

COLLABORATION: To build community & achieve more together.

INTEGRITY: To act responsibly & ethically in everything we do.
