Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.

  • Troubleshoot complex network issues methodically, communicate findings clearly, and document resolution paths that the whole team can learn from
  • Identify gaps and improvements proactively, bring forward recommendations with context, and follow through on the work
  • Support a culture of continuous improvement, not through dramatic overhauls, but through consistent, deliberate progress

  • 5 or more years of hands-on network engineering experience, with meaningful time spent in cloud environments

  • Solid working knowledge of load balancing principles and real-world application delivery

  • A communication style that is direct, open, and respectful, you surface concerns early, share context generously, and engage in honest dialogue even when it is uncomfortable
  • A growth mindset: you measure yourself not against perfection but against where you were last quarter

How you work

At ESO, the strongest signal of a great engineer is not what they know on day one, it is how they approach learning, collaboration, and accountability over time. We are looking for someone who:

  • Asks the questions that move conversations from stuck to forward
  • Takes ownership without needing to own everything alone

About Us

Crescendo is the AI-native customer experience platform built to run a company’s entire CX operation in one connected system. We bring together customer support, workforce management, quality, and knowledge, with specialized AI agents doing the work and people guiding it.
Over the past year, AI-handled volume on our platform grew 600%. Brands like Grindr, Headspace, and Nothing Bundt Cakes trust Crescendo, and Newsweek recognized us as a 2026 AI Impact Awards winner.
Our mission is to deliver exceptional customer experiences that propel organizations, combining an AI-native CX platform with CX expertise to deepen trust and drive business impact. Join us and help shape what comes next.

The Role

We’re looking for a Director Marketing, Communications and Content to own Crescendo’s story end to end: what we say, how well we say it, and where it lands. This is not a traditional PR role or a content factory. You’ll manage our PR agency, have a nose for what’s newsworthy, and the editorial judgment to distinguish content that earns attention from content that simply fills a calendar. You’ll work closely with Product Marketing, Sales, and executive leadership, measuring success by share of voice, top-tier coverage, and pipeline influence.

What You Own

Narrative & Thought Leadership:
  • Original research. You commission and produce data stories journalists reference and analysts quote: the annual AI/CX trends report, the cost of bad customer experience, and what 100% QA reveals.
Earned Media & PR:
  • Proactive earned media. You develop and execute the strategy that positions Crescendo as a leader in AI and customer experience, moving quickly on breaking stories and inserting Crescendo into conversations that matter.
  • Media relationships. You build and maintain relationships with tier-one tech and business press, CX trade and vertical media, and the analysts and influencers who shape how CX leaders buy.
  • The full PR program. You own media relations, press releases, awards, speaker placements, and thought leadership, including the briefings, media training, and follow-ups that make them successful.
  • PR agency management. You are the primary contact for our PR agency and regional partners. You set briefs, KPIs, and performance expectations, manage reviews, and ensure consistent messaging as we expand internationally.
  • Measurement. You own share of voice, reported monthly by Market Intelligence, along with coverage volume, quality, and program ROI, adjusting the strategy based on results.

Campaigns & Customer Stories:

  • ​​​Competitive campaigns. You create content that drives displacement of legacy helpdesk platforms, CCaaS incumbents, and AI-only agent vendors. “Your dashboard is lying to you” isn’t a tagline; it’s a campaign. You build campaigns like these.
  • Industry content. Retail, e-commerce, financial services, and travel. Each vertical has unique pain points. You write content tailored to each industry’s needs.
  • Customer stories. You interview customers, uncover the insight buried in their results, and turn it into case studies, video testimonials, and press-ready proof. Not just a quote and a logo, but a story with a real before and after.
Webinars, Events & Social:
  • Webinar and event content. Field Marketing manages production and logistics. You own the content: topics, speakers, pre-event thought leadership, live amplification, and repurposing each session into posts, clips, emails, and sales assets over the following six months.
  • Owned and earned social. You lead Crescendo’s LinkedIn and social media strategy, driving amplification and positioning Crescendo’s executives as voices in the AI/CX conversation.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in communications, content marketing, or editorial roles at B2B technology companies, with hands-on experience pitching, placing, and producing stories.

This isn’t just a tagline or marketing campaign – it’s at the heart of everything we do. We start from within, through a culture of kindness, positivity and inclusivity. We believe in always doing the right thing for our clients and communities and know that with a great team, everything is possible.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Qualitative
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT USPureprofile’s vision is to deliver more value from the world’s information.
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Pureprofile’s vision is to deliver more value from the world’s information. We are a global data and insights organisation providing industry-leading online research solutions to agencies, marketers, researchers and brands & businesses.

The Company, founded in 2000 and based in Surry Hills, Australia, now operates in North America, Europe and APAC and has delivered solutions for over 850 clients.

CORE PURPOSE

The Project Manager - Qualitative is a hands-on delivery role responsible for running qualitative research projects end-to-end — from kick-off through recruitment, fieldwork, and analysis to final delivery. Reporting to the Head of Operations - Qualitative, they own the day-to-day management of an allocated portfolio of projects, keeping engagements on time, on budget, and to a high standard of quality. The role coordinates internal researchers and external suppliers, serves as a reliable day-to-day client contact, and escalates risks and complex decisions to the Head of Operations early. Success in the role is measured by on-time delivery, project margin, methodological quality, and client satisfaction across the portfolio.

ABOUT THE ROLE

CORE ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Manage the end-to-end delivery of an allocated portfolio of qualitative projects — from kick-off through recruitment, fieldwork, moderation support, reviewing project data, and reporting — keeping each project on time, on budget, and to specification
  • Coordinate projects across the full qual toolkit (in-depth interviews, focus groups, ethnography, online communities, digital qual platforms, hybrid qual-quant), regularly communicating (with internal & external stakeholders) on delivery logistics and execution
  • Build and manage detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets; track progress against milestones and proactively flag risks or slippage to the Head of Operations
  • Own project margin and on-time delivery across the portfolio; monitor costs against scope and escalate variations or scope changes early
  • Quality-check key project deliverables — recruitment screeners, stimulus, fieldwork schedules, and status reports — coordinating inputs from clients and suppliers
  • Serve as a day-to-day client contact on assigned projects; manage expectations, provide clear status updates, and maintain trusted working relationships
  • Regular project updates to clients and internal sales contacts flagging concerns upfront and providing sampling strategies for hard to achieve targets
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation in Salesforce and other systems; ensure compliance with ISO requirements, Fair Data Principles, and internal best practice
  • Identify and suggest improvements to qual delivery processes, templates, and tooling, supporting the Head of Operations on their roll-out
  • Contribute to a positive, collaborative team culture — sharing knowledge with peers and supporting more junior team members and recruiters where needed

ABOUT YOU

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 2–5 years’ experience in qualitative research project management or delivery, with hands-on involvement in recruitment, fieldwork coordination, analysis, and reporting
  • Solid working knowledge of contemporary qual methodologies — IDIs, focus groups, ethnography, online communities, digital qual platforms, and hybrid qual-quant designs
  • Strong organisational and project management skills — able to juggle multiple concurrent projects, competing deadlines, and shifting priorities without dropping quality
  • Demonstrated experience managing project timelines, budgets, and quality; comfortable tracking margin and flagging issues early
  • Confident coordinating internal stakeholders and external suppliers to keep multiple projects moving in parallel
  • Good client management skills — able to communicate clearly, manage expectations, and build reliable day-to-day relationships with research buyers
  • A commercial mindset — understands the link between scope, cost, and margin, and supports sales on accurate project costing and feasibility
  • Familiarity with qual suppliers across ANZ (recruiters, viewing facilities, transcription, translation, digital qual platforms) is an advantage
  • Experience with CRM and project management systems (Salesforce or equivalent); exposure to ISO-certified environments a plus
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — clear, accurate, and well-organised in both client-facing and internal contexts.

WHY JOIN US

Be part of a growing, global organisation with a dynamic and admirable culture where you will have the ability to thrive, grow and be creative.

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome all races, religions, and genders. We have zero-tolerance for workplace bullying, discrimination, and harassment.

If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Pinterest is seeking a Manager II, Engineering to lead our Kubernetes Platform team. The team builds and operates the infrastructure and tooling that help engineers run reliable, scalable services on Kubernetes.

You will lead engineers working on production systems that need to be dependable, secure, efficient, and straightforward for customers to use. You will work with partner teams across Pinterest to improve the platform, reduce operational friction, and make sound decisions when reliability, speed, cost, and security pull in different directions.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead a team of engineers responsible for Kubernetes platform infrastructure and the systems that support it.
  • Establish the team’s 12-month strategy, roadmap, and success measures.
  • Improve the reliability, security, scalability, and operational efficiency of the platform.
  • Drive architecture and technical decisions, including in areas that are new to you. Build context quickly, involve the right experts, and make decisions when the team needs direction.
  • Build automation, standard configurations, and self-service paths that reduce manual work for both the team and its customers.
  • Set a high bar for how the team operates production systems, including service health, observability, on-call, incident response, and safe changes.
  • Partner with engineering, product, finance, security, and cloud-provider teams on shared technical and operational challenges.
  • Recruit, coach, and develop engineers; empower senior technical leaders; and sustain an inclusive, accountable team.
  • Use AI to accelerate analysis, investigations, documentation, and repeatable workflows while applying judgment and verification to ensure quality.

What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience managing engineering teams in infrastructure, platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, cloud systems, distributed systems, or similar technical areas.
  • Experience managing and developing teams that build or operate large-scale cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, shared compute platforms, or other production systems.
  • Experience setting a multi-quarter technical strategy and delivering through senior engineers.
  • Technical experience in public cloud, highly available distributed systems, Kubernetes or shared-compute platforms, and production operations.
  • A strong reliability mindset and experience leading teams responsible for the operational quality of production systems.
  • Experience leading cross-functional infrastructure programs and communicating reliability, security, cost, capacity, and delivery tradeoffs to partner teams.

  • Strong record of evaluating AI-assisted work through testing, source checking, data validation, or peer review.

      • Experience operating a large Kubernetes fleet or multi-tenant compute platform.
      • Experience with infrastructure as code, Kubernetes lifecycle management, observability, networking, or production upgrades.

jobs.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role.

What you'll do:
  • Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering.
  • Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries.
  • Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams.
What you'll bring:

Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below.

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful.
  • Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling.
  • Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use.
How you work:
  • You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state.
  • You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve.
  • You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns.
  • You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment.
  • You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. jobs.excerpt: DescriptionTripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets.
jobs.description:
Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Lead Motion & Graphic Designer in the Curriculum team, you’ll turn complex tech concepts into clear visual and interactive learning experiences, and lead the team that makes them. About 80% of your time goes to hands-on design, motion, video, and interactive work; the other 20% to team leadership. Curriculum visuals help students understand and remember a concept, so we favor clarity, calm pacing, and accurate diagrams over flashy effects.

What you will do

  • Design learning visuals. Create graphics, animations, motion pieces, and explainer videos with Learning Experience Designers, from concept and storyboard to final edit.
  • Set the quality bar. Own visual and motion standards for curriculum content: guidelines, templates, and reusable asset libraries.
  • Lead the team. Run critiques, weekly planning, and retros; mentor designers with regular, actionable feedback; improve intake, reviews, and handoffs.
  • Speed up production. Partner with product, design, and engineering on shared libraries, AI-assisted workflows, and automation of repetitive work.
  • Prototype interactive formats. Design clickable diagrams, simple simulations, and step-by-step visual explainers for our learning platform.
  • Finish video. Edit and enhance video content, adding simple visual effects and sound design.
  • Experiment with new formats. Test new video and interactive formats, using Claude Design and Claude Code to prototype faster.

Requirements

Must have

  • 4+ years in motion and graphic design. A portfolio showing motion, graphic design, and visual storytelling, built in After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Figma.
  • Design leadership. Experience leading or mentoring designers, or owning design standards and processes for a team.
  • English at B2 or higher. Confident written and spoken English for daily work in a remote, cross-functional team.

Nice to have

  • Interactive and UX work. Interactive pieces in your portfolio, and a grasp of how people read, scan, and interact with learning materials.
  • AI creative tools. Hands-on use of Claude Design, Claude Code, or AI agents in Figma to prototype.

Position Overview:

Connor Consulting is a fast-growing, modern, international company comprised of top-caliber professionals. This role sits within the Software Publisher Services (SPS) line of business and is dedicated to a single, high-volume compliance program delivered on behalf of a global enterprise software publisher.

This is a platform-led program rather than a traditional audit role. Licensees complete their own compliance review through a dedicated audit platform, and the Program Associate drives that process end to end. You will own a large portfolio of engagements over the course of the year, with a large number active at any given time, and you will be accountable for getting each one started, unstuck, and closed. The work is high-cadence and relationship-driven: daily outreach, structured follow-up, clear escalation, and disciplined tracking. It is a strong fit for someone from a compliance, audit support, renewals or customer success background who is energized by volume, ownership, and consistent execution.

This is also a build role. The program is expanding, and the person who establishes the operating rhythm in the US will be positioned to add supporting staff and grow into a Manager role.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own an assigned portfolio of active compliance engagements and drive each one from initial outreach through closure against defined cycle-time and service level targets.
  • Conduct daily outreach and structured follow-up with licensee contacts by email and phone, maintaining persistent and professional contact cadences on unresponsive accounts and applying defined escalation triggers.
  • Onboard licensees onto the audit platform: explain the process and timeline, direct them to the platform, walk them through the required inputs, and resolve access or usability issues that stall completion.
  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for licensee questions, objections, and concerns; handle pushback diplomatically and escalate contractual, disputed, or legal matters to the Senior Manager.
  • Lead the verification call with the licensee to confirm and clarify the data submitted through the platform.
  • Identify licensees unwilling or unable to use the platform and coordinate the exception path to a standard, manually executed review with the engagement team.
  • Review submissions for completeness and obvious anomalies, apply the program’s standardized methodology and templates, and prepare findings for Senior Manager review.
  • Maintain complete and accurate account status, contact history, and next actions in Connor’s engagement platform as the single system of record for the program.
  • Produce recurring program reporting for the client and internal leadership, including pipeline by stage, aging, response and completion rates, and results to date.
  • Monitor throughput, flag bottlenecks and recurring licensee objections, and recommend improvements to outreach templates, platform guidance, and process documentation.
  • Support the onboarding and day-to-day direction of additional program staff as the program scales.
  • Other duties may be assigned without notice.
  • Senior Associate: Carry a larger portfolio, own the most sensitive or highest-value accounts, quality review the work of supporting staff, and act as backup program lead.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • BA/BS in Business Administration, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
  • 2+ years in software license compliance, contract or audit compliance support, customer success, account management, renewals, inside sales, or a comparable high-volume client-facing role.
  • Exposure to software licensing concepts and contract terms. Prior license compliance or software asset management experience is preferred but not required; the ability to learn a publisher’s licensing model quickly is essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing a high volume of concurrent accounts or cases without loss of accuracy or follow-through.
  • Comfort working from a repeatable playbook: applying the same process consistently across hundreds of accounts while recognizing the exceptions that require escalation.
  • Fluency with CRM, ticketing, or case management platforms (for example Salesforce, HubSpot, Monday.com, or Zendesk) and a track record of disciplined data hygiene.
  • Proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite with solid Excel skills including lookups and pivot tables. Advanced modeling is not required.
  • Excellent written communication, with the ability to maintain a consistent and professional tone across a high volume of outbound correspondence.
  • Confident verbal communication and the ability to lead a call with a licensee’s technical, procurement, or finance contacts.
  • Professional persistence: comfortable following up repeatedly with unresponsive contacts and navigating resistance without escalating tension.
  • Self-directed, organized, and reliable with minimal day-to-day supervision.
  • Based in and available to work United States business hours, with occasional flexibility for licensees in other regions.
  • Minimal travel expected, up to 10%.

Preferred Additional Experience

  • Prior experience on a publisher-side or Big 4 software license compliance team.
  • Experience supporting customers through a self-service or customer-completed data collection platform.
  • Familiarity with common software deployment and usage data sources.
  • Second language capability (Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, or Polish) in view of planned EMEA expansion.

Competencies and Skills

  • Ownership mentality; treats the assigned portfolio as a book of business to be advanced every day
  • Consistency and follow-through
  • Resilience in the face of non-response, delay, and pushback
  • Strong organization and prioritization across many small, simultaneous commitments
  • Clear and concise communication with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Sound judgment about when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate
  • Collaborative and professional demeanor with clients, licensees, and internal teams
  • Genuine interest in process improvement and in building something repeatable and scalable

Measures of Success

  • First 30 days: Program mechanics and licensing model learned, platform fluency established, outreach templates in use, and the full portfolio loaded and accurate in the engagement platform.
  • First 60 days: Daily outreach cadence running consistently, the first cohort of licensees onboarded to the platform and submitting data, and program reporting delivered on schedule.
  • First 90 days and beyond: Consistent throughput against agreed volume and cycle-time targets, exception and escalation paths operating cleanly, and documented improvements to the program playbook.

Working Conditions

  • Remote role in the US, aligned to United States time zones
  • Sustained periods of computer and telephone-based work with a high volume of daily contacts
  • Occasional flexibility to work varied schedules to accommodate licensees in other time zones
  • Minimal travel; occasional mobility within office and client site environments

Customer understanding

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Technical Owner you’ll own every technical decision behind our programs, from the first conversation with a course author to the bug that never reaches a learner. This is a technical partner role, not a coding job: you weigh each decision against cost, time to learner, and bugs shipped, and you lead one engineer who writes autotests. The role is fully remote and full-time, for candidates based outside the US.

What you will do

  • Own each program’s technical setup. Know its environments, services, providers, and autotests, and keep a written map of what each program depends on.
  • Shape new and updated programs. Collect requirements from authors and constraints from product, test the options, and land on a workable trade-off.
  • Replace what no longer fits. Find, cost, and run the switch when a tool, provider, or setup is outdated or too expensive.
  • Manage providers. Compare offers, negotiate terms, and own integrations with external providers.
  • Lead autotest coverage. Set coverage and priorities for the autotest engineer, and write or fix tests yourself when needed.
  • Be our customer to engineering. Write specs with acceptance criteria for automation, API, and platform needs, and chase each one to done.
  • Cut bugs reaching learners. Trace each bug to where it entered, close the gap with a test, check, or process change, and track the trend.

Requirements

Must have

  • End-to-end technical ownership. 3+ years in engineering, QA automation, or technical operations, including choosing a product’s setup and living with the trade-off after launch.
  • Solid mid-level coding. Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, Git, CI, containers, and REST APIs: enough to read unfamiliar code, fix bugs, and write autotests.
  • English for requirements work. Strong enough to run requirements sessions and write specs engineering teams accept without a round of questions.

Nice to have

  • Leading engineers. Leading or mentoring at least one engineer, ideally in test automation.
  • EdTech and content validation. LMS or autograded courses, QA or release work, or agents that check content for accuracy and freshness.
  • Automation and data stack. Claude Code, MCP, n8n or Make; SQL and dashboards.

What we can offer you

  • Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
  • Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration
  • Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

Remote — International Hire ONLY | Contract Full-Time

About TNT Growth

TNT Growth is a performance-driven growth marketing agency that embeds directly into our clients' businesses to produce measurable outcomes across paid media, creative strategy, and analytics. We drive impact!

About the Role

We are looking for a senior Conversion Tracking & API Engineer who can independently own complex, production-grade tracking across browser, server, CRM, and ad-platform APIs. You combine deep backend and data-integration expertise with a practical understanding of paid-media measurement and strong client-facing communication.

This is not a tag-only or passive back-end role. You will work directly with Growth Managers, Client Success, client engineering teams, and external platforms. You will own the path from consented browser and session capture through forms and CRM lifecycle events, event processing, ad-platform delivery, diagnostics, reconciliation, and monitoring. If you can build reliable systems, prove that they work end to end, and explain them clearly to non-engineers, this role was designed for you.

What You'll Do

  • Strong Communication
    • Proactively flagging implementation gaps, risks, and unverified assumptions before a campaign goes live — and separating confirmed root cause from a working hypothesis
    • Writing implementation and QA summaries that a Growth Manager without an engineering background can read, understand, and act on
    • Responding to questions in Slack within a reasonable window during working hours
    • Asking a clarifying question rather than building the wrong thing for two days
  • Conversion Tracking Architecture & Identity
    Design, build, and maintain client-side and server-side conversion tracking across Meta Pixel/CAPI, Google Ads API and Data Manager API, Enhanced Conversions and offline uploads, TikTok Events API, and other major platforms. Own signal design, event taxonomy, account and action routing, timestamps, value and currency, attribution windows, and accuracy from landing page to ad platform.
  • CRM Integration & Event Pipeline Management
    Build and maintain integrations among client sites and forms, CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho, call-tracking and scheduling tools, TNT infrastructure, and ad-platform APIs. Use webhooks, change data capture, OAuth, and queues to deliver events with validation, idempotency, retries and backoff, dead-letter handling, replay and backfill, and a complete audit trail.
  • Browser, Identity & Cross-Domain Instrumentation
    Implement and debug GTM, server-side GTM, Google tag and GA4, platform pixels, deterministic dataLayer events, first-party session IDs and cookies, URL propagation, and form injection across redirects, subdomains, SPAs, embedded forms, and booking tools. Preserve and validate GCLID, GBRAID, WBRAID, FBCLID, FBP, FBC, TTCLID, MSCLKID, UTMs, and consent state through the funnel.
  • Ad-Platform API & Payload Engineering
    Build platform-correct payloads and matching logic: normalize and hash permitted identifiers exactly once, send consent signals, pair browser and server events with stable event or order IDs, prevent double counting, handle adjustments and redactions, diagnose partial acceptance and attribution-window failures, and improve match quality using platform diagnostics.
  • End-to-End QA, Reconciliation & Production Operations
    Create synthetic tests that follow the real user journey from landing page through CRM and queue to the ad-platform UI. Reconcile source, database, CRM, internal reporting, and platform counts; monitor match quality, attribution lag, and delivery failures; produce evidence, alerts, runbooks, and incident updates; and verify fixes after launch.
  • TypeScript Development
    Write clean, well-tested TypeScript across the stack, including API clients, webhook handlers, and event workers. Own engineering quality through automated tests, code review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Data Layer & Database Work
    Design and operate PostgreSQL schemas for attribution sessions, identities, conversion events, attempts, and delivery status. Write diagnostic SQL, optimize queries and indexes, plan retention, and trace data from ingestion through reporting without exposing sensitive data.
  • AI-Assisted Development & Tooling
    Use AI systems (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and others) as force multipliers for debugging, code generation, documentation, and pattern recognition. Validate generated work and never trade tracking correctness, security, or maintainability for speed.
  • Cross-Functional Communication & Ownership
    Communicate clearly and proactively with Growth Managers, Client Success, client engineers, and platform support. Translate root cause, risk, evidence, dependencies, and ETA into updates non-engineers can act on. Own incidents through verification and follow-up, not just code deployment. Create reusable standards, runbooks, and guidance that raise the capability of the broader team.
  • Version Control & Collaboration
    Own your work in Git. Strong branching strategy, meaningful commit history, clean PRs, and collaborative review habits. You treat version control as a professional practice, not a formality.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Senior-level, hands-on production experience with complex conversion tracking across Meta Pixel/CAPI and Google Ads API or Data Manager API, including Enhanced Conversions and offline conversions; additional TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft Ads, or Reddit CAPI experience is strongly preferred
  • Hands-on browser and server-side instrumentation with GTM, server-side GTM or equivalent, Google tag and GA4, deterministic dataLayer events, SPAs, redirects, cross-domain and subdomain flows, embedded forms, and booking tools
  • Expertise in attribution identity and matchback: GCLID, GBRAID, WBRAID, FBCLID, FBP, FBC, TTCLID, MSCLKID, first-party session IDs, cookies or URL propagation, consent state, and CRM persistence
  • Deep knowledge of ad-platform payload semantics, including event names, action source, account and action IDs, value and currency, timestamps and time zones, stable event or order IDs, browser and server deduplication, attribution windows, conversion adjustments or redactions, and partial-acceptance diagnostics
  • Experience mapping CRM objects and lifecycle stages and integrating systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Attio, GoHighLevel, Typeform, or call-tracking platforms through webhooks, change data capture, and APIs
  • Demonstrated ability to prove delivery end to end with synthetic tests, platform diagnostics, source, CRM, database, internal-reporting, and ad-platform reconciliation, match-quality monitoring, alerting, incident response, and written QA evidence
  • Experience implementing consent-aware tracking and privacy controls under GDPR, CCPA, and ad-platform policies, including permitted PII collection, normalization and hashing exactly once, data minimization, and sensitive-category restrictions
  • Strong understanding of API client design, REST and webhook integrations, OAuth and secrets handling, change data capture, rate limits, partial failures, and inter-service communication patterns
  • Direct production experience with message queues (RabbitMQ, BullMQ, SQS, or similar), including idempotency, deduplication, retries and backoff, dead-letter handling, replay, and high-volume backfills
  • Proficient in TypeScript — clean, typed, testable, and maintainable across API clients, services, and asynchronous workers
  • Strong PostgreSQL and ORM fundamentals (Prisma, TypeORM, or equivalent), including diagnostic SQL, schema design, query and index optimization, and data retention
  • Strong working knowledge of paid-media measurement: funnel and lifecycle event design, primary and secondary conversions, values, attribution windows, match quality, platform learning-volume tradeoffs, and channel differences across Meta, Google, TikTok, and related platforms
  • Strong Git skills — branching, PR workflows, code review participation, and version control discipline
  • Practical fluency with AI development tools and the judgment to validate their output; AI expertise is secondary to conversion tracking, API, and backend engineering depth
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, including client-facing technical discovery, implementation documentation, incident updates, and evidence-based explanations

Compensation

This is a non-US, long-term contract role.

  • Non-US Salary Range: $40k-$80k (Based on Location and Skillset)
  • 12 Paid Holidays and 18 Paid Days Off

You will work closely with Sales, Procurement and Inventory, Finance, and our manufacturing and fulfillment partners to make sure requirements are clear and commitments are met.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. When inventory is short, an EDI document is rejected, or a shipment is at risk, you will identify the issue early, bring the right partners together, and drive it to resolution.

As Snif expands its retail distribution, you will help shape the processes, reporting, and tools the business relies on, working directly with the VP of Operations to improve how we serve our retail partners.

This role will report directly to the VP of Operations.

    • Invoicing and Chargebacks

    • Retail Launch Readiness

    • Reporting and Process Improvement
    • Maintain accurate order records and reporting by retailer and distribution center, with clear deadlines, shipment status, exceptions, and next actions
    • Improve procedures, service reporting, and backup coverage; simplify or automate repetitive work and verify that changes improve accuracy and reliability

What You'll Bring:

    • 3+ years of relevant experience in wholesale order management, retail operations, or customer operations within a consumer products business
    • Experience personally managing national retailer orders from receipt through delivery and invoicing, including resolving exceptions across internal teams and fulfillment partners
    • Experience supporting multiple distribution centers and meeting retailer routing and compliance requirements
    • Hands-on experience monitoring EDI transactions, diagnosing operational errors, and working with providers to resolve them
    • Experience working directly with third-party warehouses and transportation partners on fulfillment and delivery issues
    • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including reconciling order, inventory, shipment, and invoice data
    • Sound judgment when priorities compete, with the ability to explain risks, recommend actions, and recognize when a decision requires approval
    • Clear communication, careful attention to detail, and consistent follow-through
    • Examples of improving an operating process, with a clear explanation of your contribution and the resulting change in accuracy, service, or manual effort

jobs.excerpt: Company Overview Imagine Everything.  Build the Future with Hexion.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Imagine Everything. Build the Future with Hexion.

At Hexion, we push boundaries, rethink possibilities, and create real impact. We activate science to deliver progress—developing breakthrough solutions that strengthen industries, protect communities, and drive a more sustainable future.

This is where bold thinkers, problem-solvers, and innovators come together to shape what’s next. Whether you're engineering advanced materials, transforming manufacturing technologies, or leading strategic innovation, your ideas and actions leave a lasting mark. We cultivate an inclusive culture of growth, collaboration, and accountability, ensuring every contribution propels us forward.

We don’t follow the status quo—we challenge it, disrupt it, and improve it. Every role at Hexion is part of something bigger.

We invest in innovation, sustainability, and continuous development—equipping you with the tools, training, and opportunities to excel. With an unwavering commitment to safety, partnership, belonging, and impact, we empower you to lead change and strengthen industries worldwide.

Your Future Starts Here.

If you’re ready to push limits, reimagine what’s possible, and create the extraordinary, Hexion is where you belong.

Anything is possible when you imagine everything.

Role Impact

The Process Controls and Automation Manager leads the process controls and automation center of excellence (COE) team in conjunction with other global engineers to hold high accountability for the performance, reliability, and standardization of the control systems that run Hexion's manufacturing network. This is a working manager role: the incumbent leads a team of process controls engineers while remaining personally engaged in design, programming, troubleshooting, and technology evaluation at the plant level.

The Manager sets the direction and standards for control system and OT network architecture, programming practice, and instrumentation across the region, and converts site issues, project demand, and emerging technology into a prioritized work plan the team can execute. The role owns the process controls project portfolio, partners with project and process engineering managers on multi-site implementations and serves as the senior technical authority when control system incidents, upgrades, or new installations require immediate direction.

The Manager reports to the Sr. Director, Manufacturing Process Engineering and works in a peer relationship with Reliability, Operations, Maintenance, EHS, IT, and AI. Success in the role combines deep technical credibility in SIS, PLC, DCS, and MES environments with the people leadership to build a capable, geographically distributed team and the business judgment to make the case for control system investment.

What You Will Do

Process Controls Leadership and Technical Direction (40% of Time)

  • Lead the Process Control and Automation COE group, setting priorities, assigning work, and ensuring the team delivers responsive support to sites across the region.
  • Own the development and maintenance of process controls standards and protocols that standardize the equipment, instrumentation, programming methods, and documentation used in plant control systems.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for instrument and control activities, communicating clearly with technicians, site leadership, and senior management when issues arise.
  • Direct the design and specification of instrument and control equipment on capital and maintenance projects, and lead or assign engineers to project design teams.
  • Manage SIS, DCS, and PLC reliability, software upgrade programs, and system downtime within a matrixed supply chain and across assets at varying stages of their depreciated life.
  • Oversee reliability calculations for safety instrumentation system (SIS) and the documentation supplied to safety standard committees.
  • Support regional specialists and site teams in troubleshooting efforts and corrective actions, providing immediate direction during process incidents and new installation start-ups.
  • Partner with Reliability, Operations, EHS, and IT to keep control system practice aligned with plant reliability, process safety, and cybersecurity requirements.

Hands-On Engineering and Technology Development (30% of Time)

  • Personally develop and review instruction code for Rockwell PLC and Emerson DeltaV networks or equivalent control systems, carrying a working share of the group's technical load.
  • Own the design approach for HMI and control platforms, including escalation to the highest levels of vendor technical support, and document and define changes for manufacturing and technical audiences.
  • Investigate new instrumentation and programming technologies, develop testing protocols, and validate viability before incorporation into the existing process controls structure.
  • Apply mathematical and data analysis to design AI-driven models for process improvement, including machine analysis platforms such as AWS, TwinThread, or equivalent.
  • Evaluate and resolve networking issues at both the IT business layer and the industrial IOT layer, including process control network, data historian, and other PCN infrastructure.
  • Provide standardized design for OT layer with proper documentation and roadmap for implementation across the network sites.
  • Maintain working knowledge of batching systems and manufacturing execution systems, including non-standard configurations in use across the network.

Project Portfolio and Strategic Planning (20% of Time)

  • Build and manage programs that deliver control system project implementations across multiple remote sites, working with project and program managers on scope, schedule, and resourcing.
  • Develop and manage the annual process controls budget, forecasting operating and capital requirements and managing performance against plan.
  • Establish a risk-based prioritization process for control system obsolescence, upgrade, and automation investment, and build the business cases that support it.
  • Escalate significant unfunded control system risk to engineering and operations leadership and participate in capital prioritization reviews.
  • Track and report control system performance, project delivery, and program metrics to the Americas Engineering leadership team.

Leadership, People Development, and Culture (10% of Time)

  • Build, coach, and develop a team of process controls engineers working remotely and across multiple sites, setting clear expectations and holding the team accountable for results.
  • Lead with flexibility and calm confidence, resolving problems quickly and steadying the team and site partners during process upsets.
  • Promote a culture of inclusion, empowerment, and psychological safety that encourages proactive problem identification.
  • Support succession planning and the technical and leadership development of engineers within the controls and broader engineering organization.
  • Model Hexion's values of integrity, innovation, accountability, and safety in all leadership actions.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor of Science in chemical or electrical engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.
  • Ten or more years of experience building, programming, and supporting industrial control systems, including significant time in a plant environment working alongside controls technicians and electrical & instrumentation technicians.
  • Demonstrated leadership of engineers or technical specialists, whether through direct supervision, project leadership, or a matrixed team.
  • Solid command of control system architecture and programming, with hands-on depth in Rockwell PLC, MES, data historian, and Emerson DeltaV platforms or equivalents.
  • Working knowledge of industrial process control network, network communication protocols, and data security in conjunction with the IT team.
  • Ability to manage controls programs and project portfolios across multiple remote sites in a matrix environment.
  • Strong technical writing, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to explain an issue and its proposed solution clearly to any audience.
  • Certified with SIS calculation and fluent in SIS calculation applications, preferably ExSILentia.
  • Advanced computer skills, including the ability to build and work in large Excel models and to collect and interpret data across sites running non-matching systems.
  • Willingness to travel, typically 50 percent, to manufacturing sites across the Americas.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in engineering or a related technical discipline, or professional registration as a licensed engineer.
  • Experience with batch and continuous chemical manufacturing processes and the working principles of unit operation.
  • Experience developing standards, documenting procedures, and maintaining controls documentation using appropriate symbols and drawing conventions.
  • Experience with machine analysis and process analytics software such as TwinThread, or with developing AI-driven models for process improvement.
  • Working knowledge of a computerized maintenance management system such as SAP PM.
  • Familiarity with electronic data management systems such as Hexion MOC, PI, and AIMs, or equivalents, and with the WAVE productivity project system.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Project and strong general Microsoft Office skills.
  • Experience building capital business cases and securing funding for automation or obsolescence projects.

Leadership Attributes

A working leader who stays close to the technology and earns credibility with the team by solving problems alongside them.

Self-directed and comfortable leading a distributed team in a matrix environment, providing immediate direction when sites are under pressure.

Flexible and quick to solve problems, imparting calming confidence without arrogance.

Skilled communicator who translates complex control system issues into terms that technicians, plant leadership, and senior management can act on.

Data driven and standards minded, balancing day-to-day site support against the longer work of building a consistent controls platform.

Other

We are an Equal Opportunity, Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, pregnancy, race, national origin, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran or military status, status as a qualified individual with a disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

To be considered for this position candidates are required to submit an application for employment through our career site and, be at least 18 years of age. Any offer of employment will be conditioned upon successful completion of a drug test and background investigation, as well as authorization for the Company to conduct additional periodic background checks as required by the Chemical Facility Anti-Terrorism Standards (CFATS) or regulations adopted by the department of Homeland Security or other regulatory agencies. A prior criminal record is not an automatic bar to employment, and the Company will conduct an individualized assessment and reassessment, consistent with applicable law, prior to making any final employment decision.

jobs.excerpt: About ShippaboShippabo is a tech-enabled ocean freight forwarder.
jobs.description:
About Shippabo

Shippabo is a tech-enabled ocean freight forwarder. Founded in 2016, we have raised $22 million from Wonder Ventures, TenOneTen Ventures, Double M Partners, and Slow Ventures. Our platform gives importers one place to book, track, and manage ocean shipments, with their internal teams and their overseas suppliers working from the same data. Behind the platform sits a real forwarding operation: a dedicated ocean contracts and pricing team that negotiates carrier rates, and a team in China that works directly with shippers at origin. We’re about 40 people across the US, Canada, Vietnam, Philippines, and China. Our engineering team builds the software that makes the operation faster and more transparent than a traditional forwarder can be.

About the role

This is an account management role built around retention, service quality, and problem solving. It’s not a quota-carrying sales job. There’s no cross-sell or upsell target, and no cold outbound. The one exception is re-engaging importers who have gone quiet or moved volume elsewhere, where the goal is to understand what went wrong and win the volume back. What we actually need is someone who can look at an account and a shipment and figure out what is really going on, then drive it to resolution without needing to hand it off.

What you’ll do

Own a portfolio of importer accounts. You are the primary relationship owner for a book of existing importers. You are accountable for retention, satisfaction, and the health of the relationship over time.

Diagnose before you escalate. When a client raises an issue, your first job is to determine what kind of issue it is. Is it a rate problem, a service failure, an expectation that was set wrong, or a process that broke internally? The answer determines who needs to be involved and what the fix is. We want you to make that call, not pass it off to someone else.

Review shipments and catch problems early. You should be able to look at a booking and know when something is off before the customer tells you. Rolled bookings, a vessel schedule change that will miss a delivery window, drayage constraints at the port of discharge, a document mismatch that will hold a container at customs. You’ll know when to dig into carrier schedules, customs entry, drayage, or documentation, and when it is normal activity not worth alarming a customer over.

Balance the client and the business. Understand what each importer is optimizing for, whether that’s landed cost, transit reliability, or predictability, and weigh that against what makes commercial sense for Shippabo. Advocate hard for the client, and be honest internally about what we got wrong.

Drive quote acceptance and forecast accuracy. Make sure forecasted volume actually books, quotes are accepted or the reason they were not is understood, and that feedback goes back to the supply/pricing team so our rates stay competitive on the lanes that matter.

Own outcomes across teams. Many customer requests require Product, Operations, Finance, or the origin team in China. You’re the owner of the outcome. You map the steps, set the timeline, follow up, and close the loop with the customer.

Monitor and report on your portfolio. Track operational and revenue metrics across your accounts. Surface trends, at-risk accounts, and volume shifts before they become surprises.

Serve as an advisor, not an order taker. Educate importers on supply chain practices and on what Shippabo's platform and network can do for them. Communicate market conditions, rate trends, surcharges, and capacity shifts in terms of what they mean for that specific customer’s business.

Handle inbound small and new importer leads. Own inbound marketing leads from smaller importers, qualify them, and get them onboarded and running.

Re-engage churned and dormant accounts. Work through importers who have reduced or stopped shipping with us, understand why, and rebuild the relationship where the fit is still there.

What we’re looking for

  • Direct experience in ocean freight forwarding, NVOCC, or as an importer managing ocean freight. You understand the mechanics of an ocean shipment end to end, from booking and origin cargo receipt through customs clearance and final delivery.
  • The ability to troubleshoot independently. You form a hypothesis about what went wrong, check it against the data, and act. You don’t need a manager to tell you where to look.
  • Strong commercial judgment. You know the difference between a concession that’s worth making and one that sets a bad precedent.
  • Structured thinking. You can take a messy situation with many moving parts, prioritize it, map out next steps, and communicate clearly what happens next and by when.
  • Clear written communication. Much of this job is explaining a complicated logistics situation to a customer in plain language, quickly.
  • Comfort in a small company. About 40 people, no large support layer, a lot of ownership.

Helpful but not required

  • Experience with a freight forwarding TMS or a modern digital forwarder platform.
  • Familiarity with customs documentation and entry requirements
  • Working knowledge of demurrage, detention, and how to keep clients out of accessorial charges.

Compensation

Base salary is $110,000 to $120,000.CAD. An annual performance bonus brings expected Year 1 total cash compensation to $130,000 to $150,000 CAD. Actual compensation is dependent upon many factors, such as training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, location, and market demands. This range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Benefits for our Shipmates

At Shippabo, our benefits are a reflection of our core values and our commitment to making healthy living affordable and accessible to everyone on board. Our team members enjoy ample Vacation and Sick time, allowing you to take the breaks you need to recharge and ensuring your well-being remains a priority as you grow with us. We offer multiple health plan options and contribute meaningfully toward the cost of coverage for you and your dependents, in addition to a RRSP Plan with matching contributions.

jobs.description:
Clipping Specialist (3-month FTC)

About the role

NewGen is hiring a Clipping Specialist on a 3-month fixed-term contract to build and run our clipping programmes at scale. You will find and onboard clipping channels, run campaigns through our in-house tech, and make sure every clip we seed lands with the right audience for the right brand.

NewGen is a social-first creator and influencer marketing agency. We work with global brands in gaming, sport, entertainment and consumer, and clipping is one of our fastest-growing propositions: turning long-form content, creator streams, trailers and campaign moments into short-form clips that are distributed through a network of clipping channels on TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and X.

This is a hands-on role at the centre of a new line of business. You will work with our campaign, creator and tech teams, and you will have a direct say in how the proposition and the tooling evolve.

Contract:

3-month fixed-term contract (FTC), with potential to extend or go permanent

Location:

Remote

Start:

ASAP

What you'll do

Work with the clipping network

  • Identify, vet and recruit clipping channels and clippers across TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and X, through platforms and our own technology.
  • Build and maintain a segmented database of channels by niche (gaming, sport, entertainment, lifestyle), audience location and typical reach
  • Manage ongoing relationships with clippers so we have a reliable, responsive network ready to activate at short notice

Run campaigns at scale through our tech

  • Set up and manage clipping campaigns end to end in NewGen's in-house tooling: campaign sign-up, channel authentication, view caps, tracking and payouts
  • Brief clippers on the content, the moments to prioritise and the brand guidelines, and quality-check clips before and after they go live
  • Monitor campaign performance daily and move budget, caps and channels around to hit view and geo targets
  • Manage multiple campaigns in parallel across different clients and markets

Report and improve

  • Produce clear performance reporting for internal teams and clients: views, reach by geo, CPM delivered, top-performing clips and channels
  • Feed back to our product and tech team on what the tooling needs to do better, and help test new features as they ship
  • Document the process and playbooks so the programme can scale beyond your contract
  • Keep on top of platform changes, clipping trends and what competitors and creators are doing

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • Hands-on experience running clipping, meme page, UGC or creator distribution campaigns, either agency-side, in-house or as a clipper or channel operator yourself
  • A working knowledge of where clippers live and how they operate: Discord communities, Clipfarm or similar platforms, payout models and view caps
  • A strong instinct for what makes a clip perform on TikTok, Shorts, Reels and X, and for spotting fake or low-quality reach
  • Comfortable managing a high volume of channels and campaigns at once, with the organisation to keep it all moving
  • Confident with campaign tooling, spreadsheets and reporting, and quick to learn new platforms

Nice-to-haves

  • Background in gaming, esports, sport or entertainment content
  • Experience with Twitch and YouTube creator campaigns, game launches or trailer moments
  • Experience with multi-market campaigns, especially US and UK
  • Familiarity with short-form editing tools or AI editing workflows
  • An existing network of clippers or channel owners you can bring with you

Contract details

  • 3-month fixed-term contract, full time, starting as soon as possible
  • Remote contract
  • Pro-rata salary or day rate depending on how you prefer to work:
  • A genuine route to extension or a permanent role if the programme grows as we expect

Coaching and Leadership Development Specialist

The Coaching & Leadership Development Specialist is responsible for supporting the design, delivery and embedding of coaching and leadership development activity across the Health Assessment Advisory Services (HAAS) within Ingeus.

The postholder will work closely with the Leadership Development Lead to support the iLEAD leadership development programme, embed a consistent coaching approach across HAAS, and strengthen manager confidence in effective development, feedback, performance, wellbeing and career conversations.

A core focus of the role is to help build practical coaching capability across managers, trainers, emerging leaders and colleagues. The postholder will develop coaching resources, facilitate coaching sessions, support action learning and reflective practice, and help ensure leadership development is transferred into day-to-day management practice.

The role will contribute to a culture of continuous learning, confident leadership and effective people development by supporting accessible, inclusive and practical coaching interventions across HAAS.

  • Support the Leadership Development Lead to develop and embed a consistent HAAS coaching framework.

  • Support delivery and embedding of the iLEAD leadership development programme.

  • Create, develop and deliver coaching sessions, group coaching, reflective practice sessions and development conversations for identified cohorts.

  • Support managers, trainers, emerging leaders and aspiring leaders to build confidence in coaching skills.

  • Develop practical coaching tools, templates, guides and resources for managers and leaders.

  • Support the creation of coaching resources for Personal Development Reviews/Plans, career conversations, feedback conversations, wellbeing conversations and performance discussions.

  • Facilitate action learning sets, peer learning groups, confidence-building sessions and learning reinforcement activities.

  • Help participants apply learning from leadership development programmes into day-to-day leadership and management practice.

  • Gather participant feedback and identify themes to support continuous improvement of iLEAD and wider leadership development activity.

  • Support evaluation of coaching impact, including participant confidence, behaviour change, learning transfer and participant experience.

  • Identify common development themes from coaching activity while maintaining appropriate confidentiality.

  • Build effective relationships with managers, leaders, People & Culture, L&D colleagues, operational stakeholders and iLEAD participants.

  • Promote inclusive, ethical and psychologically safe coaching practice.

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of coaching, leadership development, adult learning and behaviour change practice.

  • Ability to build trust and credibility with managers, leaders and participants.

  • Ability to create practical, accessible and easy-to-use development resources.

  • Good understanding of adult learning principles and blended learning approaches.

  • Ability to work sensitively with confidential development themes and coaching conversations.

  • Strong organisational and administrative skills.

  • Ability to gather feedback and use it to improve development interventions.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with L&D colleagues, operational managers and People & Culture.

  • Strong written communication skills and attention to detail.

  • Flexible, proactive and able to work effectively as part of a dispersed team.

  • Evidence of relevant CPD in coaching, mentoring, L&D, HR or leadership development.

  • General IT skills and ability to use software effectively.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience supporting leadership development programmes.

  • Network Security (including firewalls and NIDS/NIPS)

Desire and ability to learn quickly, a great attitude, and good work ethic. To be considered for this internship, the candidate must be currently serving in the United States military, be eligible for the SkillBridge program, seeking an associate, bachelor, or master's degree in cybersecurity, computer engineering, or a related discipline, and have had exposure to core information security functions, including network and application vulnerability testing, role-based access control (RBAC), security information and event management, and/or computer incident management. To be successful, a candidate should be proficient in Linux and Windows, and have at least two years of information technology experience and exposure to three or more of the following security technologies:

  • Linux Bash and Python Scripting

A turn-key cybersecurity solutions provider, InfoDefense provides best-in-class information protection, network security, system security, and identity and access management, as well as IT governance, and risk and compliance solutions. With a current focus on Department of Defense contractors with Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) compliance requirements, InfoDefense has also served financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and government customers since 2001.
