Legal Intern (Unpaid / Academic Credit Eligible)

FASD United – Justice Advisory Committee / Justice Center

Location: Remote (U.S.-based required)

Duration: Semester-based (Fall/Spring/Summer; flexible start dates)
Time Commitment: 10–15 hours per week (flexible based on academic requirements)
Compensation: Unpaid (academic credit or volunteer experience)

Position Overview

FASD United is seeking law students for a Legal Internship supporting its Justice Advisory Committee and Justice Center initiatives. This role offers hands-on experience at the intersection of law, disability, behavioral health, and public policy, with a focus on improving justice system outcomes for individuals with Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorders (FASD).

Interns will contribute to legal research, training development, and the creation of case-informed resources that support attorneys, courts, families, and policymakers.

Key Responsibilities

Legal Research & Analysis

  • Conduct legal research on topics related to FASD and the justice system (e.g., competency, Miranda rights, sentencing, diversion, disability accommodations)
  • Identify and summarize relevant case law, statutes, and emerging legal trends
  • Support development of legal briefs, memoranda, and issue summaries

Amicus Brief Support

  • Assist in research and drafting components of amicus curiae briefs
  • Compile supporting evidence, citations, and interdisciplinary research (legal + clinical)
  • Track relevant appellate and post-conviction cases involving FASD-related issues

Training & Resource Development

  • Support the development of training materials for legal professionals (judges, defense attorneys, prosecutors, law enforcement)
  • Assist in creating fact sheets, legal guides, and presentation materials
  • Translate complex legal and clinical concepts into accessible formats

Committee & Program Support

  • Assist with preparation of Justice Advisory Committee materials (agendas, summaries, research briefs)
  • Support coordination of subject-matter experts and contributors
  • Participate in internal discussions and contribute insights where appropriate

Learning Objectives

Interns will:

  • Gain exposure to disability-informed legal frameworks and justice system reform
  • Develop skills in legal research, policy analysis, and applied advocacy
  • Engage with multidisciplinary professionals across law, behavioral health, and social services
  • Build experience in nonprofit legal strategy and systems-level impact work

Qualifications

  • Current law student (1L, 2L, or 3L) in good academic standing
  • Strong legal research and writing skills
  • Interest in criminal law, juvenile justice, disability law, public defense, prosecution, or public policy
  • Ability to synthesize complex information across disciplines
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

Preferred (Not Required)

  • Coursework or experience in criminal law, evidence, constitutional law, or disability rights
  • Interest or experience related to FASD, neurodevelopmental disabilities, or behavioral health
  • Experience with legal databases (e.g., Westlaw, LexisNexis)

Supervision & Structure

  • Interns will be supervised by FASD United staff and/or designated legal advisors affiliated with the Justice Advisory Committee
  • Regular check-ins and feedback will be provided
  • Work may contribute to real-world legal resources, training materials, and policy initiatives

Academic Credit / Volunteer Structure

  • This is an unpaid position
  • FASD United will support documentation required for academic credit, externship programs, or pro bono hours
  • Interns are responsible for coordinating with their academic institution for credit approval

How to Apply

Please submit:

  1. Resume or CV
  2. Brief statement of interest included in a cover letter (1–2 paragraphs)
  3. Writing sample (legal or academic)
  4. Availability (hours per week and preferred term)

About FASD United

FASD United is a national nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing awareness, research, policy, and support for individuals and families affected by Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorders. Through its Justice initiatives, FASD United works to improve legal system responses and outcomes for individuals with FASD.

· Support product launches through documentation, enablement materials, release communications, and customer-facing presentations, ensuring capabilities and limitations are represented accurately.

As Demonstrated By:

· Customer empathy and consultative communication with strong stakeholder-management and facilitation skills.

· Structured requirements analysis, systems/process thinking, and technical aptitude.

· Product judgment, commercial awareness, and evidence-based prioritization in environments with competing priorities.

· Ability to navigate ambiguity, influence cross-functionally, and translate between business and technical audiences.

Key Requirements:

Education:

Experience:

About SERVISS

At SERVISS, we deliver cutting-edge cybersecurity and IT solutions to government and commercial clients, with a mission to secure systems, data, and critical infrastructure through innovation and expertise. We don’t just deploy tools — we engineer mission platforms that become foundational systems of record for cyber operations, compliance automation, and national cyber readiness. As we expand our capabilities, we’re seeking a hands-on CAASM engineer with Armis expertise to help build, integrate, and operate enterprise cyber asset visibility platforms.

Position Summary

SERVISS is seeking a CAASM Engineer to support the design, deployment, integration, and operation of Cyber Asset Attack Surface Management (CAASM) platforms — with a primary focus on Armis (Axonius or equivalent a plus) — across hybrid cloud and enterprise environments. The ideal candidate works as part of a cross-functional security team to onboard asset sources, streamline data pipelines, and enhance visibility into enterprise cyber assets, exposures, and risk. This is a technically hands-on role reporting to the CAASM Engineering Lead.
This position is scoped at a mid-level baseline (3+ years), but we actively encourage senior and highly experienced engineers to apply — role scope, level, and compensation can flex to match demonstrated expertise.

The Work

This is a hands-on engineering role. The selected candidate will:
  • Deploy, configure, and tune Armis (or equivalent CAASM platforms) across hybrid cloud and enterprise environments
  • Onboard and maintain data integrations from CMDBs, EDR/XDR, vulnerability feeds, cloud inventories, identity, network, and SaaS sources
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and workflow connectors (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to enhance data ingestion and normalization
  • Build normalization, correlation, and enrichment logic that turns raw telemetry into authoritative asset intelligence
  • Monitor data quality, troubleshoot integration issues, and resolve engineering escalations
  • Support platform optimization, performance tuning, and operational stability
  • Configure dashboards, reports, and risk views that render asset and exposure data for technical and stakeholder audiences
  • Produce and maintain documentation for deployment architectures, configuration baselines, and operational procedures

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with installation, configuration, and integration of CAASM platforms (Armis primary; Axonius or equivalent a plus)
  • Onboard and maintain data integrations from CMDBs, vulnerability feeds, cloud inventories, and endpoint tools
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and workflow connectors to enhance data ingestion and normalization
  • Support CAASM platform optimization, performance tuning, and operational stability
  • Monitor data quality, troubleshoot integration issues, and resolve engineering escalations
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity analysts and stakeholders to translate security requirements into technical solutions
  • Support cyber governance reporting, continuous monitoring, and compliance automation efforts

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years in cybersecurity engineering, systems integration, or IT infrastructure roles (candidates with more experience are encouraged to apply)
  • Hands-on experience with Armis, or a comparable CAASM / asset intelligence platform (e.g., Axonius)
  • Strong understanding of IT systems including Windows, Linux, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure)
  • Familiarity with APIs, data ingestion pipelines, RESTful integration, and scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash)
  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals and security principles (asset discovery, vulnerability context, normalization)
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a similar field — or equivalent experience or relevant certifications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct hands-on Armis deployment, integration, or administration experience
  • Experience with asset management, CAASM applications, or enterprise security tools
  • Familiarity with cloud-native services (AWS, Azure) and service APIs
  • Experience with SIEMs common in the federal market (e.g., Elastic, Splunk) and common sensor tools
  • Understanding of Federal cyber governance — NIST 800-53/171, RMF, CDM, and continuous monitoring
  • Certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GSEC, or vendor-specific CAASM certifications
  • Exposure to data analytics or BI dashboards related to security telemetry
  • Prior DoD or Federal civilian cybersecurity experience and an active security clearance

Freedom to Thrive.

Why Join SERVISS? Our goal as an employer is simple yet profound: to create an environment where you can be your best self, pursue your passions, and enjoy the freedom to thrive both personally and professionally. Your success is our success, and we’re committed to supporting you every step of the way.

  1. Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are headquartered in San Francisco, California with operations in Canada and the UK, and a tech-hub in Poland. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world.

About the Role

As Director of Operations, UK you will help build and lead the field operations team that installs and maintains Focal Systems shelf cameras across our UK retail partners. Our cameras are being deployed at scale, with 100,000+ units live or rolling out at leading retailers around the world, and the UK is a major part of that growth.

You will support the running of UK operations end to end: the people, the processes, the metrics, and the customer outcomes. You will work closely with senior and executive leadership to set and roll out operational strategy, and with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to make every deployment faster, more reliable, and more cost-effective than the last.

You will be joining an established, experienced team that works in cycles. Retailer rollouts bring periods of rapid scale-up, followed by quieter maintenance periods where we scale back down, and those transitions have not always been smooth. A key part of this role is making them smoother: planning ahead for each change in pace, keeping the team steady and supported through it, and building processes that let us ramp up and down without losing quality or momentum.

This is a senior leadership role. You will develop our existing team, support during scale-up and scale-down periods, set the operating rhythm for field work, and be the person our customers and colleagues rely on when something needs to get done.

What We Are Looking For

  • You are a hands-on operations leader who has scaled field teams and processes, and you are as comfortable working with stakeholders at different levels
  • You run operations on data: you define the right metrics, watch them closely, and act early when they move
  • You build structure where there is none, designing roles, workflows, and SOPs that hold up as volume grows and priorities shift
  • You hire well, coach well, and build teams that take ownership without needing to be chased
  • You understand that operations is a customer-facing function, and you take pride in exceeding what our retail partners expect
  • You thrive in a fast-moving, remote-first environment and are energised by building something new

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own ongoing field-service performance and SLA delivery, prioritising maintenance work and driving issues through to resolution.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing UK field operations team responsible for installing and maintaining shelf cameras at scale
  • Own the operational plan for UK deployments, from scheduling and logistics through installation, quality checks, and ongoing maintenance

  • Partner with executive leadership to set performance goals, budgets, and long-term operational strategy for the UK
  • Analyse operational processes end to end, identify bottlenecks, and lead improvements that increase speed, quality, and efficiency
  • Work across Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Customer Success to feed field insights back into hardware, software, and deployment playbooks
  • Act as the senior escalation point for operational and customer issues, removing blockers quickly and owning the outcome
  • Build strong relationships with retail partners, understand their store operations, agree success criteria, and deliver against them

Requirements

  • 5+ years in an operations leadership role, with a track record of managing people, processes, and budgets
  • Experience leading field operations, installation, or service teams across multiple sites, ideally deploying hardware at scale
  • Strong working knowledge of core operational functions, including finance and budgeting, customer service, logistics, and people management
  • Proven ability to plan and run operations for efficiency and productivity, using data and KPIs to drive decisions
  • Experience designing and implementing new structures, roles, and processes that support rapid growth and shifting business needs
  • Solid understanding of account management and customer success, and comfort working directly with senior customer stakeholders
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present clearly to executives, customers, and field teams
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and travel regularly within the UK

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with retail technology such as shopper-facing apps, back-room inventory management, or POS systems
  • Experience managing third-party installers, contractors, or service partners
  • Lean Six Sigma or a similar process improvement certification
  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment

Why Focal Systems

Strong Values and Mission - We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.

Exceptional Team - We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer to design, build, and maintain the data pipelines, analytical models, and trusted datasets that support business operations, reporting, and decision-making.

This is a hands-on technical role that combines data engineering, analytics engineering, and business problem-solving. You will work across operational databases, data warehouses, and reporting systems to transform complex data into reliable, reusable information.

Working closely with business stakeholders, software engineers, and data teams, you will help define business metrics, establish consistent data definitions, improve data quality, and reduce reliance on manual reporting processes.

The ideal candidate understands not only how to move and transform data, but also how to evaluate where data should reside, how it should be modeled, and how its accuracy and reliability can be maintained.

You will be expected to independently investigate complex data challenges, challenge unclear requirements, and recommend sustainable solutions that support both current operational needs and future growth.

Key Responsibilities

Data Engineering & Analytics Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and delivery.
  • Build reusable analytical datasets and data models that support multiple business processes and reporting needs.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain SQL transformations, business logic, and analytical queries.
  • Evaluate data integration approaches across operational systems, databases, data warehouses, and reporting platforms.
  • Design and maintain pipeline orchestration, scheduling, dependencies, and failure recovery processes.
  • Apply appropriate data modeling and transformation practices to improve maintainability, performance, and reuse.
  • Data Quality, Reliability & Governance
  • Develop validation, reconciliation, and monitoring processes to ensure data completeness, consistency, and accuracy.
  • Investigate and resolve data quality issues, pipeline failures, and discrepancies between systems.
  • Establish and maintain trusted business metrics, standardized definitions, and documented transformation logic.
  • Improve data traceability, auditability, and reproducibility across analytical processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data freshness, pipeline performance, and operational reliability.
  • Support appropriate data access controls, security practices, and governance standards.

Business Analytics & Collaboration

  • Work directly with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, business processes, and analytical requirements.
  • Clarify and challenge conflicting definitions, assumptions, business rules, and data requirements before implementation.
  • Develop and maintain datasets that support dashboards, reports, and analytical tools such as Metabase.
    Collaborate with software engineering and other technical teams to improve data integration and source-system reliability.
  • Identify opportunities to replace recurring manual reports and data requests with automated, reusable solutions.
  • Communicate technical findings, data limitations, and recommended approaches clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Engineering Practices & Continuous Improvement

  • Apply version control, code reviews, testing, and documentation standards to data engineering work.
  • Contribute to data architecture discussions and technical design decisions.
  • Improve pipeline maintainability, query performance, and operational support processes.
  • Help establish repeatable engineering practices that support reliable and scalable analytics.
  • Share technical knowledge and contribute to continuous improvement across the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency, including complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, and query optimization.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, analytical data warehouses, and data modeling principles.
  • Experience designing, developing, or maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Experience building reusable analytical datasets and implementing complex business transformations.
  • Understanding of data ingestion, orchestration, scheduling, dependencies, error handling, and data delivery patterns.
  • Apply version control, code reviews, testing, and documentation standards to data engineering work.
  • Contribute to data architecture discussions and technical design decisions.
  • Improve pipeline maintainability, query performance, and operational support processes.
  • Help establish repeatable engineering practices that support reliable and scalable analytics.
  • Share technical knowledge and contribute to continuous improvement across the team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Amazon Redshift and PostgreSQL, including AWS RDS.
  • Experience with Apache Airflow or comparable orchestration platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, or Database Migration Service (DMS).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, or pipeline development.
  • Experience with Metabase or comparable business intelligence platforms.
  • Experience implementing automated data quality checks, source-to-target reconciliation, and pipeline monitoring.
  • Familiarity with data governance, lineage, metadata management, auditability, and access control.
  • Experience with geospatial, agricultural, scientific, or other complex operational datasets.
  • Experience supporting analytical environments where accuracy, reproducibility, and traceability are critical.

What success looks like this role

  • Deliver trusted, reusable analytical datasets that support business reporting and decision-making.
  • Improve consistency and accuracy across data originating from multiple operational systems.
  • Reduce manual reporting effort through reliable, automated data pipelines.
  • Establish clear business definitions and maintainable transformation logic.
  • Improve data pipeline reliability, performance, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Strengthen collaboration between business stakeholders, software engineering, and data teams.
  • Contribute to a scalable and well-documented data foundation that supports future business growth.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Senior Insurance Claims Expert (Liability, Property, Contents)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

We are engaging Senior Insurance Claims Experts (Liability, Property, Contents) to contribute expertise to a customer project focused on real-world insurance claim scenarios. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Senior insurance professionals will remotely review a variety of complex claims, including disputed-fault auto incidents using video evidence and statements, property and catastrophe damage via aerial imagery, and contents valuation based on photographs. You'll deliver your professional determinations and the reasoning an adjuster would document, leveraging your advanced technical knowledge and communication skills.

Required Skills

  • Auto Liability

  • Comparative Fault Determination

  • Property & Catastrophe Damage Assessment

  • Contents Identification

Scope of Work

  • Review and analyze disputed-fault auto claims by evaluating video recordings, written statements, and supporting documentation.

  • Assess property and catastrophe-related damages using aerial roof imagery and catastrophe photos to determine accurate liability and loss.

  • Evaluate and identify contents claims through photographic evidence, providing detailed valuation and inventory assessments.

  • Draft clear, well-reasoned determination reports mirroring the documentation standards of licensed adjusters.

  • Apply comparative fault and liability principles to support precise and defensible claim outcomes.

  • Communicate findings and rationale through succinct, professional written and verbal feedback as required.

  • Contribute to the development of data and insights that will advance AI system accuracy and reliability in insurance claims processing.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in insurance claims management with a focus on auto liability, property, catastrophe, and contents assessment.

  • Active state adjuster license, or professional certifications such as AIC, CPCU, HAAG, or ACTAR.

  • Demonstrated experience with comparative fault determination and complex liability assessments.

  • Expertise in interpreting and analyzing photographic, video, and aerial imagery within an insurance claims context.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical reasoning clearly and professionally.

  • Track record of producing thorough, accurate claim documentation and valuation reports.

  • Comfort working independently in a fully remote, tech-enabled environment, leveraging digital tools for remote evidence review and report submission.

Description

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced DevSecOps / Cloud Platform Engineer to design, automate, secure, and operate ATLAS, the VA’s open-architected, multi-cloud enterprise data management and analytics platform. This hands-on role will build reliable infrastructure and shared platform services across Azure and AWS, automate the delivery of data applications and pipelines, and strengthen interoperability among the enterprise platforms used to ingest, condition, curate, and publish multi-source data as consumable data products. You will partner with architects, data engineers, developers, security teams, and government stakeholders to standardize environments, improve CI/CD, observability, resilience, and governance, and ensure consistent, secure access to trusted data. Your work will enable data scientists, analysts, and product teams to deliver insights that support evidence-based decisions and improve outcomes for Veterans and their families.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate secure, scalable platform environments across Azure and AWS for development, testing, and production workloads.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure as Code and configuration-management practices with tools such as Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, Ansible, or Packer.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines that integrate automated testing, security scanning, compliance checks, artifact management, and controlled deployments.
  • Administer containerized workloads and shared platform services using Docker, Kubernetes, and managed cloud orchestration services.
  • Support the reliable operation and deployment of Summit data services, including Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines, Databricks, Starburst, and Azure Data Lake Service.
  • Enable secure integrations among databases, APIs, event streams, data pipelines, analytics services, and external enterprise systems.
  • Implement cloud security controls including identity and access management, secrets management, encryption, network segmentation, vulnerability remediation, patching, and Zero Trust principles.
  • Build observability and operational monitoring using cloud-native and enterprise logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and dashboard capabilities.
  • Lead incident troubleshooting and root-cause analysis; implement resiliency, backup, recovery, retry, and performance-optimization strategies.
  • Support metadata, governance, and data-quality capabilities using Collibra and enable downstream Azure ML/AI services and Pyramid Analytics/Power BI solutions.
  • Partner with architecture, cybersecurity, development, database, and data engineering teams to align platform services with application and data-product requirements.
  • Develop and maintain platform architecture documentation, operational runbooks, standards, and procedures.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentor team members, and participate in Agile planning, design reviews, and stakeholder discussions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Eight (8) or more years of experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, platform engineering, systems engineering, or related enterprise roles.

We’re seeking talented writers who know how to successfully use ChatGPT as a writing tool, not as a writing replacement.

The process is as follows:

2. Develop an outline with ChatGPT

4. Edit for:

  • Structure –Improve the structure, when needed, to meet user intent better and explain concepts more clearly, and in the right order

  • Skimmable formatting –Short paragraphs, bullets, numbered lists, etc. where appropriate

  • Removing GPT voice –GPT is prone to repeating itself, adding fluff and unnecessary words, and overall has several “tells”

This remains a writing process that will likely take 5-6 hours to finalize per article.

Operations Lead

Remote | Full-time | 40-hours/week
Rate: $6 to $7/hour, with the final rate to be determined during the final interview.

About Pillar Health Solutions ()

Pillar Health Solutions partners with medical practices to provide outsourced nutrition, dietary, exercise, and wellness support to their patients.

Our model allows physician practices to expand the services available to their patients without having to build and manage an entire wellness team internally. Pillar supports the operational infrastructure behind the program, including patient coordination, provider support, scheduling, documentation, communication, reporting, and billing-related workflows.

We are building a model that should feel simple and seamless for the physician practice, even though there are many moving parts behind the scenes.

That is where the Operations Lead comes in.

About the Role

We are looking for an Operations Lead who can build, run, and continuously improve the operational engine behind Pillar Health Solutions.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who is comfortable working in a growing healthcare business where processes are still evolving.

You will work closely with leadership and take ownership of the workflows connecting physician partners, practice staff, patients, dietitians, exercise professionals, and internal support teams.

You may be investigating why patients are not scheduling, improving a referral workflow, resolving a practice issue, reviewing operational data, building a new process, creating an SOP, coordinating provider capacity, or implementing automation to eliminate repetitive work.

As Pillar grows, this role should evolve from personally managing many operational processes to building the systems, team structure, accountability, and workflows that allow the company to scale efficiently.

We are looking for someone who does not simply identify problems. You should be able to determine why they are happening, create a practical solution, implement it, and measure whether the solution worked.

What You Will Own

Practice Onboarding & Client Operations

  • Own new practice onboarding from agreement through launch, including referral, scheduling, communication, documentation, and billing-related workflows.

  • Serve as a key operational point of contact for physician partners and practice staff, ensuring requests, concerns, and follow-ups are addressed promptly.

Patient Operations & Engagement

  • Oversee the patient journey from referral through outreach, scheduling, first appointment, and ongoing engagement.

  • Monitor cancellations, no-shows, scheduling delays, and patient drop-off points, then implement workflows to improve conversion and retention.

Provider & Clinical Operations

  • Coordinate operationally with dietitians, exercise professionals, and support staff to maintain appropriate availability, capacity, and coverage.

  • Monitor provider scheduling, patient assignments, operational responsiveness, and adherence to documentation expectations.

Documentation, Billing & Revenue Operations

  • Monitor the timely completion and flow of documentation and billing-related information between providers, Pillar, and partner practices.

  • Investigate operational issues that may delay billing, reimbursement, or revenue and coordinate appropriate resolution.

Systems, SOPs & Process Improvement

  • Map workflows, identify bottlenecks, duplicated work, and failure points, then redesign processes to improve speed, accuracy, and accountability.

  • Build practical SOPs, trackers, dashboards, templates, checklists, and standardized workflows for recurring operational activities.

KPI & Performance Management

  • Track core operational KPIs across referrals, scheduling, patient engagement, provider utilization, documentation, service delivery, and partner performance.

  • Analyze trends and operational gaps to determine what changed, why it changed, and what action should be taken.

  • Provide leadership with concise reporting on performance, risks, unresolved issues, priorities, and recommended next steps.

Technology & AI

  • Evaluate and implement tools that simplify operations, reduce administrative workload, and improve visibility across the business.

  • Use AI and automation to improve reporting, workflow management, analysis, documentation, communication, and recurring operational processes.

Founder & Leadership Partnership

  • Translate leadership priorities and ideas into clear operational plans, owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

  • Surface risks and unresolved issues early while bringing recommended solutions instead of only reporting problems.

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in healthcare operations, medical practice operations, program management, client success, healthcare administration, or a closely related field.

  • Experience owning processes and outcomes rather than only completing assigned administrative tasks.

  • Strong understanding of patient scheduling, provider coordination, documentation, healthcare administrative workflows, and service operations.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify operational problems, investigate root causes, and independently implement solutions.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Strong communication skills and confidence interacting with physicians, practice staff, healthcare professionals, patients, and senior leadership.

  • Experience creating or improving SOPs, workflows, dashboards, trackers, or operational systems.

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with patient information, documentation, billing information, and operational data.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving, changing, or early-stage environment.

  • Comfortable learning unfamiliar tools, systems, workflows, and processes independently.

  • Practical experience using AI, automation, or technology to improve business processes.

Highly Preferred

  • Experience supporting US medical practices or healthcare organizations.

  • Experience in telehealth, nutrition, wellness, chronic care, preventive health, exercise programs, or virtual healthcare services.

  • Familiarity with healthcare insurance, eligibility, reimbursement, billing, claims, or revenue-cycle workflows.

  • Experience working with EHR/EMR systems, scheduling platforms, CRM tools, telehealth systems, or patient communication platforms.

  • Experience coordinating or managing remote healthcare teams.

  • Experience with physician practice onboarding, account management, or client success.

  • Experience building processes or operations within an early-stage or rapidly growing company.

  • Previous ownership of operational KPIs, service-level metrics, or business performance reporting.

The Type of Person Who Will Succeed Here

You are someone who naturally asks:

What is supposed to happen? What is actually happening? Where is the gap? Why is it happening? Who owns fixing it? How do we prevent it from happening again?

You are proactive, resourceful, highly organized, and comfortable working with ambiguity.

You do not need every process to already exist before you can start working. You are comfortable creating structure where structure is missing.

You enjoy both strategy and execution. You can discuss operational priorities with leadership and then personally investigate a scheduling issue, analyze a broken workflow, create a process, or coordinate a solution.

You are comfortable taking ownership without waiting to be repeatedly reminded.

You communicate clearly, escalate thoughtfully, and understand the difference between simply reporting a problem and actually helping solve it.

Most importantly, you think in terms of systems.

When the same issue happens repeatedly, your instinct should not be to keep fixing it manually. Your instinct should be to understand why it keeps happening and build a better process.

What Success Looks Like

During your first few weeks, success will mean developing a strong understanding of Pillar's end-to-end operating model and creating clear visibility into how physician practices, patients, providers, documentation, billing, and internal workflows connect.

You will identify the biggest operational bottlenecks, improve patient and practice workflows, strengthen accountability, establish meaningful operational reporting, and reduce recurring operational issues.

Over time, you will help build an operating system capable of supporting substantially more physician practices, patients, and providers without operational complexity increasing at the same rate as the business.

The ultimate goal is simple:

Create an operation where physician practices receive a reliable experience, patients move through the program smoothly, providers have the support they need, leadership has visibility into performance, and fewer problems require manual intervention as Pillar grows.

At Lemurian Labs, we're reimagining the foundations of computing to make AI accessible to everyone. Our mission is to remove the limits of scale, hardware, and cost that hold back innovation, so the people solving humanity's hardest problems can move faster.

We're building a new kind of software stack: a hardware-agnostic platform that makes every system — from a laptop to a supercomputer — feel like one seamless engine. Developers can write once, run anywhere, and get state-of-the-art performance across any chip, any cloud, at any scale. It's a complete rethink of how software and hardware interact — designed for the era beyond Moore's Law.

We're not looking for the comfortable or the conventional; we're looking for the bold. The engineers who crave frontier problems, who want to bend the limits of what's possible, who see infrastructure not as a constraint but as a canvas. If you want to build the foundation for the next era of AI and change what humanity can achieve in the process, join us.

About the Role

We are building a domain-specific language and compiler toolchain for programming machine learning models.

As a Senior DSL Compiler Engineer, you will focus on the compiler frontend: scanning, parsing, AST design and construction, compiler passes, type and shape inference, and error and warning reporting. You should be deeply comfortable reasoning about object ownership and lifecycle management in C++, and be prepared to work within a custom ARC system with semantics similar to the standard smart pointer types.

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement compiler frontend components including the lexer, parser, abstract syntax tree, and compiler passes.
  • Design and implement type inference and shape inference systems for the DSL.
  • Design clear, actionable error and warning diagnostics that help users understand and resolve problems in their programs.
  • Work within and extend a proprietary automatic reference counting system that governs memory management across the frontend.
  • Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and ensure sound design decisions.
  • Collaborate through pair programming sessions.
  • Contribute to the full software engineering lifecycle: product specification, requirements gathering, high-level design, low-level design, implementation, and testing.
  • Help inform the design of future DSLs as the platform expands to other scientific computing domains.

Requirements

Essential Skills and Experience

  • BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing domain-specific languages.
  • Deep expertise in compiler frontend engineering: lexical analysis, parsing, AST design, semantic analysis, and compiler passes.
  • Strong experience with type inference and shape inference systems.
  • Strong professional C++ background with modern C++ standards.
  • Deep understanding of automatic reference counting concepts and object lifetime management in C++, including thorough familiarity with the semantics of shared_ptr, weak_ptr, and unique_ptr. The frontend uses a proprietary ARC implementation with similar semantics, and you must be comfortable reasoning about ownership, reference cycles, and clean teardown in this kind of system.
  • Experience designing compiler diagnostics (errors and warnings) that are clear and useful to end users.
  • Experience across the full software engineering lifecycle: product specification, requirements gathering, high-level design, low-level design, implementation, and testing.
  • General familiarity with GPUs or other accelerator devices and their role in high-performance computing and machine learning workloads.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent
  • Experience with or willingness to use AI-assisted code generation tools in day-to-day development.
  • Familiarity with PyTorch or similar machine learning frameworks.
  • Experience with Python language internals or strategies for subsetting Python-like languages.

Why Join Lemurian Labs

  • Own a critical layer of our compiler stack where optimization decisions have direct, measurable impact on model performance
  • Work on the hardest graph-level problems in AI infrastructure — across diverse hardware targets and model architectures
  • Collaborate with a team that treats infrastructure as a canvas and optimization as a craft
  • Competitive compensation including equity, medical/dental/vision, retirement savings, and wellness benefits

Lemurian Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, age, or background.

Compensation depends on experience and geographic location and will be narrowed during the interview process. Additional benefits include equity, company bonus opportunities, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a retirement savings plan, and supplemental wellness benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Technical SEO Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Benrey — маркетинговое агентство полного цикла.  Мы работаем с компаниями, которым нужен результат, а не красивые обещания.
jobs.description:
Benrey — маркетинговое агентство полного цикла. Мы работаем с компаниями, которым нужен результат, а не красивые обещания. Никаких сказок и абстрактных теорий: только анализ и реализация.

Берём на себя весь спектр задач: performance-маркетинг и креатив, SEO, ASO, контент, PR, защиту бренда, работу с амбассадорами и многое другое — в онлайне и офлайне. Если задача двигает бренд вперёд и даёт ощутимый результат, мы за неё беремся.

К нам приходят, когда нужно сделать хорошо, быстро и без оправданий.

Если откликается — давай знакомиться!

Кого мы ищем

Технического SEO-специалиста, который одинаково уверенно чувствует себя в консоли, серверных логах и коде. Мы ведём крупные мультидоменные и мультиязычные платформы на международных рынках в высококонкурентных нишах. Руками там ничего не масштабируется, поэтому всё, что повторяется, автоматизируем.

Это не работа в духе «поправить метатеги по чек-листу». Главное здесь — выстраивать системы, которые держат оптимизацию на сотнях тысяч страниц и работают без ручного вмешательства. Нам нужен человек, который сам определит, где главная проблема, и решит её без пошагового ТЗ.

Требования

  • От 4 лет в техническом SEO под Google на крупных проектах: от десятков тысяч URL, мультиязычность или мультидоменность
  • Глубокое понимание того, как Googlebot сканирует и рендерит страницы: Web Rendering Service, очередь рендеринга, разница между исходным HTML и отрендеренной версией
  • Уверенная работа с Google Search Console: отчёты по индексации и сканированию, URL Inspection, GSC API
  • Практический опыт SSR-миграции: проект, где ты вёл или отвечал за SEO-часть, а не теория
  • Опыт с partial SSR на масштабе: какие части страницы рендерятся на сервере, какие на клиенте и что реально попадает в индекс Google
  • Опыт SEO A/B-тестов на программатик-страницах: сегментированная раскатка, верификация, честный анализ результатов
  • Python (от 1,5 лет) или TypeScript на уровне «сам пишу рабочие инструменты», а не «прошёл курс»
  • Уверенное понимание HTML, CSS, JS (от 6 месяцев) и того, как стратегия рендеринга влияет на индексацию, скорость и доступность
  • Практическая работа с логами и API: GSC API, краулеры, базы данных
  • Опыт с LLM API или автоматизацией на их основе
  • Самостоятельность и уверенность в решениях: не только найти проблему, но и довести её до исправления через другие команды
  • Английский — желательно от B1 (разговорный уровень)

Будет плюсом

  • Опыт в iGaming, программатик-SEO сайтах/SaaS или крупном e-commerce
  • Опыт в финтехе, крипте или HRTech
  • Опыт работы с западными и международными рынками
  • BigQuery, ClickHouse, работа с большими датасетами
  • Playwright, headless-краулинг
  • Статистическая грамотность при оценке результатов тестов
  • Опыт менторства или ревью чужой технической работы

Чем ты будешь заниматься

  • Технические аудиты крупных сайтов: краулинг, индексация, рендеринг, краулинговый бюджет Googlebot. Поиск узких мест в сложных структурах, где проблему не видно ни в одном интерфейсе
  • Рендеринг и миграции: диагностика CSR / SSR / partial SSR, планирование и проведение миграций, проверка того, что реально получает Googlebot, а не что показывает браузер. Работа с гидрацией, пререндерингом и кэшированием на масштабе
  • SEO A/B-тесты на программатик-страницах: гипотеза, разбиение на группы, поэтапная раскатка, сверка задеплоенного состояния с задуманным, корреляционный анализ, фильтрация сезонности и апдейтов алгоритмов Google. Отличать реальный эффект от шума и не делать выводов по двум неделям данных
  • Анализ серверных логов: как боты на самом деле ходят по сайту, где утекает краулинговый бюджет, какие шаблоны не доходят до индекса, что изменилось после релиза
  • Разработка собственных инструментов на Python или TypeScript: массовые проверки, мониторинг изменений, валидация микроразметки, перелинковка, автоматические аудиты, дашборды. Системы, которые работают постоянно, а не разовые скрипты
  • LLM в продакшене, а не в окне чата: пайплайны генерации и валидации контента, классификация страниц, детекция аномалий, работа через API (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI)
  • Микроразметка, каноникалы, robots-директивы, XML-карты сайта на уровне шаблонов и автогенерации, а не постранично
  • Core Web Vitals и производительность: диагностика, понятные задачи для разработчиков, проверка, что результат дошёл до прода
  • Аналитика и отчётность: изменения в краулинге, индексации и видимости в Google (включая AI Overviews) в цифрах, а не на ощущениях
  • Работа с разработкой: технические требования, по которым разработчики могут действовать, отстаивание приоритетов, ведение задач до релиза
  • Документирование построенных систем, чтобы они продолжали работать без тебя

Мы предлагаем

  • Полностью удалённая работа — работай откуда хочешь
  • Гибкий график
  • Конкурентная компенсация
  • 28 оплачиваемых дней отпуска в год + 10 дополнительных выходных на государственные праздники
  • 3 оплачиваемых больничных дня в год без медицинской справки
  • Компенсация спорта и спортзала
  • Поддержка в покупке софта
  • Свобода в выборе стека и инструментов
  • Прямая работа с технической командой, без прослойки менеджеров между тобой и задачей
  • Реальные возможности карьерного и профессионального роста
  • Отличная команда по всему миру

Как откликнуться

В сопроводительном письме ответь на два вопроса:

  1. Какой инструмент ты построил сам и какую проблему он решил?
  2. Приведи случай, когда логи или сырые данные выявили проблему, которую не показал ни один краулер и ни один отчёт GSC.

Отклики без ответов на эти вопросы и без опыта работы под Google не рассматриваются.

jobs.description:
About the Organization:
Red Clover Collaborative (RCC) strengthens the organizational health and connective infrastructure of the food and farm justice movement by building shared capacity, compliance confidence, and stable systems that help organizations and their leaders remain steady, strategic, and aligned under pressure.
Position Summary:
Red Clover Collaborative is seeking a Co-Director to advance the project’s efforts towards a vision of a more resilient, coordinated food and farm justice movement. The Co-Director will work in parallel with the current Co-Director. With collective responsibility, the two Co-Directors will oversee the administrative, financial, and programmatic management of Red Clover Collaborative in alignment with the project’s values, strategic aspirations, and reflected needs of the food and farm justice movements.

Primary Responsibilities

Leadership and Governance
  • Oversee and implement RCC’s strategic plan ensuring the project has policies, expertise, and funding in place to work to make progress towards our mission in the near and long term.
  • Provide supervision to the Project Coordinator as well as oversee programming work completed by contractors and consultants
  • Work with the Advisory Council to ensure RCC’s work remains aligned with its mission, vision, and values
  • Ensure that all work and collaboration within RCC reflects the project’s mission, vision, and values.
Administration, Operations, and Financial
  • Ensure sound organizational management across all functions of the project and maintain infrastructure as Red Clover Collaborative continues to grow
  • Maintain fiscal integrity of Red Clover Collaborative, develop annual budget, coordinate with Multiplier for ongoing financial, HR, and compliance management
  • Drive diversified fundraising and development efforts including grant writing, funder relations, evaluation, and reporting
Movement Partnerships & Learning
  • Continuously seek deeper understanding of what’s happening within the movement, tracking significant developments, trends, and challenges that Red Clover may be able to address.
  • Establish and maintain collaborative relationships with external partners, networks, funders, and other key movement stakeholders.
Programming
  • Oversee and execute components of RCC’s programming in partnership with other staff, contractors, or collaborative partners.
  • Ensure programming is grounded in evidence, demonstrated need, and continuous learning.
  • Ensure a process for continuous assessment, evaluation, and improvement of RCC programming based on long-term goals.

The Ideal Candidate

You are a collaborative and visionary leader with a deep commitment to food and farm justice, racial equity, and social change. You bring strategic thinking, strong organizational and financial management skills, and the ability to turn shared goals into meaningful action. You are a trusted relationship-builder who values collective leadership, democratic principles, and continuous learning. You lead with integrity, humility, and accountability, fostering a culture of collaboration and mutual respect while advancing Red Clover Collaborative’s vision of a more resilient, coordinated food and farm justice movement.

Specific Experience Requested:
We recognize that each applicant for this role will bring unique skills, knowledge, experiences, and background to this position, lending his/her/their flair to the trajectory of the Co-Director role. We welcome diverse experiences and perspectives in our applicant pool, and will be looking for candidates who possess many, but not necessarily all, of the following qualifications and experience:
  • Prior experience working with Red Clover Collaborative
  • Proven leadership experience, including staff supervision, organizational decision making, and external representation with stakeholders
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to create and execute action towards long-term goals
  • Strong commitment to social justice, racial equity, and democratic principles
  • Experience within the food and farm justice movement along with established, trusted relationships with organizations, philanthropy, and movement leaders
  • Experience facilitating and building relationships across diverse groups
  • Knowledge of nonprofit governance, operations, and compliance
Additional Information:
  • This will be a full-time (30 hours/week) role.

Workplace, Compensation & Application

Workplace & Travel: All employees work from home offices with occasional travel (1-2 times per year) for all-team in-person meetings.

Compensation: Red Clover Collaborative and Multiplier provide a comprehensive compensation package, including competitive salary ($85,000 annual salary), excellent medical and dental benefits, retirement savings, and generous vacation and sick leave policy.

Multiplier is committed to creating an inclusive, equitable, and accessible application process for all candidates. We recognize that the traditional hiring process can create barriers. If we can support your participation in the job application or interview process by providing specific assistance or accommodation, please reach out to . Requests for accommodations are confidential and will not impact your candidacy.

ABOUT US

At the heart of AG1 lies a commitment to our mission to empower people to take ownership of their health. Since 2010, we've dedicated ourselves to bringing Foundational Nutrition to people around the world.

Our ethos is deeply rooted in science, with an unwavering dedication to continuous improvement. We leverage and contribute to the latest research to deliver a powerful, straightforward solution for optimal health to our customers. We harness the finest ingredients so that every scoop of AG1 gives you the nutrients you need with the simplicity you want in a daily routine.

Likewise, our organization puts the same energy into creating an environment that is a reflection of the cultural values that define who we are and how we work together. These seven values— One Spectacular Life, Customer Obsessed, Radical Ownership, High Performance, Courage, Amazing Humans and Continuous Pursuit of Excellence —are a representation of the high standards we set, and hold ourselves accountable to, when it comes to building our global team.


THE ROLE

The Accountingdepartment is looking for a Senior Accountant to join our fast-paced, experienced team and support multiple business units within AG1. This person will focus on tracking and recording Inventory movements supporting our worldwide business as goods flow from producers to manufacturers and our ultimate end customers. This role will also assist the Revenue, Cash Applications, and Accounts Receivable cycle for the business as we continue to add revenue streams and additional international regions to our customer base. This role will also include some exposure to treasury-related work, such as cash reporting and monitoring company cash accounts. We are looking for someone who can successfully navigate through a high-volume of critical (and often, shifting) needs, while not skipping a beat.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Ensure accurate inventory levels between NetSuite and global 3PL and co-manufacturer network
  • Evaluate purchase price and quantity variances throughout the inventory cycle, providing insights into reasons for fluctuations and communicating downstream impacts to changing prices
  • Coordinate with Finance and Supply Chain teams to ensure accurate tracking of inventory-related fluctuations and proactively flag associated risks and opportunities
  • Account for the cash payment flows from customer acquisition to ultimate deposit into our bank accounts
  • Ensure all revenue streams in multiple countries of origin are reconciled to sales orders for each region
  • Perform Treasury-related activities, including cash reporting, monitoring and funding company cash accounts, assisting with wire transfers, and recording related journal entries
  • Crosstrain within the accounting department to enable coverage of Cash, Prepaids, Fixed Assets, Accruals, and Leases
  • Reconcile balance sheet accounts as assigned, utilizing Floqast software and NetSuite ERP
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements, accounting controls, and learn and grow with the business as we expand internationally

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of general accounting experience with a proven track record of reliability and attention to detail. Experience with manufacturing, inventory accounting, and reconciling inventory GL accounts is a plus, along with familiarity with costing methods such as standard costing or average costing.
  • Strong technical accounting background, with working knowledge of ASC 330 (Inventory) and ASC 606 (Revenue Recognition)
  • Big 4 experience with active CPA license
  • Experience in the CPG (consumer packaged goods) industry is a plus
  • Demonstrated ability in utilizing AI tools to streamline existing processes.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with a consistent “can-do” attitude and ability to manage multiple work streams at once.
  • Strong interpersonal, written communication, and organizational skills.
  • A full life outside of work with personal passions and hobbies!

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • Competitive compensation and performance-based incentive plans.
  • A 100% remote working environment (excluding Laboratory positions), which has been implemented from day one.
  • A strong company culture that is enforced through the hiring process to ensure values alignment and a highly collaborative team.
  • A mission-driven approach to everything that we do, with an overall goal to significantly improve our customers’ health and wellness.
  • A high-growth, dynamic environment with opportunities for your direct impact to be felt.
  • Paid holidays, company-wide reset and reflect days, and unlimited PTO (based on your country of residence).
  • In-person team meetups for optimal collaboration, team building and accelerating productivity.
  • A work environment and culture that is based on high performance, productivity and continuous improvement.
  • The opportunity to work with passionate, high-growth, business-minded colleagues who bring their all to our mission each and every day.
  • Access to AG1 products and branded swag.
  • Monthly telecom stipend to offset some of the costs of home internet/wifi for eligible team members.
  • All other benefits and insurances as required by law, based on your specific country of residence.

AG1 is dedicated to providing equitable and competitive compensation & benefits packages. For this particular role, the base salary range is $75,000 - $90,000 and will ultimately be decided at the offer stage, based on an individual candidate’s level of skills and experience aligned with the needs of this role. Base salary is one component of total compensation for this position. We provide a competitive mix of base salary, performance bonus, and stock option allocation for eligible roles.

Overview:

The leading bank in the European Union and a leading international player is seeking an Application Production Support responsible for ensuring the continuity, stability and performance of the client’s production applications. The role is part of Application Management and supports digital transformation initiatives through the adoption of modern technologies, Automation, Monitoring, DevOps and ITIL best practices.

What will you do?

  • Prepare, validate and support application releases and production deployments
  • Perform pre-production testing and ensure production readiness of new releases
  • Maintain and update technical documentation, operational procedures and knowledge repositories

    • Knowledge of ITIL, Agile and DevOps methodologies is highly valued
    • Strong experience in production monitoring, incident management and release management processes

jobs.description:
Where Trust Leads, Bold Ideas Grow, and Community Thrives

Paula’s Choice, a global skincare leader founded in 1995, empowers individuals to define beauty on their own terms through science-backed products. Our mission comes to life through four core values that guide our actions, decisions, and impact:

  • Build Trust: We set the standard for skincare, transparency, and shared knowledge.
  • Be Bold: We lead through innovation and by challenging the status quo.
  • Act with Kindness: We operate with respect and care—for our customers, colleagues, and the planet.
  • Create Community: We believe in the power of connection—whether educating customers, supporting each other, or giving back, we grow stronger together.

Our team spans North America, Australia/New Zealand, Europe, and the broader APAC region, collaborating globally to drive innovation. We offer space to thrive—personally, professionally, and through our comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being at every stage:

  • Generous paid time off, including time off to volunteer
  • Learning and development resources to support personal and professional growth
  • Wellness benefits like meditation app memberships, product discounts, and free samples of our amazing products
  • Most roles are fully remote (roles that are required to be at our Seattle HQ can be found in the details section of this job post)
  • Great location – for roles that are hybrid or fully onsite, we’re in the heart of Seattle’s beautiful International District 
  • Did we mention we’re a dog-friendly office? 

Our culture encourages continuous learning and is fueled by connection, curiosity, and cross-functional collaboration. Whether onsite, remote, or hybrid, we stay connected through shared initiatives that bring our teams together. If you’re inspired by transparency, driven to make an impact, and eager to help foster community—we’d love to have you join us.

How you’ll have an impact at Paula’s Choice:

jobs.excerpt: About CoLabAt CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
jobs.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About The Role
This role is a high-leverage operator reporting into the Director of Industry Strategy & Transformation, with direct exposure to revenue leadership and account owners. This role exists to define and scale CoLab’s supplier ecosystem strategy, building the repeatable go-to-market motion that links OEMs with their Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers so that every strategic account is connected to the network behind it.
This is a customer-facing, go-to-market, and product-influencing role. The right person is part strategist, part operator, part competitor. Someone who can read a room of executives, build a hyper compelling value case on the fly, see the supply network sitting behind the account in front of them, and close out the next step before the meeting ends.

Job Responsibilities

  • Define and own CoLab’s supplier ecosystem strategy, a scalable and repeatable go-to-market motion for how design collaboration extends from our customers into their Tier 1 and Tier 2 supply base and how that network compounds value for every company connected to it.
  • Shape how the supplier motion is packaged, priced, and resourced, partnering with product, revenue leadership, and finance to define what suppliers get, how they buy, and which teams own each stage from first connection to expansion.
  • Map the supply networks behind strategic accounts, identifying which suppliers carry the most design dependency, where feasibility, RFQ, DFM, tooling, and PPAP handoffs break down, and where the cost of that friction lands on each side.
  • Build the value case in both directions, why an OEM should bring its suppliers into CoLab and why a supplier should want to be there, grounded in quote quality, no-bid visibility, cycle time, rework, and launch risk.
  • Package supplier and network strategy plays that prospecting, BDR, and customer success teams can run without you in the room, from target lists drawn from customer supply networks to outreach angles by tier and expansion sequences for CS.
  • Spot where connected suppliers and adjacent customers become new opportunities, and build the motion that turns a supplier’s first seat in someone else’s workspace into its own enterprise relationship with CoLab.
  • Run executive, management, and user workshops that expose workflow friction on both sides of the OEM and supplier relationship and create the urgency needed to mobilize multi-stakeholder buying groups.
  • Bring the supplier network into deal strategy on CoLab’s most strategic opportunities, partnering with account executives to coach champions, align stakeholders across engineering, quality, supply chain, and procurement, and build the executive narratives that move buying groups forward.
  • Track how the motion performs, from supplier activation to supplier-sourced pipeline, and turn those signals into structured product feedback and a clear view of where to invest next.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • You've worked inside an OEM, and you understand the supplier side of the relationship.
  • You bring direct experience in engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, supplier quality, or product development at an OEM, where you've owned or worked closely with the handoffs to Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers. Time on the supplier side is a strong plus.
  • You know what an OEM feels when a part misses PPAP and what a supplier feels when a late change lands on a quote, and you can speak credibly to both.
  • You are a network thinker. You see an account as one node in a larger system, and you can look at a customer's supply base and quickly see where the leverage is, which relationships will carry adoption, and which ones will stall it.
  • High emotional intelligence and the ability to read a room of executives in real time. You know when to push, when to pause, when to ask the harder question, and when to take the win and move on.
  • Competitive by nature. You are wired to play to win, you put in the reps, and you run at high cadence. You take losses personally enough to learn from them and not personally enough to slow down.
  • Sharp sense of time value. You understand which work compounds, which work is throwaway, and which conversations are worth a calendar hold versus a quick Slack. You make calls and you move.
  • Clear, direct communicator. You write concisely, present without filler, and can build a clean, compelling deck under pressure. You know that a strong deck is a forcing function, not a deliverable, and you build them that way.
  • Fluent with AI tools as a force multiplier. You know how to use AI to compress research, sharpen messaging, and build faster. You don't just tolerate the tools, you intentionally reach for them to do more with less.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • You have defined CoLab’s supplier ecosystem strategy, and multiple strategic accounts are actively bringing their suppliers into CoLab as a result.
  • You have shaped how the supplier motion is packaged, priced, and resourced, and it runs as a repeatable motion across the revenue org.
  • Your network plays are in use by prospecting and CS, with supplier-sourced pipeline and expansion you can point to.
  • You are owning strategic supplier mapping workshops with our top enterprise accounts.
  • You have meaningfully influenced the outcome of multiple seven figure deals.
  • You are trusted to drive customer leadership conversations without backup.

Extra Details

  • This is a full-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes stock options
  • Unlimited paid vacation, extended health benefits, and RRSP/401k matching
  • Remote-friendly within Eastern or Central time zones in Canada or the US.
  • This role will have a travel component to visit customers onsite. Customer visits are typically 1-3 days total, one or two a month.

Equity Note
Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don't meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.

As one of our Client Success Specialists (CSS), you'll provide accurate and timely support and consistent relationship management to Spektrix clients as a member of a Client Success Delivery Team. You'll act as the named relationship owner for an assigned group of clients, while also contributing to the shared reactive support the team provides across its full client cohort. Ultimately, the success of this role is achieved through the delivery of services that lead to successful outcomes for all Spektrix clients within the delivery team’s portfolio.

  • Multi-Channel Resolution & On-Call Coverage: Resolve inbound client inquiries across phone, email, and video call using internal documentation and established processes, and participate in the support schedule, including rotating on-call coverage outside business hours.
  • Proactive Issue Detection: Identify broader trends during support interactions such as recurring bugs, training gaps, or emerging risks and either address them directly or escalate them to the right internal team.
  • Account Ownership & Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, keeping a clear view of their organizational goals, platform usage, and key stakeholders while maintaining consistent touchpoints.

What You Bring

  • Proven ability to quickly learn and navigate complex software systems, and to apply that knowledge to client questions and needs.

  • Ability to provide explanations and reasons for the choices you make and the advice you provide.

  • Professional development opportunities
  • Flexible working with support for WFH setup / equipment

Working From HomeWhile many Spektrix team members live near one of our offices (NYC, London, or Manchester), remote/non-local team members work from home most of the time, and all team members work from home at least some of the time!

We provide reasonable support and all the hardware you need to get started, but we do require that you have the have the following in place to work from home:

Workplace diversity is something we aim to achieve and maintain at Spektrix, and we are pursuing a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and work in. Product and Partner Implementation Manager | Relevate Health

WHO WE ARE

At Relevate Health, we believe every HCP communication should be genuinely relevant, and we've built a company of exceptional people around that purpose. We're healthcare marketing experts who push ourselves every day to deliver life-changing engagement, and our work is growing fast, especially in point-of-care solutions that put the right message in front of clinicians at the right moment in their workflow.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Our Point of Care (POC) product portfolio has grown exponentially, and we're adding new partners and new products at a pace that calls for someone who can build the machine behind the momentum. As our Product and Partner Implementation Manager, you'll take new and evolving POC-enabled healthcare advertising products, including EHR offerings, and turn them into fully operational, compliant, and scalable solutions that our teams can confidently sell, execute, and support.

You'll sit at the center of a cross-functional network spanning Product, Technology, Marketing Operations, Delivery, Analytics, Sales, Client Service, and external vendor partners. You'll define the workflows, document the specs, run the pilots, and write the playbook for how Relevate Health onboards every new partner and product from here on out. You won't own contracts or system builds. You'll own clarity: who does what, when, and how, so launches go smoothly and teams hand off with confidence. This is a role for someone who is energized by ambiguity and can drive alignment without direct authority.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the end-to-end operationalization of POC products and partners, from concept through launch
  • Manage pilot projects and lead cross-functional teams to develop SOPs, tech specs, vendor and client spec documents, Workfront templates, and Sales and Account decks

  • Define roles, responsibilities, SLAs, and handoffs across internal teams and external partners

  • Partner with Technology and SDS teams by defining operational requirements and real-world use cases, and supporting UAT and launch readiness
  • Partner with the POC Solutions team to deliver training for Sales, internal teams, and key stakeholders
  • Create and maintain SOPs, workflow documentation, requirements docs, and product playbooks as products, vendors, and regulations evolve
  • Hand off ongoing management to each team's functional leaders once products are live
  • Monitor adoption, execution quality, and operational performance, gather feedback, and drive continuous improvement

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Haves

  • 5 to 8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Product Implementation, Marketing Operations, or Ad Operations
  • Proven experience designing and documenting processes, and implementing them in a prior role
  • Experience managing third-party vendors and partner relationships
  • Experience building and directing cross-functional teams
  • Experience managing pilot projects
  • Strong process design, documentation, and cross-functional leadership skills
  • Ability to operationalize products with both internal and external partners
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and driving clarity without direct authority
  • Proficiency with Microsoft products

Big Pluses

  • Experience with EHR, healthcare advertising, ad tech, or other regulated digital products
  • Agency or pharma experience
  • Familiarity with Workfront or similar project management tools
  • Experience working with Legal, Procurement, and Technology teams on vendor onboarding

This role can be fully remote. If you live within 40 miles of a Relevate Health office (Cincinnati, or New Jersey), the role is hybrid. Travel is not regular, but you may join the team in person a few times a year for team meetings.

WHY RELEVATE?

We offer more than a job. We offer a place to grow, do meaningful work, and feel genuinely supported doing it.

Our Culture & Values

Be a part of a compassionate, driven team that emphasizes open communication through our PACT Core Values: Pioneering, Accountable, Caring, and Transparent.

PACT Bonus Program

We put our money where our values are. Every month, we recognize colleagues who go above and beyond to exemplify our PACT Core Values with a monetary bonus ranging from $500 to $2,500. At Relevate, living our values doesn't go unnoticed.

Be a Part of Our FUN!

  • Team Impact: Bringing our colleagues together to think outside the box and implement ingenious activities to involve, inspire, and facilitate positivity and caring.
  • Team HOPE: Seeks out philanthropic opportunities so that we can proactively care, respect, help, serve, and grow.

Set Up for Success

A welcoming onboarding program with the focus on setting our new colleagues up for success from day one.

Competitive Pay & Top Benefits, Including:

  • Unlimited PTO
  • 401K
  • Pet Insurance
  • Health, Dental & Vision
  • Employer-paid STD, LTD, Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital, and Life Insurance
  • and more!

READY TO APPLY?

If you're a systems-minded builder who loves turning complexity into clear, repeatable process, and you want to shape how a fast-growing portfolio scales, we want to hear from you. This is your chance to write the playbook, not just follow one. Apply today and let's talk.
