Location: United States - Remote (field-based; approximately 50-75% travel)
Preferred Location: North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, or Florida
Reports To: Director of Sales - North America & Europe
Compensation: $90,000 - $130,000 USD annual base salary plus target incentive

Who We Are
At UE Systems we believe that every person, regardless of their industry, company size, experience, or budget, should have the tools and support to help their facilities operate more efficiently, reliably, and safely. We do this by providing a portfolio of ultrasound solutions designed to be versatile and simple to use.

Since 1973, we have helped thousands of customers across the world prevent equipment failures, identify energy losses, and return home safe to their families. We are continuing to grow as we build a more disciplined, globally connected operating system to support our customers and our next stage of growth.

About the Role
We are looking for a driven, technically minded professional to take ownership of UE Systems' Southeast sales territory, develop new business, and help industrial organizations improve the reliability, efficiency, and safety of their operations.

This is an opportunity to combine your technical knowledge with consultative sales, customer relationships, and territory growth. You will have the independence to build your sales pipeline, win new customers, grow existing accounts, and introduce innovative ultrasound solutions while becoming a trusted advisor to maintenance and reliability professionals across the region.

You do not need a traditional sales background to succeed in this role. We welcome professionals whose experience is primarily in industrial maintenance, reliability, predictive maintenance (PdM), field applications, technical training, or technical service. If you can earn trust on the plant floor, explain technical findings clearly, and are motivated to develop new business and build customer relationships, UE Systems will provide the sales training, product knowledge, tools, and ongoing support to help you confidently manage the sales process and succeed in growing your territory.

Ideally, this position will be based in North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, or Florida to effectively support our Southeast territory.

Our People
They Own Their Day: We do not micro-manage. Our team understands the outcome, makes disciplined decisions, and communicates early when priorities, risks, or constraints change.

They Believe in a Team Approach: No one is expected to be a master of everything. We rely on each other, bring different strengths to the table, and build better systems together.

They Always Look Through a Customer Lens: Every process we build should make it easier to serve the customer accurately, reliably, and on time.

Your Impact

  • Take ownership of the Southeast sales territory, developing and executing a territory plan to grow revenue, win new customers, and expand existing accounts.
  • Proactively prospect for new business, identify opportunities across industrial markets, and reconnect with inactive or underdeveloped accounts to build a strong sales pipeline.
  • Build relationships with maintenance, reliability, operations, engineering, and business leaders to understand their challenges, identify opportunities, and become a trusted technical advisor.
  • Introduce customers to UE Systems' ultrasound solutions, including hardware, software, training, and services, and demonstrate how they can improve uptime, safety, energy efficiency, and asset performance.
  • Lead customer discovery, onsite evaluations, product demonstrations, and proof-of-value engagements that showcase the practical benefits of our technology and move sales opportunities forward.
  • Translate technical challenges into practical solutions and business cases that demonstrate measurable value through reduced downtime, improved lubrication practices, energy savings, and safer inspections.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, from identifying and qualifying opportunities through proposals, negotiation, and closing, with support from Sales Leadership and internal teams.
  • Maintain an organized territory plan and accurate sales pipeline, including customer activity, opportunity values, next steps, close dates, and revenue forecasts using HubSpot or the designated CRM platform.
  • Develop and strengthen relationships across customer organizations, from plant-floor technicians and reliability engineers to maintenance leaders, plant managers, procurement teams, and executive decision-makers.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Training, Inside Sales, Operations, and technical specialists to support customer needs, deliver a positive customer experience, and identify opportunities for continued growth.
  • Represent UE Systems at customer sites, industry events, workshops, and professional associations while gathering customer feedback and market insights to help strengthen our solutions and market presence.
  • Follow customer-site safety requirements, PPE standards, and UE Systems policies while maintaining a professional, solutions-first approach.
  • Travel regularly throughout the territory, with approximately 50–75% travel depending on customer demand and territory development needs.
Your Experience
  • 5+ years of experience supporting, servicing, or leading maintenance, reliability, predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, or related plant operations within manufacturing or another asset-intensive environment.
  • Working knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance practices, condition-based monitoring, rotating equipment, and common industrial failure modes.
  • Experience with reliability or condition-monitoring technologies such as ultrasound, vibration analysis, infrared thermography, oil analysis, motor testing, or precision alignment.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and translate reliability opportunities into practical operational and financial value for plant-floor, management, and executive audiences.
  • Experience regularly traveling to customer sites in a field-based technical, service, training, or customer-facing role, with the ability and willingness to travel 50–75% in this position.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working independently while collaborating with a broader team.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel within the assigned territory while meeting customer-site safety and access requirements.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, industrial technology, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
Nice to Have
  • Experience in industrial B2B sales, technical sales, consultative selling, field applications, customer training, or other customer-facing technical roles.
  • Experience conducting customer discovery, technical demonstrations, presentations, or product and application training in industrial environments.
  • Familiarity with commercial activities such as account planning, opportunity qualification, CRM management, pipeline development, and forecasting.
  • Experience working with manufacturing, utilities, food and beverage, pharmaceutical, chemical, pulp and paper, or other asset-intensive industries.
  • Ultrasound Level I or II certification, CMRP, CRL, or relevant certification in vibration analysis, infrared thermography, lubrication, motor testing, or precision maintenance.
  • Practical experience applying reliability methods such as asset criticality, root-cause analysis, FMEA, Pareto analysis, defect elimination, or failure-elimination planning.
  • Established relationships within the Southeast industrial maintenance, reliability, or manufacturing community.
  • Experience using HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, or a comparable CRM platform.

Why Join Us?
We have the typical benefits you would expect like dental, vision, and health insurance, paid time off and retirement contributions but your main interest should be to join a family as we are in the process of radically transforming our business in a way that will redefine our company and our place in the market, making this one of the most exciting times in UE Systems history. There is more opportunity than ever before for our people as we expand our business to become a world-class purpose-driven, digitally-led ultrasound solution provider and we need your help to achieve this.

The ideal candidate is excited to create branded social content that feels as authentic as our editorial, with a passion for travel, lifestyle, and hospitality and a sharp instinct for what makes people stop scrolling.

This role is perfect for someone who loves bringing a brand partnership to life from brief to final post. You’ll own the production of our editorial sponsored social campaigns, turning partner goals into carousels, videos, and posts that feel unmistakably Afar. If you can balance creative vision with client needs, move quickly without cutting corners, and thrive in a collaborative environment, we’d love to hear from you.

The successful candidate will report to our Director, Social Platforms.

This role is 100% remote (based in the US)

In this role, you will:

  • Produce social content for paid brand partnerships across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube, including carousels, Reels, short-form video, and Stories.

  • Translate partner briefs into creative concepts that meet campaign goals while staying true to Afar’s editorial voice and travel-for-good values.

  • Act as a creative gatekeeper, making judgment calls on placement and format (such as in-feed vs. dark posts) and pushing back on briefs that don’t fit the brand.

  • Manage campaign timelines and feedback rounds, keeping revisions focused and turnaround fast.

  • Work closely with partnerships, marketing, editorial, and art teams to deliver final assets on schedule and on budget. .

  • Produce, shoot and edit some branded video, including coordinating logistics, managing talent and crew, and making sure every shot needed for the final edit is captured

  • Build sponsored content that performs organically, driving reach and interactions so campaigns rely less on boost budget.

  • Manage a database of footage for potential licensing

  • Track campaign performance and share results and learnings with partners and internal teams.

  • Manage release forms, location permits, usage rights, and music licensing for every project, making sure all content is legally cleared before it goes live.

  • Ensure all sponsored content follows platform policies and FTC disclosure requirements.

  • Develop business rules to guide internal teams and external partners.

Qualifications

  • 2–3 years of experience producing editorial social content, with clear examples of branded and organic work on major platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

  • A strong understanding of Afar’s audience and brand voice, and the confidence to advocate for it with partners

  • Experience managing client and multiple stakeholders feedback and multiple campaigns at once

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, Photoshop) and comfort editing short-form video and designing carousels

  • A track record of branded content that performed, with examples of reach and engagement results

  • Excellent organizational and communication skills and the ability to consistently meet deadlines

  • All applicants must be able to provide legal proof of their eligibility to work in the U.S.

Nice to have:

  • Agency, publisher, or branded content studio experience

  • Familiarity with paid social tools such as Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager

  • Shooting experience or comfort on camera

  • Motion graphics or design skills

  • Experience with Canva, CapCut, or AI-assisted creative tools

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Lead Motion & Graphic Designer in the Curriculum team, you’ll turn complex tech concepts into clear visual and interactive learning experiences, and lead the team that makes them. About 80% of your time goes to hands-on design, motion, video, and interactive work; the other 20% to team leadership. Curriculum visuals help students understand and remember a concept, so we favor clarity, calm pacing, and accurate diagrams over flashy effects.

What you will do

  • Design learning visuals. Create graphics, animations, motion pieces, and explainer videos with Learning Experience Designers, from concept and storyboard to final edit.
  • Set the quality bar. Own visual and motion standards for curriculum content: guidelines, templates, and reusable asset libraries.
  • Lead the team. Run critiques, weekly planning, and retros; mentor designers with regular, actionable feedback; improve intake, reviews, and handoffs.
  • Speed up production. Partner with product, design, and engineering on shared libraries, AI-assisted workflows, and automation of repetitive work.
  • Prototype interactive formats. Design clickable diagrams, simple simulations, and step-by-step visual explainers for our learning platform.
  • Finish video. Edit and enhance video content, adding simple visual effects and sound design.
  • Experiment with new formats. Test new video and interactive formats, using Claude Design and Claude Code to prototype faster.

Requirements

Must have

  • 4+ years in motion and graphic design. A portfolio showing motion, graphic design, and visual storytelling, built in After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Figma.
  • Design leadership. Experience leading or mentoring designers, or owning design standards and processes for a team.
  • English at B2 or higher. Confident written and spoken English for daily work in a remote, cross-functional team.

Nice to have

  • Interactive and UX work. Interactive pieces in your portfolio, and a grasp of how people read, scan, and interact with learning materials.
  • AI creative tools. Hands-on use of Claude Design, Claude Code, or AI agents in Figma to prototype.
  • Ed-tech and languages. Experience in ed-tech, e-learning, or instructional design; Spanish or Portuguese.

What we can offer you

  • Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
  • Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration.
  • Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

ABOUT US

Syniti,part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.

The Role

The Associate Account Executive role is a supporting sales role designed for high potential professionals looking to build foundational field sales skills before progressing into a full quota-carrying position. This role serves as a natural next step from inside sales roles, with an emphasis on learning territory strategy, deal mechanics, and enterprise sales motion through hands-on support and guided ownership.

The AAE partners closely with Client Account Executives to support defined territories and opportunities, assisting with pipeline development, account research, prospect engagement, and deal execution. While the role may include managing smaller transactional opportunities, its primary focus is skill development, exposure, and readiness for progression into a quota-carrying Account Executive role.

Success in this role requires a coachable mindset, strong organizational skills, and the ability to balance independent execution with collaborative support.

What You Will Do

  • Support Client Account Executives (CAEs) across the sales cycle for assigned accounts and opportunities, contributing to prospecting, qualification, discovery preparation, and deal coordination.
  • Assist with pipeline development through outbound outreach, account research and partner collaborations.
  • Participate in discovery calls, proposal development, and customer presentations for mid-market and enterprise opportunities led by CAEs.
  • Learn to position Syniti’s portfolio of software, services, and support by aligning solutions to customer needs in collaboration with senior sales leaders.
  • Participate in territory reviews, pipeline calls, and deal strategy sessions with sales leadership as part of ongoing development.
  • Build industry, market, and product knowledge to understand Syniti’s value proposition and competitive landscape.
  • Travel occasionally for customer meetings, training, and internal events as part of onboarding and professional development.

What It Takes

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 3–5 years of experience in sales, inside sales, SDR/BDR, customer success, or a related client-facing role within software or IT services.
  • Strong research, communication, and relationship-building skills, with comfort engaging a variety of stakeholder levels alongside senior sellers.
  • Experience using CRM systems and sales productivity tools (Salesforce preferred).

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

Syniti discloses salary range information in compliance with state and local pay transparency obligations. The disclosed range represents the lowest to highest salary we, in good faith, believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting, although we may ultimately pay more or less than the disclosed range, and the range may be modified in the future. The disclosed range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to: relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, performance, sales or revenue-based metrics, and business or organizational needs. At Syniti, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role. The base salary range for this role is $76,844 - $124,872. This role may be eligible for other compensation including variable compensation, bonus, or commission. Full time regular employees are eligible for paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), and any other benefits to eligible employees. Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. About Intuitial

Intuitial is a people-first, remote-friendly digital services company serving shoulder-to-shoulder with U.S. federal agencies to deliver innovative, human-centered solutions. We build modern, secure products the right way: with empowered teams, strong delivery discipline, and deep respect for the people who use—and operate—what we ship.

We’re guided by values like Kindness, Grit, Growth Mindset, and Radical Candor, and we aim to create a culture where people can do their best work with trust, autonomy, and support. We value clear communication, healthy collaboration, and continuous learning—because mission impact and excellent engineering both come from teams who feel safe, accountable, and energized.

Our work spans human-centered design, agile delivery, mobile and cloud-native engineering, and practical, responsible use of AI. We’re here to help government services work better for the public—and we believe that starts by building an environment where our teammates can thrive.

The role

Intuitial is looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead a cross-functional agile team supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs' Travel Pay product. The role sits within Intuitial Six, Intuitial's joint venture delivering a larger VA program serving Veterans. This role owns both product and delivery for the team: running the team's agile practice, managing the roadmap and backlog, coordinating releases with other VA teams, and keeping work moving when priorities shift. The Senior Product Manager will present upcoming and completed work to stakeholders and lead working sessions across teams.

We look for Product Managers who lead with confidence and bring structure to a team, and who also embrace empowerment and a growth mindset. If you care deeply not just about your own aptitude, but about supporting others' growth, we'd love to hear from you. We look for people who are both tactical and strategic, and who are energized by delivering in complex environments with many moving parts. Most importantly, we look for folks who are passionate about solving problems that impact millions of users. We are here to make a difference in government, and Product Managers are the primary champions of our cause!

Contract Timeline

The current contract period ends February 16, 2027. We expect VA to extend the work through June 2027, ahead of a planned recompete. These plans have not been finalized, and the timeline is subject to change. We welcome questions and will share what we know as transparently as we can throughout the hiring process.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership and Delivery
    • Lead the team's agile practice day to day: plan and facilitate sprint ceremonies, run meetings, and keep the team on track
    • Help the team establish and refine how it works best, including norms, rituals, and ways of collaborating
    • Own release planning, dependency tracking, and status reporting for the team
  • Cross-Team Collaboration
    • Coordinate with other VA teams, product managers, and partners whose work the team depends on, and who depend on the team
    • Facilitate cross-team discussions and negotiate release timing and scope across teams
    • Raise and resolve blockers with dependent teams, escalating when needed so the team can keep delivering
  • Product Direction and Communication
    • Partner with VA stakeholders who set product direction, translating their priorities into a clear, iterative plan the team can deliver
    • Shape and communicate the roadmap as priorities shift, keeping stakeholders and the team aligned on tradeoffs
    • Bring ideas and recommendations to stakeholders with confidence, grounded in user needs and delivery realities
  • Agile Delivery
    • Manage and prioritize the product backlog, and lead regular backlog refinement with the team
    • Break down problems so value can be delivered iteratively and incrementally. Lead the team to early validation of risky assumptions, and early and continuous delivery of value
    • Write user stories and acceptance criteria that convey the what and why, leaving room for the team to determine the how
  • Discovery
    • Partner with UX research and design on the team to understand users and prioritize the needs that deliver the most value
    • Establish a healthy, trust-based rapport with teammates and stakeholders
    • Collaboratively identify and work to understand stakeholder constraints. Develop solutions that address diverse and sometimes conflicting stakeholder needs
    • We expect the responsibilities of this position to shift and grow organically over time, in response to considerations such as the unique strengths and interests of the selected candidate and other team members and an evolving understanding of the delivery environment

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of product management or product ownership experience, plus relevant experience in technology delivery or project management
  • Experience leading a team's agile practice, including facilitating ceremonies, without a dedicated scrum master or delivery manager
  • Experience delivering products that depend on multiple teams or external stakeholders, including coordinating and negotiating releases
  • Effective communicator, leader, and motivator
  • In-depth knowledge and application of Agile principles and practices
  • Proven track record of launching products from conception to production, and managing clients and key stakeholders
  • High level cross-disciplinary understanding of the software development process, including research, design, development, testing, and deployment
  • Comfort and familiarity working in GitHub, including issues, project boards, and pull request workflows
  • Openness to AI tools and good judgment about where they improve outcomes
  • Has lived and worked in the United States for 3 of the last 5 years
  • Some of our clients may request or require travel from time to time. If this is a concern for you, we encourage you to apply and discuss it with us at your initial interview
  • Able to start within 2 to 4 weeks of an offer. The team is working against near-term deadlines, so we’re looking for someone who can join and ramp up quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with government agencies. Familiarity with VA OIT or a similar federal IT environment, including platform governance processes such as VA's collaboration cycle, is a strong plus
  • Experience using AI-powered prototyping tools or IDEs (such as Vercel V0, Lovable, Replit, Copilot, or Cursor) or enabling technologies such as MCP servers to prototype solutions and support delivery, retaining oversight over all work produced
  • You are a U.S. Veteran. As a service-disabled veteran-owned small business, Intuitial recognizes the transition to civilian life can be tricky, and welcomes and encourages Veterans to apply.

At Intuitial, we are committed to building teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We’re eager to meet people who believe in our mission and who can contribute to our team in a variety of ways.

Salary and Benefits

As a small and growing government contractor, our open roles are tied to the contracts we support and the funding available. We aim to offer compensation that’s competitive and fair, reflecting the scope of the role, your experience, and the market.

The salary for this position is: $158,804.

Our benefits are designed to support sustainable, high-quality work and a healthy life outside of it. We value autonomy and trust, and we encourage teammates to take the time they need to rest, recharge, and show up at their best.

Benefits include:

  • Competitive salary
  • 401(k) with employer matching
  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees
  • Flexible PTO
  • Paid federal holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Sick time and wellness days

Hiring Practices

Intuitial is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out . We’ll do our best to ensure you can participate fully in our hiring process.

Interviews are conducted on a rolling basis until the position has been filled.

great people. great services. great results.

Each and every individual plays a key role in the growth and legacy of our company. We know the next big idea can come from anyone. We encourage developing and attracting expertise that differentiates us as a company as we continue to raise the bar.

Job Summary

The Solutioner Uplifts and Benchmarking leader will help Support Services identify, quantify, and operationalize opportunities to improve client value, financial performance, and competitive position. This role will combine market intelligence, operational benchmarking, financial modeling, and solution design to translate data into better proposals, stronger renewals, and measurable performance improvement. The role is especially important as Compass Group expands its data center capabilities, where clients expect disciplined operating models, technical credibility, resilient service delivery, and clear evidence of value.

This position requires approximately 50–75% travel, based on business needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop benchmark-informed solutions for new business, renewals, expansions, transitions, and strategic
    client opportunities.
  • Analyze labor, productivity, service levels, operating costs, scope, pricing, and performance data to identify
    uplift opportunities.
  • Build financial models and scenarios that quantify the impact of staffing models, service design,
    technology, capital, process changes, and commercial terms.
  • Partner with operations, finance, sales and growth, solutions, procurement, EHS, and subject matter
    experts to shape winning and executable solutions.
  • Translate data center operating requirements into practical service models, including critical environments,
    technical infrastructure, maintenance, staffing, coverage, safety, and continuity considerations.
  • Create clear executive-ready recommendations that distinguish assumptions, benchmarks, risks,
    investment requirements, and expected returns.
  • Evaluate commercial and operational risks, including contract assumptions, escalation exposure, service
    level commitments, mobilization, contingencies, and client data dependencies.
  • Establish reusable benchmarking frameworks, libraries, assumptions, and solution playbooks for Support
    Services and data center pursuits.
  • Challenge legacy assumptions and identify where Compass Group can differentiate through operating
    discipline, talent strategy, technology, or service innovation.
  • Support negotiations and transition planning by ensuring that proposed value is operationally credible and
    measurable.
  • Lead operational validation and implementation handoff, establishing accountable owners, milestones,
    benefit targets, and measurement methods before launch.
  • Create a benefits-realization framework with baselines, reporting cadence, ownership, corrective actions,
    and escalation procedures.

    account strategies.

    degree preferred.
  • Seven or more years of experience in solutions, commercial strategy, pricing, benchmarking, consulting,
    finance, operations transformation, or related work.
  • Strong financial modeling skills, including scenario analysis, cost-to-serve, margin, productivity, and return
    on-investment analysis.
  • Experience translating operational data into client-facing recommendations and executable operating
    models.
  • Knowledge of facilities management, technical services, data centers, foodservice, outsourcing,
    construction, or another asset-intensive operating environment preferred.
  • Ability to evaluate labor models, service scope, performance metrics, and market intelligence with sound
    business judgment.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder influence skills.
  • Advanced proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint; experience with business intelligence, workforce
    analytics, or talent intelligence tools preferred.
  • Willingness to travel periodically to client sites, operating locations, and data center markets.

What Success Looks Like

  • Recommendations improve both competitiveness and operational credibility.
  • Uplift opportunities are quantified before they are presented and tracked after implementation.
  • Leaders can clearly explain the assumptions, investment, risk, and expected value behind a solution.
  • Benchmarking becomes a repeatable capability rather than a one-time analysis.
  • The role helps Support Services win, retain, and grow business while protecting execution quality and

Integrity, Compliance, Value Creation, Principled Entrepreneurship, Customer Focus, Knowledge, Change, Humility, Respect, & Fulfillment

The salary for this opportunity is $105,000.

Job Summary

The Corporate Social Media Manager will lead the social media operating model across Pacific Hospitality Group properties and outlets. The role owns the AI-agent flow, publishing through Sprout Social, and assigned social channels across the Meritage Collection and legacy portfolio, translating brand direction into channel plans, organic engagement, and measurable performance.

The role will work with Property Marketing Leads to define the content needed; PMLs will capture and approve property-specific content on site, while the Corporate Brand & Content Manager owns content strategy, video editing, and brand consistency.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the social media day-to-day operating model for assigned PHG properties and outlets, aligned with business priorities, brand standards, and property initiatives.
  • Own multiple social media channels for all Pacific Hospitality properties including outlets and collaborate with Stay Golden by Meritage Collection.
  • Own the AI-agent flow from content request through review, routing, and publishing, using established brand and approval standards.
  • Manage social calendars, publishing schedules, campaign rollouts, and day-to-day channel operations through Sprout Social.
  • Own organic content engagement across assigned channels; Property Marketing Leads own direct messages and property-specific guest follow-up.
  • Plan and manage Facebook Events for property activations, restaurant programming, seasonal experiences, and other approved initiatives.
  • Work with Property Marketing Leads to identify content needs, define capture requests, and coordinate the flow of approved on-site assets.
  • Size and prepare images for social publishing and create supporting social assets.
  • Source and organize video assets that need to be converted into Reels or other short-form formats.
  • Oversee organic content boosting and platform optimization in coordination with marketing priorities and approved budgets.
  • Own and continuously improve the AI-driven social media content engine, reviewing generated outputs for accuracy, brand voice, platform fit, legal or reputational concerns, and strategic alignment before routing content to the appropriate Property Marketing Lead for review and approval.
  • Coordinate social content management across assigned properties and outlets, ensuring timely receipt.
  • Monitor platform trends, competitor activity, audience sentiment, algorithm changes, and emerging opportunities to inform recommendations.
  • Research social, hospitality, luxury, travel, restaurant, and competitive-set trends and upload relevant compset data to support reporting, benchmarking, and strategic recommendations.

ANALYTICS & PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT

  • Own monthly and quarterly social reporting through Sprout Social, including reach, engagement, audience growth, content performance, and relevant referral or conversion indicators.
  • Translate performance data into clear insights, optimization recommendations, and channel or property-level actions.
  • Build consistent KPI definitions and reporting practices across PHG’s portfolio.
  • Track progress against strategic objectives and communicate risks, opportunities, and decisions to corporate and property stakeholders.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP

  • Partner with the Corporate Brand & Content Manager to align social execution with content strategy, brand positioning, campaigns, creative direction, and portfolio-wide governance.
  • Build strong working relationships with Property Marketing Leads, hotel teams, restaurant teams, and agency or vendor partners as needed to define content needs, route approvals, and support timely execution.
  • Advise stakeholders on platform best practices, social-first storytelling, community response, and content readiness.
  • Provide strategic support for openings, activations, promotions, events, and other moments that benefit from timely social amplification.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience leading brand social media strategy, channel management, community management, or digital marketing programs.
  • Experience managing social media across multiple properties, brands, locations, or business units; enterprise or multi-property experience is strongly preferred.
  • This position requires approximately 25% travel and may be based remotely in California, Texas, Arizona, or Hawaii, near one of our property markets.
  • Strong working knowledge of Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and emerging social platforms; TikTok experience is preferred.
  • Proficiency with Sprout Social or a comparable social media management and reporting platform.
  • Portfolio or representative work sample demonstrating social media strategy, photography, visual storytelling, and/or social-first creative is required.
  • Strong visual judgment and photography literacy, including the ability to define image needs, assess on-site captures, and prepare assets for publishing.
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite for image adjustments and production, plus Canva for social asset creation and adaptation.
  • Familiarity with short-form video formats and the ability to source, organize, and brief video assets for editing is preferred; video editing is not the primary responsibility of this role.
  • Excellent writing, editing, judgment, and brand-voice skills, with the ability to manage AI-assisted content critically and improve it when needed.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, deadlines, approvals, and escalation paths in a fast-moving environment.
  • Hospitality, luxury lifestyle, travel, restaurant, or multi-property brand experience preferred.

SUCCESS MEASURES

  • A clear, adopted, and measurable social media strategy across PHG’s portfolio.
  • Consistent brand voice, governance, and publishing quality across channels and properties.
  • Timely, accurate, and actionable social reporting that informs decisions and optimization.
  • Improved audience engagement, community responsiveness, channel health, and organic visibility.
  • Effective ownership of the AI-driven social media content engine, increasing efficiency without compromising accuracy, brand integrity, property approval requirements, or guest trust.
  • Strong partnership with corporate and property marketing teams and reliable support for campaigns, activations, and business priorities.

This is a Full Time (not contract/C2C), 100% remote position for mainland US "onshore" only.

Agency experience preferred.

You must submit a cover letter written by you (not AI).Submissions without a cover letter will be ignored.

Please explain how your experience and future goals align with this position. Ask at least one question about the role in your cover letter.

This position is for a Senior “LAMP” developer with Laravel expertise and experience in containerization. Please read this carefully. This is not an entry level position and there are specific requirements, just like any software development project.

You must be a PHP developer first, and a Laravel developer second. Front end experience is also a must.

Agency experience is preferred as you will be tasked with generating timelines and estimates for projects, then delivering them. At times, smaller projects may have little Project Management and delivery is handled by the developer. This is a typical example of Agency work. Larger projects have more Project Management. However, our developers are often communicating directly with the clients and internal teams regarding scope, costs, and timelines. In effect, you are soup-to-nuts freelancer, but as a full time position.

  • We are a small company with heavy hitting clients
  • Training is limited - you must be able to git the ground running
  • We are often hired to solve problems that cannot be solved by our client’s internal teams
  • Interruptions and client management is part of Agency life
  • Accountability and improvement is key to our survival
  • Independence is key
  • Security is an absolute

Responsibilities & Qualifications

This is a full time, client facing role requiring excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. A background check and references are required.

Your primary role will be to collaborate with cross-functional teams building highly secure, complex back-end and front-end products with many moving parts. This role includes projects for a Fortune 500 investment company, as well as our Laravel based CMS for law firms called LawFirm CMS, and many others.

Upgrading versions and maintaining Laravel is a must! However, clean sheet development of a PHP based application is also a requirement. You must be a PHP developer first, and a Laravel developer second.

You will also be involved with the co-creation of project plans and pre-sales activities (information architecture, estimates, scope, schedule, risks, etc.).

Your keen insight into data consumption, manipulation, and presentation will be tested. A passion for problem solving and self governance is a necessity.

With the rapid change in techniques and tools available, you will be tasked with creating maintainable, best-practice based system architectures. We maintain everything we produce and pride ourselves on long term, sustainable partnerships with our clients and related vendors. It is important to understand that maintenance is a large part of our business, which means building software but also maintaining it over time.

Also, because of our clients we tend towards conservative development approaches instead of bleeding edge. This means managing aging projects, as well as upgrading them to the latest best practices.

As with all of our projects, we pride ourselves on our customer service on all levels. Constant, clear communication in both good and challenging times keeps our customers active for many years.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field: Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline
  • 5+ years “Full Stack” development with considerable Laravel experience
  • Client facing product management and development
  • Independent team player in a typically fast paced, sometimes complex environment
  • Ability to shift priorities and handle multiple, concurrent projects while still managing to smile and laugh
  • Passion for problem solving
  • Integrate with and troubleshoot complex client DevOps
  • Independence is a must - many projects are often handled by a single developer, not a team
  • The first line of Quality Assurance is you
  • Collaboration, honesty, and integrity are absolutes

Professionals Skills & Knowledge

As a developer, your current career has led you to already incorporate many of the following technologies and techniques into your project workflows. It is understood that you may have more experience in some areas than others, or even lack a specific experience below. We are looking for constant learners with proven foundations in application development who are always looking to enhance their skills.

We often deal with aging code. Working with older code, upgrading the application, or even recreating the application in the latest and greatest is part of our service offerings.

Front End

Required: Semantic HTML/CSS, JavaScript (DOM, JSON, JQuery, AJAX, etc.), Bootstrap, Quality Assurance on your own code.

Experience with: React, Gulp, and/or other frameworks

Back End/Implementation

Required: PHP 7/8, Laravel, SQL (MySQL/MSSQL/NoSQL/Other), REST/SOAP

Experience with / Nice to have: Python, Node.js, SOLR, PDF Publishing, and other frameworks

CMS/Frameworks

Required: Laravel

Experience with / Nice to have: Symfony, Drupal 8/9/10, WordPress, Other

Systems/Stacks

Required: Docker, bash, Apache/Nginx/MySQL/Linux maintenance

Experience with / Nice to have: K8S, LAMP Stack (and variations), Bash and command line, Performance/PEN Testing, Hosting configurations, AWS/Azure/Cloud experience, Caching, DNS

Workflow/Other

CICD/DevOps (Jenkins), Git (GitHub, BitBucket)/SVN, SSO/SAML, SEO Best Practices, Compliance (ADA/SOC/GDPR/PCI DSS)

Tools

Visual Studio Code (our standard IDE), Office Suite, Google Suite, Slack/Teams, Basecamp, Jira, Other

Nice to Have

Acquia/Other Drupal hosts & workflows, SAST/DAST tools, React Native/Xamarin/Flutter/PWA, Adobe Suite

Compensation & Benefits

$100,000 - $130,000. Individual compensation varies based on job related factors, including business needs, experience, level of responsibility, and qualifications.

Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required.

Join our Future Talent network and you'll be one of the first people we reach when the right opening appears. We make around 160 hires a year, so it happens often.

The role

As a VP of Client Services, you will own a new-logo quota in the US. You'll design and run the strategy to attract new opportunities, build a network of US technology buyers, and take each deal from first conversation to signed contract.

Your day-to-day: Win new business in the US

Build a US network

Design the demand strategy

  • Work with BDRs and marketing to align efforts, warm up target accounts, and increase inbound and outbound pipeline.
  • Partner with the Growth team to find new levers for company growth.

Improve conversion

  • Review lost and stalled deals, find the patterns, and fix them.
  • Keep the CRM current and the forecast accurate, and tell leadership early when a deal is slipping.

Expand current clients

  • Spot growth potential in our current portfolio: new relationships inside existing clients and new service lines to sell them.

  • Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

jobs.description:
Role: Grants and Compliance Manager

Reports to: Head of Operations

Salary: $75,000–$85,000

Status: Full-time

Location: This is a remote position within the United States

Who We Are:

National Math Stars ensures mathematically extraordinary students from all communities have the resources they need to reach the frontiers of math and science.

Through our Math Awards Program, we collaborate with schools and districts to identify and recognize their highest-achieving 2% of 2nd- and 3rd-grade math students. Those students are invited to a competitive admissions process, which aims to select the top talent from all communities. (You could roughly think of this as 'the best young mathematician in every ZIP code,' if the US didn't have quite so many ZIP codes!)

We admit those top students to our Stars Programs and work with them (and their families) over the course of a decade to support their journeys to the frontiers of STEM. All Stars receive access to advanced math opportunities, family guidance, and community gatherings. Within the Stars Program, we have two tracks: (1) our fully funded Voyager Stars program, for Stars furthest from opportunity, and (2) our Pathfinder Stars program, which provides lighter-touch advising and access to partial funding for STEM opportunities. We currently serve over 900 Stars across ten states and are rapidly expanding our reach.

Role Overview:

As Grants and Compliance Manager, you'll own NMS's grant compliance and record-keeping to ensure we fulfill all federal requirements. Your first major responsibility is a newly awarded four-year agreement with the National Science Foundation (NSF). You'll be the administrative lead on that award, partnering with our CEO (Principal Investigator) and operations team. You'll own the operational work behind the grant budget, drawdowns, federal financial reporting, and other compliance requirements.

You'll also build our grants function across federal and (potentially) state funders: creating the systems that keep every award compliant. Our Finance team handles transactions and reconciliations; you'll make sure every grant dollar is spent, documented, and reported the way the funder requires.

This is a position for someone who is precise with details and clear with people. You'll take genuine satisfaction in a clean audit trail and an on-time report. You'll also be the person who explains, in plain language, why a cost can or can't go on a grant. Many of our grant systems are still being built, so you should be someone who can design simple processes that program staff will actually use.

We anticipate a start date in December 2026 or January 2027. This is a remote position with occasional travel for team events and retreats.

Key Responsibilities:

The Grants and Compliance Manager's key responsibilities fall under the following categories:

NSF award management (~45%)

  • Serve as NMS’s administrative contact with NSF grants and program officers (alongside the PI and co-PI), keeping communication timely and resolving questions or compliance issues quickly
  • Project manage grant compliance: keep track of implementation, reporting, and financial requirements, and ensure they are being fulfilled
  • Own the award budget: track spending, forecast future quarters/years, and flag variances early
  • Support drawdowns through NSF's payment system
  • Prepare federal financial reports on time
  • Track costs by grant workstream and advise of any updated classifications that need NSF approval
  • Ensure all costs charged to the grant are allowable under 2 CFR and the specific terms of the award
  • Prepare prior approval requests, budget revisions, and no-cost extension requests
  • Support the PI on annual and final project reports in Research.gov
  • Keep SAM.gov, Research.gov, and related registrations and certifications current
  • Lead award closeout

Grants compliance across NMS (~25%)

  • Follow, reinforce with staff, and help revise as needed the written policies federal, state, and private awards require (financial management, procurement, conflict of interest, travel, record retention)
  • Run a single grants calendar and database covering every award's deadlines, restrictions, and reports
  • Partner with the Finance team so restricted grant funds are coded and tracked correctly
  • Prepare grant documentation for the annual financial audit and, when required, a federal Single Audit
  • Ensure staff follow procedures to enable Finance team to properly allot funds to grant(s)
  • Track changes in federal and state grant rules and explain what they mean for NMS

New funding: pre-award (~20%)

  • Keep an eye out for RFPs from agencies or organizations that fit NMS's strategy

  • Support preparation and submission of new grant proposals

  • Review every proposal against funder requirements before it goes out

  • Build working relationships with program officers in the course of pre-award work

Reporting and improvement (~10%)

  • Report quarterly to the Head of Operations and CEO on active awards and compliance risks
  • Simplify grant processes for program staff, including through automation where it saves real time

Skills and Experience:

  • 3+ years of grants management, including post-award management of at least one federal grant or cooperative agreement
  • Working knowledge of 2 CFR 200 (Uniform Guidance), especially cost allowability, budgeting, and financial reporting
  • Comfort building grant budgets and reading financial reports
  • Ability to explain complex rules simply to people who are not grants experts
  • Strong organization: you track many deadlines and miss none of them
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
  • Preferred: NSF award experience (PAPPG, Research.gov, ACM$), participant support cost management, CGMS or a similar credential, and fluency with Google Workspace and QuickBooks Online

Compensation and Benefits:

  • The salary range for this role is $75,000–$85,000
  • $1,500 one-time home office stipend
  • 5% non-elective contribution to 401K
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life insurance coverage with 100% employer contribution for employees & 70% coverage for dependents
  • Generous paid vacation & sick time off from day one
  • Paid parental leave
  • Free pie every Pi Day

We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 / year

jobs.description:
About us

The Earthshot Prize is the world's most prestigious environmental prize. Founded by HRH Prince William in 2020, we are driving a decade of action for the planet, guided by the belief that Urgency + Optimism = Action.

Our mission is to find, celebrate, and scale the solutions that will repair our planet by 2030. At our heart are five Earthshots: Protect and Restore Nature, Clean Our Air, Revive Our Oceans, Build a Waste-free World, and Fix Our Climate.

Each year, we select 15 Finalists and five Winners, who each receive £1 million to take their work further. What makes the Prize unique is what happens next. We work with every Finalist on a plan to grow their impact, then bring in our Global Alliance of partners to help make it happen.

Our regional programmes build on what we do best: convening leaders, spotlighting solutions, building ecosystems of changemakers, and connecting local solutions to global platforms.

Australia and the Pacific are a growing focus for the Prize. We are looking for a Director of Oceania to build the partnerships and programmes that will make those moments count, and carry their impact well beyond them.

About the job

The Director of Oceania is part of Earthshot’s global leadership team. You will lead our impact and partnerships work across Australia and the Pacific nations, and be our senior voice in the region.We are looking for an outstanding, entrepreneurial, and visionary leader in partnerships and programmes. Your focus will be fourfold: building an ecosystem of partners and changemakers ahead of major Earthshot moments in the region, securing legacy funding for a long-term regional programme, leading on specific Finalists and Winners in the region to help scale their impact, and securing sponsorship for any regional events with support from our global partnerships team.

You will work closely with colleagues and external leaders to open up new and existing networks of philanthropists, foundations, investors, and corporations. You will also nurture our regional community of supporters, from Official Nominators, Expert Advisors, nominees, and Finalists to philanthropists, investors, and friends.You will be the voice of The Earthshot Prize in the region, and the voice of the region to the Prize. Given the distance and time difference from our London team, we need someone we can confidently put on stage and in front of the media, and who is comfortable making decisions on the ground. This is a unique opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, with the autonomy to drive real change and make a meaningful difference to the planet.

Key responsibilities

Ecosystem building

  • Establish and oversee a regional advisory council, bringing in First Nations and Pacific Island voices so our work is shaped with communities, not for them.
  • Nurture our regional community of supporters, from Official Nominators, Expert Advisors, nominees, and Finalists to philanthropists, investors, and friends.

Impact and partnerships strategy

You will act as a strategic adviser to these Finalists and Winners with links to the region, and will drive these plans to help them go further, faster.
  • Identify and secure partnerships with philanthropists, governments/policymakers, foundations, investors, corporations, and governments that help these solutions scale.

Legacy funding and long-term programme

  • Secure multi-year legacy funding for a long-term regional programme that continues well beyond our major events in the region.
  • Develop and deliver that programme with partners, so the relationships formed around these moments turn into lasting outcomes for solutions and communities.

Media and public voice

  • Act as the senior face of The Earthshot Prize in the region, speaking on stage, with the media, and at partner events.
  • Share regional insight and partner feedback with the global team to shape our approach.

Candidate criteria

Essential

  • A strategic thinker with a proven track record of delivering impact through a network of senior partnerships.
  • Highly autonomous and self-driven: comfortable leading alone in the region, making sound judgements, and keeping a distant team well informed.
  • A demonstrated record of raising substantial gifts, sponsorship, or investment, including multi-year funding.
  • Strong existing networks across Australian philanthropy, business, government, and civil society, including UHNWIs, family offices, foundations, and corporations.
  • A confident, credible communicator who builds trust quickly with senior stakeholders.

Desirable

jobs.excerpt: BforeAI is an innovative and rapidly expanding scale-up dedicated to deterring cybercrime through cutting-edge predictive and preemptive technologies.
jobs.description:
BforeAI is an innovative and rapidly expanding scale-up dedicated to deterring cybercrime through cutting-edge predictive and preemptive technologies. We've harnessed the power of prescriptive AI to revolutionize the way we tackle cyber threats, stopping attacks before they launch.

Named by Gartner® in 41 reports over the last 3 years (14 in 2025 alone!) and recognized as a Tech Innovator for Preemptive Cybersecurity in the 2025 Emerging Tech report, BforeAI is the industry’s fastest, most accurate solution for automated protection against online fraud.

Join us in the fight for a safer cyberspace!

🚀 Why it’s great to work here

We are a location-independent company with a fully distributed team. We believe diversity of experience, background, and thinking leads to stronger teams and a better product. We value autonomy, intellectual honesty, practical decision-making, and engineers who take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for perfectly defined tasks.

We offer an intellectually stimulating company environment and you’ll be working with a bright, dedicated team from across the globe. Additionally, we offer flexible time off, sick days, all public holidays, and stock options.

✨ What’s cool about this job

We are building the data and intelligence foundation required to turn large, diverse sources of threat data into reliable, explainable, and actionable protection for our customers. You will work with a dedicated global team on technically difficult problems involving cybersecurity, distributed systems, data engineering, machine learning, and SaaS product development.

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer to build the production services and pipelines that acquire, normalize, enrich, relate, score, and deliver threat intelligence through BforeAI’s customer-facing SaaS product.

📣 What you’ll be doing

This is a hands-on product-engineering role. You will design systems and write production software for event-driven data processing and we need an engineer who understands when a managed service is appropriate, when custom code is necessary, and how to deliver either choice as a reliable product capability.

Build product data services

  • Design, implement, test, deploy, and operate production services for ingestion, normalization, enrichment, identity resolution, scoring, and intelligence delivery.
  • Build maintainable pipeline workers, event consumers, APIs, scheduled processes, and supporting libraries rather than relying exclusively on notebooks, visual workflows, or vendor configuration.
  • Own the complete software lifecycle, including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and improvement.
  • Establish reusable engineering patterns that other members of the team can follow.

Engineer reliable event-driven pipelines

  • Develop asynchronous workflows with explicit data, event, and work contracts.
  • Design for duplicate delivery, ordering constraints, idempotency, retries, timeouts, partial failure, dead-letter handling, backpressure, and recovery.
  • Make pipeline state and failures observable, with reconciliation that identifies missing, delayed, duplicated, or inconsistent processing.
  • Support safe replay and reprocessing without silently changing the meaning of historical results.

Protect data integrity and tenant boundaries

  • Preserve source evidence, provenance, lineage, processing context, and applicable versions from the first write so customer-visible results remain explainable.
  • Define validation and quality controls at service boundaries and support safe evolution of schemas, contracts, and processing logic.
  • Preserve tenant isolation while safely combining shared intelligence with customer-private evidence, configuration, and conclusions.
  • Apply authorization, retention, deletion, audit, GDPR, and SOC 2 requirements throughout data-processing workflows.

Shape the architecture and team

  • Evaluate when to use a managed service, open-source component, existing capability, or purpose-built service based on product and operational requirements.
  • Contribute to architecture through working software, written proposals, prototypes, and constructive technical review.
  • Work with Product, Platform Engineering, Threat Research, Data Science, Security, and customer-facing teams. Platform Engineering includes Data Engineering and SRE responsibilities.
  • Translate product requirements into clear technical contracts, communicate tradeoffs, and mentor engineers in modern data and distributed-systems practices.

💥 You’ll be a great fit if

  • You have significant hands-on experience building and operating data-intensive software for an externally used SaaS product.
  • You are a strong software engineer who specializes in data systems, not solely a user or administrator of data tools.
  • You have production development experience with Go, Scala, Rust, Java, or another comparable language used to build reliable backend services.
  • You are willing to work primarily in Go for pipeline and product data services. Existing Go experience is strongly preferred, but deep experience with Scala, Rust, or similar languages can provide a strong foundation.
  • You are proficient with Python and SQL where their data-processing, analytics, integration, or machine-learning ecosystems provide a practical advantage.
  • You understand relational, document, graph, key-value, analytical, and object-storage models and their tradeoffs.
  • You understand distributed-systems concerns such as asynchronous processing, delivery semantics, concurrency, backpressure, idempotency, consistency, recovery, and failure isolation.
  • You have designed or operated event-driven systems using technologies such as Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, AWS Kinesis, or comparable messaging infrastructure.
  • You have experience with containers, cloud infrastructure, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and production operations.
  • You can reason about provenance, replay, data quality, multi-tenant isolation, shared data, private customer context, and authorization boundaries.
  • You evaluate unfamiliar technologies based on engineering principles, communicate clearly, challenge weak assumptions constructively, and own delivery outcomes.

You do not need every item below, but relevant experience may help you have an immediate impact:

  • Cybersecurity, threat intelligence, fraud, abuse prevention, or other evidence-intensive domains
  • Data provenance, explainability, auditability, or regulated data systems
  • Graph-based data processing, Neo4j, Azure Data Explorer, or Azure Data Lake Storage
  • Machine-learning feature pipelines, model inputs and outputs, or feedback and learning systems
  • Migrating legacy batch or pipeline workloads into service-based, event-driven architectures
  • Operating customer-facing data systems under defined reliability and recovery expectations

💻 Our environment

Our Azure-based environment includes Go and Python services, Event Hubs and Kafka-compatible messaging, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Explorer, PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Redis, Databricks for appropriate analytics and machine-learning workloads, Kubernetes, and Azure-managed compute services.

Experience with every component is not required. We care more about whether you understand the engineering principles underneath these technologies, can become productive in an unfamiliar environment, and can choose the appropriate combination of managed services and custom software.

Don't meet every single requirement? Don't count yourself out just yet.

We recognize that strong candidates may have taken different paths and may not match every technology or qualification listed here. If you are an experienced software or data engineer who has built production data-intensive systems, understands the problems underneath the tools, and wants to help build the data foundation of a cybersecurity product, we encourage you to apply.

At BforeAI, we're dedicated to building a diverse workplace based on merit, work ethics, and character, and we believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success! If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we hope you’ll still consider applying!

We use an Employee of Record service to facilitate seamless global hiring processes and offer benefits tailored to the country where you will be working! For countries not supported by our EOR partner, talk to us about being a contractor. In all cases, this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship so you will need to be authorized to work in the country you’re based in. We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed.

Accela is seeking an experienced Senior Compliance Analyst to lead the implementation, certification, and ongoing maintenance of our ISO/IEC 27001:2022 program. The Senior Compliance Analyst will work closely with Information Security, IT, Engineering, Legal, HR, and other business stakeholders to implement controls, manage compliance activities, coordinate certification audits, and maintain audit readiness. The ideal candidate brings hands-on ISO 27001 implementation experience, strong project management capabilities, and the ability to independently drive cross-functional initiatives while supporting Accela's broader governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) objectives.

ISO 27001 Implementation & Certification

  • Lead the end-to-end implementation and certification of Accela's ISO/IEC 27001:2022 program.
  • Develop and manage implementation plans, milestones, deliverables, and stakeholder responsibilities.
  • Conduct gap assessments, identify compliance requirements, and coordinate remediation activities.
  • Establish and maintain the ISMS scope, objectives, and Statement of Applicability (SoA).

  • Evaluate control effectiveness, identify gaps, and track remediation through completion.
  • Coordinate internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions, and continual improvement activities.
  • Monitor organizational and regulatory changes that may affect ISMS requirements and compliance obligations.

Policies, Documentation & Compliance Operations

  • Establish processes for documentation management, control assessments, evidence collection, and ongoing compliance monitoring.
  • Ensure required documentation and records are accurate, current, appropriately approved, and audit-ready.
  • Integrate ISO 27001 requirements into existing business processes while leveraging established controls and documentation.

GRC Platform & Evidence Management

  • Map existing controls and evidence to ISO 27001 requirements, identifying opportunities to streamline compliance activities.
  • Establish control ownership, evidence requirements, and ongoing monitoring processes.
  • Leverage automation to improve evidence collection, reporting, and audit readiness.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Reporting

  • Partner with Information Security, IT, Engineering, HR, Legal, Finance, and other stakeholders to operationalize ISO 27001 requirements.
  • Communicate compliance expectations, priorities, and deadlines while driving accountability across teams.
  • Collaborate with the GRC Manager to align ISO 27001 activities with broader GRC initiatives.

jobs.excerpt: About UsInStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it.
jobs.description:
About Us

InStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it. Through this mission, we are expanding access to insurance-based care, increasing engagement in treatment, and improving treatment outcomes. We are doing this by combining research-backed clinical care and innovative technology to eliminate the major problems with care today: difficulty finding providers, months of waiting to be seen, arduous onboarding processes, and inconsistent use of evidence-based therapies and outcomes tracking. Our vision is to become the nation’s most trusted provider of pediatric anxiety and OCD care.

TeamInStride Health: Our Core Values

  • Give Heart: We lead with heart, treating patients and their families the way we want our loved ones to be treated.
  • Work Smart: We find smarter ways to solve hard problems and fix the broken mental health system by leveraging technology, diversity of thought, and innovation.
  • Have Humility: We leave our egos at the door, empowering our team to collaborate, celebrate diversity, and adopt a growth mindset.
  • Embrace Community: We all belong. We are in this together, and we never worry alone. We believe in each other and recognize that every voice matters.

About the Role

The Clinical Evaluator is the first voice and face of InStride Health for patients and families seeking care. Evaluators conduct phone screens and comprehensive clinical evaluations to determine clinical eligibility and appropriateness for InStride services. They provide education and orientation about InStride, serve as brand ambassadors, and ensure families feel engaged and motivated from their first interaction.

Clinical Evaluators are strong diagnosticians with excellent case conceptualization skills, adept at assessing patient presentation and navigating sensitive conversations. They determine when medical clearance is required prior to admission and, when families are not appropriate for InStride, redirect them to alternative resources with empathy and clarity.

Clinical Evaluators also generate thorough, timely documentation that ensures a smooth and intentional handoff to the care team, supported by AI note-writing tools. They provide feedback to the Tech Product team on workflows, systems, and patient experience, and to the Clinical Product team on biopsychosocial assessment and patient needs.

Key Responsibilities/Essential Functions

  • Conducts phone screens and clinical evaluations for patients and families seeking admission.
  • Accurately assesses diagnoses, case conceptualization, and clinical eligibility for InStride.
  • Provides education, orientation, and motivation to engage patients and families in care.
  • Determines when medical clearance is required prior to admission.
  • Redirects patients and families to alternative resources when InStride is not appropriate.
  • Produces robust, timely documentation to support seamless transitions into treatment, leveraging AI note-writing tools.
  • Serves as a brand ambassador, creating a welcoming and professional first experience for families.
  • Collaborates with internal stakeholders by providing feedback and insights:
    • To the Tech Product team on workflows, systems, and patient/family experience.
    • To the Clinical Product team on patient presentation and assessment processes.
  • Participates in designated trainings, team meetings, and clinical rounds to ensure alignment with care pathways and best practices.
  • Upholds InStride’s mission, values, and ethical standards in all interactions.

Qualifications

Required Education & Licensure

  • Ph.D. or PsyD in psychology from an accredited program; OR
  • Master’s degree in social work, counseling, or related field from an accredited program with independent licensure (LICSW, LMHC, LMFT, or equivalent, depending on state).
  • Active state-specific licensure in good standing; willingness to obtain additional licensure in other states, as requested.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Expertise in diagnosing and treating children, adolescents, and young adults with anxiety, OCD, and related disorders.
  • Strong skills in case conceptualization, assessment, and measurement-based care.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to motivate and engage patients and families.
  • Ability to navigate sensitive conversations and redirect families to alternative care resources when needed.
  • Strong clinical judgment and decision-making skills in time-sensitive situations.
  • Commitment to creating a positive, professional, and brand-aligned first impression for families.
  • Excellent organizational and documentation skills, including comfort using AI-assisted tools.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a fast-paced, mission-driven team.
  • Cultural responsiveness and demonstrated commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.
  • Flexibility in adapting to technology platforms and updates in a fully virtual care environment.

The expected annual salary for this role is between $85,000-95,000. Actual starting salary will be determined on an individualized basis and will be based on several factors including but not limited to specific skill set, work experience, licensure, etc.

Work Schedule

Clinical Evaluators are hired in a full-time capacity, typically at 40 hours per week, which may include evening hours (3pm-8pm local time) to align with family availability across time zones.

Commitment to Ethical Conduct

InStride Health is committed to building and maintaining an inclusive, equitable, and ethical environment. The Clinical Evaluator is required to comply with InStride Health’s Code of Conduct and its policies and procedures, and must refrain from participating in any activity that could be construed as fraud or abuse. In any instance where there is suspicion or knowledge of fraud, abuse, or a violation of law or policy, the Clinical Evaluator is required to report the same to the Chief Compliance Officer. Compliance with this requirement will be considered in evaluating overall job performance

Why Join Our Team

  • Generous benefits package (401k with match, Flexible PTO, paid holidays, paid service days, 4 week paid sabbatical, 12 week paid parental leave, health benefits starting on your first day, and more)
  • Opportunity to join a mission-driven company that is changing the landscape of pediatric mental health treatment
  • Chance to make a far-reaching impact by helping children and families access desperately-needed, evidence-based care
  • Opportunity to work with talented and experienced team members who have devoted their lives to solving this problem
  • Fully virtual: work from the comfort of your home with periodic in-person retreats

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging (DEIB)

We want to make our clinical services available for everyone, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or how you identify. To achieve this, we recognize we must continually make progress in building a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive team. Through these efforts, we support two primary objectives at InStride Health:

  1. Providing high quality patient care to families. We are in a privileged position to support families during a vulnerable time in their lives. We approach all families and each other with compassion and are most effective as a diverse team where all individuals feel valued, respected, and accepted.
  2. Building a mission-driven business that lasts. Specifically, we believe our commitment to a supportive culture improves innovation, decision-making, and efficiency.

We invite you to share any additional information about yourself or your experiences that may not be reflected in your CV. Inclusion of this information is completely voluntary.

Beware of fake job postings and offers. All official communications from InStride Health will come from email addresses ending in @instride.health. We will never ask for personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank details during the application process.
