City: Remote

State: Remote

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the planning, coordination, readiness, and execution of complex cybersecurity verification and validation activities across large-scale data center construction and commissioning programs.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This is a highly technical program leadership role positioned at the intersection of data center construction, commissioning, controls engineering, operational technology, networking, cybersecurity, facility operations, and OEM/vendor management.

The Technical Program Manager will coordinate activities across construction teams, commissioning organizations, data center operations, controls and automation teams, OEMs, system integrators, network teams, cybersecurity specialists, and independent Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents.

The successful candidate must be capable of understanding both the construction/commissioning lifecycle and the underlying technical systems being validated. This is not a general administrative project-management position.

Key Responsibilities

1. Program & Multi-Site Delivery Management

  • Lead technical program coordination across multiple concurrent data center projects.
  • Align all sites with integrated program plans covering cybersecurity verification and validation, construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and technical dependencies.
  • Coordinate activities across multiple geographic regions, sites, delivery teams, and Cybersecurity commissioning agents.
  • Maintain visibility of site readiness, schedules, dependencies, risks, constraints, and required technical resources.
  • Maintain program-level schedule, effort, resource utilization, budget, and financial health tracking.
  • Own and coordinate program and site-level prerequisites required for successful execution.
  • Develop standardized governance and execution processes that can scale across a large multi-site portfolio.
  • Coordinate work allocation and execution across multiple cybersecurity assurance vendors while maintaining consistent program expectations.

2. Construction & Commissioning Integration

  • Integrate cybersecurity V&V activities into the overall data center construction and commissioning lifecycle.
  • Understand and coordinate dependencies between construction completion, equipment installation, controls integration, functional testing, commissioning, and cybersecurity validation.
  • Work with General Contractors, commissioning teams, system integrators, technical PMOs, and site teams to determine when systems are sufficiently ready for cybersecurity activities.
  • Prevent premature mobilization by establishing clear technical and operational readiness criteria.
  • Coordinate cybersecurity activities around critical project milestones without unnecessarily affecting construction or commissioning progress.

3. Controls / Data Center Engineering / OT Systems Coordination

Provide technical coordination across data center control and monitoring environments, including systems such as:

  • Building Management Systems (BMS)
  • Power Management Systems (PMS)
  • SCADA
  • DCS and industrial control platforms
  • PLCs and industrial controllers
  • RTUs, gateways, meters, relays, and IEDs
  • EPMS and electrical monitoring systems
  • Environmental and mechanical controls
  • Industrial networking infrastructure
  • Engineering workstations and management platforms
  • Associated servers, applications, interfaces, and communications infrastructure
  • Maintain sufficient technical knowledge of controls and OT platforms to understand system architecture, ownership, technical dependencies, testing prerequisites, and escalation requirements.

· 4. Data Center Operations Integration

  • Establish strong coordination between project delivery teams and Data Center Operations.
  • Ensure cybersecurity verification activities consider operational constraints and production-readiness requirements.
  • Coordinate technical handover requirements between construction/commissioning teams and operations.
  • Track ownership of systems, credentials, documentation, configurations, software, and technical artifacts necessary for validation.
  • Help resolve gaps between global program objectives and actual site execution conditions.

5. OEM, Vendor & System Integrator Coordination

  • Serve as the program-level coordination point for OEMs, system integrators, contractors, controls vendors, and Cybersecurity Commissioning Agent organizations.
  • Identify the correct technical owner for equipment and systems requiring verification.
  • Coordinate vendor availability during testing windows.
  • Ensure required engineering software, documentation, configurations, credentials, access, technical SMEs, and testing support are available.
  • Escalate unresolved vendor or technical dependencies before they affect execution.
  • Coordinate common requirements across OEMs rather than repeatedly resolving the same issues independently at each site.

6. Technical Logistics & Readiness

Own the technical-readiness process covering:

  • Site access
  • Assessment workstations
  • Network connectivity
  • Engineering system access
  • Required documentation
  • Network and controls architecture
  • Asset inventories
  • Configuration documentation
  • OEM technical resources
  • System integrator resources
  • Cybersecurity commissioning agent requirements
  • Testing windows
  • Evidence collection
  • Technical repositories
  • Finding and workflow-management systems

Establish a formal readiness gate before site mobilization.

7. Cybersecurity Verification & Validation Program Coordination

  • Coordinate execution between program stakeholders and independent Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents.
  • Translate program objectives into executable site-level technical activities.
  • Maintain consistent V&V expectations, evidence requirements, acceptance criteria, and reporting across multiple providers.
  • Coordinate testing activities involving OT devices, controls platforms, industrial networks, applications, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Track systemic findings and recurring issues across the portfolio.
  • Facilitate escalation of findings requiring program-level rather than site-level resolution.
  • Support integration of lessons learned into future design, procurement, commissioning, and operational requirements.

8. Program Governance & Reporting

  • Maintain integrated RAID logs covering risks, actions, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
  • Develop program dashboards covering readiness, execution status, testing progress, findings, dependencies, and blockers.
  • Facilitate technical program reviews and readiness meetings.
  • Maintain clear RACI across site teams, operations, controls teams, OEMs, integrators, Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents, and other stakeholders.
  • Escalate systemic issues requiring enterprise or program-level decisions.
  • Drive consistent methods across sites while accommodating genuine technical differences between facilities.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • None

Skills

The requirements listed below are representative of acquired skills required.

Candidates must demonstrate relevant experience across all of the following areas. These requirements represent the core technical and program-management capabilities necessary for the role.

Data Center Experience

  • Significant experience delivering technical programs within hyperscale, colocation, mission-critical, or similarly complex data center environments.
  • Demonstrated understanding of data center construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and handover.

Construction Experience

  • Demonstrated experience working within major construction or infrastructure delivery programs.
  • Strong understanding of construction schedules, contractor dependencies, site readiness, commissioning gates, and project controls.

Controls / OT Experience

  • Strong working knowledge of building automation, industrial control, power-management, SCADA/DCS, PLC, and related cyber-physical systems.
  • Ability to interpret controls architecture, network diagrams, system interfaces, and technical dependencies.

Networking Experience

Working understanding of:

  • TCP/IP
  • VLANs
  • Routing and switching
  • Firewalls
  • Network segmentation
  • Industrial Ethernet
  • Remote access
  • IT/OT integration

Demonstrated ability to engage effectively understand and interact with network engineering teams on architecture, segmentation, routing, switching, firewall, remote-access, and IT/OT integration requirements.

Cybersecurity Experience

  • Experience leading or coordinating cybersecurity programs involving OT, industrial systems, critical infrastructure, or cyber-physical systems.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity verification, validation, assessment, risk management, remediation, and technical assurance.
  • Ability to translate cybersecurity requirements into activities that engineering and commissioning organizations can execute.

Commissioning Experience

  • Direct experience working with commissioning organizations or commissioning programs.
  • Understanding of FAT, SAT, functional testing, integrated systems testing, commissioning, acceptance, turnover, and operational readiness.
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate additional assurance requirements into an active commissioning environment.

Program Management Experience

  • Demonstrated experience coordinating complex, multi-site technical programs.
  • Experience managing multiple contractors, vendors, engineering organizations, and technical workstreams simultaneously.
  • Strong dependency, escalation, risk, schedule, and stakeholder-management capabilities.

Competencies

The requirements listed below are competencies required to perform the job successfully.

Technical credibility
Demonstrates sufficient technical depth to actively lead discussions with controls engineers, network engineers, commissioning teams, cybersecurity specialists, and data center operations personnel.

Construction fluency
Demonstrates strong understanding of construction execution, commissioning sequences, schedule pressures, project dependencies, and operational-readiness milestones.

Systems and Safety thinking
Identifies cross-functional dependencies affecting cybersecurity execution, including OEM contracts, construction schedules, controls integration, configurations, credentials, network readiness, technical ownership, and operational constraints.

Execution discipline
Turns program requirements into owners, dependencies, readiness gates, dates, escalation paths, and measurable outcomes.

Vendor orchestration
Can coordinate multiple Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents and technical vendors without allowing delivery methodology or quality to fragment between sites.

Executive communication
Can convert complex construction, OT, commissioning, cyber, and vendor issues into concise program-level decisions.

Technical curiosity
Demonstrates strong root-cause analysis and technical problem-solving skills to identify and resolve underlying readiness and execution constraints.

Education, Certifications, and Experience (required)

Experience Level

12+ years of overall relevant industry experience, including substantial experience across data center construction/commissioning and technical infrastructure programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Electrical, Controls, Automation, Mechanical, Network, Computer, Systems, or related engineering degree.
  • PMP or PgMP.
  • Commissioning credentials such as CxA, CCP, CBCP, or equivalent experience.
  • CISSP, GICSP, IEC 62443, or comparable cybersecurity certification.
  • Experience with controls ecosystems from Schneider Electric, Siemens, Rockwell Automation, ABB, Honeywell, Johnson Controls, or similar OEMs.
  • Experience with mission-critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure.
  • Experience coordinating third-party testing, assurance, validation, inspection, or commissioning organizations.
  • Experience supporting global programs spanning multiple regions and delivery organizations.

MissionOne Media is a brand within BarkleyOKRP that combines full-funnel media planning and buying services, CRM, data, analytics, retail media, SEO, and digital experiences. We're an independent media partner offering transparency, integration, and a relentless focus on business impact.

We're looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to act as the operational backbone of our engineering team. The initial focus of this role is to take operational ownership of our legacy environment, while helping shape the architecture and strategy for our future-facing projects.

You'll ensure the stability, security, and high availability of our core production VMs running Java/Tomcat applications and MySQL 5.7 instances. You'll manage incidents, diagnose root causes, tune performance, and keep these critical legacy systems stable.

At the same time, you'll partner with us on our long-term growth. We're actively developing multiple new products and services on modern tech stacks and need someone who can balance maintaining legacy reliability with helping us design and scale our next-generation cloud architecture.

Responsibilities:

  • Incident Response & Operational Stability: Own the incident management lifecycle for production. Triage alerts, troubleshoot OS-level bottlenecks, debug performance issues, and drive rapid root-cause analysis.

  • Performance Monitoring & Debugging: Actively monitor system performance, application logs, and resource health using modern observability platforms (such as Observe by Snowflake) to quickly diagnose and resolve operational issues.

  • Legacy Infrastructure Management: Proactively maintain, patch, and secure our existing virtual machines on GCP.

  • Legacy Database Operations & Health: Monitor MySQL 5.7 instances, manage backups, and troubleshoot connection pool exhaustion or locking issues.

  • Cloud Architecture & Modernization: Collaborate to design, provision, and scale forward-looking cloud infrastructure for our new products and services, incorporating modern cloud-native tools and managed services (such as Cloud SQL and BigQuery).

  • Automation & Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Gradually replace manual operational tasks with clean automation scripts and infrastructure tools to reduce toil and improve repeatability.

  • Security & Compliance: Ensure systems comply with enterprise security baselines through rigorous OS hardening, access controls, and vulnerability patching.

Qualificiations:

  • Experience: 5+ years in a System Administration, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Infrastructure Operations role within an enterprise environment.

  • Legacy Stack Mastery:

    • Deep expertise in Linux administration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting (including storage and file system management, specifically ZFS).

    • Proven experience running, tuning, and debugging Java/Tomcat applications in production.

    • Strong working knowledge of MySQL 5.7, including query tuning, replication, backup/restore strategies, and migration troubleshooting.

    • Proficiency in shell scripting and writing lightweight automation (Bash)

  • Cloud & Modernization Experience:

    • Practical experience with Google Cloud Platform and managed services, including operational databases (Cloud SQL) and data warehousing platforms (BigQuery).

    • Production experience architecting and running containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes to support new product stacks.

    • Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform) and modern CI/CD deployment workflows.

  • Mindset & Soft Skills:

    • Calm under pressure: A methodical, safety-first approach to live-site incident response.

    • Pragmatic problem solver: You understand the realities of legacy software and prefer practical, stable solutions over chasing unproven tech fads.

    • Strong communication skills to collaborate with developers and stakeholders during high-stakes migrations or outages.

Ideal Experience / But Not Required:

  • Familiarity with Java development, enabling you to read application code, assist developers with debugging, or understand internal stack traces more deeply.

  • Experience with transitioning legacy tech stacks to modern GCP / cloud-native setups.

The annual gross base salary range is $90,000 - $150,000USD. This range represents the anticipated target salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and are based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and geographic location. Salary is one component of BarkleyOKRP's total compensation package, which includes multiple health insurance options, flexible PTO, life insurance, and 401K.

Description

WHO WE ARE

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Cyera is seeking a Privacy Specialist to help us win and expand our privacy line of business. This is a technical, customer-facing go-to-market role that supports our sales organization. You will be the privacy expert in the room alongside our Account Executives and Sales Engineers, turning a prospect's privacy requirements into compelling, credible demonstrations, proofs of value, and RFP responses that help our sellers move deals forward. You will work in front of prospects and customers across the full suite of privacy capabilities, including data subject requests, data mapping, privacy assessments, risk management, and consent and preference management.

To be clear about what this is: a technical, external-facing role that supports our sales team, not an in-house privacy or compliance role. Your privacy expertise matters because it helps our sellers win. You will be equally comfortable presenting to executive privacy leaders and to hands-on technologists and operators, building tailored demos, and writing RFP responses that stand out. You will be a key player in how Cyera sells privacy, and your insight from the field will shape the product. We're an AI-forward team, and the strongest candidates will show us how they use AI to work smarter and how they'd help customers navigate the intersection of AI, privacy, and data security.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Field Engagement

  • Serve as the privacy subject matter expert for sales and solutions teams, joining discovery calls, demos, and executive briefings with prospects and customers.
  • Build and deliver tailored demos that connect Cyera's privacy capabilities to each customer's regulatory drivers, operating model, and existing use cases.
  • Lead proof of value engagements from scoping through customer readout, including success criteria, tenant and environment setup with the account team, and aligning product capabilities to customer use cases.
  • Own privacy responses to RFPs, RFIs, and related questionnaires, delivering accurate, consistent, and timely answers and coordinating input from internal teams.
  • Coach go-to-market (GTM) teams on privacy discovery and qualification, and help them pursue privacy opportunities across prospects and existing accounts.

Pre-Sales Support

  • Run the privacy demo request process, including intake, prep documentation, agendas, and engaging the right SMEs for each call.
  • Provide privacy-specific input to sellers and Revenue Operations so privacy opportunities are accurately scoped and recorded in our CRM.
  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact on active pursuits, POVs, and RFPs.
  • Hand off cleanly to Customer Success and Implementation teams so customers move smoothly from sale to deployment.

Product and Technical Expertise

  • Act as a power user of the privacy products, with working knowledge of its modules, integrations, and configuration, so you can demo and troubleshoot with confidence.
  • Capture structured customer feedback, feature gaps, and win and loss insights, and relay them to the Product team to influence the roadmap.

GTM Enablement

  • Develop demo scripts, talk tracks, and recorded walkthroughs across the full suite of privacy capabilities.
  • Enable and certify technical teams to present privacy modules with confidence.
  • Work with Product Marketing to turn field learnings into positioning, collateral, and customer stories.

Privacy and Data Landscape

  • Translate regulatory and market developments (GDPR, US state laws, AI regulation) into clear positioning, sales plays, and customer guidance.
  • Help shape Cyera's point of view on how privacy, data security, and AI intersect.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 4+ years in a privacy-focused pre-sales, solutions engineering, privacy consulting, or technical privacy implementation role.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and deliver tailored product demos to technical and executive audiences, in person and virtually.
  • Strong working knowledge of privacy laws and frameworks (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other US state laws), emerging frameworks around AI governance, and core privacy operations concepts such as DSRs, data mapping, RoPA, privacy impact assessments, and consent.
  • Exceptional written communication, with the ability to produce clear, accurate, and persuasive responses, proposals, and customer-ready documents.
  • Excellent presentation skills and the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value for privacy, legal, security, and data leaders.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent pursuits, deadlines, and stakeholders.
  • Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment, working in or alongside Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success.

Nice to have

  • Everyday AI fluency: you already use AI tools to sharpen research, call prep, drafting, and follow-up, and you enjoy sharing what works with teammates.
  • Curiosity about the AI opportunity: you can explain how AI adoption raises the stakes for privacy and data governance (assessments, data mapping, processing records) and turn that into a compelling conversation with customers.
  • Experience with privacy tooling where you have selected, implemented or operated these tools in-house or through consulting engagements.
  • Privacy certifications such as CIPP, CIPM, or CIPT.
  • Familiarity with data security concepts such as data discovery and data classification.

COMPENSATION INFORMATION:

Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.

This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors.

BENEFITS - Why Cyera?

  • Ability to work remotely, with office setup reimbursement
  • Competitive salary
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid holidays and sick time
  • Health, vision, and dental insurance
  • Life, short and long-term disability insurance

  • Direct oversight of trade contractors (electrical, mechanical, generator, controls, structural) in active, energized construction settings.

Business Link Alberta (“BLA”) is a government-funded, not-for-profit organization dedicated to supporting entrepreneurs and small business owners across Alberta. For more than 30 years, BLA has helped thousands of prospective and existing entrepreneurs through webinars, events, conferences, and personalized one-on-one consultations. In addition to providing guidance on how and where to access support, BLA has also administered grant funding programs on behalf of the government.

BLA collaborates with a wide range of service providers, funding organizations, and small business support agencies throughout the province. Each year, BLA serves more than 5,000 clients from across Alberta, including those in rural communities, and urban centers.

Our Mission

BLA helps Alberta’s small businesses start and succeed.

Our Values

  • Impactful
  • Non-Judgmental

Our Culture

  • Innovative
  • Transparent
  • Open-Minded
  • Collaborative
  • Respectful
  • Belonging

Reporting to the Manager, Client Service, the Strategist delivers client-centered guidance that supports entrepreneurs in starting and growing their businesses.

Through one-on-one engagements, the Strategist provides practical, tailored support, helping clients navigate programs, connect with ecosystem supports, and clarify their goals. The role focuses on building client capability and confidence, enabling informed decision-making at each stage of the business journey.

The Strategist also plays a key role in strengthening the broader entrepreneurial ecosystem. Through meaningful outreach and relationship-building, they increased awareness of services and ensure more entrepreneurs can access and benefit from available supports.

In addition, the Strategist contributes to continuous improvement by capturing client insights, identifying emerging needs, and supporting data-informed enhancements to programs and service delivery.

  • Ecosystem partners
  • Community organizations serving diverse and underserved populations

  • Occasional in-person client meetings, events and community engagement within their region
  • Occasional travel elsewhere in Alberta, approximately 4-6 times per year

Client Guidance & Experience

  • Conduct needs assessments and provide clear, actionable guidance
  • Support clients in navigating programs, funding, and ecosystem resources

jobs.description:
MPLC provides a legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe. Our business has been running for over 30 years, and we are the number one trusted partner to studios and producers for public performance licensing. We work with every major Hollywood studio and hundreds of independents, and we are a key player in the entertainment and intellectual property ecosystem.

We are on a truly exciting journey as a company. We're growing quickly, investing in our teams, and have bold plans for the future. To support that growth, we're looking for an Associate Customer Success Executive to join our Customer Success Team.

The job in two bullet points:
  • Own a portfolio of existing customers and take direct accountability for minimizing churn within that book, alongside driving renewal and expansion revenue.
  • Ensure coverage completeness by confirming every customer site and location, including newly added ones, is properly covered by their license.

You will love this job if...

  • You have 1-2 years of experience in customer success, account management, or licensing, with a track record of managing renewals and mitigating churn.
  • You are comfortable handling commercial objections, including cost-driven pushback, in a calm and consultative way.
  • You have strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • You are comfortable working across internal teams and directly with client contacts at varying seniority levels.
  • You are proficient with CRM tools.
  • You are comfortable with a high volume of proactive outbound calls as a core, everyday part of the role.
  • Experience with licensing, media, or intellectual property is a plus.

Let's be honest!
This is a proactive, commercially focused customer success role. You will be responsible for renewal and expansion revenue, minimizing churn, confirming coverage accuracy, handling objections, and following up on payment. Collected revenue, not simply a signed renewal, is what counts toward your book of business and your results in this role.
As a function, this team is a net revenue retention play. The goal is to move net revenue retention from 102% to 105% in Year 1, calculated as expansion plus renewal minus churn. Individual measures roll up to the team's overall net revenue retention target, not a standalone quota.

If you need a bit more information...

This position runs on a structured outbound calling cadence, proactively checking in with every customer approximately 90 days ahead of their renewal date to confirm coverage, catch any new sites or locations, and resolve compliance questions well before renewal.

You will monitor customer usage declarations against public sources, provide compliance assurance, handle renewal objections, identify and close upsell opportunities, and take direct ownership of ensuring customer invoices are paid in full and on time. You will also coordinate with Legal and Finance on deal amendments and documentation, maintain accurate CRM records, and escalate the most complex renewal objections, compliance questions, or at-risk accounts to a senior colleague.

Benefits

  • Remote located in the United States
  • Comprehensive health insurance package (medical, dental, sick pay)

Utilize Salesforce.com for reporting, lead management, and customer performance tracking.

Collaborate closely with Wholesale Specialists, peers, and other Manheim teams to support client success.

Work effectively within a continuous improvement and Lean environment, contributing to process enhancement.

Comply with Manheim inspection standards, including the NAAA Frame/Structure Damage Policy.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Develop working knowledge of inspection standards and client expectations

Maintain strong dealer relationships and inspection quality standards

Model safety, professionalism, and operational excellence

jobs.excerpt: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm's engineering team is building a large-scale, highly available, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products. Ensuring that our infrastructure is accessible to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis.

Affirm runs its workloads on more than 85 Amazon EKS clusters, and the number is growing. The Workload Safety team creates one set of standards for how workloads are configured and run, so Affirm can grow globally and still meet its availability and latency SLOs. The team identifies the industry best practices Affirm needs, drives their adoption across every engineering team on EKS, and enforces them through policy and automation so new workloads comply by default.

As a senior engineer on the team, you will help set its roadmap, decide which standards matter most, and build a repeatable way to take each standard from research to enforcement across the fleet.

What you’ll do

  • Define and evolve workload safety standards for Affirm's EKS fleet, such as CPU and memory settings, workload isolation and placement, tolerance for disruption, graceful termination to name a few

  • Own each standard end to end: research and prototyping, white-glove onboarding for early adopters, self-service guidance for everyone else, and automation and policy guardrails that keep every workload compliant from day one

  • Lead cross-team initiatives from design through fleet-wide rollout, mentor other engineers, and set a high bar for design, code review, and operational readiness

  • Isolate workloads by criticality and resource profile so one misbehaving workload cannot degrade critical paths such as checkout

  • Fix stuck workloads and node lifecycle problems, such as pods that ignore termination signals, pod disruption budgets that block node cycling, and Karpenter timeouts that prevent bin packing and the removal of excess capacity

  • Determine the safe operating limits of each cluster (pod count, node count, API server request volume), keep clusters within them, and develop control plane scaling patterns for bursty workloads such as scheduled batch jobs and large deployments

  • Analyze workload resource profiles across the fleet (CPU, memory, disk, network) to guide EC2 instance type strategy, and automate that analysis as workloads change

  • Measure each standard's impact on availability, latency, risk, and cost, and use the results to prioritize the roadmap

  • Participate in on-call for Kubernetes runtime issues across the fleet, and turn recurring failure patterns into roadmap items

  • Work closely with the teams that run services, batch jobs, and ML workloads on EKS, and with the deployment, capacity, and SRE teams

  • Keep up with new best practices from the Kubernetes community and adapt them to Affirm's needs

What we look for

  • 5+ years of experience running Kubernetes in production at scale, ideally Amazon EKS across many clusters

  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes resource management and scheduling: requests and limits, OOM and CPU throttling behavior, affinity and anti-affinity, taints and tolerations, and topology spread constraints

  • Solid grasp of the pod lifecycle and disruption management, including graceful termination, pod disruption budgets, and node draining

  • Experience enforcing configuration standards through admission control and policy-as-code (for example, OPA Gatekeeper or Kyverno)

  • Proficiency in Go or Python, including building production infrastructure software such as Kubernetes controllers, operators, or admission webhooks

  • Strong production debugging skills and a demonstrated ability to turn recurring incidents into systemic fixes

  • Track record of leading technical initiatives across multiple teams, driving adoption of shared standards, and mentoring other engineers

  • Experience quantifying the impact of infrastructure changes on availability, latency, and cost

  • Strong written communication, including standards and guidance that teams can adopt on their own

  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - 9

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $195000 - $255000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $173000 - $233000

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewOrbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

Job Summary

Own the agentic systems at the center of Orbis AI — the orchestration, planning, retrieval, and tool-use machinery behind the Agent Catalog and the OSINT Agent Harness. You will build agents that hold up under real mission workloads and set the evaluation bar the rest of the organization writes against. This is senior engineering on AI systems: the hard problems are correctness, explainability, cost, and behavior at scale.

Travel: Up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and ship agents across the portfolio — knowledge agents over customer data, tool agents that wrap external operations, and goal-driven agents that plan and execute multi-step analysis.
  • Own the orchestration layer: planning, tool selection, state and memory, retries, partial failure, and termination behavior.
  • Design and own retrieval end to end — chunking, embedding, indexing, ranking, and the query-time behavior that decides answer quality.
  • Build the provenance and citation paths that let a user see how a conclusion was reached, and treat unexplainable output as a defect rather than a limitation.
  • Own the evaluation infrastructure for agent quality — accuracy, groundedness, explainability, latency, and cost — and set the standard other engineers write cases against.
  • Integrate model providers and third-party tools behind stable internal interfaces, and instrument agents so quality regressions and cost anomalies surface before a customer finds them.
  • Partner with research engineers to productionize validated results, and mentor engineers moving into AI work from a conventional software background.
  • Travel up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years building LLM-backed or agentic systems in production
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript, with substantial production code in at least one
  • Deep practical experience with retrieval-augmented generation — embeddings, vector search, chunking strategy, ranking, and the failure modes of each
  • Demonstrated experience building and debugging multi-step, tool-using agents, whether on a framework or from primitives
  • Proven rigor about evaluation, including harnesses that measured whether an AI change actually improved anything
  • Willingness to travel up to 15%

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution, or information extraction
  • Experience running open-weight models in constrained or disconnected environments where a hosted API is not an option
  • Experience with production observability and cost control for model-backed workloads
  • Familiarity with OSINT, intelligence, or research workflows and the accuracy and provenance expectations that come with them
  • Experience mentoring engineers into AI work from a conventional software background
  • Open-source contributions, publications, or academic collaboration in applied AI

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
  • Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions
  • Travel: Up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration.

Orbis Benefits

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

Orbis Locations

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,

qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non-discrimination laws in every jurisdiction in which we operate. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.

Role Summary

This role is primarily dedicated to our Square customer segment, where you will develop deep expertise in the Square integration and its onboarding motion. You will not be limited to that segment: you will also support customers on other POS platforms (Toast, EPOS Now, and others) as business needs require. You will work closely with Sales, Support, Training, Data Processing, Customer Success, and Product, and act as a key feedback channel back into the product.

What You Will Do

Own the End-to-End Customer Journey

  • Single owner: Serve as the primary point of contact for the customer from kickoff through training completion and early live use.
    • Plan and drive: Build and execute implementation and training plans with clear milestones, timelines, owners, and success criteria for each account.
    • Portfolio management: Manage a portfolio of concurrent customers at different stages, prioritizing effectively to keep every account moving toward go-live.
    • Clean completion: Confirm that implementation and training milestones are fully met — not just delivered — before transitioning the account to Customer Success or Support.
    Implementation & Integration
    • Configure the MarketMan system for each customer: inventory, suppliers, recipes, locations, users, and permissions.
    • Own POS and API integration setup end to end, with deep specialization in the Square integration and working proficiency across Toast, EPOS Now, and other supported platforms.
    • Partner with the Data Processing team to get customer inventory and item lists processed, validated, and uploaded accurately and on schedule.
    • Identify and resolve issues during and after implementation; escalate to Technical Support or R&D with clear, reproducible detail when needed.
    • Maintain accurate documentation of configuration decisions, integration setup, and customer-specific requirements.

Training & Enablement

  • Deliver engaging training across formats — 1:1 sessions, cohort-based (1:many) sessions, and webinars — covering inventory counts, purchasing, invoice scanning, recipe costing, and reporting workflows.
    • Tailor sessions to real restaurant scenarios and to the customer’s own data, so training maps directly to how their operation runs.
    • Verify competency before sign-off, and run refresher or re-training sessions where adoption lags.

Required

Advantage

Senior Account Executive

📍 Remote (Canada) │ Hybrid Available – Kitchener, ON

🧑‍💼 Reports to: Manager, New Sales

💰 Salary range: $90,000–$100,000 CAD base

🏢 About Encircle

Encircle is leading the $1.6 trillion property insurance industry out of the dark ages of pen-and-paper processes, into the digital age of transparency and empowerment. Our easy-to-use software platform enables thousands of restoration contractors and insurance professionals around the world to process claims faster. We're a remote-first company with a collaboration hub in downtown Kitchener — and we're growing.

📌 About the Role

Restoration contractors choose Encircle because the first conversation feels different: people who know their industry, understand their business and show them exactly how Encircle makes them money. As Senior Account Executive, you'll own the full sales cycle - prospecting, discovery, demo, proposal and close - for a book of restoration, independent adjusting and multi-location accounts.

This is an end to end sales position. You’ll be held accountable to hunting your own deals, not just working the marketing funnel. You'll build pipeline of your own alongside meetings sourced by our BDR team, and you'll be coached to the same formula every AE runs on: discovery and demo, demo-to-proposal, proposal-to-close, sales cycle length and ACV, using the SPICED methodology and the documented playbook. As a senior member of the team, you're expected to perform at or above benchmark, take on the more complex, multi-stakeholder deals — franchise locations, multi-site operators, independent adjusting relationships — and help sharpen the playbook for the reps coming up behind you.

You'll work closely with Onboarding & Activation and Account Management so every new customer starts with a plan, and with our BDR team so sourced pipeline converts cleanly into revenue.

🔧 What You'll Be Doing

Own the full sales cycle

  • Prospect and build pipeline in your territory: self-sourced outbound plus inbound and BDR-sourced meetings, managed as one connected funnel
  • Run discovery, demo, proposal and negotiation using SPICED and the documented playbook, converting at or above benchmark at every stage
  • Build and defend a monthly forecast — pipeline coverage, stage conversion and deal velocity you can stand behind
  • Own deal strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder accounts: franchise and network structures, multi-location operators and independent restoration relationships

Be the trusted advisor restoration contractors remember

  • Diagnose the real business pain behind every conversation — tool consolidation, adjuster pushback, time lost in the field, missed revenue on jobs — and connect it to how Encircle solves it
  • Run demos and presentations tailored to the room, from field crews to owners and executive leadership
  • Build account-based plans for named target accounts, including multi-location and franchise prospects
  • Use real ROI data and customer proof points to build a business case that holds up to scrutiny

Close clean and hand off cleaner

  • Close deals with signed contracts and accurate CRM data that sets up a smooth transition
  • Partner with Onboarding & Activation on a mutual onboarding plan at the point of close, so every new customer starts strong
  • Partner with Account Management on account context and handoff for multi-location and franchise-influenced accounts
  • Maintain Salesforce hygiene so your pipeline and deal data are accurate and usable by the wider business

Raise the bar for the team

  • Contribute to the AE playbook: what's working in discovery, demos, objection handling and negotiation, and feed it back to your manager
  • Mentor newer AEs through call reviews, deal strategy and territory planning as a senior peer on the team
  • Lead by example on activity and pipeline discipline, hitting or exceeding published benchmarks
  • Bring AI into your own workflow — account research, call prep, follow-up and forecasting — and share what works with the team

Collaborate across the business

  • Partner with BDRs on outbound targeting, meeting quality and handoff feedback
  • Partner with Marketing on lead quality, campaign feedback and product-led buying signals
  • Feed win-loss insights, objection patterns and competitive intelligence back to Marketing and Product
  • Partner with the Enterprise team on franchise-location opportunities that sit under a national or network relationship

Key Metrics You'll Own

•New ARR and quota attainment

•Pipeline coverage

•Stage conversion rates vs. benchmark

•ACV and product attach rate

•Sales cycle length

•Forecast accuracy

Immediate Priorities

In your first few months, you'll ramp to the formula and start proving it:

1.Complete onboarding and ramp to full quota productivity on the defined timeline

2.Build pipeline to target coverage against quota within your first 90 days

3.Run discovery, demo and proposal stages at or above published benchmarks

4.Close your first deals with a clean, documented handoff to Onboarding & Activation

✅ What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of full-cycle B2B SaaS (or similar) direct sales experience, with a stable, proven track record of quota attainment
  • Experience running discovery, demo, proposal and negotiation for multi-stakeholder deals — not just working a queue of inbound leads
  • Skilled at building account-based plans and self-sourcing pipeline, not just closing what's handed to you
  • Comfortable navigating franchise, multi-location or network buying structures, including access to decision-makers up to the C-suite
  • A track record of building and defending an accurate forecast
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and familiarity with sales tools like Gong and DocuSign
  • Fluency with AI tools in your own workflow — research, call prep, follow-up and forecasting
  • A consultative, industry-fluent selling style: you close deals customers are glad they signed
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience selling to blue-collar or field-based industries, or in vertical SaaS, is a plus but not required

🤝 Why Encircle?

We VALUE our people:

  • ⚖️ Balance: Flexible hours, self-managed vacation and trust to manage your time.
  • 🏠 Remote-first: Work where you're most productive — with access to our collaboration hub in Kitchener.
  • 🚀 Growth-oriented: We support your learning and career development.
  • 💪 Well-being: We care about the full human — inside and outside of work.

jobs.excerpt: At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc.
jobs.description:
At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together?

About the Role

PrizePicks’ Creative Collective is looking to add a Lead 3D Designer to our roster. The Creative Collective is a small, high-conviction team built around one standard: commit fully or not at all. We move fast, debate hard, and once a call is made, we stand behind it together.

You'll lead our 3D discipline from start to finish, working alongside our Art Directors & Product teams to design a 3D language that adds to the fan experience in our product and throughout our marketing.

You are an elite 3D craftsperson first. You build characters, environments, and objects that add to the PrizePicks experience/brand, and you know when to hand-build and when to let AI tools do the heavy lifting so you can move faster without losing the idea. You're also the person who now decides how 3D work gets briefed, reviewed, and shipped across the organization.

If you've spent your career being the best 3D mind in every room you've been in and you're ready to lead the discipline instead of just contributing to it, this is it.

How We Work

Lead with conviction — Be Iverson

Bring work you believe in and have a strong POV. Authenticity matters more than the idea itself. If the idea could live with another brand's logo on it, it doesn't belong here. We'd rather refine a bold idea than try to save a safe one.

↳ Not: "This is just an option" or over-explaining to compensate for weak belief

Sharpen each other — Be Pharrell

Value direct feedback and be comfortable in conflict. Debate makes the work better. Once a call is made, we move together. Mediocre work is a collective failure, not an individual one.

↳ Not: Silent agreement followed by side conversations or ego-driven critique

Execute under pressure — Be Jordan

The standard does not change when the moment does. We move with precision and continually refine our judgment. Practice or clutch time, you show up with the same intensity.

↳ Not: "We didn't have time" or overcomplicating simple calls

Show up fully — Be Virgil

Show up wherever you are needed, whenever you are needed, without hesitation. Not for credit — for the outcome. It's not about doing everything. It's about doing what's required to make it right.

↳ Not: "That's not my job" or trying to protect your role over protecting the work

What You'll Do

Build worlds that feel unmistakably PrizePicks

  • Design and build 3D characters, environments, and objects for brand campaigns, product moments, and cultural activations
  • Translate 2D concepts and mood boards into fully realized 3D executions
  • Own the render quality bar — lighting, materials, composition — from first pass to final delivery

Push what 3D + AI can do together

  • Integrate AI image generation workflows (Weavy) into the 3D pipeline to speed up ideation and exploration
  • Experiment with real-time rendering and emerging tools that shorten the distance between idea and finished asset
  • Bring new techniques back to the team — you're the one testing what's next, not waiting for someone else to

Lead the 3D discipline through craft, not authority

  • Own how 3D work gets briefed, reviewed, and delivered across the team
  • Partner with the Art Directors so 3D work lands inside the bigger creative idea, not bolted onto it
  • Create an environment where 3D work at PrizePicks is something the team is genuinely proud of

Own the pipeline

  • Maintain clean, reusable asset libraries, rigs, and templates so the team can move fast without rebuilding from scratch
  • Balance multiple projects across brand, social, and campaign timelines without dropping quality
  • Know when to hand-build and when to lean on procedural or AI-assisted workflows to hit a deadline without cutting corners

Who You Are

  • A maker first who's ready to lead — you'd rather build it than brief it out, and the team gets better because they watch you work
  • Fast — what would take an agency weeks, you can do in days
  • Deep in the tools — Blender/C4D (or equivalent) is second nature, not something you're still learning
  • A player-coach — you lead through craft and feedback, not authority for its own sake
  • Low ego about ownership
  • Curious by default — new tools, new workflows, new techniques get you excited, not defensive
  • Chronically online enough to know what culture actually looks/feels like right now
  • Die hard sports fan

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of 3D design experience, with a portfolio that shows range across character, environment, and object design
  • Strong command of Blender (or equivalent: Cinema 4D, Maya) plus a rendering engine like Octane or Redshift
  • Comfort integrating AI tools into a creative pipeline — this isn't optional, it's how we work now
  • A sports, streetwear, or hip-hop culture fluency that shows up in your work, not just your playlist

Bonus Points

  • Experience with real-time engines (Unreal, Unity) or procedural tools (Houdini)
  • Experience managing, mentoring, or directly leading other 3D or design talent
  • Motion or animation background alongside 3D

What Success Looks Like

  • In 90 days, you’ll have a real working rhythm — the 3D work is faster and the output is sharper than it ever has been at PrizePicks.
  • In six months, there's 3D work with your fingerprints on it that's genuinely moved the brand forward — campaigns, product moments, cultural activations that wouldn't have looked the same without you.
  • In a year, the 3D discipline at PrizePicks is looked upon as the industry standard, and you're a big reason why.

Location

  • While we prefer candidates based in Atlanta, we are open to qualified applicants from anywhere in the U.S. and are willing to consider remote candidates.

Working at PrizePicks:

The typical salary range for this position is $90,000 to $110,000. At PrizePicks, we consider your role, level, and where you'll be working when determining our salary ranges. The compensation info you see on our job postings gives you an idea of the starting pay range for the position. Your actual pay within that range will depend on your specific work location, as well as your skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter will be happy to chat more about the specific pay range for your location and how we arrived at it during the hiring process.

  • Company-wide in-person events and team outings

jobs.title: Senior Manager, People Operations
jobs.excerpt: GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011.
jobs.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

About this Role

GiveDirectly's People Operations team owns global payroll, employee lifecycle, HR data, and total rewards delivery for a workforce spread across more than 20 countries. As the team has grown, so has the case for additional capacity at the leadership level to help own the operating engine that keeps payroll, service delivery, and people data running well every day. This role is that operating engine.

The Senior Manager, People Operations will manage a team of Associates and Coordinators (3 in total for now). You'll own end-to-end payroll delivery, the ticketing system and employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, transfers), HRIS data quality, and execution of the annual compensation cycle and mobility transactions. You'll be the first point of contact for country HR teams on operational payroll, data, and ticketing matters, and you'll build depth across your team so critical knowledge doesn't sit with one person.

This is a hands-on, builder's role. You'll set the operating model for your areas (cadence, controls, service standards) and be accountable for the outcomes, not just for delivering against someone else's plan.

Job Type: Full-time

Reports to: Senior Manager, People Operations

Level: Senior Manager

Location: Remote, with a requirement to overlap with an East Africa timezone by at least 3 hours, and meaningful overlap with US Eastern hours. We can only employ people in certain places at the moment, so it's worth checking our current list of eligible countries to see if yours is included. If you're based elsewhere, it's not an automatic no, but do flag it early with your recruiter. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

Travel Requirements: Must be able to travel ~3-4 times per year to one of our countries of operation for team retreats and oversight.

What you'll do

  1. Team leadership and delivery:
    • Lead, coach, and develop a team, setting clear priorities, standards of work, and ownership across payroll, service delivery, people data, and lifecycle operations
    • Build depth and cover across the team so critical knowledge is not concentrated in one person, and establish clear escalation paths for absences and peak periods
    • Define the operating model for your areas, including cadence, controls, service standards, and how work is prioritized against the function roadmap
    • Serve as the first point of contact for country HR teams on operational payroll, data, lifecycle, and ticketing matters
  2. Global payroll:
    • Own end-to-end payroll delivery for all global staff across entities and employer of record arrangements, ensuring accurate and timely processing of salaries, benefits, and deductions
    • Own the payroll calendar, approvals, controls, and reconciliation, partnering with Finance on month-end, accruals, and people cost reporting
    • Manage payroll providers operationally, including service quality, issue resolution, invoicing, and migrations
    • Maintain current knowledge of payroll and statutory requirements across all operating locations, and drive the changes needed to stay compliant
    • Run annual bonus administration end to end, ensuring calculations are accurate and payments are made within designated timelines
  3. People operations service delivery and employee lifecycle:
    • Own the ticketing system and its operating rhythm, including triage, assignment, SLA performance, and reporting
    • Own onboarding, offboarding, transfers, and role changes as designed processes rather than a series of transactions, and be accountable for the experience they produce
    • Analyze trends and root causes of recurring issues and deliver structural fixes rather than repeat workarounds
    • Drive the implementation of tools that improve functionality and user experience
    • Act as the escalation point for complex or high-priority tickets, providing direction and ensuring timely resolution
  4. People data and systems:
    • Own HRIS operations and data quality, including the method for preventing inaccurate data entering the system at source
    • Own the people systems roadmap covering workflows, automation, integrations, and reporting infrastructure, partnering with IT and Finance on delivery
    • Run the audit and reporting cycle, and maintain reporting standards in practice
    • Produce the people reporting that leadership decisions rely on
  5. Total rewards and mobility operations:
    • Execute annual compensation cycles, salary adjustments, and increase rollouts accurately and on time
    • Own benefits administration across all locations, including renewals, enrollments, and issue resolution
    • Produce the analysis behind compensation decisions, including benchmarking, compa ratio and cost modelling, and equity audits
    • Execute mobility transactions end to end, including payroll and entity transfers, contract issuance, location-based pay changes, work permit and employer of record administration, and the supporting trackers and records
  6. Other tasks:
    • Participate in cross-functional initiatives and organizational projects, representing People Operations requirements
    • Perform all other duties that may be assigned to you from time to time by the Senior Manager, People Operations and stakeholders

What you'll bring:

  • 6+ years of professional experience in People Operations, HR operations, or global payroll, including at least 2 years managing a team
  • Direct experience running multi-country payroll and people operations, ideally including Sub-Saharan Africa and employer of record arrangements
  • Demonstrated ownership of an HRIS, including an implementation, migration, or significant data quality turnaround
  • A systems and process mindset, with the ability to point to workflows you have automated, simplified, or eliminated
  • Working knowledge of employment and statutory requirements across multiple jurisdictions, with sound judgment on compliance risk and a clear sense of when to decide and when to escalate
  • Strong analytical skills, including comfort with compensation and cost modelling and advanced spreadsheet ability
  • Ability to liaise remotely with a wide range of people at all levels and across different cultures, and to act with credibility, tact, and diplomacy
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate technical people operations content to non-specialist audiences
  • Comfort operating with incomplete guidance and shifting priorities, and strong time management across competing deadlines
  • Professionally proficient in English
  • Experience in a global non-profit, international development organization, or mission-driven company with an Africa presence preferred
  • Familiarity with employer of record and contractor models across multiple countries (Oyster, Remote, or similar) preferred
  • Aptitude to learn new software tools such as Slack, BambooHR, Jira, and Asana, and comfort with AI-assisted tools to streamline people operations workflows
  • Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

United States

  • Base Salary: $114,660
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10% (~$11,466, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be $13,415 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $126,126+

Kenya
