jobs.title: Cloud Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Atmosera empowers businesses to redefine what's possible with modern technology and human expertise.
jobs.description:
Atmosera empowers businesses to redefine what's possible with modern technology and human expertise. Our exceptional experience across Applications, Data & AI, DevOps, Security, and the Microsoft Azure platform enables organizations to accelerate innovation, enhance security, and optimize operational agility. As a Microsoft Partner with seven specializations, GitHub AI Partner of the Year, a member of the GitHub Advisory Board, and a member of the prestigious Microsoft Intelligent Security Association (MISA), Atmosera expertly delivers cutting-edge, integrated solutions that deliver business value.

Your Impact

You are joining us to lead one of two peer functions within Atmosera's Client Operations organization: either the Technician team responsible for initial client support and ticket management, or the Administrator/Engineer team responsible for advanced administration, engineering, and escalated technical work. In either assignment, you will own the performance, development, service quality, and continuous improvement of your assigned team while partnering closely with the peer Client Operations manager to create a connected operating model and seamless client experience.

Your day-to-day will include coaching and developing employees; hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, capacity management, and 24x7 coverage; overseeing ticket health, workload, escalations, and incident, problem, and change practices; and using service data, automation, and AI to improve quality, efficiency, and scalability. You will maintain clear operating procedures, technical documentation, and client-specific runbooks; ensure employees are trained and appropriately authorized for their work; and partner with Client Success, Professional Services, Security Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholders to support client environments and service transitions.

You will also work with peer Client Operations leaders to coordinate operational priorities, major incident response, cross-team improvements, and temporary leadership coverage during vacations, leaves, on-call rotations, and other business continuity situations. Success in this role means building a capable, accountable, and client-focused team; developing future leaders; strengthening operational discipline; and delivering measurable improvements in service performance and client experience.

What Success Looks Like

    We measure success by results and alignment. Here is how we define a win for this role over your first year.

    After 90 Days

  • The Foundation: Develop a strong understanding of Atmosera's Client Operations organization, service delivery model, client portfolio, operational tooling, escalation paths, compliance requirements, and ITIL-based processes. Assess your team's capabilities, service performance, coverage model, operational health, and improvement opportunities.
  • The Integration: Establish trusted working relationships with your team, peer Client Operations leaders, Client Success, Professional Services, Security Operations, Compliance, and other key stakeholders. Create clear expectations, accountability, communication rhythms, and partnership practices within your assigned function.
  • The Contribution: Identify and begin executing a measurable operational improvement focused on an area such as queue health, backlog reduction, escalation quality, incident management, change management, automation, knowledge management, service coverage, or client experience.

    • After 1 Year

  • Your Impact: Lead a high-performing operational team that consistently achieves its service objectives, contributes to strong client satisfaction, and supports operational excellence across Atmosera's managed services organization. Deliver measurable improvements in service performance, resolution quality, team capability, operational efficiency, and scalability.
  • Your Growth: Be recognized as a trusted leader who successfully balances the needs of clients, employees, and the business. Build the technical, operational, and leadership capability of your team while developing future leaders and supporting meaningful career progression.
  • Your Influence: Build strong partnerships across Client Operations and related departments, helping create repeatable operating practices, scalable processes, effective runbooks, automation opportunities, and service improvements that elevate the client experience and strengthen organizational effectiveness.

The Skills Matrix

    Required Skills: The Non-Negotiables

  • Years of Experience: Five or more years of experience in cloud operations, infrastructure operations, managed services, technical support, engineering, or service delivery, including at least three years directly managing technical teams.
  • Role-Specific Mastery: Experience leading a technical support, service delivery, engineering, operations, or managed services team in a fast-paced environment. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud operations, with the technical depth and troubleshooting expertise to guide either a Technician team or an Administrator/Engineer team and earn credibility with technical employees and stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to hire, onboard, coach, evaluate, and develop employees; establish clear expectations and development plans; and support career progression and certification attainment.
  • Operational Excellence: Experience owning service delivery for an assigned team in a 24x7 environment, including workforce and capacity planning, schedules, shift and on-call coverage, ticket health, workload management, and service quality. Ability to ensure work is prioritized, routed, documented, escalated, and resolved in line with service commitments; lead or support major incidents; enforce incident, problem, and change practices; maintain escalation paths, operating procedures, technical documentation, and client-specific runbooks; and ensure employees are trained and appropriately eligible, authorized, and assigned for regulated work. Sound judgment to balance urgency, quality, operational risk, coverage, and client communication under pressure, including the ability to pass a federal background check for Public Trust Fitness.
  • Communication: Clear, calm, and effective written and verbal communication skills. Ability to report KPIs, service performance, emerging risks, incident summaries, improvement priorities, and recommended actions to individual contributors, technical contacts, client executives, and internal leadership. Commitment to professional, timely communication during incidents, escalations, operational reviews, and service transitions.
  • Collaboration: Experience partnering across operational teams and support functions to coordinate staffing, priorities, escalations, major incidents, service transitions, and continuous improvement. Ability to work closely with peer Client Operations leaders without blurring ownership of the assigned team; collaborate with Client Success, Professional Services, Security Operations, Security, and Compliance; support audits, evidence collection, and remediation; and provide temporary leadership coverage during vacations, leaves, on-call rotations, major incidents, and other business continuity situations.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to use service and workforce data to identify trends, root causes, resource needs, and operational risks, then implement durable solutions that reduce repeat incidents and improve the client experience. Experience owning and reporting relevant KPIs, such as SLA attainment, response and resolution time, escalation rate, backlog, ticket aging, change success rate, service quality, automation adoption, and client satisfaction. Demonstrated ability to improve processes, tooling, training, monitoring, documentation, automation, or AI-assisted workflows while coordinating cross-team changes to avoid unintended downstream impacts.

Nice to Have: The Bonus Points

  • Experience working for a managed services provider, ideally a Microsoft Azure Expert MSP.
  • Microsoft certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or other relevant Azure certifications.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation or an advanced ITIL certification.
  • Experience with Azure Lighthouse, Azure Monitor, Azure Arc, Azure Policy, Azure Automation, PowerShell, monitoring and alert tuning, AIOps, or Copilot-enabled workflows.
  • Experience supporting FedRAMP, HIPAA, HITRUST, IRS-1075, or comparable regulated environments, including audit support and secure operating practices.
  • Experience leading teams distributed across multiple time zones or countries.
  • Knowledge of IT security practices and secure cloud operations.
  • Experience with a ticketing or IT service management platform such as Zendesk or ServiceNow.

How We Show Up

    These Core Three represent the heartbeat of Atmosera. They are the behaviors and attributes we align to every day, defining how we interact, solve problems, and celebrate our wins together. This is simply who we are at our best.

  • Humble: Low Ego, High Impact. We share credit easily, admit when we're wrong, and view every mistake as a data point for growth.
  • Hungry: Internal Drive. We have a natural bias for action. We don't wait for permission to solve a problem or find a better way to do things.
  • Mindful: Intentional Awareness. We are conscious of our impact on the team. We listen more than we speak and respond to challenges with empathy and situational awareness.

Our Interview Process

    We value your time and aim for transparency. Our typical interview process includes:

  • Talent Screen: 30 minutes. A conversation about your background, leadership experience, career goals, and the mission of the role.
  • Impact & Attributes Assessment: 45 minutes. A discussion focused on how you lead, solve problems, develop people, handle operational pressure, and demonstrate Atmosera's Core Three.
  • Collaborator Loop: 60-90 minutes. Conversations with key partners focused on your technical and operational capabilities, service management experience, leadership approach, and ability to work across teams. This stage may include a presentation, scenario, or work sample.
  • Final Alignment: 30 minutes. A closing conversation with leadership to align on expectations, organizational needs, and the impact of the role.
We value our employees and are committed to providing a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your well-being and financial security. Here's what you can look forward to:

Financial Security & Growth:

Competitive Salary: We offer competitive salaries commensurate with experience and skills.
Generous 401(k) Plan: Secure your financial future with our generous 401(k) plan, featuring a 100% company match on your contributions up to 4% of your salary! This is a fantastic opportunity to build your retirement savings with our support.
Performance-Based Compensation: Your hard work and dedication will be recognized and rewarded through our performance-based compensation program, which includes bonus potential in addition to your base salary.

Health & Well-being:

100% Employer-Paid Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance for employees: Say goodbye to expensive premiums! We cover 100% of the cost of your health, vision, and dental insurance premiums, saving you potentially thousands of dollars each year. Focus on your health, not your healthcare costs.
Company-Paid Life, AD&D, Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance: We provide company-paid life, accidental death & dismemberment, and short- and long-term disability insurance to protect you and your family.

Time Off & Work-Life Balance:

Generous Paid Time Off (PTO): Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with three weeks of paid time off, allowing you to relax, recharge, and pursue your personal interests. This flexible PTO can be used for vacation, personal time, or sick leave.
11 Paid Holidays: We observe 11 paid holidays throughout the year, giving you additional time to spend with family and friends.
Community Service Leave: We believe in giving back to the community and offer paid time off for you to volunteer with organizations that are meaningful to you.

Additional Perks & Recognition:

Employee Recognition and Reward Program: We celebrate and reward outstanding performance and contributions through our employee recognition program. We value your dedication and are committed to showing our appreciation.

We have a couple of reps closing real enterprise business, and we have founders still sitting in most of the important deals. We're looking for the first sales leader who takes over as a hands-on sales leader: helps closing the largest opportunities herself, makes the reps we already have better/ successful, and builds the team and the machinery that makes revenue predictable without her in every cycle.

This is a carrying-a-number job before it's a managing job. There's a working foundational playbook here. There is no machine yet, and building it is the job.

What You’ll Do

  • Carry a personal number. For the first stretch you're the closer on our largest opportunities, not the coach watching one.
  • Run full cycles yourself: discovery, POC, security and architecture review, procurement, signature.

  • Build the operating rhythm. A forecast you'd put your own money behind, pipeline reviews with real teeth, one qualification standard the team actually uses instead of quietly ignoring.
  • Turn your own wins into playbooks. Written from deals you closed, not adapted from a template
  • Own the number in front of the board, along with the honest version of what's working and what isn't.

The First Year

30 days. You can run the demo and the pitch without help, and you've sat in on live deals. You know where our product wins, where it loses, and what we don't do yet.

90 days. Named account list, territory map, and a working point of view on which enterprise segments we should stop chasing. You're multi-threaded into several accounts, running your own cycles, and in the existing reps' deals often enough to know exactly where each of them is strong and where they're guessing.

6 months. 3x coverage against your number, several POCs in flight, your first hires closed and ramping, and a forecast the executive team stop second-guessing.

12 months. The forecast holds within a reasonable band. Reps are closing deals you weren't in. The playbook exists on paper and the team uses it repeatedly to win.

  • Enough technical range that a senior data platform leader stays in the conversation

Seniority: Director or VP Level experience, reports to co-founder

Location: Bay Area, CA or Remote

  • Discretionary allowance for cell phone, wifi, gym memberships, wellness, and more
  • Flexible PTO
  • Professional development allowance

  • At Prophecy, we hire for merit and foster an inclusive culture where people from diverse backgrounds can excel and do their best work. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards.

Don’t miss the rocket ship, join Prophecy and build the next data revolution!

jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Telecom Dispute Analyst to join our team. This role requires strong telecom dispute knowledge, including CABS, intercarrier billing, access charges, and billing variance analysis. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with telecom tariffs, contracts, and dispute workflows, with the ability to manage complex, high-impact cases while meeting deadlines and service-level expectations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Investigate telecom-related customer, vendor, or carrier disputes by reviewing billing records, tariffs, contracts, switch data, and supporting documentation.
  • Analyze CABS invoices, access charges, usage records, LD/IXC billing, and intercarrier settlement details to determine dispute validity and financial impact.
  • Review, interpret, and apply FCC tariffs, PUC tariffs, and contractual agreements to validate charges and support dispute positions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (billing operations, network, finance, carrier relations, vendor management) to resolve discrepancies.
  • Prepare detailed case summaries, financial analyses, and recommendations for dispute outcomes.
  • Process approved adjustments, credits, or escalations based on telecom billing standards and policy requirements.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and ensure compliance with audit, regulatory, and contractual obligations.
  • Identify recurring dispute trends; present findings and partner with leadership on process improvements.
  • Manage dispute queues while meeting turnaround times (TAT), SLA requirements, and quality targets.
  • Support system enhancements, workflow updates, and training for telecom dispute processes.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, Telecommunications, or related field (preferred but not required with equivalent telecom experience).
  • Telecom dispute knowledge is a must, including access billing, intercarrier compensation, and billing variance investigation.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience with CABS (Carrier Access Billing System) including analysis of carrier invoices, access charges, and usage discrepancies.
  • Must have experience with Telecom FCC tariffs, PUC tariffs, and contractual agreements, with the ability to interpret rate structures, rules, and billing requirements.
  • 2+ years of experience in dispute resolution, telecom billing analysis, revenue assurance, or intercarrier operations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables) and data analysis/reporting tools.
  • Ability to read and interpret carrier contracts, rate decks, service agreements, and regulatory filings.
  • Wholesale/Large Business Collections a plus
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience with telecom billing or mediation systems preferred (e.g., TEOCO, Ericsson, Oracle, SAP, or other industry platforms).
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Competency

  • Telecom billing and dispute expertise
  • Tariff and contract interpretation
  • Critical thinking and quantitative analysis
  • Strong documentation and communication
  • Attention to detail and accuracy
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Accountability and ownership

Work Environment & Schedule

  • Full-time role with standard business hours.
  • Full Remote
  • Occasional overtime during peak billing or dispute cycles.

WHY JOIN US?

We aspire to contemporary ways of working.

Recognized as a Top Workplace by the Charlotte Observer, Brightspeed HQ is located on the 7th floor of the new Vantage South End - East Tower in Charlotte, NC. We prioritize hiring talent in the Charlotte area, whenever possible, to make it a truly vibrant destination for our hybrid workforce. At Brightspeed, we have roles that are designated as remote, hybrid, office or field-based, depending on the position, business needs and individual circumstances. We also invest in technology that enables our entire team to stay connected. Why? Because Brightspeed recognizes the value of finding the best talent for the job, wherever they may be.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

Our benefits and paid time off programs reflect our underlying belief in promoting overall wellness through physical, emotional and financial health. Brightspeed offers a comprehensive benefit program, including competitive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; an employee assistance program; a 401K plan with company match and a host of voluntary benefits.

Inclusion and belonging are at the center of our grounding belief in Being Real.

When we bring our authentic selves to work, everyone is better as a result. A diverse team helps us be fierce advocates for more accessible, inclusive and high-quality internet, because we believe doing so promotes equity in the communities we serve.

Brightspeed is an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to inclusion of all qualified individuals, including individuals with a disability/veterans. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact to initiate the accommodations process.

Medical Director, Utilization Management

Location: New Jersey – Fully Remote

Schedule: Standard business hours; schedule to be determined with the client
Start Date: Immediate / ASAP

Openings: 1

About the Position

Bickham Services Unlimited, LLC is seeking a Medical Director, Utilization Management to support a healthcare utilization management program client serving members.

The Medical Director will lead and support clinical utilization management activities, with a primary focus on inpatient and post-acute care reviews. This position is responsible for ensuring timely, consistent, and appropriate medical necessity determinations based on member benefit plans, medical policies, clinical criteria, CMS regulations, and evidence-based practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct timely utilization reviews and medical necessity determinations for inpatient admissions and continued stays.
  • Review post-acute care services, including SNF, IRF, LTACH, and home health.
  • Evaluate the appropriateness of acute and post-acute services using MCG, InterQual, CMS criteria, commercial medical policies, and member benefit plans.
  • Apply applicable regulatory and coverage standards based on the member's line of business.
  • Serve as a physician reviewer for escalated, complex, or potentially adverse utilization management cases.
  • Participate in peer-to-peer discussions with treating and attending physicians.
  • Collaborate with utilization management and care management teams to support consistent and cost-effective care.
  • Identify utilization trends and support initiatives designed to reduce avoidable admissions and readmissions.
  • Provide clinical input regarding medical policies, clinical guidelines, and utilization management protocols.
  • Support regulatory compliance, audit readiness, accreditation, and delegated oversight activities.
  • Contribute to quality improvement initiatives involving utilization patterns, readmissions, and care transitions.
  • Ensure reviews and determinations are appropriately documented in accordance with CMS, NCQA, and applicable state and federal requirements.
  • Participate in utilization management committee meetings and represent the health plan externally when needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Active, unrestricted M.D. or D.O. license in good standing.
  • Current board certification in an appropriate medical specialty.
  • At least 5 years of clinical experience, including at least 3 years of experience in utilization management, physician review, or medical leadership within a managed care or health plan environment.
  • Physician-level utilization management experience.
  • Strong experience with inpatient and post-acute care reviews and medical necessity determinations.
  • Knowledge of commercial benefits, coverage requirements, and medical policies.
  • Experience applying MCG and/or InterQual guidelines.
  • Experience conducting peer-to-peer discussions and communicating complex or adverse determinations.
  • Candidate must reside in or hold applicable licensure for New Jersey.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree such as MPH, MBA, or MHA.
  • ABQAURP certification.
  • Experience with quality improvement, regulatory compliance, accreditation, or delegated oversight.
Salary: DOE

jobs.excerpt: Senior DevOps / SRE EngineerThis is a remote position within the UK.
jobs.description:
Senior DevOps / SRE Engineer

This is a remote position within the UK. We currently don’t provide visa sponsorship.

You must be currently residing in the UK to apply.

We are a B2B Fintech focusing on disrupting the small business lending market. SMEs make up 99% of all UK businesses yet are traditionally underserved by big banks and financial institutions. Built from nearly a decade of experience powering a digital credit broking marketplace, our SaaS solutions serve banks, lenders, and the wider SME finance ecosystem. Leveraging live, validated transactional data from the UK’s advanced data environment, FXE Technologies’ products drive accurate decisioning and proactive engagement. Our products are used by over 80 leading high street and challenger banks and specialist lenders

Role Description

Behind those products is a platform that has to earn the trust of the institutions that depend on it. FXE is a lean, fast-moving organisation with strong ambitions, and the DevOps team sits at the centre of it. We build and operate multi-tenant platforms used by customers including Tier 1 banks, so everything we build must meet the security, reliability and scale expectations of regulated financial institutions.

It's an exciting time to join. We're delivering several projects that will shape where FXE goes next, and the DevOps team is critical to making them happen.

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to take real ownership of DevOps at FXE. You'll bring deep, hands-on infrastructure and networking expertise, a strong command of Terraform, AWS, identity and access management, delivery pipelines and observability, and recent, extensive experience running infrastructure through automation.

Your decisions on infrastructure, delivery pipelines, operations, FinOps, maintainability and reliability, together with the product and application architecture decisions you help shape, will directly determine how fast the business ships, how confidently it scales and how well it holds up under pressure.

This isn't a role where you quietly maintain someone else's designs. You'll create and help define them. You'll lead infrastructure and delivery initiatives end to end, hold your own in design and planning discussions with the most experienced engineers in the company, and bring modern DevOps, SRE and security thinking to how we build, deploy and run systems.

You'll also be a bridge between DevOps and Engineering. You'll understand infrastructure deeply, but you'll also be able to read, reason about and ideally contribute to application code, so that platform and application decisions are made together rather than handed over a wall.

Beyond product infrastructure and delivery pipelines, the DevOps team is responsible for FXE's security systems, supports our corporate IT infrastructure (including Microsoft 365 and our zero-trust network access), and assists with compliance activity such as SOC 2 and Cyber Essentials Plus. This role shares in all of that, not just product-facing infrastructure.

If you want a role where your judgement genuinely counts, where your thinking will be challenged rather than rubber-stamped, and where the scope runs from network design to production reliability to shaping how Engineering and DevOps work together, this is it.

What you'll do

Infrastructure & platform

  • Design, build and operate cloud infrastructure on AWS, with a strong emphasis on IAM and identity services, compute and container services such as EC2 and EKS, networking (VPC design, routing, service mesh, load balancing, DNS, connectivity, segmentation and security boundaries), database services, serverless (e.g. Lambda, Step Functions) and analytics services.
  • Own infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and the delivery pipelines that move code changes across environments.
  • Design for resilience, maintainability, availability (multi-AZ, failover, self-healing, backup and recovery), security and operability (observability, alerting, capacity), and overall functional and non-functional suitability, efficiency, and effectiveness.
  • Securely and reliably integrate and configure 3rd party services used to complement the AWS environment.
  • Use languages such as Python to automate DevOps tasks and support production capabilities owned by DevOps
  • Identify, document, and remediate as necessary infrastructure and platform-level technical risks following established processes.

Delivery pipelines and developer experience

  • Design, build and maintain software delivery (CI/CD) pipelines that are fast, reliable and secure by default.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code configuration, security and guardrail solutions (e.g. Helm charts, Open Policy Agent policies, and EKS admission controllers) to enforce secure, consistent deployment patterns across environments.
  • Improve build, test, release and deployment workflows in collaboration with Engineering.
  • Contribute to environment strategy (dev/test/staging/production) and release management strategies.
  • Support the Engineers during rollouts and deployments.

Bridging DevOps and Engineering

  • Work directly with Engineering teams to understand application-level constraints, so infrastructure and pipeline decisions reflect real delivery needs.
  • Ideally, read, debug and reason about backend and/or frontend code where needed, enough to have credible technical conversations with engineers, contribute to root-cause analysis, and make informed platform decisions that account for application behaviour.
  • Represent DevOps in architecture, design and planning discussions, including with senior engineers and product, and be able to constructively challenge and defend a technical position, as well as understand when trade-offs are necessary.

Leadership and initiative

  • Take ownership of significant infrastructure and delivery initiatives from proposal through to delivery and operations.
  • Research emerging tools, practices and approaches to identify improvements to our platform, delivery pipelines and operational processes, and propose practical, well-reasoned solutions to the problems you find.
  • Participate as a peer in design and planning conversations across DevOps and Engineering, contributing independent judgement rather than executing instructions.
  • Support the Head of Architecture and Security and the other DevOps Engineers in technical direction-setting and be capable of covering senior technical decisions and initiatives in their absence.
  • Document significant technical decisions (e.g. via ADRs/RFCs), review and contribute to RFCs written by Engineers, and to the team's standards, patterns and reference architectures.

Monitoring, observability and reliability

  • Design observability across infrastructure and services: metrics, logs, tracing and alerting that give early warning rather than after-the-fact explanations.
  • Bring SRE practice into how the team works: define and track metrics where meaningful, drive incident response and blameless post-incident review, and turn recurring issues into permanent fixes rather than repeat firefighting.
  • Continuously improve signal quality, reduce alert noise, close observability gaps, and make it fast to answer "what's actually happening in production right now".

Security, IT infrastructure and compliance support

  • Evaluate, monitor, and improve as necessary the security resilience of FXE’s systems. Keep IT and network controls aligned with security and architecture requirements, and to keep audit evidence current and defensible.
  • Help support and operate FXE's corporate IT infrastructure, including Microsoft 365 (identity, device management, mail, collaboration tooling) in collaboration with a 3rd party, and our ZTNA network.
  • Assist with technical evidence, control implementation and remediation work for compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 and Cyber Essentials Plus.
  • Balance this work proportionately alongside product infrastructure and delivery responsibilities, this is a supporting part of the role, not the majority of it.

What we are looking for

Essential

  • Extensive, hands-on experience in infrastructure; you can design, troubleshoot and reason about network architecture at depth, not just consume managed services.
  • Real experience developing, deploying and supporting complex infrastructures made up of many moving parts, not just designing them on a whiteboard. The kind of knowledge and judgement that only comes from having built these systems, watched them break, and fixed them under pressure.
  • Strong, production-grade experience with Infrastructure as Code, including design, state management and multi-environment workflows, as well as scripting languages such as Python.
  • Deep working knowledge of AWS across compute, networking, storage, IAM, and managed services in a multi-account setup.
  • In-depth understanding of access controls, encryption, and networking concepts and protocols.
  • Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD delivery pipelines in a production environment.
  • Experience with containerisation and orchestration (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent).
  • Experience implementing security and guardrail controls in Infrastructure as Code and Kubernetes environments to enforce policy at deploy time rather than relying solely on after-the-fact review.
  • Solid experience with monitoring and observability tooling (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting) and using it to drive real reliability improvements, not just dashboards.
  • SRE experience or equivalent; comfortable owning production reliability, leading or contributing to incident response, and working from SLIs/SLOs where appropriate.
  • Recent, hands-on experience developing and supporting modern, multi-tenant systems, using AI-assisted tooling and workflows in day-to-day engineering, current DevOps practices, and close, ongoing collaboration with developers/engineers.
  • Track record of taking technical ownership of initiatives from design through to delivery, with minimal oversight.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a credible technical peer in design and architecture discussions with senior/lead-level engineers.
  • Working knowledge of software development sufficient to read and reason about application code (backend and/or frontend) and engage meaningfully with engineers on design trade-offs.
  • Solid understanding of resilience, security and operability considerations in infrastructure design (e.g. failover, backup/recovery, least-privilege access, secrets management, observability).
  • Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable documenting decisions and rationale for technical and non-technical audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience working in a small or mid-sized organisation where DevOps and Engineering are separate but tightly coupled teams.
  • Experience with configuration/decision-recording practices such as ADRs and RFCs.
  • Hands-on development experience in Kotlin/Java and/or React, beyond simply reading code.
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365 (identity, device management, security configuration) and/or ZTNA network solutions.
  • Direct experience supporting SOC 2 and/or Cyber Essentials Plus certification or renewal, including evidence gathering and control remediation.

How you’ll work

  • You'll report to the Head of Architecture and Security, and work day-to-day alongside the DevOps team, sharing ownership of the infrastructure and delivery platform rather than working in a silo. This includes being part of on call rotas.
  • You'll engage directly and regularly with Engineering; this role is as much about acting as bridge between platform and application teams as it is about infrastructure delivery.
  • You'll be trusted to make and defend significant technical decisions independently, with appropriate visibility and documentation rather than sign-off at every step.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days
    You've built a working understanding of FXE's infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and the applications they support, enough to start contributing to technically sound, well-reasoned decisions that reflect real application constraints, not just infrastructure best practice in isolation. You've met the Engineering and Product teams you'll be working with and understand how DevOps and Engineering currently collaborate.
  • First 60 days
    You're an active contributor to the DevOps team and joint decisions between Engineering and DevOps rather than someone waiting to be looped in; collaboration on initiatives has visibly increased as a result. You've taken ownership of at least one meaningful piece of infrastructure or pipeline work, and the DevOps team's delivery capacity is measurably higher with you in it.
  • First 90+ days
    You're leading significant initiatives end to end, from design through to operations, with clear ownership and minimal oversight. You're recognised as a credible technical peer by the team's most experienced engineers. You regularly collaborate in the definition of designs and architecture patterns through mechanisms such as RFC reviews. You are actively contributing to the definition and delivery of DevOps strategic roadmap items, as well as the improvement to the efficiency and effectiveness of processes and tools.

Benefits

  • Salary banding 70K-85K GBP.
  • This position offers fully-remote work, you must be based within the UK.
  • Flexible working.
  • Autoenrollment in the pension scheme with contributions from FXE.
  • 25 days annual leave PLUS UK Bank Holidays.
  • Talent Referral Scheme.
  • Regular socials and team get togethers.

FXE is an equal opportunities employer and all positions are open to all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.

Company: IPS Group, Inc., a Nayax company, is a design, engineering and manufacturing company focused on low-power wireless telecommunications and parking technologies. IPS invented the credit card-enabled, solar-powered single-space parking meter and today offers a fully integrated smart parking ecosystem. Founded in 2000 and headquartered in San Diego, where it manufactures its products locally, IPS manages more than 250,000 parking spaces across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Ireland.

The IPS platform includes single-space smart meters and vehicle detection sensors, multi-space pay stations and upgrade kits, the Elevate platform, digital payments (mobile app and text-to-pay), enforcement, permit management, DMV data services, and smart cash collection.

In 2026, IPS became part of Nayax (Nasdaq: NYAX), a global payments and commerce platform operating in more than 120 countries. IPS’s leadership team continues to run the business from San Diego. Together, the two companies offer cities, universities, and private operators one platform for parking, payments, and EV charging at the curb.

Job Description:

As a Regional Account Executive, you will be the trusted partner for cities, counties, parking authorities, and private operators that already rely on IPS, helping them get more from a growing ecosystem of parking software, payments, and services. You will own a regional portfolio, learn what each customer is trying to achieve, and turn that insight into renewals and expansion across the IPS and Nayax platform. Your work shapes how communities manage their curbs and how IPS grows as part of Nayax.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Grow the value each customer gets from the IPS smart parking ecosystem. The Account Executive positions IPS as a long-term technology and services partner rather than a hardware vendor, moving each account toward a connected suite of software, payments, data, and services built on IPS hardware.

  • Customer success and retention: Act as a trusted advisor who helps every customer achieve measurable results with IPS, building lasting partnerships that carry existing agreements through renewal and extension.
  • Software and services adoption: Expand each customer’s use of the IPS software and services suite, including Elevate, enforcement, permit management, DMV data services, and digital payments, and connect these solutions into one integrated ecosystem where data, payments, and operations work together.
  • Nayax payments and curb services: Introduce payment processing, EV charging, and other Nayax offerings that broaden IPS’s role at the curb.
  • Hardware as the foundation: Keep each customer’s technology current and suited to their goals, recommending the right solutions and upgrades to support the services they rely on.

jobs.excerpt: Thank you for considering Tailscale.  If this job description resonates with you, please apply.
jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic, creative, and highly experienced Head of Communications to lead and scale Tailscale's global communications function. This leader will shape how Tailscale is understood by the market, elevate our visibility in the media, and build the communications engine needed to support our next phase of growth.

Tailscale is a multi-product secure connectivity platform spanning networking, privileged access, workload connectivity, and AI infrastructure. We have an opportunity to help define the future of secure connectivity, establishing Tailscale as the obvious and best networking choice for AI and agentic infrastructure. We're looking for someone who can turn our technical innovation, customer impact, and vision into compelling stories that earn attention and establish Tailscale as a category leader.

Reporting to the SVP of Marketing, you will own product and corporate communications, public relations, media strategy, internal communications, crisis communications, award applications, international comms and media relations, new media engagement, and executive communications across the leadership team outside the CEO. You'll also partner closely with a separate dedicated CEO and policy communications leader to ensure our stories are coordinated and consistent.

This is a builder role for someone who combines strong strategic judgment with exceptional execution. You will initially be hands-on while hiring and developing a small, high-performing team. You will work directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, People, Legal, and the executive team to build a communications function that can scale with Tailscale's ambitions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Tailscale's global communications strategy, strengthening brand awareness, reputation, and market leadership.
  • Lead product and technology communications, translating complex innovations, product launches, and customer stories into compelling narratives that earn meaningful media coverage. This should include sustained product storytelling between launches, including through independent reviews, technical publications, comparisons, creators, and third party validation. It could also include research-led PR.
  • Build strong relationships with top-tier business, technology, cybersecurity, and AI journalists, driving proactive media opportunities and increasing Tailscale's share of voice.
  • Expand Tailscale's presence across emerging media channels, including influential podcasts, newsletters, creators, and technical communities.
  • Own corporate communications for major company milestones, strategic partnerships, funding announcements, and other business developments.
  • Build and scale international communications programs, including regional media relations and agency partnerships.
  • Develop executive communications and thought leadership programs for the leadership team outside the CEO, including speaking opportunities, media engagements, and executive social presence. Partner closely with the dedicated CEO and policy communications lead to coordinate company narratives, major announcements, and executive engagement, building comms campaigns for executives that align with the overall company narrative.
  • Oversee internal communications, partnering with People and executive leadership on company-wide messaging, all-hands, organizational changes, and employee engagement communications.
  • Lead crisis communications, establishing response plans and partnering with Legal, Security, Engineering, and leadership to protect customer trust and company reputation. You should be able to improve processes over time as we scale.
  • Own Tailscale's awards and recognition strategy, identifying and securing high-value industry and company accolades.
  • Hire, manage, and develop a high-performing communications team while overseeing external agencies, communications processes, and performance measurement. This team will start small (likely 2 heads), but has the potential to grow in the future as we scale.
  • Partner closely with the dedicated CEO and policy communications individual contributor to maintain consistent narratives and support broader policy communications initiatives.

What We Are Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in public relations, product communications, or corporate communications, ideally within high-growth B2B technology companies.
  • Proven track record of securing meaningful earned media coverage and building strong relationships with influential journalists.
  • Deep product communications expertise, with the ability to translate complex technical products into clear, compelling stories.
  • Experience hiring, managing, and developing communications professionals and overseeing agency partners.
  • Exceptional writing, storytelling, and editorial judgment across external, executive, and internal communications.
  • Experience advising senior executives and navigating high-stakes or sensitive communications situations.
  • Strong strategic judgment and operational discipline, with the ability to prioritize, build scalable processes, and measure impact. Curiosity around and openness to leveraging AI to support operations and execution but not replace human taste and judgement.
  • A hands-on, creative, and highly accountable leader who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and is comfortable building from the ground up.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in networking, cybersecurity, infrastructure, developer tools, or AI.
  • Experience scaling communications at a high-growth, global technology company.
  • Experience supporting fundraising, acquisitions, or pre-IPO communications as well as experience supporting a company through an IPO.

  • Experience collaborating with teams who support analyst relations, public policy, or major industry research initiatives.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range
$190,000—$237,000 USD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

At Terakeet, we’re comfortable with the uncomfortable. We live in the future of marketing and are revolutionizing how the world’s most valuable brands connect and build trust with their audiences. We are experts who deliver exceptional outcomes. Together, we win.

What We Do

Terakeet controls online reputation and visibility for leading brands and executives. We proactively build, protect, and repair brand narratives and perception to drive trust across organic and AI-powered search using patented technology and decades of expertise.

Where We Hire

We are a remote-first organization hiring specifically within 60 miles of of Chicago, IL., Dallas, TX., Austin, TX., Charlotte, NC., Atlanta, GA., Phoenix, AZ., Minneapolis, MN., and Syracuse, NY to help create opportunities for connectivity and collaboration in-person as you see fit. Learn more about our hiring hubs on our Careers blog.

The Content Manager develops cross-channel content strategies across traditional search and generative AI engines. Functioning as a player-coach, you will lead a team of writers and editors while remaining hands-on in strategy execution, AI prompt optimization, and content QA. jobs.title: Architecte principal(e)/Principal Architect
jobs.excerpt: English description below À propos d'IngenoIngeno est une firme de services professionnels basée au Québec, spécialisée dans le développement de solutions logicielles sur mesure et de solutions en intelligence artificielle, avec un focus sur les secteurs manufacturier et de la défense.
jobs.description:
English description below

À propos d'Ingeno

Ingeno est une firme de services professionnels basée au Québec, spécialisée dans le développement de solutions logicielles sur mesure et de solutions en intelligence artificielle, avec un focus sur les secteurs manufacturier et de la défense. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la conception, la construction et la mise à l'échelle de systèmes critiques, en combinant une expertise technique pointue à une approche pragmatique axée sur la livraison et la valeur ajoutée.

Aperçu du poste

L'architecte principal(e) partage son temps entre le leadership technique sur les mandats clients les plus complexes et la standardisation des pratiques, des processus et de l'orientation technique à l'échelle de l'entreprise. À ce titre, ce rôle exerce une influence directe sur les décisions technologiques et l'orientation technique d'Ingeno.

Responsabilités

L'architecte principal(e) combine le leadership technique sur les mandats clients les plus complexes avec la responsabilité de standardiser les pratiques, les processus et l'orientation technique à l'échelle de l'entreprise, couvrant les domaines suivants :

1. Livraison client

  • Agir à titre d'architecte principal(e) sur les mandats clients les plus complexes et à plus haut risque d'Ingeno
  • Servir de point d'escalade technique pour les équipes de livraison confrontées à des enjeux d'architecture
  • Diriger l'architecture de solution durant les phases de découverte stratégique et de conception de solution pour les comptes stratégiques
  • Effectuer la révision des risques techniques et l'approbation des énoncés de travail (SOW) dépassant un seuil de complexité défini

2. Cycle de développement logiciel

  • Détenir et faire évoluer en continu le cadre de développement en cinq phases d'Ingeno (découverte stratégique, conception de solution, planification de livraison, développement itératif, déploiement et transition)
  • Diriger la révision d'architecture pour les projets dépassant un seuil de taille ou de complexité défini
  • Détenir le cadre de mesure de performance et d'indicateurs par phase; s'assurer que les leçons tirées des rétrospectives et post-mortems se traduisent en améliorations concrètes des processus

3. Estimation

  • Standardiser la méthodologie d'estimation à travers les équipes de livraison
  • Réviser et approuver les estimations dépassant un seuil défini avant leur communication aux clients

4. Utilisation de l'IA

  • Définir les stratégies d'utilisation de l'IA à l'interne et pour les projets clients
  • Optimiser les processus de développement produit et logiciel en faisant levier sur l’IA
  • Définir les garde-fous et les bonnes pratiques pour une utilisation sécuritaire et responsable de l'IA, incluant la gestion des données client sensibles
  • Établir les standards d'intégration et d'interopérabilité pour les composants d'IA (LLM, RAG, bases de données vectorielles, modèles de ML), tant à l'interne que dans les solutions clients
  • Superviser les décisions de type « bâtir ou acheter » pour les outils et l'infrastructure d'IA
  • Maintenir des standards d'utilisation de l'IA cohérents à travers l'organisation

5. Stratégie technologique

  • Établir, en collaboration avec la haute direction, les stratégies technologiques de l'entreprise et participer à leur implantation

6. Développement des compétences

  • Contribuer à l'évolution de l'échelle de compétences techniques (la propriété demeure celle des chefs d'équipe et de la direction)

7. Soutien aux ventes

  • Fournir, au besoin, un appui à la solution technique et à la révision des risques des SOW pour les opportunités complexes

Qualifications requises

  • Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente
  • 12 années ou plus d'expérience en génie logiciel, incluant une portion significative en architecture
  • Feuille de route éprouvée dans la conception de systèmes complexes de niveau production, en contexte de services-conseils
  • Expérience concrète d'intégration de composants d'IA/ML (LLM, RAG, bases de données vectorielles) dans des systèmes en production
  • Expérience de standardisation des pratiques de génie logiciel à travers plusieurs équipes (cycle de développement, estimation, qualité du code)
  • Bilinguisme (français/anglais), à l'oral et à l'écrit — Ingeno opère dans les deux langues
  • Expérience dans des secteurs réglementés ou à haute conformité (p. ex. défense, santé) constitue un atout
  • Excellentes habiletés de communication, à l'aise autant avec les équipes de livraison qu'avec la haute direction

Attributs clés

  • Pragmatique — sait équilibrer la rigueur de standardisation avec l'autonomie et la rapidité des équipes de livraison
  • Leader technique crédible qui demeure impliqué sur le terrain, au-delà d'un rôle purement stratégique
  • À l'aise de porter un double mandat et de protéger le temps alloué à chacune des deux facettes du rôle
  • Bon instinct de gestion du changement pour favoriser l'adoption de nouveaux standards sans lourdeur excessive

Travailler chez Ingeno, c’est aussi...

  • Une politique de télétravail 100% Remote avec la possibilité de venir travailler dans nos bureaux à Québec;
  • Un horaire flexible pour que tu puisses skier, promener ton chien ou rendre visite à ta grand-mère. C’est toi qui décides;
  • 26 jours de vacances et deux jours de maladie dès ton premier jour;
  • Assurances collectives;
  • Une licence Claude Max 5x pour booster ta productivité;
  • Un budget pour certains aspects de l'aménagement de ton espace de travail;
  • Un budget annuel pour des activités sociales et sportives;
  • Accès à un gym au bureau de Québec, télémédecine, PAE et une politique santé et bien-être;
  • La possibilité de demander du temps d'étude pour compléter une certification AWS;
  • Des collègues incroyablement compétent(e)s avec qui tu pourras partager ta passion et grandir;
  • Et bien plus encore!

========================================================================

About Ingeno

Ingeno is a Québec-based professional services firm delivering custom software and AI solutions, with a focus on the manufacturing and defence sectors. We partner with our clients to design, build, and scale mission-critical systems, combining deep technical expertise with a pragmatic approach focused on delivery and added value.

Position Overview

The Principal Architect splits their time between hands-on technical leadership on Ingeno's most complex client engagements and standardizing practices, processes, and technical direction across the firm. In this capacity, the role has a direct impact on Ingeno's technological decisions and direction.

Responsibilities

The Principal Architect combines hands-on technical leadership on Ingeno's most complex client engagements with responsibility for standardizing practices, processes, and technical direction across the firm, covering the following areas:

1. Client Delivery

  • Serve as principal/lead architect on Ingeno's most complex and highest-risk client engagements
  • Act as the technical escalation point for delivery teams facing architecture-level challenges
  • Lead solution architecture during the Strategic Discovery and Solution Design phases on flagship accounts
  • Provide technical risk review and sign-off on statements of work (SOWs) above a defined complexity threshold

2. Software Development Lifecycle

  • Own and continuously evolve Ingeno's five-phase Development Process Framework (Strategic Discovery, Solution Design, Delivery Planning, Iterative Development, Deployment & Transition)
  • Run architecture review for projects above a defined size/complexity threshold
  • Own the phase-level KPI and performance measurement framework; ensure lessons from project retrospectives and post-mortems translate into concrete process improvements

3. Estimation

  • Standardize estimation methodology across delivery teams
  • Review and approve estimates above a defined threshold before they are communicated to clients

4. AI Usage

  • Define AI usage strategies for internal operations and client projects
    • Define guardrails and best practices for safe, responsible AI use, including handling of sensitive client data
    • Establish integration and interoperability standards for AI components (LLMs, RAG, vector databases, ML models), across both internal and client-facing solutions
    • Oversee build-vs-buy decisions for AI tooling and infrastructure
    • Maintain consistent AI usage standards across the organization

5. Technology Strategy

  • Establish the company's technology strategies in collaboration with senior leadership and participate in their implementation

6. Competency Development

  • Contribute to the evolution of the technical competency ladder (ownership remains with team leads and leadership)

7. Sales Support

  • Provide technical solutioning and SOW risk review for complex opportunities, as required

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in architecture roles
  • Proven track record architecting complex, production-grade systems in a client services / consulting environment
  • Direct experience integrating AI/ML components (LLMs, RAG, vector databases) into production systems
  • Experience standardizing engineering practices across multiple teams (SDLC, estimation, code quality)
  • Bilingual (French/English), spoken and written — Ingeno operates in both languages
  • Experience in regulated or high-compliance sectors (e.g., defence, healthcare) is an asset
  • Strong communication skills, comfortable working with both hands-on delivery teams and executive leadership

Key Attributes

  • Pragmatic — balances standardization rigor with delivery-team autonomy and speed
  • Credible technical leader who remains hands-on, not purely strategic
  • Comfortable holding a dual mandate and protecting time for both sides of the role
  • Strong change-management instincts to drive adoption of new standards without heavy-handedness

Working at Ingeno also means...

  • A 100% remote work policy, with the option to work from our Québec City office;
  • Flexible hours so you can go skiing, walk your dog, or visit your grandmother. You decide;
  • 26 vacation days and two sick days starting on your first day;
  • Group insurance benefits;
  • A Claude Max 5x license to boost your productivity;
  • A budget toward setting up your workspace;
  • An annual budget for social and sports activities;
  • Access to a gym at the Québec City office, telemedicine, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness policy;
  • The option to request study time to complete an AWS certification;
  • Incredibly talented colleagues to share your passion and grow with;
  • And much more!

jobs.description:
At the American Cancer Society, we're working to end cancer as we know it, for everyone. Our employees and 1.3 million volunteers are raising the bar every single day. We are a culture comprised of diverse backgrounds and experience, to better serve our communities.

The people who work at the American Cancer Society focus their diverse talents on our lifesaving mission. It is a calling. And the people who answer it are fulfilled.

BrightEdge is the innovation, impact investment and venture capital arm of the American Cancer Society. We invest in for-profit, early-stage companies developing cutting-edge, cancer-focused therapeutics, diagnostics, devices, and technologies to fuel and accelerate ACS’s mission of ending cancer as we know it, for everyone.

The Principal will lead sourcing and due diligence for early-stage private company investment opportunities and manage all stages of the investment process, from initial contact through execution. The Principal will interface with internal and external ecosystem partners to identify and evaluate potential investments, conduct in-depth due diligence on both the scientific and business merits of select deals, and develop investment recommendations. The Principal will also provide guidance and mentorship to Associates and Senior Associates supporting deal execution, and will contribute to evolving BrightEdge’s investment strategy based on insights from curated deal flow and the broader investment landscape. The role requires a high level of self-motivation, sound independent judgment, and a meaningful level of responsibility from the outset.

***This position is a remote role, open anywhere throughout the United States. Experience in digital health tech field is preferred.***

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Lead the end-to-end investment process for prospective portfolio companies across therapeutics, diagnostics, and healthcare technologies, from sourcing through close, including due diligence, financial modeling, and development of investment recommendations. (25%)
  • Lead drafting and delivery of investment memos summarizing the investment thesis, risk profile, and recommendation; present directly to the BrightEdge team and Investment Committee, and participate directly in Investment Committee discussions. (15%)
  • Manage and oversee ongoing portfolio company relationships, including board observer responsibilities where applicable, quarterly and annual reporting, and monitoring of company performance, strategy, and market developments. (15%)
  • Develop and champion investment views and proactive investment theses based on innovation trends and in-depth understanding of patient-centric unmet needs; represent BrightEdge at scientific and medical conferences (e.g. AACR, ASCO, etc.) to identify emerging investment opportunities. (10%)
  • Provide guidance, mentorship, and quality review to Associates and Senior Associates supporting due diligence, financial modeling, and deal execution; contribute to their professional development. (10%)
  • Lead sourcing of investment opportunities and management of co-investor, venture partner, and ecosystem relationships to drive high-quality deal flow aligned with BrightEdge's investment strategy. (10%)
  • Support innovation and venture development initiatives, including review of BrightEdge Innovation program applicants and advising selected participants on scientific and fundraising strategy; engage ecosystem stakeholders across ACS researchers, research institutions, and advisory networks. (10%)
  • Contribute to firm-building initiatives, including investor engagement, fundraising support, and development of external relationships. (5%)

EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum Degree Required: Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (PhD, MD, MPH, MBA, or related field) or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Preferred Degree: Advanced degree or equivalent experience in health tech, digital health, life sciences, or a related field; PhD or MD a plus but not required.
  • Certificate(s) or License(s):
  • Years of experience: At least 8 years of experience in venture capital and innovation (business development, external innovation, strategy consulting) in the biomedical/healthcare, health tech, or digital health industry (or equivalent), with a demonstrated investment/deal track record.
  • Driver’s License Requirement(s) [Included only if driving is part of the job duties]:
  • Vaccine Requirement(s) [Included only if vaccinations are required for the role]:

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITY:

  • Strong background in health tech, digital health, and/or life sciences investing, with the ability to evaluate scientific, technical, and commercial merit across a range of cancer-focused innovation
  • Proven investment experience in the biomedical/healthcare, health tech, or digital health industry, with demonstrated ability to lead deals from sourcing through close
  • Experience with and/or strong desire to learn the specifics of impact investing and venture philanthropy
  • Motivated by impacting the lives of patients through healthcare innovation
  • Builds networks - Effectively builds formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
  • Cultivates innovation - Creates new and better ways for the organization to be successful.
  • Optimizes work processes - Knows the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement. Analytical/evaluative thinker.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills. Excellent attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop junior investment professionals (Associates and Senior Associates)

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Capacity to travel up to 25%. Regular travel to onsite meetings in Boston, MA required.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • N/A

The starting rate is $175,000 to $200,000 annual. The final candidate's relevant experience/skills will be considered before an offer is extended. Actual starting pay will vary based on non-discriminatory factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, experience, skills, specialty, and education.

ACS provides staff a generous paid time off policy; medical, dental, retirement benefits, wellness programs, and professional development programs to enhance staff skills. Further details on our benefits can be found on our careers site at: jobs.cancer.org/benefits. We are a proud equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
Senior Instructional Designer

Red Nucleus is seeking a Senior Instructional Designer to join our L&D team, with expertise in designing and developing engaging instructor-led and virtual workshop experiences. This individual will partner with clients, stakeholders, and subject matter experts to create learning solutions that drive knowledge, skill development, and behavior change.

About Red Nucleus

Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives.
We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry.

Within our L&D team, we work with life sciences companies of all sizes, from those bringing their first product to market to the largest multinational firms. This role will primarily service clients in the oncology space, supporting sales reps, HCPs, MSLs, and other commercial roles.

About This Role

The Senior Instructional Designer role leads the design and writing of interactive, engaging, and creative learning solutions for life sciences industry professionals, across a number of modalities including live and virtual workshops.

This individual will translate client goals, objectives, and strategy into effective learning experiences for target learners. Every day is different and can range from performing curriculum
analyses and developing measurement strategies to designing specific deliverables that leverage blended approaches.

This position does not require original research of medical content but may use content written by a Medical Writer or client to create a new learning asset.

Specifically, this role will:

  • Design and develop engaging, effective instructor-led and virtual workshop materials, including facilitator guides, participant guides, job aids, quick reference guides, learning activities, simulations, and assessments
  • Lead instructional design discussions and reviews with clients and project teams to align learning solutions with business objectives
  • Develop interactive learning strategies that incorporate adult learning principles, application exercises, case studies, and facilitated discussions
  • Deliver and facilitate Train-the-Trainer sessions to prepare facilitators for successful workshop delivery
  • Support business development efforts through participation in proposals, pitches, and learning strategy discussions
  • Review and revise training materials created by others for instructional quality, learner engagement, and educational effectiveness

Requirements

  • Undergraduate or graduate degree in education, instructional design, organizational development, or a related field; or equivalent experience
  • Demonstrated experience in needs analysis, instructional design, curriculum development, learning measurement, and adult learning methodologies
  • Experience designing live and virtual instructor-led workshops and learning experiences
  • Ability to translate complex content into impactful learning experiences
  • Comfortable with AI tools, MS Office, and virtual meeting platforms
  • Exceptional verbal, written, presentation, and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced client environment
  • Strong collaboration, consulting, and stakeholder management skills
  • Knowledge of and experience within the life sciences industry, such as
    pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and/or medical device training

Red Nucleus is an equal opportunity employer. If you're interested in joining the Red Nucleus family, please submit your resume, cover letter, and salary requirements.

Learn more about Red Nucleus at .Salary: $90000 - $110000

Ambiente de colaboração e compartilhamento de conhecimento, propício à inovação e criatividade constante.

Benefícios: Temos também benefícios abrangentes como plano de saúde e odontológico, Cartão flexível para demandas de alimentação, cultura, educação, mobilidade, etc., programa de idiomas, Total Pass e outros. Temos ainda ambiente descontraído, horário de trabalho flexível e intenso investimento na carreira.

Nosso objetivo é criar um ambiente de trabalho justo que dê às pessoas o apoio de que precisam para prosperar, crescer e atingir seus objetivos. Para isso, construímos todos os dias um ambiente inclusivo e diverso em relação à deficiências, idade, identidade de gênero e orientação sexual, etnia e raça, religião, culturas e experiências, oferecendo oportunidades equitativas para todos construírem sua carreira em uma empresa que só cresce. By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

As a Sales Executive supporting GasBuddy, you will drive digital advertising revenue by building and expanding relationships with major media agencies and national brands across the New York and Northeast markets. You will be responsible for developing new business, growing existing accounts, and positioning GasBuddy's advertising solutions as a valuable part of customers' media strategies. This role requires strong agency relationships, a consultative sales approach, and a proven ability to develop opportunities, close business, and consistently deliver revenue results.

Responsibilities

    • Develop and strengthen relationships with major advertising holding companies, media agencies, and decision-makers across the New York and Northeast markets.
    • Position GasBuddy as a preferred advertising partner for national and regional media campaigns.
    • Manage and grow relationships with national brands across industries including quick-service restaurants (QSR), consumer packaged goods (CPG), retail, and fuel.
    • Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts, reengage former advertisers, and secure incremental advertising budgets.
    • Prospect, pitch, and close new business opportunities by developing customized digital advertising solutions aligned with customer objectives.
    • Translate GasBuddy's audience insights, advertising capabilities, and in-app media formats into compelling proposals that support brand awareness, store visits, promotions, and seasonal campaigns.
    • Manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, responding to requests for proposals (RFPs), media planning, presentations, negotiations, and closing.
    • Develop and maintain a qualified sales pipeline, ensuring accurate opportunity tracking, campaign flight dates, and revenue forecasting within Salesforce.
    • Partner with Campaign Management, Advertising Operations, and Insights teams to support campaign execution, performance reporting, and customer satisfaction.
    • Leverage campaign results and performance insights to identify renewal opportunities, increase advertising spend, and strengthen long-term relationships.
    • Monitor advertising industry trends, competitive offerings, and market developments to identify opportunities for revenue growth.
    • Consistently achieve or exceed assigned revenue targets and sales performance objectives.

Qualifications

    • Minimum of 5 years of experience in digital media or digital advertising sales.
    • Established relationships with media agencies, advertising holding companies, and key decision-makers within the New York and Northeast markets.
    • Demonstrated success generating advertising revenue through new business development, account growth, and renewals.
    • Experience selling digital advertising solutions to national brands and agencies, preferably within QSR, CPG, retail, or related industries.
    • Strong understanding of digital advertising, media planning, campaign performance, and advertiser objectives.
    • Experience responding to RFPs, developing media proposals, and negotiating advertising agreements.
    • Proven ability to manage complex sales cycles and consistently achieve or exceed revenue targets.
    • Strong consultative selling, relationship management, presentation, and negotiation skills.
    • Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM platform for pipeline management and revenue forecasting.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with Campaign Management, Ad Ops, Insights, and other cross-functional teams.
    • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, opportunities, and competing priorities.
PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.
