jobs.description:
Endpoint Security Engineer (Mid-Level) – Carbon Black & Symantec

January Start Date

Contract or Contract to hire

**No Agencies Please

Position Summary

We are seeking a mid-level Endpoint Security Engineer with hands-on expertise in VMware Carbon Black and Symantec endpoint security products. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, tuning, and supporting endpoint security controls across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments, ensuring endpoints are protected, monitored, and aligned to organizational security standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deploy, configure, and maintain Carbon Black and Symantec endpoint agents across enterprise environments.
  • Design and implement policies, rules, and profiles to protect endpoints while minimizing business disruption.
  • Participate in endpoint security architecture discussions and contribute to baselines and hardening guides.
  • Monitor and manage alerts, detections, and events from Carbon Black and Symantec consoles.
  • Tune policies and signatures to reduce false positives while maintaining strong coverage.
  • Support agent health, troubleshooting installation issues, connectivity, and upgrade cycles.
  • Assist in triage, investigation, and containment of endpoint security incidents.
  • Collect and analyze endpoint telemetry using Carbon Black and Symantec tools.
  • Collaborate with SOC, IT, and engineering teams to coordinate deployments and operations.
  • Maintain runbooks, SOPs, and technical documentation.
  • Align endpoint controls to security policies and compliance frameworks.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in information security or endpoint engineering.
  • 2+ year hands-on experience administering VMware Carbon Black (App Control, EDR, Cloud).
  • 2+ year hands-on experience with Symantec endpoint products (SEP, SES, Symantec EDR).
  • Understanding of endpoint security concepts such as malware, exploits, and lateral movement.
  • Practical knowledge of Windows, macOS, and/or Linux internals.
  • Familiarity with SIEM/SOC workflows and alert development.
  • Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in medium-to-large enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with NIST CSF, ISO27001, CIS Controls, or similar frameworks.
  • PowerShell, Python, or Bash scripting experience.
  • Experience integrating endpoint tools with SIEM platforms.
  • Relevant certifications (Carbon Black, Symantec, Security+, CySA+, GSEC, etc.).

Soft Skills & Work Style

  • Ownership mindset and ability to follow issues through to resolution.
  • Detail-oriented with disciplined change management and documentation habits.
  • Ability to balance usability and security requirements thoughtfully.
  • Strong independent work capability with effective team collaboration.

Hiring Assumptions: Potential Start date - January 1, 2026

Duration of Project - 1 year Mid Resource

  • On Target Earnings: $85,000 - $110,000

Location: This position is remote, based in the U.S. with optional travel quarterly for in-person company events and other ad hoc meetings.

  • Candidate must be authorized to work and reside in the United States; we do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

  • Serve as first point of contact for SpecterOps inbound leads.
  • Work with Regional Directors and Account Executives on outbound account targets and scheduling demos.

  • Provide metrics and status updates of all leads, demos and new pipelines added weekly to the sales team.

  • Familiarity (or ability to quickly become proficient) with sales tools: Salesforce.com, LinkedIn Navigator, Zoom Info, and outreach tools.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook; Salesforce.com experience is a plus.

  • 13 paid holidays annually

  • Stock Options

  • $500 annual home office allowance after first year
  • $150 monthly cell phone and internet reimbursement
  • $5,000 annual professional development allowance
  • $5,250 towards continuing education or student loan repayment
  • $1,200 annual budget for lifestyle, wellness, pet insurance and more
  • A one-time $10,000 benefit towards family planning

jobs.description:
About Multiview

Multiview is The Healthcare ERP Company. Purpose-built for healthcare finance teams, Multiview delivers a powerful, scalable, and cost-effective ERP that unites financials, supply chain management, reporting, and analytics in a single platform. Backed by deep expertise in healthcare finance and recognized by KLAS Research as the #1 ERP for healthcare organizations under 300 beds, Multiview helps mid-sized healthcare organizations gain clarity, move faster, make better decisions, and stay focused on care.

We are a values-led organization:

People First. Client Obsessed. Stronger Together. Work Smart. Believe in Better.

Position Summary

Reporting to the President and CEO, the Vice President of Information Technology & Chief Information Security Officer (VP of IT/CISO) is responsible for leading the organization's overall internal technology strategy, IT operations, cybersecurity programs, and regulatory compliance initiatives. This executive role serves as both the senior technology leader and the principal information security officer, ensuring that technology investments, security controls, and governance programs enable business growth while protecting critical company assets and client data.

As a SaaS ERP provider supporting clients who maintain highly sensitive Protected Health Information (PHI), the VP of IT/CISO is accountable for developing and maintaining a best-in-class security and compliance program that meets the requirements of HIPAA, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and other applicable privacy and security regulations. The role will be responsible for the protection of internal corporate systems and cloud infrastructure. This is not a DevOps role, nor is there DevOps responsibility, however our compliance and security are owned by this position.

The ideal candidate is a strategic executive capable of balancing innovation, scalability, risk management, compliance, and execution at a high level of operational excellence in a high-growth SaaS environment. A successful VP of IT/CISO will combine the strategic mindset of a technology executive with the rigour of a security leader.

This role is not suited for someone who prefers delegation or high-level oversight alone. The VP of IT/CISO must be eager to roll up their sleeves, dive into day-to-day IT activities, and personally influence the employee and stakeholder experience.

We are a proud award winning employer and intend to continue to improve the company as a place to work so that we can be worthy of the incredible talent we have.

We are a remote-first company and welcome candidates across Canada. The expectations are that in-person meetings or in-person work will be less than 10% of the time.

We welcome candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences.

If you bring strong IT leadership, a passion for security, and a willingness to work directly at both strategic and tactical levels, we want to hear from you.

The salary for this role is $180,000.00 to 250,000.00 CAD plus variable. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's IT and cybersecurity strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to leadership on technology investments, cybersecurity risk, compliance obligations, and operational scalability.
  • Establish IT and security roadmaps that enable growth, scalability and employee effectiveness.
  • Lead annual technology planning, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation processes.
  • Present regular updates to leadership regarding cybersecurity posture, risk landscape, compliance status, and strategic initiatives.
  • Build and lead a high-performing technology and security organization focused on accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Support and participate as required on the Security & Privacy Committee.

Cybersecurity & Information Security Leadership

  • Serve as the company's Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) with enterprise-wide responsibility for information security governance.
  • Implement and maintain an enterprise cybersecurity program based on recognized frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
  • Maintain appropriate security architecture, policies, procedures, and standards across all systems and environments.
  • Lead security monitoring, vulnerability management, penetration testing, threat intelligence, security operations, and incident response capabilities.
  • Ensure implementation of robust identity and access management, privileged access controls, multi-factor authentication, endpoint protection, data loss prevention, encryption, and zero-trust principles.
  • Oversee third-party security reviews and vendor risk management programs.
  • Direct forensic investigations, incident response activities, and breach notification processes when required.
  • Conduct regular cybersecurity risk assessments and maintain enterprise risk registers.

Data Privacy & Compliance

  • Maintain responsibility for protecting sensitive data and ensuring continued compliance with applicable standards including:
    • HIPAA
    • Provincial, state and federal privacy regulations
    • SOC 2 Type II requirements
    • Client contractual security obligations
  • Partner with Legal, Engineering, Product, and Client Success teams to ensure proper handling of PHI and Personally Identifiable Information (PII).
  • Oversee security controls protecting client data throughout its lifecycle including collection, transmission, storage, processing, backup, archival, and destruction.
  • Ensure implementation of appropriate administrative, physical, and technical safeguards for all regulated information.
  • Lead client security reviews, audits, and due diligence assessments.
  • Serve as executive sponsor for external audits, compliance certifications, and client risk assessments.
  • Serves as Privacy Officer

IT Infrastructure & Operations

  • Lead all internal IT operations including corporate systems, service desk, networking, cloud infrastructure, endpoint management, and collaboration platforms.
  • Oversee disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and resilience testing programs.
  • Monitor and maintain appropriate service-level agreements (SLAs), operational metrics, and performance standards.
  • Drive modernization, automation strategies, and operational excellence programs, including support functions to improve security posture, operational efficiency, and service delivery.
  • Support organizational wide adoption of AI to increase velocity of stakeholder impact.
  • Ensure secure remote workforce capabilities and endpoint management practices.

SaaS Platform Security

  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Champion secure-by-design and privacy-by-design principles.
  • Oversee application security programs and cloud-native security controls across AWS and applicable multi-cloud environments with Engineering.
  • Ensure corporate applications maintain the highest standards of confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
  • Support the completion of RFP/RFQs from prospective and current clients and other stakeholders as required.

Risk Management & Governance

  • Maintain applicable enterprise technology governance structures and security oversight programs.
  • Develop risk management methodologies and reporting mechanisms.
  • Maintain cybersecurity insurance readiness and support annual policy renewals.
  • Create meaningful executive dashboards and KPIs related to:
    • Security risk
    • Compliance posture
    • System availability
    • IT performance
    • Audit findings
    • Incident response metrics
  • Lead business continuity and crisis management planning efforts.

Team Development & Vendor Management

  • Recruit, develop, and retain top-tier IT and cybersecurity talent.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, security awareness, and client-centric service.
  • Manage strategic technology vendors, managed service providers, cloud providers, and security partners.
  • Negotiate and manage technology contracts and licensing agreements.
  • Develop succession plans for critical technology and security leadership positions.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or related field.
  • 12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience.
  • 7+ years leading enterprise cybersecurity programs.
  • Experience serving as a CISO, VP of IT, CIO, or equivalent
  • Experience within SaaS, cloud software, healthcare technology, ERP software, or highly regulated industries with specific data-handling considerations.
  • Strong understanding of applicable security, privacy and compliance standards, certifications and frameworks including:
    • HIPAA
    • NIST Cybersecurity Framework
    • ISO 27001
  • Experience managing IT budgets and technology organizations.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certifications such as: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, CCSP, HCISPP
  • Experience leading organizations through significant growth and scaling initiatives.
  • Experience supporting rapidly growing SaaS businesses.
  • Strong understanding of data privacy and protection laws.
  • Experience and curiosity surrounding the advancements of AI in SaaS operations.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Federal Pre-Sales Solutions Architect
Remote w/ travel (25-30%)

About Us

Istari Digital is a high-growth technology company enabling the next generation of AI-native engineering across aerospace, defense, and industrial enterprises. Our infrastructure platform orchestrates data across tools, organizations, and classification levels—removing barriers that limit digital engineering—and empowers customers to modernize mission-critical workflows and unlock meaningful ROI from digital transformation at scale.

To support rapid growth in federal markets, we are expanding our technical go-to-market team. This role is critical to enabling how customers understand, adopt, and operationalize Istari infrastructure to address mission critical challenges.

Position Overview

The Solutions Architect is the technical authority for how Istari enables modern digital engineering workflows across federal and commercial missions. This role partners closely with engineering leaders, program teams, and account executives to understand how engineering data is created, shared, governed, and operationalized across tools, organizations, and security boundaries—and to architect Istari as the connective infrastructure that makes those workflows possible.

You will lead engineering-centric discovery, design workflow-driven solution architectures, and deliver compelling technical narratives that resonate with engineers, program managers, and digital engineering leadership. While you will advise on secure deployment patterns, your primary focus is enabling new ways of working: faster collaboration, reusable data, cross-program visibility, and measurable mission impact.

Account Executives own account strategy, opportunity qualification, and overall deal execution.

Solutions Architects own technical credibility, engineering workflow alignment, and solution viability—ensuring Istari is positioned as foundational digital engineering infrastructure, not just another tool or deployment.

Together, these roles form Istari’s growth engine by aligning mission needs, engineering realities, and platform capabilities into winning capture strategies.

Core Responsibilities

    Engineering Workflow Discovery & Mission Understanding

  • Lead discovery sessions with engineering teams to understand design, analysis, simulation, integration, and sustainment workflows.

  • Analyze how data flows across CAD, CAE, PLM, MBSE, simulation, and custom engineering tools.

  • Identify friction points such as broken handoffs, siloed data, limited reuse, and cross-program collaboration challenges.

  • Understand mission context, program structure, and organizational boundaries that shape how engineering work gets done.

  • Translate engineering pain points into Istari-enabled workflow architectures and value narratives.

    • Engineering-Centric Solution Architecture

  • Architect Istari solutions that orchestrate engineering tools, data models, and workflows across programs and organizations.

  • Design patterns for engineering data versioning, traceability, access control, and reuse.

  • Define how Istari integrates into existing toolchains rather than replacing them.

  • Ensure solution designs support engineering velocity, collaboration, and program outcomes—not just technical correctness.

  • Incorporate secure deployment considerations (cloud, on-prem, hybrid) as constraints within engineering-first designs.

    • Demo Delivery, Technical Storytelling & Value Translation

  • Own end-to-end demo preparation and delivery for prospects

  • Tailor demos to mission-specific scenarios, data flows, engineering tools, and classification requirements.

  • Build repeatable demo environments and customize them for unique use cases across DoD, IC, and federal civilian agencies.

  • Collaborate with AEs to craft compelling technical narratives that articulate the “why,” not just the “how,” of Istari.

  • Capture demo feedback to refine content, improve demo flows, and influence roadmap priorities.

    • Pre-Sales Engagement & Technical Validation

  • Lead whiteboarding sessions focused on engineering workflows, data movement, and collaboration patterns.

  • Develop lightweight proofs of value that validate engineering integrations and workflow improvements.

  • Partner with Account Executives to quantify engineering impact (cycle time, reuse, coordination, risk reduction).

  • Articulate a clear technical path from initial workflow validation to production-scale adoption.

    • Security, Compliance & Infrastructure Expertise

  • Design engineering workflows that respect classification boundaries without breaking collaboration or continuity.

  • Advise on deployment patterns that enable cross-domain engineering while aligning with federal security requirements.

  • Partner with cybersecurity and infrastructure stakeholders to balance risk management with engineering productivity.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to translate real-world engineering needs into roadmap inputs.

  • Partner with Cybersecurity and Customer Success to ensure solutions scale beyond initial use cases.

  • Support federal capture efforts by shaping teaming strategies, solution architectures, and technical win themes.

  • Contribute reusable workflow patterns, demo assets, and technical documentation to scale the federal GTM motion.

Required Qualifications

    Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).

    • Experience

  • 5–10+ years in solutions architecture, systems engineering, pre-sales engineering, or technical consulting for complex engineering or infrastructure software.

  • Experience supporting federal missions (DoD, IC, national labs, or defense primes).

  • Hands-on experience working with engineering tools, workflows, or digital engineering environments.

  • Experience leading technical demos and customer-facing engineering discussions.

    • Skills & Capabilities

  • Deep ability to understand and articulate engineering workflows and data lifecycles.

  • Strong technical storytelling skills—able to translate complex engineering concepts into mission-relevant narratives.

  • Comfort whiteboarding workflows, toolchains, and data movement with engineering stakeholders.

  • Ability to design secure, distributed systems that support engineering collaboration.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with sales, product, and engineering teams.

    • Preferred Experience

  • Background in aerospace, defense, or mission-critical engineering environments.

  • Familiarity with CAD/CAE, PLM, MBSE, simulation pipelines, or engineering data platforms.

  • Experience supporting sales efforts or technical win strategy.

Why Join Us?

  • Shape the future of digital engineering across the DoD and national security ecosystem.

  • Lead the technical motion at the intersection of AI, engineering infrastructure, and multi-domain collaboration.

  • Work directly engineering leadership and mission stakeholders on high-impact deployments.

  • Influence the product roadmap through real mission needs and demo feedback.

  • Join a high-trust, mission-driven team building transformative technology.

About Istari Digital

Istari is a digital engineering software company building open, scalable infrastructure for engineering data. Our platform lets customers simply and securely integrate engineering models across disciplines, organizations, and security levels — whether they're designing prototypes, performing virtual testing, or training AI and autonomy for complex systems.

Focus is rewarded. Finish is remembered.

Facts are friendly. Even when they are not fun.

Fellowship is fundamental. Make others successful.

jobs.description:
About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

  • SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
  • Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
  • IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
  • Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
  • Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
  • Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Position

The Head of Solutions, Power Markets (West Region) leads Energy Exemplar's presales Solutions team across the Western United States and Canada. The role owns the technical win for every opportunity in ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, WECC, AESO, and IESO. Accountability runs from first discovery through technical close and a signed handoff to Services. Scope covers new-logo pursuits and expansion within existing accounts across utilities, ISOs/RTOs, regulators, developers, traders, and consultancies.

This is the region's senior pre-sales leader and its engine of retention and growth. The role turns deployed software into measurable customer outcomes: calibrated models, trusted results, and repeatable decision workflows across resource adequacy, capacity expansion, transmission planning, and market operations. Working with the Regional VP of Sales under a shared handoff protocol, the Head of Solutions ensures every West Region account has a success plan, an executive sponsor, and a clear path to expansion.

Key Responsibilities

The role is accountable for five things: team leadership, technical presales execution, pipeline partnership with Sales, market expertise across six Western markets, and a clean handoff to Services.

  • Lead, coach, and develop the West Region presales Solutions team of energy economists, power systems engineers, and modeling specialists; set goals and build succession depth.
  • Own technical presales across the sales cycle - discovery, solution design, demonstrations, proofs of concept, and proposals - for PLEXOS, Aurora, and Adapt2 opportunities.
  • Partner with the Regional VP of Sales on territory plans, account strategies, and pipeline reviews; align Solutions capacity to the highest-value pursuits.
  • Lead discovery with prospects to map business problems - resource adequacy, capacity expansion, transmission planning, trading - to differentiated Energy Exemplar solutions.
  • Design and deliver compelling, market-specific demonstrations and workshops that prove value quickly and advance opportunities toward technical close.
  • Scope, govern, and execute proofs of concept and pilots with clear success criteria, timelines, and exit decisions tied to commercial outcomes.
  • Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires; own solution architecture, pricing inputs, and statements of work for Services handoff.
  • Operate the signed Presales-to-Services handoff protocol so every closed deal transfers with agreed scope, assumptions, model artifacts, and success criteria.
  • Bring deep market expertise across ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, WECC, AESO, and IESO to position PLEXOS and Aurora against competitors credibly.
  • Translate regulatory and market change (FERC Order 1920, WRAP, EDAM, SPP Markets+, ERCOT reliability standards) into use cases, campaigns, and pipeline.
  • Drive expansion within existing accounts by identifying new use cases, additional modules, and AI-enabled upsell opportunities with Sales and Services.
  • Build reusable demo environments, reference models, playbooks, and datasets for Western markets that shorten sales cycles and scale team capacity.
  • Represent Energy Exemplar at ISO stakeholder forums, conferences, and webinars; channel competitive intelligence and prospect feedback to Product and Marketing.
  • Track presales metrics - win rate, technical-close velocity, POC conversion, utilization - and report regional pipeline health monthly to leadership.

Candidate Requirements

The ideal candidate combines Western power-market depth, technical presales leadership, and hands-on modeling credibility.

  • 10-15+ years of experience in power markets, energy consulting, or utility planning, including 5+ years leading technical presales or advisory teams.
  • Proven record owning technical wins - discovery, demonstrations, proofs of concept, proposals - for enterprise software or analytics sales.
  • Working knowledge of at least three of ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, WECC, AESO, and IESO market designs and planning processes.
  • Hands-on experience with production cost, capacity expansion, or resource adequacy modeling; PLEXOS or Aurora proficiency strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to run multiple concurrent pursuits, allocating specialists and managing scope, timelines, and quality of deliverables.
  • Executive presence and credibility with utility, ISO, and regulatory leaders; comfortable presenting model results and recommendations to C-suite.
  • Strong people leadership: hiring, coaching, performance management, and developing technical talent in a distributed team.
  • Data fluency with Python, SQL, or similar tools, and familiarity with applying AI/ML to energy modeling workflows.
  • Commercial acumen: able to qualify opportunities, shape deal strategy with Sales, and scope services for proposals.

Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in power systems engineering, energy economics, energy policy, or a related discipline.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or an equivalent professional engineering credential.
  • Formal training in a solution-selling or value-selling methodology (for example, MEDDICC, Challenger, or Command of the Message).
  • Active membership in IEEE PES, IAEE, USAEE, ISO stakeholder committees or similar professional bodies..
  • Prior presales or solutions engineering experience at an energy modeling, analytics, or enterprise software vendor serving utilities and grid operators.
  • Published or presented work on electricity market design, resource adequacy, or transmission planning.
  • PLEXOS or Aurora certification, or completion of Energy Exemplar's advanced training programs.

About the Company

Our client is a leading Commerce Advertising platform, connecting premium publishers with 80,000+ advertisers across 200+ networks worldwide. They are now building a new content destination website in the vein of top10.com, Forbes Advisor, and BuyersGuide.org: an editorially driven, affiliate-monetized property designed to scale rapidly. This role sits at the very foundation of that growth engine.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Media Buyer (Search) with deep expertise in paid search to own and scale acquisition (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads) for a new content site from day one.

This is not a pure execution role. You will act as a key partner to engineering and product teams, ensuring the technical foundation — conversion tracking, pixel implementation, data layer architecture, and signal quality — is built correctly so that automated bidding and machine learning can perform at their best.

If you thrive at the intersection of media buying, analytics, and technical collaboration, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Plan, launch, and optimize paid search campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads targeting high-intent users in affiliate verticals
  • Own full-funnel keyword strategy — from discovery to transactional queries aligned with affiliate economics
  • Develop and test ad copy, landing page messaging, and audience overlays (RLSA, Customer Match, in-market segments)
  • Build and maintain a structured experimentation roadmap (A/B and multivariate testing)
  • Manage significant budgets with accountability to revenue, CPC, and tCPA/tROAS targets

Conversion Tracking & Signal Quality

  • Partner with engineering to design and implement a robust conversion tracking infrastructure
  • Ensure accurate attribution of clicks, affiliate conversions, and revenue events
  • Define data layer schema and event taxonomy for clean, granular signal passing
  • QA and troubleshoot pixel implementation, tag firing, and attribution discrepancies
  • Implement Enhanced Conversions and Conversion Adjustments
  • Collaborate with Google and Microsoft technical teams to maximize signal quality and capabilities

Automated Bidding & Algorithm Management

  • Design bidding strategies (tCPA, tROAS, Max Conversions) aligned with affiliate economics
  • Structure campaigns and segmentation to support algorithm learning and performance
  • Manage learning phases and optimize conversion volume thresholds
  • Monitor and interpret Smart Bidding performance — knowing when to trust vs. guide the algorithm
  • Define conversion actions and values that reflect true business outcomes

Analytics, Reporting & Collaboration

  • Build dashboards in GA4 and BI tools linking spend to revenue, LTV, and engagement
  • Deliver clear, insight-driven performance reporting to leadership
  • Identify growth opportunities and recommend strategic actions
  • Stay up to date with platform updates, betas, and industry trends

What You Bring

Required

  • 5+ years of hands-on paid search experience (Google Ads & Microsoft Ads)
  • Proven experience with Smart Bidding (tCPA, tROAS, Max Conversions)
  • Strong technical expertise in conversion tracking (GTM, GA4, data layers, pixel QA, Enhanced Conversions)
  • Experience passing conversion values and signals back to ad platforms to optimize performance
  • Background in affiliate, comparison, or performance content environments (e.g. finance, insurance, SaaS, e-commerce, home services)
  • Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Solid analytical skills (Excel/Sheets, GA4, BI tools)
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, zero-to-one environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Google Ads API, scripts, or Python automation
  • Familiarity with affiliate platforms (Impact, CJ, Awin, Partnerize)
  • Experience with server-side tracking or Conversion APIs
  • Previous involvement in launching a content/media property
  • Knowledge of tools like SEMrush, SpyFu, or similar

Who You Are

  • Systems thinker — you understand the full loop from click to signal quality
  • Proactively technical — you define tracking requirements, not just execute them
  • High ownership mindset — strategic and hands-on when needed
  • Experiment-driven — you test, learn, and scale quickly
  • Balanced — you know when speed matters and when precision is critical

What's on Offer

  • Foundational role in building a new content property within a well-funded organization
  • Access to a large global advertiser network and deep affiliate expertise
  • High-impact, cross-functional collaboration with product and engineering
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Fully remote, global team

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

jobs.description:
About Definitive Healthcare:

At Definitive Healthcare (NASDAQ: DH), we’re passionate about turning data, analytics, and expertise into meaningful intelligence that helps our customers achieve success and shape the future of healthcare. We empower them to uncover the right markets, opportunities, and people—paving the way for smarter decisions and greater impact.

Headquartered just outside of Boston, Massachusetts, Definitive Healthcare operates across North America, Europe, and India, supporting a growing global client base of more than 2,400 customers since our founding in 2011.

We’re also a great place to work. In 2024 and 2025, we earned multiple workplace honors, including Built In’s 100 Best Places to Work in Boston (both years), a Stevie Bronze Award for Great Employers, and recognition as a Great Place to Work in India.

We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where diverse perspectives drive innovation. Through programs like DefinitiveCares and our employee-led affinity groups we strive to promote connection, education, and inclusion.

About the position:

We are looking for an energetic and motivated Sales Executive to join our New Business Sales Team. If you would like to work at a fast-paced company that is experiencing high growth, keep reading!

What you’ll do:

You’ll run the entire new business sales cycle; your outbound effort will be complemented by inbound leads and inside sales support as you research prospective customers, develop outreach strategies, identify prospects, demo decision makers, and close business. This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated and driven sales professional looking to take their sales career to the next level!

  • Research, identify, and connect with individuals and corporations who would be strong prospects for Definitive Healthcare solutions
  • Partner with internal Marketing and Inside Sales teams to follow-up on all leads within your assigned territory
  • Build and nurture relationships with prospects and key stake holders in Marketing, Sales, and the C-Suite to identify opportunities and secure new business
  • Manage all facets of complex sales cycles
  • Conduct online product demonstrations
  • Close new business consistently at or above quota level
  • Accurately forecast opportunities and update the CRM

What you’ll need:

  • BA or BS degree
  • 3-5 years of individual quota carrying/closing sales experience
  • Documented evidence that you are top producer
  • Expertise in delivering product demonstrations via the web
  • Experience in a cold-calling sales environment
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills
  • A powerful work ethic with tons of energy, humor, compassion, and enthusiasm

Compensation and Benefits:

The salary range for this position is $88,000– $132,000 per year, which represents the base pay the company reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this role. Actual pay within this range will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

Depending on the position, employees may also be eligible to participate in a company bonus or commission plan. All employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, and participation in the company’s 401(k) plan with employer contribution.

Why we love Definitive, and why you will too!

  • Industry leading products
  • Work hard, and have fun doing it
  • Incredibly fast growth means limitless opportunity
  • Flexible and dynamic culture
  • Work alongside some of the most talented and dedicated teammates
  • Definitive Cares, our community service group, gives all of us a chance to give back
  • Competitive benefits package including great healthcare benefits and a 401(k) match

What our Employees are saying about us on Glassdoor:

“Great Work atmosphere, great work life balance, excellent company to work for, amazing top notch product, incredible customer service, lots of tools to help you succeed.”

-Business Development Manager

“Great team. Amazing growth. Employees are treated very well.”

-Research Analyst

“I have waited 36 years to work at a dream job for a dream company and I am so happy to have finally got there.”

-Profile Analyst

If you don’t fit all of these qualifications, but believe you’re still a great fit, feel free to apply and tell us why in your cover letter.

If you are a California, Colorado, New York City or Washington resident and this role is a remote role, you can receive additional information about the compensation and benefits for this role, which we will provide upon request.

Definitive Hiring Philosophy

Definitive Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other status. If you’re interested in working in a fast growing, exciting working environment – we encourage you to apply!

Privacy
Your privacy is important to us. Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice which tells you how we use and process your personal information.

Please note: All communications regarding the hiring process at Definitive Healthcare will come directly from one of our corporate recruiters or coordinators using an @definitivehc.com email address. We do not advertise open roles on Facebook and will never request money transfers or ask candidates to purchase equipment with a promise of reimbursement. If you receive any suspicious communication, please contact to verify your status in the application process.

DISCLOSURES

This document defines the scope of work and service expectations for an independent contractor engagement and does not create an employment relationship. Scope, deliverables, tools, priorities, and assignments may be modified through written amendment based on client needs, regulatory requirements, or contractual obligations.

ABOUT FREEDOM HEALTH SYSTEMS, INC

Freedom Health Systems, Inc. is a mission-driven healthcare advisory and management consulting firm that partners with behavioral health and human services organizations to improve access, equity, and operational excellence. We specialize in guiding providers through program development, accreditation, compliance, and clinical best practices.

While Freedom Health Systems does not provide direct clinical services, the organization delivers critical operational support through revenue cycle management, prior authorization, medical billing and coding, compliance consulting, and administrative services to outpatient behavioral health providers.

Medical Biller & Coder 2 (Team A)

Colombia (Remote)

SERVICE OVERVIEW

Remote LATAM role. Compensation listed in USD with local currency equivalent. This particular role is a Colombia-based independent contractor engagement.

COMPANY WEBSITE:

COMPANY PHONE NUMBER: 667-239-9572

HUMAN RESOURCES PHONE: 667-239-9572 EXT 10

HUMAN RESOURCES EMAIL:

SERVICE TITLE: Medical Biller & Coder 2 (Team A)

ALTERNATE SERVICE TITLES: Medical Billing Specialist (Contractor), Medical Coding Specialist (Contractor)

CONTRACTING ENTITY: Freedom Health Systems, Inc. (In support of outpatient mental health center clients under contract)

DIVISION: Accounting & Finance

DEPARTMENT: Accounts Receivables

UNIT: Medical Billing & Coding (Revenue Cycle Management Services)

BENEFITS PACKAGE: Not applicable (Independent Contractor)

SERVICE HOURS: Monday – Friday, aligned with U.S. Eastern Time business hours (8:00 AM EST – 5:00 PM EST or as otherwise contractually agreed)

REPORTING & COORDINATION

The contractor will coordinate daily service delivery with the Medical Billing & Coding Analyst 1 (Team Lead – Team A). Escalations, risks, or unresolved issues will be routed through the Team Lead to the Accounts Receivables Department Manager as required.

CONTRACT CLASSIFICATION: W8BEN – Independent Contractor

COMPENSATION RANGE: USD $5.00–$6.50 (≈ COP 19,000–24,700/hr)

ANTICIPATED TRAVEL: None

SCOPE OF ASSIGNMENT

This scope of work applies to Team A, supporting one or more outpatient mental health center clients. The Medical Biller & Coder is responsible for executing accurate, compliant, and timely billing and coding services to support end-to-end revenue cycle operations.

SUMMARY OF CONTRACT SCOPE

The Medical Biller & Coder provides medical billing and coding services for outpatient mental health center clients. This includes translating clinical documentation into accurate diagnosis and procedure codes, entering charges, submitting claims, correcting errors, and supporting accounts receivable workflows.

All services are performed under the functional oversight and quality review of the Medical Billing & Coding Analyst 1 (Team Lead – Team A) and are a critical component of the Revenue Cycle Management process.

CORE SCOPE OF WORK & DELIVERABLES

  • Review clinical documentation to confirm required elements are present prior to billing (signed notes, treatment plans, service dates, units, provider credentials)
  • Assign accurate CPT, ICD-10-CM, and applicable HCPCS codes based on documentation
  • Enter charges accurately into the EHR or billing system
  • Submit claims timely and in compliance with payer-specific requirements
  • Verify patient demographics, insurance information, and payer details prior to claim submission
  • Identify and correct claim rejections, coding errors, and data entry issues
  • Support denial resolution activities by correcting coding or documentation issues as directed
  • Ensure all services rendered are captured and billed; escalate suspected missed charges
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready billing records and supporting documentation
  • Adhere to workflows, quality standards, and productivity expectations established by the Team Lead
  • Communicate documentation gaps, authorization issues, or system barriers promptly to the Team Lead

UNSCHEDULED / SUPPORT DUTIES

  • Assist with billing backlogs or high-volume periods
  • Support internal quality assurance reviews and audits
  • Participate in training, coaching, and cross-training activities
  • Provide coverage for essential billing tasks during team member absences
  • Support process improvement initiatives related to billing accuracy and turnaround time

TECHNOLOGY, DATA SECURITY & MONITORING REQUIREMENTS

  • All work must be performed exclusively on the assigned Amazon Workstation (AWS virtual workstation) authorized by Freedom Health Systems.
  • Use of personal devices, local storage, screenshots, external email forwarding, or unauthorized systems is strictly prohibited.
  • The Amazon Workstation environment is monitored by the Company for security, compliance, productivity, and quality assurance purposes.
  • System access logs, activity monitoring, and usage metrics may be reviewed to ensure compliance with HIPAA, client contracts, and Company policies.
  • Failure to comply with technology, security, or monitoring requirements may result in immediate termination of the contract.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Service quality and contract effectiveness will be evaluated using, but not limited to, the following KPIs:

  • Coding accuracy rate
  • Charge entry accuracy and completeness
  • Clean claim submission rate
  • Claim rejection rate
  • Timeliness of claim submission
  • Error correction and resubmission turnaround time
  • Audit findings and error trends
  • Adherence to established workflows and instructions
  • Responsiveness to Team Lead requests and escalations

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Continuous use of EHR and billing platforms
  • Frequent virtual communication via chat, phone, or video

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Fully remote (Colombia-based) via assigned Amazon Workstation
  • Production-driven, deadline-oriented revenue cycle environment
  • Collaboration across time zones with U.S.-based leadership and client operations

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERTISE

  • Minimum 2–4 years of U.S. medical billing and coding experience
  • Outpatient mental health or behavioral health billing experience preferred
  • Working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10-CM, and basic HCPCS coding
  • Familiarity with U.S. insurance, Medicaid, and managed care billing processes
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to follow defined workflows and quality standards
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Experience working in secure virtual workstation environments preferred
  • Professional coding certifications (CPC or equivalent) preferred
Salary: USD $5.00–$6.50 (≈ COP 19,000–24,700/hr)

jobs.title: KIPP Foundation, Senior Vice President, Growth
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION KIPP Public Schools is a national network of tuition-free public charter schools that prepares students with the skills and confidence to create the future they want for themselves, their communities, and us all.
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION

KIPP Public Schools is a national network of tuition-free public charter schools that prepares students with the skills and confidence to create the future they want for themselves, their communities, and us all. We are a network of 279 schools, nearly 16,500 educators, and nearly 210,000 students and alumni.

Our mission: Together with families and communities, we create joyful, academically excellent schools that prepare students with the skills and confidence to pursue the paths they choose—college, career, and beyond—so they can lead fulfilling lives and build a more just world.

Our vision: Every child grows up free to create the future they want for themselves and their communities.

The KIPP Foundation is a nonprofit organization that supports KIPP public charter schools across the country. The KIPP Foundation helps to develop outstanding educators to lead KIPP schools; provides tools and resources for excellent teaching and learning; promotes innovation; and facilitates the exchange of insights and ideas across KIPP and other public schools and organizations.

To learn more about the KIPP Foundation, please visit .

ABOUT OUR VALUES

Excellent Results for Students: We value results over effort and know that our work is not finished until all students thrive. We maintain high expectations for self, team, and students. We drive outcomes by operating with agility, removing barriers, differentiating support, and prioritizing student-centered solutions—especially for those at the margins.

Collective Impact: We are one team. We win together. We embody a one-team mindset by working collaboratively across teams, aligning goals, and leveraging the strengths of all teammates. We build trust-based relationships and ensure inclusive decision-making by engaging those closest to the work. We provide clarity through simple, repeatable systems and goals that enable transformational outcomes.

Courageous Action: Our belief in what we can achieve is unwavering, fueling our optimism and commitment to overcome any challenge. We demonstrate an unwavering belief in students' potential and a commitment to addressing systemic inequities. We approach challenges with resilience, a solutions-focused mindset, and adaptability. We foster a psychologically safe environment centered on trust and accountability where feedback is encouraged. We leverage data to reflect on progress, own setbacks, celebrate successes, and continuously improve to maximize impact.

ABOUT THE POSITION

The SVP, Growth is a role with direct accountability for the success of work that impacts the entire KIPP network. This role sets the vision, goals, and strategy for KIPP’s growth function - stewarding the criteria and readiness frameworks that determine where growth should happen, shaping the long-term portfolio plan, and holding the network accountable for growing with rigor. Every new school, every expanded region, and every scale decision must be grounded in evidence, anchored in student outcomes, and designed to hold up over the long term.

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, this role operates as a senior partner to the Chief Schools Officer and CEO—setting vision and strategy for the growth function and making network-level decisions on growth policy and priorities. The SVP is accountable for both defining the vision and ensuring its execution through their team. The SVP, Growth holds network-wide strategic accountability, partners with Chief-level leaders to make consequential organization-wide decisions, and manages one Senior Director of Growth.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Enterprise Growth Strategy & Vision

  • Define and own KIPP’s enterprise-wide growth and scale strategy—including multi-year targets, portfolio priorities, and the conditions required for sustainable expansion.
  • Set the vision and standards for how KIPP grows as a network, ensuring every scale decision is evidence-based, equity-centered, and aligned with the One KIPP strategy.
  • Establish the methodology and criteria by which regions are tagged as viability risks and oversee an assessment of those regions to determine what’s required for long term sustainability and success.
  • Serve as the primary senior voice on growth to the Chief Schools Officer, Chief of Regional Impact, CEO, and Board—providing strategic counsel, synthesizing landscape intelligence, and driving organizational alignment around growth priorities.
  • Shape and steward cross-functional planning across the Office of the Chief Schools Officer and Chief of Regional Impact, ensuring that growth considerations are integrated into organizational and financial planning cycles.

Regional Growth Leadership & Accountability

  • Lead the Foundation’s partnership with regions pursuing opportunistic growth—driving strategy, ensuring accountability, and working through peer leaders for thought partnership and analytical support to translate ambition into executable plans.
  • Establish and lead the progress-monitoring systems that keep growth plans on track; exercise sound judgment about when course correction is needed and escalate risks to the Chief of Regional Impact and C-suite.
  • Identify cross-regional growth patterns, scale effective practices across the portfolio, and address systemic gaps—ensuring that what works in one region becomes a learning opportunity for the full network.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for regions on growth-related matters, exercising judgment about when issues require the attention of the Chief of Regional Impact, Chief Schools Officer, or CEO.

People Management & Development

  • Lead, develop and manage the performance of the Senior Director of Growth to drive regional growth partnerships, readiness assessment, and landscape analysis.
  • Build a culture of accountability, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Represent the Growth function in executive decision-making forums, cross-functional planning, and Board-level growth updates—serving as a credible, compelling senior presence.

SKILLS & MINDSETS

  • Mission and Student Focus: Demonstrates passion and commitment to KIPP’s mission and possesses the desire and ability to uphold KIPP’s core values (Focus on Excellent Results, Collective Impact, and Courageous Action).
  • Self Management: Demonstrated record of setting and achieving ambitious goals for their departments in complex or ambiguous environment; uses data, research, and analysis to set a high bar of excellence for goal setting; effectively distributes and redistributes work among direct reports, teammates, and teams to optimizes goal attainments; effectively sets and fosters a culture that enables and celebrates teammates’ achievements and goals attainment.
  • Work Management: Sets a clear vision that ensures alignment of the team's work to organizational goals. Effectively prioritize and deliver work products that ensure sustainability and scalability of work. Develops and implements agile project plans that ensure cross functional collaboration and resource sharing to ensure achieving organizational goals; create and ensure systems are in place for knowledge management.
  • Process Management: Able to build and align goals and project plans with organization priorities; Develops and codifies processes that promote coordination, efficiency and efficacy across KF and the Network; Prioritizes processes that ensure sustainability and scalability; ensures team is finding efficiencies through process implementation and improvement, resource sharing, or other methods.
  • Data-Driven Actions and Decisions: Effectively uses data to shape teamwide decisions and the learning agenda or evaluation of a function or significant initiative. Able to generate, implement, and evaluate solutions with a focus on scalability and sustainability.
  • Communication and Change Management: Effectively articulates case for change to multiple functions, teams, and/or offices through clear and compelling presentations, tailoring communications and engagement approach for different audiences. Effectively translates vision into actionable plans among across team stakeholders; Champions KF and networkwide change with all stakeholders.
  • Collaboration: Identifies and leverages opportunities with both internal and external stakeholders to increase impact. Leads successful collaboration across functions and evolves plans to get strong results. Has the interpersonal, diplomatic, relationships building and communication skills to connect and compel teammates across different functions to collaborate effectively toward shared goals.
  • People Management & Development: Effectively ensures strong professional development and coaching for teammates directly and through layers. Proficient in the mechanics of succession management and performance management for teammates. Skilled at fostering a positive team culture in which teammates feel ownership and accountability for their own and the broader team’s work and results.

Requirements

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in strategy, growth, and network development, or related enterprise leadership roles, ideally in K-12 education or a comparable mission-driven environment.
  • Proven track record of managing and developing people managers across nested teams of 4 or more direct reports with measurable impact on their performance and the organizational outcomes they drive.
  • Demonstrated ability to set vision, goals, and strategy for a function or multiple functions with executive-level autonomy, and to translate that vision into accountable execution through a team.
  • Direct accountability for network-wide strategic priorities with demonstrated outcomes that impacted all regions or the full network.
  • Proven track record of designing and maintaining readiness or assessment frameworks grounded in data, and translating quantitative and qualitative inputs into clear recommendations that drive network-wide organizational accountability.
  • Strong analytical and strategic skills, including landscape analysis, financial modeling, and the ability to synthesize complex information into crisp strategic narratives for executive and Board audiences.
  • Demonstrated executive presence and ability to make network-level decisions with autonomy while serving as a credible senior thought partner to C-suite leaders and regional boards.
  • Demonstrated record of partnering with regional or field-based leaders to translate national strategy into executable plans tailored to local context, while maintaining network-wide coherence.
  • Experience in K-12 education, charter school growth, or a comparable mission-driven environment strongly preferred.

WORK CONDITIONS

  • Travel requirements: High Travel: 21-30% (40-60 days per year)
  • Job Type: Full time, Exempt

LOCATION

It is preferred, but not mandatory for this role to be based out of a KIPP Foundation office. This role has the option of working from a remote office full-time. KIPP Foundation offices are in NYC and Chicago.

Benefits

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, and relevant experience. The salary range for this position is $249,600 - $295,000. In addition, KIPP Foundation provides a variety of benefits to employees, including:

  • 25 holidays for + 18 days additional flexible PTO days (flexible PTO increases to 23 days for years 3 and 4 and to 28 days for years 5+).
  • 100% paid parental leave
  • 100% coverage of the premium for employees and 75% for employee + family’s medical/dental/vision plans.
  • Wellness benefits such as fitness reimbursements, discounted tickets to theme parks/attractions, backup care support for children and adults/elders, and our employee assistance program
  • Finance Security benefits include such as a 401K retirement plan with 4% match, employer-sponsored legal plans, life/disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts

TO APPLY

Please submit a resume online at

KIPP Foundation embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects the diversity of the students and communities with whom we work and the world that’s around them. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

Transform data into mission impact as a Data Engineer supporting the Department of the Navy’s Human Resources Civilian Portfolio. GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career.


HOW A DATA ENGINEER WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

Description

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced SQL Developer / Database Engineer to support ATLAS, the VA’s open-architected, multi-cloud enterprise data management and analytics platform. In this role, you will design, maintain, integrate, and optimize SQL database structures, transformation logic, and data pipelines that ingest, condition, curate, and deliver multi-source data as secure, reusable enterprise data products. You will use SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines, Databricks, Starburst, and Azure Data Lake Service to improve data reliability, performance, and interoperability across ATLAS and connected source platforms. You will troubleshoot discrepancies and ETL/ELT failures, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and help provide consistent access to trusted data that supports analytics, evidence-based decisions, and better outcomes for Veterans and their families.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, install, configure, maintain, and optimize SQL database systems and related data structures supporting ATLAS.
  • Develop, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot ETL/ELT workflows and data pipelines using Azure Data Factory and Synapse Pipelines.
  • Integrate structured and unstructured data from databases, APIs, cloud platforms, and other enterprise sources into Azure Data Lake Service.
  • Create and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, database objects, and transformation logic for data conditioning and curation.
  • Use Databricks and Starburst to query, transform, and integrate distributed data across lakehouse and enterprise data sources.
  • Investigate data discrepancies, pipeline failures, and performance issues; perform root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes.
  • Apply data-quality controls and support metadata management and data cataloging using Collibra.
  • Monitor database and pipeline performance; perform query tuning, indexing, backup, recovery, patching, and reliability improvements.
  • Support secure, consistent, and compliant access to enterprise data through appropriate identity, authorization, and data-protection controls.
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and product teams to create consumable data products and enable Azure ML/AI services.
  • Support reporting and visualization needs using Pyramid Analytics and Power BI, including validation of underlying data structures and accuracy.
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications and communicate solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Document database structures, data mappings, pipelines, operational procedures, and technical decisions.
  • Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and support continuous improvement of ATLAS data services.

TAG:

TAG: INDMJC

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum five (5) years of experience in database development, administration, and maintenance.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server, including complex SQL queries, stored procedures, database design, indexing, optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Experience developing and troubleshooting data integrations, ETL/ELT processes, and SSIS packages.
  • Hands-on experience creating, updating, monitoring, and troubleshooting Azure Data Factory and Synapse Pipelines.
  • Experience with Databricks, Starburst, Azure Data Lake Service, and distributed or large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with Collibra for data cataloging, metadata management, or data governance.
  • Experience supporting Azure ML/AI services and preparing reliable data for analytics or machine-learning use cases.
  • Experience supporting Pyramid Analytics and Power BI visualization solutions and validating source data.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Ability to communicate technical details to non-technical users and stakeholders, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability/Fitness determination based on client requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting federal agencies, the Department of Veterans Affairs, or other regulated environments.
  • Experience with enterprise data lakes, lakehouses, Delta Lake, Parquet, and multi-cloud data integration.
  • Experience working independently and collaboratively within Agile data-product teams.

Apply Today

jobs.excerpt: Found is transforming personalized weight care with an evidence-based platform that combines modern medicine, behavior change support, personalized coaching, and a supportive community.
jobs.description:
Found is transforming personalized weight care with an evidence-based platform that combines modern medicine, behavior change support, personalized coaching, and a supportive community. Since launching in 2019, Found has served over 250,000 patients across the U.S., making high-quality, affordable treatment more accessible while reducing healthcare costs for consumers, employers, and payors. Backed by $130M+ from top investors including Atomic, GV, WestCap, IVP, TCG, and Define Ventures, Found is redefining how personalized weight care is delivered at scale.

Pippen Health, the virtual medicine practice affiliated with Found, is looking for registered dietitians (RDs) to join their team of care providers dedicated to delivering high-quality, patient-centric care. Found’s platform integrates leading weight management clinical practice with innovative technology to provide holistic support for patients during their health journeys. Led by Dr. Rekha Kumar, a leader in obesity medicine, Found's program brings a more personalized, supportive, and hands-on approach to obesity care than other telemedicine companies.

You will get to be an early part of Found’s newest offering, expanding RD services and personalized nutritional coaching and support to members with insurance primarily through synchronous consultations. Consultations include health assessments, lab screenings, management of diagnoses related to obesity, documentation, & follow-up care for patients. Alongside our clinical prescribing and member support team, you will provide ongoing support to patients as they navigate their weight care journey, including managing medication side effects, changing nutrition treatment plans based on changes in patient’s health, weight loss progress, &/or insurance coverage. Best efforts are made to maintain continuity of care between patient & clinician to develop long-term relationships.

Providers at Found are passionate about increasing access, improving health outcomes, and delivering an excellent experience to patients at the cutting edge of weight management and obesity care. The ideal candidate would be a technologically-savvy, life-long learner who has independent practice experience in obesity medicine and telemedicine (synchronous and asynchronous).

Research shows that addressing weight health reduces the long-term risk of diabetes, heart disease, and some forms of cancer. Found believes in giving members tools that will help them add years to their lives and reach their goals. Because weight care is not just what you've lost, it's about what you've Found.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct synchronous nutrition counseling sessions with patients (60min initial and 30min followup) to support their individual medication assisted weight loss journeys.
  • Proactively manage common GLP-1 and AOMs side effects (nausea, constipation, reflux, reduced appetite, risk of lean-mass loss) through personalized nutrition strategies that preserve muscle mass, support adequate protein and fiber intake, and enable sustainable weight loss.
  • Apply evidence-based behavior change techniques (motivational interviewing, SMART goal-setting, CBT-informed coaching) to build self-efficacy and long-term lifestyle change.
  • Adapt care plans in response to changes in medication or dosing, insurance coverage, weight-loss plateaus, or evolving patient goals, in partnership with the prescribing clinician.
  • Followup with patients via asynchronous messaging to address questions
  • Coordinate care with Found clinicians, and member support team leveraging Found’s internal EMR provider messaging function.
  • Serve patients with high standards of personal and professional integrity and ethics, with the ability to practice a high level of confidentiality.
  • Complete session documentation (including ADIME notes, patient communication, and care team follow-up messages) in a timely manner for processing and reporting.
  • Leverage Found’s technology platform to keep patients engaged in their care journey between sessions.
  • Stay up to date on current nutrition topics.

Qualifications:

  • RD/RDN credentialed with the CDR (active and in good standing)
  • Licensed in multiple states, including some combination of: NY, IN, CA, PA, NC, GA, TX, SC, MD, OH, CT, MA, HI, SD or MT. Candidates with licensure in additional states are welcome to apply. Active NPI required.
  • At least 2 years of independent practice experience, preferably in obesity medicine, cardiometabolic disease, or medication-assisted weight loss
  • Previous telemedicine experience
  • Strong and empathetic oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to adapt and remain agile, while helping to improve our ability to deliver care
  • Obesity medicine experience and/or certification preferred
  • Please note that you must be authorized to work and physically based in the U.S. for this position
  • Proficiency with EMR documentation (ADIME notes) and secure provider-to-patient messaging; comfort learning new clinical software quickly
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a private, HIPAA-compliant workspace with a professional-quality webcam and headset
  • Active professional liability (malpractice) insurance, or willingness to obtain coverage prior to start

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Board Certified Specialist in Obesity and Weight Management (CSOWM) through CDR, or equivalent obesity medicine credentialing
  • Direct experience supporting patients on GLP-1 receptor agonists (e.g., semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide) or other anti-obesity medications (AOMs), including nutrition strategies to preserve lean mass and manage GI side effects
  • Training in motivational interviewing, cognitive behavioral techniques, or the Transtheoretical Model of Change
  • Master’s degree in nutrition, public health, or a related clinical field
  • Bilingual English/Spanish (or other additional languages)

Position: This is a 1099 contract role
